shipped.text:
sylvia_gm_runtime:
  format: 1
  state_namespace: pneuma.riichi-mahjong
features: {}
abilities: {}
tools:
  _reset_hand:
    description: Package-owned reset hand.
    parameters:
    - name: actor
      type: entity_id
      resolve: entity
    pre_conditions: []
    effects:
    - set:
        field: actor.game
        value:
          hand: []
          melds: []
          discards: []
          riichi: false
          double_riichi: false
          ippatsu: false
          temporary_furiten: false
          riichi_furiten: false
          draw_count: 0
          last_draw: null
          rinshan: false
          forbidden_discards: []
          choices: []
          decision_actions: []
          riichi_waits: []
          pao_dragon: null
          pao_wind: null
          revealed: false
    narrative: {}
  _draw:
    description: Package-owned draw.
    parameters:
    - name: actor
      type: entity_id
      resolve: entity
    pre_conditions: []
    effects:
    - require:
        condition: len(state.live) > 0
        error: The live wall is empty.
    - set:
        field: _tile
        value: state.live[0]
    - set:
        field: _hand
        value: joined(actor.game.hand, one(_tile))
    - set:
        field: actor.game.hand
        value: _hand
    - set:
        field: actor.game.last_draw
        value: _tile
    - set:
        field: actor.game.draw_count
        value: actor.game.draw_count + 1
    - set:
        field: actor.game.temporary_furiten
        value: false
    - set:
        field: actor.game.rinshan
        value: false
    - set:
        field: state.live
        value: portion(state.live, 1, len(state.live))
    - set:
        field: state.phase
        value: '"discard"'
    narrative: {}
  _new_hand:
    description: Package-owned new hand.
    parameters: []
    pre_conditions: []
    effects:
    - shuffle:
        collection: indices(136)
      store_as: _wall
    - set:
        field: state.pending_riichi
        value: null
    - set:
        field: state.pending_kan
        value: null
    - set:
        field: state.ron_seats
        value: []
    - set:
        field: state.kan_owners
        value: []
    - set:
        field: state.abort_after_discard
        value: false
    - set:
        field: state.result
        value: null
    - set:
        field: state.winners
        value: []
    - set:
        field: state.dead
        value: portion(_wall, 122, 136)
    - set:
        field: state.live
        value: portion(_wall, 52, 122)
    - set:
        field: state.kan_count
        value: 0
    - set:
        field: state.kan_pending_dora
        value: 0
    - set:
        field: state.any_call
        value: false
    - set:
        field: state.last_discard
        value: null
    - set:
        field: state.responses
        value: []
    - set:
        field: state.pending_calls
        value: []
    - set:
        field: _seat_ids
        value: state.seats
    - set:
        field: _index
        value: 0
    - for_each:
        collection: _seat_ids
        as: _seat
        do:
        - call: _reset_hand
          params:
            actor: '{_seat}'
        - call: _deal_seat
          params:
            actor: '{_seat}'
            tiles: '{_wall}'
            offset: '{_index}'
        - set:
            field: _index
            value: _index + 1
    - set:
        field: state.actor
        value: state.seats[state.dealer]
    - call: _draw
      params:
        actor: '{state.actor}'
    narrative: {}
  _deal_seat:
    description: Package-owned deal seat.
    parameters:
    - name: actor
      type: entity_id
      resolve: entity
    - name: tiles
      type: array
      items:
        type: integer
    - name: offset
      type: integer
    pre_conditions: []
    effects:
    - set:
        field: actor.game.hand
        value: portion(tiles, offset * 13, (offset + 1) * 13)
    narrative: {}
  _reset_score:
    description: Package-owned reset score.
    parameters:
    - name: actor
      type: entity_id
      resolve: entity
    pre_conditions: []
    effects:
    - set:
        field: actor.score
        value: 25000
    narrative: {}
  _refresh:
    description: Package-owned refresh.
    parameters: []
    pre_conditions: []
    effects:
    - call: _forced_responses
      params: {}
    - set:
        field: state.sequence
        value: state.sequence + 1
    - call: _options
      params:
        actor: '{state.actor}'
      export_context:
        _choices: _choices
    - require:
        condition: len(_choices) <= 256
        error: The current action set exceeds its bound.
    - shuffle:
        collection: indices(256)
      store_as: _opaque_indices
    - set:
        field: _numbered
        value: []
    - set:
        field: _choice_ids
        value: []
    - set:
        field: _index
        value: 0
    - for_each:
        collection: _choices
        as: _choice
        do:
        - set:
            field: _id
            value: '''choice:'' + text(state.sequence) + '':'' + text(_opaque_indices[_index])'
        - set:
            field: _row
            value:
              id: _id
        - set:
            field: _row
            value: merge(_choice, _row)
        - list_push:
            list: _numbered
            value: _row
        - list_push:
            list: _choice_ids
            value: _id
        - set:
            field: _index
            value: _index + 1
    - set:
        field: state.choices
        value: _numbered
    - set:
        field: state.choice_ids
        value: _choice_ids
    - call: _actor_choices
      params:
        actor: '{state.actor}'
        choices: '{_numbered}'
    - set:
        field: _areas
        value: []
    - set:
        field: _statuses
        value: []
    - set:
        field: _seat_ids
        value: state.seats
    - for_each:
        collection: _seat_ids
        as: _seat
        do:
        - call: _seat_table
          params:
            actor: '{_seat}'
          export_context:
            _area: _area
            _status: _status
        - list_push:
            list: _areas
            value: _area
        - list_push:
            list: _statuses
            value: _status
    - call: _center_table
      params: {}
      export_context:
        _center: _center
    - list_push:
        list: _areas
        value: _center
    - list_push:
        list: _statuses
        value:
          label: '"Round"'
          value: definitions.winds[min(state.round_wind, 2)] + ' ' + text(state.dealer
            + 1)
    - list_push:
        list: _statuses
        value:
          label: '"Honba"'
          value: text(state.honba)
    - list_push:
        list: _statuses
        value:
          label: '"Riichi sticks"'
          value: text(state.sticks)
    - list_push:
        list: _statuses
        value:
          label: '"Live wall"'
          value: text(len(state.live))
    - set:
        field: state.table
        value:
          format: 1
          layout: '"four_sided"'
          title: '"Riichi Mahjong"'
          status: _statuses
          areas: _areas
    - set:
        field: _records
        value: []
    - set:
        field: _seats
        value: state.seats
    - for_each:
        collection: _seats
        as: _seat
        do:
        - call: _public_seat
          params:
            actor: '{_seat}'
          export_context:
            _public_seat: _public_seat
        - list_push:
            list: _records
            value: _public_seat
    - call: _actor_public_table
      params:
        actor: '{state.actor}'
        records: '{_records}'
    narrative: {}
  _actor_choices:
    description: Package-owned actor choices.
    parameters:
    - name: actor
      type: entity_id
      resolve: entity
    - name: choices
      type: array
      items:
        type: object
    pre_conditions: []
    effects:
    - set:
        field: actor.game.choices
        value: choices
    - set:
        field: _decisions
        value: []
    - for_each:
        collection: choices
        as: _choice
        do:
        - list_push:
            list: _decisions
            value:
              id: _choice.id
              label: _choice.label
              operation: '"take_action"'
              arguments:
                choice: _choice.id
    - set:
        field: actor.game.decision_actions
        value: _decisions
    narrative: {}
  _seat_table:
    description: Package-owned seat table.
    parameters:
    - name: actor
      type: entity_id
      resolve: entity
    pre_conditions: []
    effects:
    - set:
        field: _pieces
        value: []
    - set:
        field: _tiles
        value: ordered(actor.game.hand)
    - for_each:
        collection: _tiles
        as: _tile
        do:
        - set:
            field: _face
            value: definitions.tiles[_tile]
        - set:
            field: _piece
            value:
              id: '''tile:'' + text(_tile)'
              label: _face.label
              face: _face.face
              flags: []
        - condition:
            condition: _face.red
            on_true:
            - set:
                field: _piece
                value: merge(_piece, definitions.red_presentation)
            on_false: []
        - condition:
            condition: actor.game.last_draw == _tile
            on_true:
            - set:
                field: _drawn
                value:
                  detail: '"Drawn tile"'
                  emphasis: '"accent"'
                  flags:
                  - '"drawn"'
            - set:
                field: _piece
                value: merge(_piece, _drawn)
            on_false: []
        - condition:
            condition: _actor_id == state.actor and actor.control == 'player'
            on_true:
            - set:
                field: _choices
                value: state.choices
            - for_each:
                collection: _choices
                as: _choice
                do:
                - condition:
                    condition: _choice.op == 'discard' and _choice.tiles[0] == _tile
                    on_true:
                    - set:
                        field: _action
                        value:
                          id: _choice.id
                          action_id: '"play"'
                    - set:
                        field: _piece
                        value: merge(_piece, _action)
                    on_false: []
            on_false: []
        - list_push:
            list: _pieces
            value: _piece
    - set:
        field: _hand
        value:
          id: '"hand"'
          label: '"Hand"'
          role: '"rack"'
          visibility: '"owner"'
          owner: _actor_id
          show_count: true
          pieces: _pieces
    - condition:
        condition: actor.control == 'player'
        on_true:
        - set:
            field: _hand_owner
            value:
              owner: actor.participant_id
        - set:
            field: _hand
            value: merge(_hand, _hand_owner)
        on_false: []
    - set:
        field: _pieces
        value: []
    - set:
        field: _discards
        value: actor.game.discards
    - for_each:
        collection: _discards
        as: _discard
        do:
        - set:
            field: _face
            value: definitions.tiles[_discard.tile]
        - list_push:
            list: _pieces
            value:
              id: '''discard:'' + text(_discard.tile)'
              label: _face.label
    - set:
        field: _discard_group
        value:
          id: '"discards"'
          label: '"Discards"'
          visibility: '"public"'
          pieces: _pieces
    - set:
        field: _area
        value:
          id: _actor_id
          label: actor.name
          position: definitions.positions[actor.seat]
          groups:
          - _hand
          - _discard_group
    - set:
        field: _status
        value:
          label: actor.name
          value: text(actor.score)
    - condition:
        condition: actor.game.revealed
        on_true:
        - set:
            field: _visible
            value:
              visibility: '"public"'
        - set:
            field: _hand
            value: merge(_hand, _visible)
        on_false: []
    - condition:
        condition: actor.game.revealed and state.result != null and state.result.kind
          == 'win' and actor.seat in state.winners and not state.win_tsumo
        on_true:
        - set:
            field: _winning_piece
            value:
              id: '"winning-discard"'
              label: definitions.tiles[state.winning_tile].label
              face: definitions.tiles[state.winning_tile].face
              flags: []
              detail: '"Winning discard"'
              emphasis: '"accent"'
        - set:
            field: _complete_hand
            value:
              pieces: joined(_hand.pieces, one(_winning_piece))
        - set:
            field: _hand
            value: merge(_hand, _complete_hand)
        on_false: []
    - set:
        field: _pieces
        value: []
    - set:
        field: _riichi_marker
        value: false
    - set:
        field: _discards
        value: actor.game.discards
    - for_each:
        collection: _discards
        as: _discard
        do:
        - set:
            field: _piece
            value:
              id: '''discard:'' + text(_discard.tile)'
              label: definitions.tiles[_discard.tile].label
              face: definitions.tiles[_discard.tile].face
              flags: []
        - condition:
            condition: definitions.tiles[_discard.tile].red
            on_true:
            - set:
                field: _piece
                value: merge(_piece, definitions.red_presentation)
            on_false: []
        - condition:
            condition: _discard.riichi
            on_true:
            - set:
                field: _riichi_marker
                value: true
            - set:
                field: _flag
                value:
                  detail: '"Riichi declaration"'
                  emphasis: '"accent"'
            - set:
                field: _piece
                value: merge(_piece, _flag)
            on_false: []
        - condition:
            condition: _discard.claimed
            on_true:
            - set:
                field: _flag
                value:
                  detail: '"Called into a meld"'
                  emphasis: '"muted"'
                  flags:
                  - '"claimed"'
            - set:
                field: _piece
                value: merge(_piece, _flag)
            on_false: []
        - condition:
            condition: _riichi_marker and not _discard.claimed
            on_true:
            - set:
                field: _flag
                value:
                  flags:
                  - '"sideways"'
            - set:
                field: _piece
                value: merge(_piece, _flag)
            - set:
                field: _riichi_marker
                value: false
            on_false: []
        - condition:
            condition: state.last_discard != null and _discard.tile == state.last_discard.tile
              and not _discard.claimed
            on_true:
            - set:
                field: _flag
                value:
                  emphasis: '"accent"'
                  flags: joined(_piece.flags, one('latest'))
            - set:
                field: _piece
                value: merge(_piece, _flag)
            on_false: []
        - list_push:
            list: _pieces
            value: _piece
    - set:
        field: _discard_group
        value:
          id: '"discards"'
          label: '"Discards"'
          role: '"pond"'
          visibility: '"public"'
          pieces: _pieces
    - set:
        field: _regular
        value: []
    - set:
        field: _drawn_pieces
        value: []
    - set:
        field: _rack_pieces
        value: _hand.pieces
    - for_each:
        collection: _rack_pieces
        as: _rack_piece
        do:
        - condition:
            condition: '''drawn'' in _rack_piece.flags'
            on_true:
            - list_push:
                list: _drawn_pieces
                value: _rack_piece
            on_false:
            - list_push:
                list: _regular
                value: _rack_piece
    - set:
        field: _complete_hand
        value:
          pieces: joined(_regular, _drawn_pieces)
    - set:
        field: _hand
        value: merge(_hand, _complete_hand)
    - set:
        field: _groups
        value:
        - _hand
        - _discard_group
    - set:
        field: _melds
        value: actor.game.melds
    - set:
        field: _index
        value: 0
    - for_each:
        collection: _melds
        as: _meld
        do:
        - set:
            field: _pieces
            value: []
        - set:
            field: _tiles
            value: ordered(_meld.tiles)
        - set:
            field: _called
            value: -1
        - set:
            field: _added
            value: -1
        - set:
            field: _offset
            value: (_meld.source_seat - actor.seat + 4) % 4
        - condition:
            condition: _meld.opened
            on_true:
            - condition:
                condition: 'true'
                on_true:
                - set:
                    field: _argument_actor
                    value: state.seats[_meld.source_seat]
                - call: _discard_history
                  params:
                    actor: '{_argument_actor}'
                  export_context:
                    _source_discards: _source_discards
                on_false: []
            - for_each:
                collection: _source_discards
                as: _source_discard
                do:
                - condition:
                    condition: _source_discard.claimed and _source_discard.tile in
                      _meld.tiles
                    on_true:
                    - set:
                        field: _called
                        value: _source_discard.tile
                    on_false: []
            - condition:
                condition: _meld.quad and _called != _meld.tiles[3]
                on_true:
                - set:
                    field: _added
                    value: _meld.tiles[3]
                on_false: []
            on_false: []
        - set:
            field: _normal
            value: []
        - for_each:
            collection: _tiles
            as: _normal_tile
            do:
            - condition:
                condition: _normal_tile != _called and _normal_tile != _added
                on_true:
                - list_push:
                    list: _normal
                    value: _normal_tile
                on_false: []
        - set:
            field: _ordered
            value: _tiles
        - condition:
            condition: not _meld.opened and definitions.tiles[_tiles[0]].red
            on_true:
            - set:
                field: _ordered
                value:
                - _tiles[1]
                - _tiles[0]
                - _tiles[2]
                - _tiles[3]
            on_false: []
        - condition:
            condition: _called >= 0
            on_true:
            - set:
                field: _slot
                value: 0
            - condition:
                condition: _offset == 1
                on_true:
                - set:
                    field: _slot
                    value: len(_normal)
                on_false: []
            - condition:
                condition: _offset == 2
                on_true:
                - set:
                    field: _slot
                    value: 1
                on_false: []
            - set:
                field: _ordered
                value: joined(joined(portion(_normal, 0, _slot), one(_called)), portion(_normal,
                  _slot, len(_normal)))
            on_false: []
        - for_each:
            collection: _ordered
            as: _tile
            do:
            - set:
                field: _piece
                value:
                  id: '''meld:'' + text(_tile)'
                  label: definitions.tiles[_tile].label
                  face: definitions.tiles[_tile].face
                  flags: []
            - condition:
                condition: _tile == _called
                on_true:
                - set:
                    field: _flag
                    value:
                      flags:
                      - '"sideways"'
                - set:
                    field: _piece
                    value: merge(_piece, _flag)
                on_false: []
            - condition:
                condition: not _meld.opened and (_tile == _ordered[0] or _tile ==
                  _ordered[3])
                on_true:
                - set:
                    field: _flag
                    value:
                      flags:
                      - '"back"'
                - set:
                    field: _piece
                    value: merge(_piece, _flag)
                on_false: []
            - condition:
                condition: definitions.tiles[_tile].red
                on_true:
                - set:
                    field: _piece
                    value: merge(_piece, definitions.red_presentation)
                on_false: []
            - list_push:
                list: _pieces
                value: _piece
            - condition:
                condition: _tile == _called and _added >= 0
                on_true:
                - list_push:
                    list: _pieces
                    value:
                      id: '''meld:'' + text(_added)'
                      label: definitions.tiles[_added].label
                      face: definitions.tiles[_added].face
                      flags:
                      - '"stacked"'
                on_false: []
        - set:
            field: _label
            value: '"Pon"'
        - condition:
            condition: _meld.form == 'sequence'
            on_true:
            - set:
                field: _label
                value: '"Chi"'
            on_false: []
        - condition:
            condition: _meld.quad
            on_true:
            - set:
                field: _label
                value: '"Open kan"'
            - condition:
                condition: not _meld.opened
                on_true:
                - set:
                    field: _label
                    value: '"Concealed kan"'
                on_false: []
            on_false: []
        - list_push:
            list: _groups
            value:
              id: '''meld:'' + text(_index)'
              label: _label
              role: '"meld"'
              source: definitions.call_sources[_offset]
              visibility: '"public"'
              pieces: _pieces
        - set:
            field: _index
            value: _index + 1
    - set:
        field: _seat_label
        value: actor.name + ' / ' + definitions.seat_winds[(actor.seat - state.dealer
          + 4) % 4]
    - condition:
        condition: actor.game.riichi
        on_true:
        - set:
            field: _seat_label
            value: _seat_label + ' / Riichi'
        on_false: []
    - condition:
        condition: state.result != null and state.result.kind == 'draw'
        on_true:
        - condition:
            condition: actor.game.revealed
            on_true:
            - set:
                field: _seat_label
                value: _seat_label + ' / Tenpai'
            on_false:
            - set:
                field: _seat_label
                value: _seat_label + ' / Noten'
        on_false: []
    - set:
        field: _area
        value:
          id: _actor_id
          label: _seat_label
          position: definitions.positions[actor.seat]
          badge: definitions.wind_glyphs[(actor.seat - state.dealer + 4) % 4]
          score: text(actor.score)
          active: _actor_id == state.actor and not state.finished
          groups: _groups
    narrative: {}
  _center_table:
    description: Package-owned center table.
    parameters: []
    pre_conditions: []
    effects:
    - set:
        field: _dora
        value: []
    - set:
        field: _visible_indicators
        value: 1 + state.kan_count - state.kan_pending_dora
    - condition:
        condition: state.phase == 'kan_response' and state.pending_kan.op == 'ankan'
        on_true:
        - set:
            field: _visible_indicators
            value: _visible_indicators + 1
        on_false: []
    - set:
        field: _indexes
        value: indices(_visible_indicators)
    - for_each:
        collection: _indexes
        as: _index
        do:
        - list_push:
            list: _dora
            value:
              id: '''dora:'' + text(_index)'
              label: definitions.tiles[state.dead[4 + _index * 2]].label
              face: definitions.tiles[state.dead[4 + _index * 2]].face
    - call: _choice_table
      params:
        actor: '{state.actor}'
      export_context:
        _options: _options
        _turn: _turn
    - set:
        field: _info
        value:
        - id: '"message"'
          label: state.message
    - condition:
        condition: state.finished and state.match_result != null
        on_true:
        - set:
            field: _standings
            value: state.match_result.standings
        - for_each:
            collection: _standings
            as: _standing
            do:
            - list_push:
                list: _info
                value:
                  id: '''place:'' + text(_standing.seat)'
                  label: 'text(_standing.rank) + ''. '' + _standing.name + '': ''
                    + text(_standing.points)'
        on_false: []
    - condition:
        condition: state.pending_kan != null and state.phase == 'kan_response'
        on_true:
        - list_push:
            list: _info
            value:
              id: '"kan"'
              label: '''Kan declared: '' + definitions.tiles[state.last_discard.tile].label'
        on_false: []
    - condition:
        condition: state.result != null and state.result.kind == 'win'
        on_true:
        - set:
            field: _wins
            value: state.result.winners
        - for_each:
            collection: _wins
            as: _win
            do:
            - set:
                field: _score_summary
                value: text(_win.score.han) + ' han / ' + text(_win.score.fu) + '
                  fu; ' + 'dora ' + text(_win.score.dora) + ', red ' + text(_win.score.red)
                  + ', ura ' + text(_win.score.ura)
            - condition:
                condition: _win.score.yakuman_units > 0
                on_true:
                - set:
                    field: _score_summary
                    value: text(_win.score.yakuman_units) + ' yakuman'
                on_false: []
            - list_push:
                list: _info
                value:
                  id: '''winner:'' + text(_win.seat)'
                  label: _win.name + ' +' + text(_win.gain)
                  detail: _score_summary
                  emphasis: '"accent"'
            - set:
                field: _yaku
                value: _win.score.yaku
            - set:
                field: _index
                value: 0
            - for_each:
                collection: _yaku
                as: _label
                do:
                - list_push:
                    list: _info
                    value:
                      id: '''yaku:'' + text(_win.seat) + '':'' + text(_index)'
                      label: _label
                - set:
                    field: _index
                    value: _index + 1
        on_false: []
    - set:
        field: _center
        value:
          id: '"shared"'
          label: _turn
          position: '"center"'
          groups:
          - id: '"dora"'
            label: '"Dora indicators"'
            role: '"indicators"'
            visibility: '"public"'
            pieces: _dora
          - id: '"choices"'
            label: '"Actions"'
            role: '"actions"'
            visibility: '"public"'
            pieces: _options
          - id: '"result"'
            label: '"Table"'
            role: '"message"'
            visibility: '"public"'
            pieces: _info
    narrative: {}
  _choice_table:
    description: Package-owned choice table.
    parameters:
    - name: actor
      type: entity_id
      resolve: entity
    pre_conditions: []
    effects:
    - set:
        field: _turn
        value: actor.name + ' to act'
    - condition:
        condition: state.phase == 'hand_end'

        - set:

        - set:

        - for_each:
            collection: _choices
            as: _choice
            do:
            - condition:
                condition: _choice.op != 'discard'
                on_true:
                - set:

                    value: []
                - set:
                    field: _choice_tiles
                    value: _choice.tiles
                - for_each:
                    collection: _choice_tiles
                    as: _choice_tile
                    do:
                    - list_push:
                        list: _faces
                        value: definitions.tiles[_choice_tile].face
                - condition:
                    condition: _choice.op == 'chi' or _choice.op == 'pon' or _choice.op
                      == 'minkan'
                    on_true:
                    - list_push:
                        list: _faces
                        value: definitions.tiles[state.last_discard.tile].face
                    on_false: []
                - list_push:
                    list: _options
                    value:
                      id: _choice.id
                      label: definitions.action_labels[_choice.op]

                on_false: []
        on_false: []

  _waits:
    description: Package-owned waits.
    parameters:
    - name: actor
      type: entity_id
      resolve: entity
    - name: tiles
      type: array
      items:
        type: integer
    pre_conditions: []
    effects:
    - set:
        field: _kinds
        value: []
    - for_each:
        collection: tiles
        as: _tile
        do:
        - list_push:
            list: _kinds
            value: definitions.tiles[_tile].kind
    - set:
        field: _waits
        value: completions(_kinds, definitions.patterns, definitions.group_sizes[len(actor.game.melds)],
          indices(34))
    - set:
        field: _pairs
        value: []
    - set:
        field: _singles
        value: []
    - set:
        field: _terminals
        value: []
    - set:
        field: _types
        value: indices(34)
    - set:
        field: _only_terminals
        value: true
    - for_each:
        collection: _types
        as: _kind
        do:
        - set:
            field: _count
            value: occurrences(_kinds, _kind)
        - condition:
            condition: _count == 2
            on_true:
            - list_push:
                list: _pairs
                value: _kind
            on_false: []
        - condition:
            condition: _count == 1
            on_true:
            - list_push:
                list: _singles
                value: _kind
            on_false: []
        - condition:
            condition: _count > 0
            on_true:
            - condition:
                condition: _kind in definitions.terminals
                on_true:
                - list_push:
                    list: _terminals
                    value: _kind
                on_false:
                - set:
                    field: _only_terminals
                    value: false
            on_false: []
    - condition:
        condition: len(actor.game.melds) == 0
        on_true:
        - condition:
            condition: len(_pairs) == 6 and len(_singles) == 1
            on_true:
            - list_push:
                list: _waits
                value: _singles[0]
            on_false: []
        - condition:
            condition: _only_terminals and len(_terminals) == 13
            on_true:
            - set:
                field: _waits
                value: definitions.terminals
            on_false: []
        - condition:
            condition: _only_terminals and len(_terminals) == 12 and len(_pairs) ==
              1
            on_true:
            - set:
                field: _missing
                value: without(definitions.terminals, _terminals)
            - list_push:
                list: _waits
                value: _missing[0]
            on_false: []
        on_false: []
    - set:
        field: _all
        value: _kinds
    - set:
        field: _melds
        value: actor.game.melds
    - for_each:
        collection: _melds
        as: _meld
        do:
        - set:
            field: _meld_tiles
            value: _meld.tiles
        - for_each:
            collection: _meld_tiles
            as: _tile
            do:
            - list_push:
                list: _all
                value: definitions.tiles[_tile].kind
    - set:
        field: _filtered
        value: []
    - for_each:
        collection: _waits
        as: _kind
        do:
        - condition:
            condition: occurrences(_all, _kind) < 4 and _kind not in _filtered
            on_true:
            - list_push:
                list: _filtered
                value: _kind
            on_false: []
    - set:
        field: _waits
        value: _filtered
    narrative: {}
  _score_hand:
    description: Package-owned score hand.
    parameters:
    - name: actor
      type: entity_id
      resolve: entity
    - name: winning_tile
      type: integer
    - name: is_tsumo
      type: boolean
    - name: win_source
      type: string
    pre_conditions: []
    effects:
    - set:
        field: _score
        value:
          valid: false
          total: 0
          han: 0
          fu: 0
          basic: 0
          yakuman_units: 0
          yaku: []
          dora: 0
          red: 0
          ura: 0
    - set:
        field: _closed_tiles
        value: actor.game.hand
    - condition:
        condition: not is_tsumo
        on_true:
        - set:
            field: _closed_tiles
            value: joined(_closed_tiles, one(winning_tile))
        on_false: []
    - set:
        field: _kinds
        value: []
    - for_each:
        collection: _closed_tiles
        as: _tile
        do:
        - list_push:
            list: _kinds
            value: definitions.tiles[_tile].kind
    - set:
        field: _winning_kind
        value: definitions.tiles[winning_tile].kind
    - set:
        field: _patterns
        value: partitions(_kinds, definitions.patterns, definitions.group_sizes[len(actor.game.melds)])
    - for_each:
        collection: _patterns
        as: _partition
        do:
        - set:
            field: _groups
            value: []
        - for_each:
            collection: _partition
            as: _pattern
            do:
            - condition:
                condition: _pattern < 34
                on_true:
                - list_push:
                    list: _groups
                    value:
                      form: '"pair"'
                      base: _pattern
                      opened: false
                      quad: false
                on_false:
                - condition:
                    condition: _pattern < 68
                    on_true:
                    - list_push:
                        list: _groups
                        value:
                          form: '"triplet"'
                          base: _pattern - 34
                          opened: false
                          quad: false
                    on_false:
                    - list_push:
                        list: _groups
                        value:
                          form: '"sequence"'
                          base: definitions.sequence_starts[_pattern - 68]
                          opened: false
                          quad: false
        - set:
            field: _closed_count
            value: len(_groups)
        - set:
            field: _melds
            value: actor.game.melds
        - for_each:
            collection: _melds
            as: _meld
            do:
            - list_push:
                list: _groups
                value:
                  form: _meld.form
                  base: _meld.base
                  opened: _meld.opened
                  quad: _meld.quad
        - set:
            field: _placements
            value: indices(_closed_count)
        - for_each:
            collection: _placements
            as: _placement
            do:
            - set:
                field: _group
                value: _groups[_placement]
            - condition:
                condition: (_group.form == 'sequence' and _winning_kind >= _group.base
                  and _winning_kind <= _group.base + 2) or (_group.form != 'sequence'
                  and _winning_kind == _group.base)
                on_true:
                - call: _score_shape
                  params:
                    actor: '{_actor_id}'
                    winning_tile: '{winning_tile}'
                    is_tsumo: '{is_tsumo}'
                    win_source: '{win_source}'
                    groups: '{_groups}'
                    placement: '{_placement}'
                    shape: standard
                  export_context:
                    _candidate: _candidate
                - condition:
                    condition: (_candidate.valid and not _score.valid) or (_candidate.valid
                      == _score.valid and (_candidate.total > _score.total or (_candidate.total
                      == _score.total and (_candidate.yakuman_units > _score.yakuman_units
                      or (_candidate.yakuman_units == _score.yakuman_units and _candidate.han
                      > _score.han)))))
                    on_true:
                    - set:
                        field: _score
                        value: _candidate
                    on_false: []
                on_false: []
    - condition:
        condition: len(actor.game.melds) == 0 and len(_closed_tiles) == 14
        on_true:
        - set:
            field: _pair_count
            value: 0
        - set:
            field: _distinct_terminals
            value: 0
        - set:
            field: _only_terminals
            value: true
        - set:
            field: _types
            value: indices(34)
        - for_each:
            collection: _types
            as: _kind
            do:
            - set:
                field: _count
                value: occurrences(_kinds, _kind)
            - condition:
                condition: _count == 2
                on_true:
                - set:
                    field: _pair_count
                    value: _pair_count + 1
                on_false: []
            - condition:
                condition: _count > 0
                on_true:
                - condition:
                    condition: _kind in definitions.terminals
                    on_true:
                    - set:
                        field: _distinct_terminals
                        value: _distinct_terminals + 1
                    on_false:
                    - set:
                        field: _only_terminals
                        value: false
                on_false: []
        - set:
            field: _shape
            value: null
        - condition:
            condition: _pair_count == 7
            on_true:
            - set:
                field: _shape
                value: '"seven_pairs"'
            on_false: []
        - condition:
            condition: _only_terminals and _distinct_terminals == 13
            on_true:
            - set:
                field: _shape
                value: '"orphans"'
            on_false: []
        - condition:
            condition: _shape != null
            on_true:
            - call: _score_shape
              params:
                actor: '{_actor_id}'
                winning_tile: '{winning_tile}'
                is_tsumo: '{is_tsumo}'
                win_source: '{win_source}'
                groups: []
                placement: -1
                shape: '{_shape}'
              export_context:
                _candidate: _candidate
            - condition:
                condition: (_candidate.valid and not _score.valid) or (_candidate.valid
                  == _score.valid and (_candidate.total > _score.total or (_candidate.total
                  == _score.total and (_candidate.yakuman_units > _score.yakuman_units
                  or (_candidate.yakuman_units == _score.yakuman_units and _candidate.han
                  > _score.han)))))
                on_true:
                - set:
                    field: _score
                    value: _candidate
                on_false: []
            on_false: []
        on_false: []
    narrative: {}
  _score_shape:
    description: Package-owned score shape.
    parameters:
    - name: actor
      type: entity_id
      resolve: entity
    - name: winning_tile
      type: integer
    - name: is_tsumo
      type: boolean
    - name: win_source
      type: string
    - name: groups
      type: array
      items:
        type: object
    - name: placement
      type: integer
    - name: shape
      type: string
    pre_conditions: []
    effects:
    - set:
        field: _closed
        value: true
    - set:
        field: _tiles
        value: actor.game.hand
    - condition:
        condition: not is_tsumo
        on_true:
        - set:
            field: _tiles
            value: joined(_tiles, one(winning_tile))
        on_false: []
    - set:
        field: _melds
        value: actor.game.melds
    - for_each:
        collection: _melds
        as: _meld
        do:
        - set:
            field: _tiles
            value: joined(_tiles, _meld.tiles)
        - condition:
            condition: _meld.opened
            on_true:
            - set:
                field: _closed
                value: false
            on_false: []
    - set:
        field: _kinds
        value: []
    - set:
        field: _suits
        value: []
    - set:
        field: _red
        value: 0
    - set:
        field: _all_simple
        value: true
    - set:
        field: _all_honors
        value: true
    - set:
        field: _all_terminals
        value: true
    - set:
        field: _all_outside
        value: true
    - set:
        field: _has_honors
        value: false
    - set:
        field: _all_green
        value: true
    - for_each:
        collection: _tiles
        as: _tile
        do:
        - set:
            field: _face
            value: definitions.tiles[_tile]
        - list_push:
            list: _kinds
            value: _face.kind
        - condition:
            condition: _face.red
            on_true:
            - set:
                field: _red
                value: _red + 1
            on_false: []
        - condition:
            condition: _face.kind >= 27
            on_true:
            - set:
                field: _all_simple
                value: false
            - set:
                field: _all_terminals
                value: false
            - set:
                field: _has_honors
                value: true
            on_false:
            - set:
                field: _all_honors
                value: false
            - set:
                field: _suit
                value: _face.kind // 9
            - condition:
                condition: _suit not in _suits
                on_true:
                - list_push:
                    list: _suits
                    value: _suit
                on_false: []
            - condition:
                condition: _face.kind % 9 == 0 or _face.kind % 9 == 8
                on_true:
                - set:
                    field: _all_simple
                    value: false
                on_false:
                - set:
                    field: _all_terminals
                    value: false
                - set:
                    field: _all_outside
                    value: false
        - condition:
            condition: _face.kind not in definitions.green_kinds
            on_true:
            - set:
                field: _all_green
                value: false
            on_false: []
    - set:
        field: _seat_wind
        value: 27 + (actor.seat - state.dealer + 4) % 4
    - set:
        field: _round_wind
        value: 27 + state.round_wind
    - set:
        field: _winning_kind
        value: definitions.tiles[winning_tile].kind
    - set:
        field: _sequences
        value: []
    - set:
        field: _triplets
        value: []
    - set:
        field: _concealed_sets
        value: 0
    - set:
        field: _quads
        value: 0
    - set:
        field: _dragons
        value: 0
    - set:
        field: _winds
        value: 0
    - set:
        field: _yakuhai
        value: 0
    - set:
        field: _pair
        value: -1
    - set:
        field: _meld_fu
        value: 0
    - set:
        field: _pair_fu
        value: 0
    - set:
        field: _wait_fu
        value: 0
    - set:
        field: _outside_groups
        value: true
    - set:
        field: _index
        value: 0
    - for_each:
        collection: groups
        as: _group
        do:
        - set:
            field: _outside
            value: _group.base >= 27 or _group.base % 9 == 0 or _group.base % 9 ==
              8
        - condition:
            condition: _group.form == 'pair'
            on_true:
            - set:
                field: _pair
                value: _group.base
            - condition:
                condition: _pair >= 31
                on_true:
                - set:
                    field: _pair_fu
                    value: _pair_fu + 2
                on_false: []
            - condition:
                condition: _pair == _seat_wind
                on_true:
                - set:
                    field: _pair_fu
                    value: _pair_fu + 2
                on_false: []
            - condition:
                condition: _pair == _round_wind
                on_true:
                - set:
                    field: _pair_fu
                    value: _pair_fu + 2
                on_false: []
            - condition:
                condition: _index == placement
                on_true:
                - set:
                    field: _wait_fu
                    value: 2
                on_false: []
            on_false:
            - condition:
                condition: _group.form == 'sequence'
                on_true:
                - list_push:
                    list: _sequences
                    value: _group.base
                - set:
                    field: _outside
                    value: _group.base % 9 == 0 or _group.base % 9 == 6
                - condition:
                    condition: _index == placement and (_winning_kind == _group.base
                      + 1 or (_group.base % 9 == 0 and _winning_kind == _group.base
                      + 2) or (_group.base % 9 == 6 and _winning_kind == _group.base))
                    on_true:
                    - set:
                        field: _wait_fu
                        value: 2
                    on_false: []
                on_false:
                - list_push:
                    list: _triplets
                    value: _group.base
                - set:
                    field: _open
                    value: _group.opened or (not is_tsumo and _index == placement)
                - condition:
                    condition: not _open
                    on_true:
                    - set:
                        field: _concealed_sets
                        value: _concealed_sets + 1
                    on_false: []
                - set:
                    field: _fu
                    value: 2
                - condition:
                    condition: not _open
                    on_true:
                    - set:
                        field: _fu
                        value: _fu * 2
                    on_false: []
                - condition:
                    condition: _group.quad
                    on_true:
                    - set:
                        field: _fu
                        value: _fu * 4
                    - set:
                        field: _quads
                        value: _quads + 1
                    on_false: []
                - condition:
                    condition: _outside
                    on_true:
                    - set:
                        field: _fu
                        value: _fu * 2
                    on_false: []
                - set:
                    field: _meld_fu
                    value: _meld_fu + _fu
                - condition:
                    condition: _group.base >= 31
                    on_true:
                    - set:
                        field: _dragons
                        value: _dragons + 1
                    - set:
                        field: _yakuhai
                        value: _yakuhai + 1
                    on_false: []
                - condition:
                    condition: _group.base >= 27 and _group.base <= 30
                    on_true:
                    - set:
                        field: _winds
                        value: _winds + 1
                    on_false: []
                - condition:
                    condition: _group.base == _seat_wind
                    on_true:
                    - set:
                        field: _yakuhai
                        value: _yakuhai + 1
                    on_false: []
                - condition:
                    condition: _group.base == _round_wind
                    on_true:
                    - set:
                        field: _yakuhai
                        value: _yakuhai + 1
                    on_false: []
        - condition:
            condition: not _outside
            on_true:
            - set:
                field: _outside_groups
                value: false
            on_false: []
        - set:
            field: _index
            value: _index + 1
    - set:
        field: _sequence_pairs
        value: 0
    - set:
        field: _starts
        value: indices(27)
    - for_each:
        collection: _starts
        as: _start
        do:
        - set:
            field: _sequence_pairs
            value: _sequence_pairs + occurrences(_sequences, _start) // 2
    - set:
        field: _sanshoku_sequences
        value: false
    - set:
        field: _sanshoku_triplets
        value: false
    - set:
        field: _straight
        value: false
    - set:
        field: _ranks
        value: indices(9)
    - for_each:
        collection: _ranks
        as: _rank
        do:
        - condition:
            condition: _rank in _sequences and _rank + 9 in _sequences and _rank +
              18 in _sequences
            on_true:
            - set:
                field: _sanshoku_sequences
                value: true
            on_false: []
        - condition:
            condition: _rank in _triplets and _rank + 9 in _triplets and _rank + 18
              in _triplets
            on_true:
            - set:
                field: _sanshoku_triplets
                value: true
            on_false: []
    - set:
        field: _bases
        value:
        - 0
        - 9
        - 18
    - for_each:
        collection: _bases
        as: _base
        do:
        - condition:
            condition: _base in _sequences and _base + 3 in _sequences and _base +
              6 in _sequences
            on_true:
            - set:
                field: _straight
                value: true
            on_false: []
    - set:
        field: _pinfu
        value: shape == 'standard' and _closed and len(_sequences) == 4 and _pair_fu
          == 0 and _wait_fu == 0
    - set:
        field: _nine_gates
        value: false
    - set:
        field: _pure_nine_gates
        value: false
    - condition:
        condition: _closed and len(actor.game.melds) == 0 and len(_suits) == 1 and
          not _has_honors
        on_true:
        - set:
            field: _base
            value: _suits[0] * 9
        - set:
            field: _nine_gates
            value: true
        - set:
            field: _pure_nine_gates
            value: true
        - for_each:
            collection: _ranks
            as: _rank
            do:
            - set:
                field: _required
                value: 1
            - condition:
                condition: _rank == 0 or _rank == 8
                on_true:
                - set:
                    field: _required
                    value: 3
                on_false: []
            - set:
                field: _count
                value: occurrences(_kinds, _base + _rank)
            - condition:
                condition: _count < _required
                on_true:
                - set:
                    field: _nine_gates
                    value: false
                on_false: []
            - condition:
                condition: _base + _rank == _winning_kind
                on_true:
                - set:
                    field: _count
                    value: _count - 1
                on_false: []
            - condition:
                condition: _count != _required
                on_true:
                - set:
                    field: _pure_nine_gates
                    value: false
                on_false: []
        on_false: []
    - set:
        field: _han
        value: 0
    - set:
        field: _yakuman

        - list_push:

        - set:

        - list_push:
            list: _yakuman_yaku
            value: '"Nine gates"'
        on_false: []
    - condition:
        condition: shape == 'orphans' and (occurrences(_kinds, _winning_kind) == 2

        on_true:
        - set:

        - list_push:
            list: _yakuman_yaku

    - condition:

        on_true:
        - set:
            field: _yakuman
            value: _yakuman + 1
        - list_push:
            list: _yakuman_yaku
            value: '"Thirteen orphans"'
        on_false: []
    - condition:
        condition: _heaven

        - set:
            field: _yakuman
            value: _yakuman + 1
        - list_push:
            list: _yakuman_yaku
            value: '"Blessing of heaven"'
        on_false: []
    - condition:
        condition: is_tsumo and actor.game.draw_count == 1 and len(actor.game.discards)
          == 0 and not state.any_call and actor.seat != state.dealer
        on_true:
        - set:
            field: _yakuman
            value: _yakuman + 1
        - list_push:
            list: _yakuman_yaku
            value: '"Blessing of earth"'

    - set:

    - condition:
