                ability_modifier: '{target_state.saving_throw_modifiers.intelligence}'
                proficiency_bonus: 0

                circumstantial_modifier: 0
                target_number: '{_befuddlement_due_source.save_dc}'
                advantage: false
                disadvantage: false

            - set:

                value: _befuddlement_repeat_roll
            - set:
                field: lasting_state.timed_condition_sources.{_befuddlement_due_id}.last_repeat_outcome
                value: _befuddlement_repeat_outcome
            - set:
                field: lasting_state.timed_condition_sources.{_befuddlement_due_id}.last_repeat_total
                value: _befuddlement_repeat_total
            - call: retire_srd_timed_condition_source
              params:
                lasting_state: '{_lasting_state_id}'
                source_id: '{_befuddlement_due_id}'
              condition: _befuddlement_repeat_outcome == 'success'

        scene: state.spatial_scene

          shape:
            kind: box
            min: '{_black_tentacles_scene_source.volume.min}'
            max: '{_black_tentacles_scene_source.volume.max}'
          include:
          - entities

        value: _black_tentacles_initial_area.results
    - for_each:
        collection: _black_tentacles_scene_entities

        - call: resolve_srd_black_tentacles_event

    description: Package-owned forced responses.
    parameters: []
    pre_conditions: []
    effects:
    - set:

        value: true
    - set:
        field: _steps
        value:
        - 0
        - 1
        - 2
    - for_each:
        collection: _steps
        as: _step
        do:
        - condition:
            condition: _keep_advancing and (state.phase == 'response' or state.phase
              == 'kan_response')
            on_true:
            - call: _options
              params:
                actor: '{state.actor}'
              export_context:
                _choices: _choices
            - condition:
                condition: len(_choices) == 1 and _choices[0].op == 'pass'
                on_true:
                - set:

                    value: _choices[0]
                - call: _respond
                  params:
                    actor: '{state.actor}'
                on_false:
                - set:
                    field: _keep_advancing
                    value: false
            on_false: []
    narrative: {}

    parameters:
    - name: actor
      type: entity_id
      resolve: entity
    pre_conditions: []
    effects:
    - call: _waits
      params:
        actor: '{_actor_id}'
        tiles: '{actor.game.hand}'
      export_context:
        _waits: _waits
    - set:
        field: _tenpai
        value: len(_waits) > 0
    - set:
        field: _nagashi
        value: len(actor.game.discards) > 0
    - set:
        field: _discards
        value: actor.game.discards
    - for_each:
        collection: _discards
        as: _discard
        do:
        - condition:
            condition: _discard.claimed or definitions.tiles[_discard.tile].kind not
              in definitions.terminals
            on_true:
            - set:
                field: _nagashi
                value: false
            on_false: []
    - set:
        field: _melds
        value: actor.game.melds
    - for_each:
        collection: _melds
        as: _meld
        do:
        - condition:
            condition: _meld.opened and definitions.profile.nagashi_closed_required
            on_true:
            - set:
                field: _nagashi
                value: false
            on_false: []
    - set:
        field: actor.game.revealed
        value: _tenpai
    narrative: {}

      - call: resolve_srd_counterspell
        params:

          reaction_trigger_id: '{reaction_trigger_id}'
          save_dc: '{save_dc}'

      - set:

          value: _reaction_trigger.actor_state_id
      - call: record_srd_result_text
        params:
          text: Constitution save {_outcome}; roll {_d20_test.results}; total {_adjusted_total};
            DC {save_dc}.
        export_context:
          _recorded_result_text: _recorded_result_text
      - set:
          field: _reaction_outcome_text
          value: _recorded_result_text
    - condition: spell == 'shield'
      on_true:
      - call: read_srd_rest_clock
        params:
          lasting_state: state
        export_context:
          _rest_now: _rest_now
      - set:
          field: _shield_turns
          value: 0
      - set:
          field: _shield_turns
          value: caster_state.turns_started
        condition: caster_state.turns_started != null

          value:

            expires_tick: _rest_now + 2
            trigger_id: reaction_trigger_id
      - set:
          field: _reaction_outcome_text
          value: '''+5 AC until the next caster turn; no Magic Missile damage.'''

      on_true:
      - call: record_srd_spell_target_result

          _spell_target_detail: _spell_target_detail

          value: _spell_target_summary
      - list_push:
          list: _spell_detail_rows
          value: _spell_target_detail

      params:
        caster_state: '{_caster_state_id}'
        reaction_trigger_id: '{reaction_trigger_id}'
        targets: '{targets}'
        actual_spell_level: '{actual_spell_level}'
        spell_cast_id: '{spell_cast_id}'
      export_context:

        _spell_detail_rows: _spell_detail_rows
      condition: spell == 'feather_fall'
    - call: resolve_srd_hellish_rebuke
      params:
        caster_state: '{_caster_state_id}'
        reaction_trigger_id: '{reaction_trigger_id}'
        save_dc: '{save_dc}'
        actual_spell_level: '{actual_spell_level}'
        spell_cast_id: '{spell_cast_id}'
      export_context:
        _spell_summary_rows: _spell_summary_rows
        _spell_detail_rows: _spell_detail_rows
        _hellish_damage_roll: _hellish_damage_roll
      condition: spell == 'hellish_rebuke'

tools:
  open_srd_extended_spell_window:
    effects:
    - require:
        condition: caster_state.concentration_effect_family == 'extended_casting'
          and caster_state.extended_casting != null
        error: A longer-casting reaction needs its actual ongoing channel.
    - set:
        field: _extended_attempt
        value: caster_state.extended_casting
    - require:
        condition: _extended_attempt.components != null and _extended_attempt.limited_use
          != null
        error: Restart this older channel to bind its actual source and components.
    - set:
        field: lasting_state.pending_srd_actions
        value: {}
      condition: lasting_state.pending_srd_actions == null
    - set:
        field: lasting_state.pending_srd_action_stack
        value: []
      condition: lasting_state.pending_srd_action_stack == null
    - set:
        field: _pending_stack
        value: lasting_state.pending_srd_action_stack
    - require:
        condition: len(_pending_stack) < 16
        error: Complete an existing reaction window first.
    - set:
        field: lasting_state.pending_srd_action_sequence
        value: 0
      condition: lasting_state.pending_srd_action_sequence == null
    - set:
        field: lasting_state.pending_srd_action_sequence
        value: lasting_state.pending_srd_action_sequence + 1
    - call: record_srd_result_text
      params:
        text: action-{lasting_state.pending_srd_action_sequence}
      export_context:
        _recorded_result_text: _recorded_result_text
    - set:
        field: _pending_action_id
        value: _recorded_result_text
    - set:
        field: lasting_state.pending_srd_actions.{_pending_action_id}
        value:
          kind: '''extended_casting'''
          owner_kind: '''extended_casting'''
          status: '''open'''
          stage: '''reaction'''
          actor_state_id: _caster_state_id
          target_state_id: _caster_state_id
          parameters: {}
          context: {}
          sanctuary_saves: []
    - set:
        field: lasting_state.pending_srd_actions.{_pending_action_id}.turn_actor
        value: null
    - set:
        field: lasting_state.pending_srd_actions.{_pending_action_id}.turn_actor
        value: combat.active_actor
      condition: combat.encounter_active == true
    - list_push:
        list: _pending_stack
        value: _pending_action_id
    - set:
        field: lasting_state.pending_srd_action_stack
        value: _pending_stack
    - set:
        field: lasting_state.pending_srd_actions.{_pending_action_id}.kind
        value: '''spell_cast'''
    - set:
        field: lasting_state.pending_srd_actions.{_pending_action_id}.spell
        value: _extended_attempt.spell
    - set:
        field: lasting_state.pending_srd_actions.{_pending_action_id}.parameters
        value:
          spell: _extended_attempt.spell
    - set:
        field: lasting_state.pending_srd_actions.{_pending_action_id}.components
        value: _extended_attempt.components
    - set:
        field: lasting_state.pending_srd_actions.{_pending_action_id}.constitution_save_modifier
        value: null
    - set:
        field: lasting_state.pending_srd_actions.{_pending_action_id}.constitution_save_modifier
        value: caster_state.concentration_save_modifier
      condition: caster_state.concentration_save_modifier != null
    - set:
        field: lasting_state.pending_srd_actions.{_pending_action_id}.limited_use_kind
        value: _extended_attempt.limited_use.kind
    - set:
        field: lasting_state.pending_srd_actions.{_pending_action_id}.limited_use_pool
        value: _extended_attempt.limited_use.pool
    - set:
        field: lasting_state.pending_srd_actions.{_pending_action_id}.limited_use_maximum
        value: _extended_attempt.limited_use.maximum
    - set:
        field: caster_state.extended_casting.window_action_id
        value: _pending_action_id

sylvia_gm_runtime:
  format: 1
  state_namespace: pkg
tools:
  settle_srd_native_wight_rise:
    effects:
    - call: read_srd_native_wight_rise
      params:
        corpse_state: '{_corpse_state_id}'
      export_context:
        _native_rise: _native_rise
        _native_rise_id: _native_rise_id
    - condition: _native_rise.active == true
      on_true:
      - condition: corpse_state.is_alive == true or corpse_state.death_tick != _native_rise.death_tick
        on_true:
        - set:
            field: lasting_state.native_wight_rise_records.{_native_rise_id}.active
        - set:
            field: lasting_state.native_wight_rise_records.{_native_rise_id}.status
            value: '''cancelled_original_body'''
        on_false:
        - condition: lasting_state.lasting_tick >= _native_rise.deadline
          on_true:
          - require:
              condition: lasting_state.lasting_tick == _native_rise.deadline
              error: Advance to the actual native rise deadline; overdue chronology
                is unsupported.
          - require:
              condition: corpse_state.body_available == true and corpse_state.body_animated_actor_id
                == null
              error: Join the actual available original body at its deadline; unavailability
                alone does not prove destruction.
          - require:
              condition: _native_rise.other_language != null
              error: Admit this printed Zombie other understood language before its
                deadline.
          - require:
              condition: combat.encounter_active != true and combat.turn_active !=
                true
              error: Join actual independent Initiative before rising inside an existing
                encounter.
          - call: qualify_srd_native_wight_body
            params:
              actor_state: '{_native_rise.controller}'
          - call: count_srd_native_wight_controlled_zombies
            params:
              controller_state: '{_native_rise.controller}'
            export_context:
              _native_wight_controlled_count: _native_wight_controlled_count
          - require:
              condition: _native_wight_controlled_count < 12
              error: This actual Wight already controls twelve living native Zombies;
                over-cap scheduling is unsupported.
          - call: record_srd_result_text
            params:
              text: wight_zombie_{_native_rise.sequence}
            export_context:
              _recorded_result_text: _recorded_result_text
          - set:
              field: _native_rise_zombie
              value: _recorded_result_text
          - call: create_srd_native_wight_zombie_scene
            params:
              corpse_state: '{_corpse_state_id}'
              controller_state: '{_native_rise.controller}'
              summon_id: '{_native_rise_zombie}'
          - call: prepare_srd_native_wight_zombie
            params:
              creature_id: '{_native_rise_zombie}'
              corpse_state: '{_corpse_state_id}'
              source_caster: '{_native_rise.controller}'
              other_language: '{_native_rise.other_language}'
              rise_id: '{_native_rise_id}'
    metadata:
      category: internal
      visible_to_player: false
    parameters:
    - param_corpse_state_6bcdfaad9076a62a
    - param_lasting_state_7bff8d20c3cf7d0f
  record_srd_attack_mark_zero:
    effects:
    - require:
        condition: target_state.hp == 0
        error: A mark transfer requires actual zero HP, not an asserted defeat.
    - call: get_srd_attack_rider_source
      params:
        source_id: '{source_id}'
      export_context:
        _rider_source_id: _rider_source_id
        _rider_source: _rider_source
        _rider_live: _rider_live
    - condition: _rider_live == true and _rider_source.caster == _caster_state_id
        and _rider_source.target == _target_state_id and (_rider_source.spell == 'hex'
        or _rider_source.spell == 'hunters_mark') and _rider_source.dropped_to_zero
        != true
      on_true:
      - set:
          field: lasting_state.attack_rider_sources.{source_id}.dropped_to_zero
          value: true
      - set:
          field: lasting_state.attack_rider_sources.{source_id}.dropped_tick
          value: lasting_state.lasting_tick
      - set:
          field: lasting_state.attack_rider_sources.{source_id}.dropped_caster_turn
          value: caster_state.turns_started
        condition: state.map
    metadata:
      category: internal
      visible_to_player: false
    parameters:
    - param_caster_state_5310b8b23a525eea
    - param_target_state_cb03a83d0b3e524f
    - param_source_id_da8b650d256d2fc5
    - param_lasting_state_7bff8d20c3cf7d0f
parameter_declarations:
  param_caster_state_5310b8b23a525eea:

    resolve: entity
  param_corpse_state_6bcdfaad9076a62a:
    name: corpse_state
    resolve: entity

    required: false
    resolve: entity
    default: state
  param_source_id_da8b650d256d2fc5:
    name: source_id
  param_target_state_cb03a83d0b3e524f:
    name: target_state

sylvia_gm_runtime:
  format: 1
  state_namespace: pkg
tools:
  qualify_srd_coordinate_opportunity_move:
    description: Find the first supported hostile reach boundary in this actual coordinate
      segment.
    parameters:
    - name: actor_state
      resolve: entity
    - name: destination
      type: array
      items:
        type: number
      min_items: 3
      max_items: 3
    - name: lasting_state
      resolve: entity
      required: false
      default: state
    effects:
    - set:
        field: _coordinate_candidates
        value: []
    - set:
        field: _coordinate_first_exit
        value: 1
    - set:
        field: _coordinate_ignored
        value: []
    - condition: lasting_state.pending_srd_movement != null
      on_true:
      - require:
          condition: lasting_state.pending_srd_movement.stage == 'resuming' and lasting_state.pending_srd_movement.actor
            == _actor_state_id
          error: Resolve the saved movement Reaction before another movement.
      - set:
          field: _coordinate_ignored
          value: lasting_state.pending_srd_movement.ignored
    - set:
        field: _coordinate_frames
        value: lasting_state.spatial_scene.entities
    - for_each:
        collection: _coordinate_frames
        as: _coordinate_frame
        do:
        - set:
            field: _coordinate_ref
            value: _coordinate_frame.id
        - condition: _coordinate_frame.metadata.participant_ref != null
          on_true:
          - set:
              field: _coordinate_ref
              value: _coordinate_frame.metadata.participant_ref
        - condition: _coordinate_frame.active == true and _coordinate_frame.metadata.participant_ref
            != null and _coordinate_frame.metadata.creature_type != null
          on_true:
          - call: qualify_srd_coordinate_opportunity_reactor
            params:
              mover_state: '{_actor_state_id}'
              reactor_state: '{_coordinate_ref}'
              destination: '{destination}'
              ignored: '{_coordinate_ignored}'
            export_context:
              _coordinate_reactor: _coordinate_reactor
          - condition: _coordinate_reactor != null
            on_true:
            - condition: _coordinate_reactor.exit < _coordinate_first_exit - 0.000001
              on_true:
              - set:
                  field: _coordinate_first_exit
                  value: _coordinate_reactor.exit
              - set:
                  field: _coordinate_candidates
                  value: []
            - condition: abs(_coordinate_reactor.exit - _coordinate_first_exit) <=
                0.000001
              on_true:
              - list_push:
                  list: _coordinate_candidates
                  value: _coordinate_reactor
    - call: srd_information_scene_entity
      params:
        subject: '{_actor_state_id}'
      export_context:
        _info_scene_entity: _info_scene_entity
        _info_position: _info_position
    - set:
        field: _coordinate_move_origin
        value: _info_position
    - call: measure_srd_information_distance
      params:
        start: '{_coordinate_move_origin}'
        end: '{destination}'
      export_context:
        _scene_distance: _scene_distance
    - set:
        field: _coordinate_requested_distance
        value: _scene_distance
    - set:
        field: _coordinate_move_destination
        value:
        - _coordinate_move_origin[0] + (destination[0] - _coordinate_move_origin[0])
          * _coordinate_first_exit
        - _coordinate_move_origin[1] + (destination[1] - _coordinate_move_origin[1])
          * _coordinate_first_exit
        - _coordinate_move_origin[2] + (destination[2] - _coordinate_move_origin[2])
          * _coordinate_first_exit
    metadata:
      category: internal
      visible_to_player: false
      costs_action: false

tools:
  record_srd_object_break_node:
    effects:
    - require:
        condition: combat.encounter_active != true
        error: Admit object facts outside combat.
    - require:
        condition: combat.pending_action == null
        error: Finish the pending action first.
    - call: srd_information_scene_entity
      params:
        subject: '{object_id}'
      export_context:
        _info_scene_entity: _info_scene_entity
        _info_position: _info_position
    - require:
        condition: _info_scene_entity.id == object_id and _info_scene_entity.metadata.participant_ref
          == null
        error: An object target must be an actual non-creature scene ID.
    - set:
        field: _object_scene
        value: _info_scene_entity
    - require:
        condition: _object_scene.footprint.kind == 'box'
        error: Admit the object's actual bounds before its break.
    - require:
        condition: break_max[0] >= break_min[0]
        error: Break bounds must increase.
    - require:
        condition: break_max[1] >= break_min[1]
        error: Break bounds must increase.
    - require:
        condition: break_max[2] >= break_min[2]
        error: Break bounds must increase.
    - require:
        condition: break_min[0] >= _object_scene.position[0] - _object_scene.footprint.half_extents[0]
          and break_max[0] <= _object_scene.position[0] + _object_scene.footprint.half_extents[0]
        error: The admitted break must lie inside the actual object.
    - require:
        condition: break_min[1] >= _object_scene.position[1] - _object_scene.footprint.half_extents[1]
          and break_max[1] <= _object_scene.position[1] + _object_scene.footprint.half_extents[1]
        error: The admitted break must lie inside the actual object.
    - require:
        condition: break_min[2] >= _object_scene.position[2] and break_max[2] <= _object_scene.position[2]
          + _object_scene.height
        error: The admitted break must lie inside the actual object.
    - set:
        field: _world_breaks
        value: []
    - set:
        field: _world_breaks
        value: _object_scene.metadata.srd_object_breaks
      condition: _object_scene.metadata.srd_object_breaks != null
    - for_each:
        collection: _world_breaks
        as: _world_break
        do:
        - require:
            condition: _world_break.id != break_id
            error: This physical break is already admitted.
    - list_push:
        list: _world_breaks
        value:
          id: break_id
          min: break_min
          max: break_max
    - require:
        condition: lasting_state.spatial_scene != null
        error: This operation needs the admitted spatial scene.
    - require:
        condition: lasting_state.spatial_scene.map.grid.unit == 'ft'
        error: SRD scene distances use feet.
    - spatial_query:
        scene: state.spatial_scene
        operation: snapshot
      store_as: _info_snapshot
    - set:
        field: _world_changes
        value:
          srd_object_breaks: _world_breaks
    - call: initialize_srd_lite_constants_d63675087646
      export_context: '*'
    - set:
        field: _world_changes
        value: merge(_world_changes, _world_object_marker)
    - set:
        field: _world_metadata
        value: merge(_object_scene.metadata, _world_changes)
    - spatial_mutation:
        scene: state.spatial_scene
        map_id: '{lasting_state.spatial_scene.map.id}'
        expected_revision: '{_info_snapshot.geometry_revision}'
        target:
          kind: entity
          id: '{object_id}'
        patch:
          metadata: '{_world_metadata}'
      store_as: _world_mutation
    - call: refresh_srd_spell_triggers
      condition: state.has_spell_triggers == true
    metadata:
      category: internal
      visible_to_player: false
    parameters:
    - param_object_id_2b5cfd2dd4c129d5
    - param_break_id_15ec21c4eb892729
    - param_break_min_f4e1ba5be149d9f4
    - param_break_max_03e8a31f53c2b837
    - param_lasting_state_7bff8d20c3cf7d0f
  refresh_srd_moonbeam_darkness:

    - 7
    - require:
        condition: _storm_source_frame.footprint.kind == 'box' and _storm_source_frame.metadata.plane

        error: Storm of Vengeance's chosen point must be on the caster's actual plane.
    - set:
        field: _storm_plane
        value: _storm_source_frame.metadata.plane
    - set:
        field: _storm_origin
        value: storm_cloud_point
    - require:
        condition: storm_cloud_point[0] >= lasting_state.spatial_scene.map.bounds.min[0]
          and storm_cloud_point[0] <= lasting_state.spatial_scene.map.bounds.max[0]
          and storm_cloud_point[1] >= lasting_state.spatial_scene.map.bounds.min[1]
          and storm_cloud_point[1] <= lasting_state.spatial_scene.map.bounds.max[1]
          and storm_cloud_point[2] >= lasting_state.spatial_scene.map.bounds.min[2]
          and storm_cloud_point[2] <= lasting_state.spatial_scene.map.bounds.max[2]
        error: Storm of Vengeance's point must be inside the admitted scene.
    - set:
        field: _sunburst_range_start
        value:
        - max(_storm_source_frame.position[0] - _storm_source_frame.footprint.half_extents[0],
          min(storm_cloud_point[0], _storm_source_frame.position[0] + _storm_source_frame.footprint.half_extents[0]))
        - max(_storm_source_frame.position[1] - _storm_source_frame.footprint.half_extents[1],

    - set:
        field: _volume_point
        value:
        - 0
        - 0
        - 0
    - condition: volume.kind == 'box'
      on_true:
      - set:
          field: _volume_point
          value:
          - min(volume.max[0], max(volume.min[0], origin[0]))
          - min(volume.max[1], max(volume.min[1], origin[1]))
          - min(volume.max[2], max(volume.min[2], origin[2]))
      on_false:
      - set:
          field: _volume_xy_distance
          value: ((origin[0] - volume.center[0]) ** 2 + (origin[1] - volume.center[1])
            ** 2) ** 0.5
      - set:
          field: _volume_scale
          value: 1
      - set:
          field: _volume_scale
          value: volume.radius * _volume_xy_distance ** -1
        condition: _volume_xy_distance > volume.radius
      - set:
          field: _volume_point
          value:
          - volume.center[0] + (origin[0] - volume.center[0]) * _volume_scale
          - volume.center[1] + (origin[1] - volume.center[1]) * _volume_scale
          - min(volume.center[2] + volume.height, max(volume.center[2], origin[2]))

    - set:

    - call: resolve_srd_spike_growth_intervals

        end: '{end}'
        mode: '{mode}'
      export_context:

      condition: actor_state.spike_growth_travel == null

        as: _spike_interval

        - set:
            field: _spike_remainder
            value: 0
        - set:
            field: _spike_receipt
            value: actor_state.spike_growth_travel[_spike_interval.area_id]
        - set:
            field: _spike_remainder
            value: _spike_receipt.remainder
          condition: _spike_receipt != null and _spike_receipt.sequence == _spike_interval.sequence
        - set:
            field: _spike_remainder
            value: _spike_remainder + _spike_committed_distance * (_spike_interval.exit

            value: _spike_remainder >= 5 - 0.000000001
        - set:

            value: max(0, _spike_remainder - 5)
          condition: _spike_damage_due == true
        - set:
            field: actor_state.spike_growth_travel.{_spike_interval.area_id}
            value:

        - call: apply_srd_spike_growth_damage

            target_state: '{_actor_state_id}'

sylvia_gm_runtime:
  format: 1
  state_namespace: pkg
tools:
  disperse_srd_control_weather_fog:
    effects:
    - call: format_srd_information_projection
      params:
        message: '{area_id}'
      export_context:
        _environment_area_key: _info_projection_message
    - set:
        field: _weather_fog
        value: lasting_state.persistent_spell_areas[_environment_area_key]
    - condition: _weather_fog.active == true and lasting_state.lasting_tick < _weather_fog.expires_tick
        and (_weather_fog.mode == 'fog' or _weather_fog.mode == 'cloudkill' or _weather_fog.mode
        == 'stinking_cloud' or _weather_fog.mode == 'incendiary_cloud')
      on_true:
      - call: resolve_srd_weather_setting
        params:
          point: '{_weather_fog.origin}'
          plane: '{_weather_fog.plane}'
          fallback: ''
        export_context:
          _weather_setting: _weather_setting
      - condition: _weather_setting == 'outdoors'
        on_true:
        - call: resolve_srd_control_weather_point
          params:
            point: '{_weather_fog.origin}'
            plane: '{_weather_fog.plane}'
          export_context:
            _weather_known: _weather_known
            _weather_conditions: _weather_conditions
            _weather_phase: _weather_phase
            _weather_source_id: _weather_source_id
        - condition: _weather_known == true and _weather_conditions.wind_stage >=
            3
          on_true:
          - call: qualify_srd_environment_concentration
            params:
              source_state: '{_weather_fog.caster}'
              area_id: '{_environment_area_key}'
          - call: end_srd_concentration_node
            params:
              source_state: '{_weather_fog.caster}'
              target_state: '{_weather_fog.caster}'
              lasting_state: state
    metadata:
      category: internal
      visible_to_player: false
    parameters:
    - param_area_id_e089c46d11628c06
    - param_lasting_state_f791c68f01bb49c8
  start_srd_damage_rider_turn:
    effects:
    - require:
        condition: combat.turn_active == true and combat.active_actor == _target_state_id
          and target_state.turns_started != null
        error: Use this target's actual committed start turn.
    - set:
        field: _rider_start_ids
        value: []
    - set:
        field: _rider_turn_rows
        value: []
    - set:
        field: _rider_turn_damage
        value: 0
    - set:
        field: _rider_start_ids
        value: target_state.attack_rider_source_ids
      condition: target_state.attack_rider_source_ids != null
    - for_each:
        collection: _rider_start_ids
        as: _rider_start_id
        do:
        - call: get_srd_attack_rider_source
          params:
            source_id: '{_rider_start_id}'
          export_context:
            _rider_source_id: _rider_source_id
            _rider_source: _rider_source
            _rider_live: _rider_live
            _rider_current: _rider_current
        - condition: _rider_current == true and (_rider_source.spell == 'searing_smite'
            or _rider_source.spell == 'ensnaring_strike') and _rider_source.target
            == _target_state_id and target_state.turns_started > _rider_source.last_target_turn
          on_true:
          - condition: _rider_live == true
            on_true:
            - condition: _rider_source.spell == 'ensnaring_strike'
              on_true:
              - call: resolve_srd_ensnaring_strike_turn
                params:
                  target_state: '{_target_state_id}'
                  source_id: '{_rider_start_id}'
                export_context:
                  _ensnaring_damage_roll: _ensnaring_damage_roll
                  _ensnaring_damage_taken: _ensnaring_damage_taken
              - set:
                  field: _rider_turn_damage
                  value: _rider_turn_damage + _ensnaring_damage_taken
              - set:
                  field: _ensnaring_turn_row
                  value:
                    kind: '''Ensnaring Strike'''
                    target: _target_state_id
                    value: _ensnaring_damage_taken
                    damage_roll: null
                    detail: '''Start-turn Piercing; no repeat save'''
              - condition: _ensnaring_damage_roll != null
                on_true:
                - set:
                    field: _ensnaring_roll_patch
                    value:
                      damage_roll: _ensnaring_damage_roll
                - set:
                    field: _ensnaring_turn_row
                    value: merge(_ensnaring_turn_row, _ensnaring_roll_patch)
              - list_push:
                  list: _rider_turn_rows
                  value: _ensnaring_turn_row
              on_false:
              - call: resolve_srd_searing_smite_turn
                params:
                  target_state: '{_target_state_id}'
                  source_id: '{_rider_start_id}'
                export_context:
                  _searing_damage_roll: _searing_damage_roll
                  _searing_damage_taken: _searing_damage_taken
                  _searing_save: _searing_save
                  _searing_save_outcome: _searing_save_outcome
              - set:
                  field: _rider_turn_damage
                  value: _rider_turn_damage + _searing_damage_taken
              - list_push:
                  list: _rider_turn_rows
                  value:
                    kind: '''Searing Smite'''
                    target: _target_state_id
                    value: _searing_damage_taken
                    detail: _searing_save_outcome
                    damage_roll: _searing_damage_roll
                    save_roll: _searing_save
            on_false:
            - set:
                field: lasting_state.attack_rider_sources.{_rider_start_id}.last_target_turn
                value: target_state.turns_started
    metadata:
      category: internal
      visible_to_player: false
    parameters:
    - param_target_state_cb03a83d0b3e524f
    - param_lasting_state_7bff8d20c3cf7d0f

        lasting_state: '{_lasting_state_id}'
      export_context:
        _environment_entirely_silenced: _environment_entirely_silenced
        _environment_silence_expires: _environment_silence_expires
    - condition: target_state.environment_silence_condition_id != null

        lasting_state: '{_lasting_state_id}'

    parameters:
    - param_target_state_cb03a83d0b3e524f
    - param_lasting_state_f791c68f01bb49c8

meta:
  id: mutation-case
tools:
  damage_srd_guardian_target:
    effects:
    - require:
        condition: lasting_state.spatial_scene != null
        error: This operation needs the admitted spatial scene.
    - require:
        condition: lasting_state.spatial_scene.map.grid.unit == 'ft'
        error: SRD scene distances use feet.
    - spatial_query:
        scene: state.spatial_scene
        operation: snapshot
      store_as: _info_snapshot
    - set:
        field: _guardian_record
        value: lasting_state.spell_force_records[force_id]
    - table_lookup:
        table: definitions.spells
        key: _guardian_record.spell
        required: true
      store_as: _guardian_profile
    - set:
        field: _guardian_half_cover
        value: []
    - set:
        field: _guardian_three_quarters
        value: []
    - spatial_query:
        scene: state.spatial_scene
        operation: exposure
        snapshot: '{_info_snapshot}'
        query:
          map_id: '{lasting_state.spatial_scene.map.id}'
          observer:
            point: '{observer}'
          target:
            entity_id: '{target_scene.id}'
          samples:
            horizontal: 3
            vertical: 3
          include:
          - geometry
      store_as: _guardian_exposure
    - condition: _guardian_exposure.visible_samples > 0
      on_true:
      - condition: _guardian_exposure.visible_samples < len(_guardian_exposure.samples)
        do:
        - require:
            condition: target_scene.metadata.cover_from != null
            error: Admit partial Cover from the actual guardian source.
        - set:
            field: _guardian_cover
            value: target_scene.metadata.cover_from[force_id]
        - require:
            condition: _guardian_cover == 'none' or _guardian_cover == 'half' or _guardian_cover
              == 'three_quarters'
            error: Qualify actual guardian partial Cover.
        - list_push:
            list: _guardian_half_cover
            value: _target_state_id
          condition: _guardian_cover == 'half'
        - list_push:
            list: _guardian_three_quarters
            value: _target_state_id
          condition: _guardian_cover == 'three_quarters'
      - call: resolve_spell_area_save_damage_target
        params:
          spell: guardian_of_faith
          target: '{_target_state_id}'
          save_ability: '{_guardian_profile.save_ability}'
          spell_save_dc: '{_guardian_record.save_dc}'
          damage_total: '{_guardian_profile.damage_amount}'
          damage_type: '{_guardian_profile.damage_type}'
          success_damage: '{_guardian_profile.success_damage}'
          construct_save_disadvantage: false
          half_cover_targets: '{_guardian_half_cover}'
          three_quarters_cover_targets: '{_guardian_three_quarters}'
          source_state_id: '{_guardian_record.caster}'
        export_context:
          _spell_summary_rows: _spell_summary_rows
          _spell_detail_rows: _spell_detail_rows
          _affliction_trigger_damage: _affliction_trigger_damage
      - set:
          field: lasting_state.spell_force_records.{force_id}.damage_dealt
          value: _guardian_record.damage_dealt + _affliction_trigger_damage
      - call: remove_srd_spell_force
        params:
          force_id: '{force_id}'
        condition: _guardian_record.damage_dealt + _affliction_trigger_damage >= _guardian_profile.damage_limit
    metadata:
      category: internal
      visible_to_player: false
    parameters:
    - param_force_id_fd9b53495049afdd
    - param_target_state_cb03a83d0b3e524f
    - param_lasting_state_7bff8d20c3cf7d0f
    - name: observer
      type: array
      items:
        type: number
      min_items: 3
      max_items: 3
    - param_target_scene_1879e8f42cc9231a
  read_srd_actor_weapon_spell:
    effects:
    - call: initialize_srd_lite_constants_7d83b2be33fb
      export_context: '*'
    - set:
        field: _weapon_spell_records
        value: []
    - set:
        field: _weapon_spell_records
        value: lasting_state.turn_effects
      condition: lasting_state.turn_effects != null
    - for_each:
        collection: _weapon_spell_records
        as: _weapon_spell_record
        do:
        - condition: _weapon_spell_record.kind == 'actor_spell_modifier' and _weapon_spell_record.target
            == _actor_state_id and _weapon_spell_record.weapon == weapon and lasting_state.lasting_tick
            < _weapon_spell_record.expires_tick
          on_true:
          - condition: _weapon_spell_record.mode == 'magic_weapon'
            on_true:
            - set:
                field: _weapon_spell_bonus
                value: max(_weapon_spell_bonus, _weapon_spell_record.weapon_bonus)
            - set:
                field: _weapon_spell_magic
                value: true
          - condition: _weapon_spell_record.mode == 'shillelagh' and actor_state.held_items
              != null and weapon in actor_state.held_items and actor_state.inventory
              != null and weapon in actor_state.inventory and (_weapon_spell_record.weapon_copy_serial
              == null or _weapon_spell_record.weapon_copy_serial == weapon_copy_serial)
            on_true:
            - set:
                field: _weapon_spell_ability
                value: _weapon_spell_record.casting_ability
            - set:
                field: _weapon_spell_modifier
                value: _weapon_spell_record.casting_modifier
            - set:
                field: _weapon_spell_die
                value: '''1d8'''
            - set:
                field: _weapon_spell_die
                value: '''1d10'''
              condition: _weapon_spell_record.casting_level >= 5
            - set:
                field: _weapon_spell_die
                value: '''1d12'''
              condition: _weapon_spell_record.casting_level >= 11
            - set:
                field: _weapon_spell_die
                value: '''2d6'''
              condition: _weapon_spell_record.casting_level >= 17
    metadata:
      category: internal
      visible_to_player: false
    parameters:
    - param_actor_state_d3c054b169a46c77
    - param_lasting_state_a0a632fef1e150e2
    - param_weapon_73979bc6ddb1ae68
    - name: weapon_copy_serial
      type: integer
      required: false
      minimum: 1

sylvia_gm_runtime:
  format: 1
  state_namespace: pkg
tools:
  validate_srd_dancing_light_points:
    effects:
    - call: srd_information_scene_entity
      params:
        subject: '{_caster_state_id}'
      export_context:
        _info_scene_entity: _info_scene_entity
        _info_position: _info_position
    - set:
        field: _dance_caster_origin
        value: _info_position
    - set:
        field: _dance_point_index
        value: 0
    - for_each:
        collection: points
        as: _dance_point
        do:
        - require:
            condition: len(_dance_point) == 3
            error: A light position needs three coordinates.
        - call: measure_srd_information_distance
          params:
            start: '{_dance_caster_origin}'
            end: '{_dance_point}'
          export_context:
            _dance_point_range: _scene_distance
        - require:
            condition: _dance_point_range <= 120
            error: A Dancing Light must be within 120 feet of its caster.
        - set:
            field: _dance_neighbor
            value: combined == true
        - set:
            field: _dance_neighbor_index
            value: 0
        - for_each:
            collection: points
            as: _dance_other_point
            do:
            - condition: _dance_neighbor_index != _dance_point_index
              on_true:
              - call: measure_srd_information_distance
                params:
                  start: '{_dance_point}'
                  end: '{_dance_other_point}'
                export_context:
                  _dance_separation: _scene_distance
              - set:
                  field: _dance_neighbor
                  value: true
                condition: _dance_separation <= 20
            - set:
                field: _dance_neighbor_index
                value: _dance_neighbor_index + 1
        - require:
            condition: _dance_neighbor == true
            error: Each Dancing Light must be within 20 feet of another light; use
              a combined form for one source.
        - set:
            field: _dance_point_index
            value: _dance_point_index + 1
    metadata:
      visible_to_player: false
    parameters:
    - param_caster_state_5310b8b23a525eea
    - param_points_158d7c17623224fc
    - name: combined
      type: boolean
  install_srd_control_behavior_source:
    effects:
    - set:
        field: target_state.timed_condition_unowned_frightened
        value: '''frightened'' in target_state.conditions'
      condition: target_state.timed_condition_unowned_frightened == null
    - set:
        field: target_state.timed_condition_unowned_unconscious
        value: '''unconscious'' in target_state.conditions'
      condition: target_state.timed_condition_unowned_unconscious == null
    - call: install_srd_timed_condition_source
      params:
        target_state: '{_target_state_id}'
        caster_state: '{_caster_state_id}'
        lasting_state: '{_lasting_state_id}'
        spell: '{spell}'
        condition: '{condition}'
        save_dc: state.map
        duration_rounds: 10
        repeat_save_timing: none
        save_ability: wisdom
        control_profile: '{behavior}'
        concentration_sequence: '{concentration_sequence}'
        actual_spell_level: '{actual_spell_level}'
        spell_cast_id: '{spell_cast_id}'
        spell_cast_owner: '{_spell_cast_owner_id}'
      export_context:
        _timed_condition_source_id: _timed_condition_source_id
    - set:
        field: _control_end_turn
        value: 1
    - set:
        field: _control_end_turn
        value: target_state.turns_started + 1
      condition: target_state.turns_started != null
    - set:
        field: lasting_state.timed_condition_sources.{_timed_condition_source_id}.next_end_turn
        value: _control_end_turn
    - set:
        field: lasting_state.timed_condition_sources.{_timed_condition_source_id}.stage
        value: '''first'''
    - set:
        field: lasting_state.timed_condition_sources.{_timed_condition_source_id}.caster_visible
        value: null
    - set:
        field: lasting_state.timed_condition_sources.{_timed_condition_source_id}.last_end_turn
        value: -1
    - set:
        field: lasting_state.timed_condition_sources.{_timed_condition_source_id}.expires_tick
        value: lasting_state.lasting_tick + 4
      condition: behavior == 'dance_brief'
    - call: refresh_srd_timed_condition_target
      params:
        target_state: '{_target_state_id}'
        lasting_state: '{_lasting_state_id}'
    - call: observe_srd_time_stop_creature_effect
      params:
        target_state: '{_target_state_id}'
        source_state: '{time_stop_state.time_stop_source.caster}'
      condition: time_stop_state.time_stop_source != null and time_stop_state.time_stop_source.active
        == true and time_stop_state.time_stop_source.spell_action_active == true
    metadata:
      category: internal
      visible_to_player: false
    parameters:
    - param_target_state_cb03a83d0b3e524f
    - param_caster_state_5310b8b23a525eea
    - param_lasting_state_7bff8d20c3cf7d0f

sylvia_gm_runtime:
  format: 1
  state_namespace: pkg
tools:
  record_srd_creature_relationship:
    description: Record the scene's creature relationship used by hostility and witnessed-ally
      consequences.
    effects:
    - require:
        condition: _actor_state_id != _toward_state_id
        error: Record a relationship toward another creature.
    - set:
        field: actor_state.attitudes
        value: {}
      condition: actor_state.attitudes == null
    - set:
        field: actor_state.attitudes.{_toward_state_id}
        value: attitude
    - set:
        field: _relationship_allies
        value: []
    - set:
        field: _relationship_old_allies
        value: []
    - set:
        field: _relationship_old_allies
        value: actor_state.ally_state_ids
      condition: actor_state.ally_state_ids != null
    - for_each:
        collection: _relationship_old_allies
        as: _relationship_ally
        do:
        - list_push:
            list: _relationship_allies
            value: _relationship_ally
          condition: _relationship_ally != _toward_state_id
    - list_push:
        list: _relationship_allies
        value: _toward_state_id
      condition: is_ally == true
    - set:
        field: actor_state.ally_state_ids
        value: _relationship_allies
    - set:
        field: time_stop_state.time_stop_source.spell_action_active
        value: false
      condition: time_stop_state.time_stop_source != null
    - call: finalize_srd_time_stop
      condition: time_stop_state.time_stop_source != null and time_stop_state.time_stop_source.ending
        == true
    metadata:
      category: social
      result_card:
        version: 1
        footprint: inline
        title: Relationship recorded
        summary:
        - label: Recorded attitude
          value:
            path: parameters.attitude
        - label: Ally recorded
          value:
            path: parameters.is_ally
        details:
        - label: Creature ID
          value:
            path: parameters.actor_state
        - label: Toward creature ID
          value:
            path: parameters.toward_state
    parameters:
    - param_actor_state_d3c054b169a46c77
    - param_toward_state_0a12ca7c909a8762
    - name: attitude
      type: enum
      enum_values:
      - hostile
      - indifferent
      - friendly
    - name: is_ally
      type: boolean
      required: false
      default: false
    - param_time_stop_state_ffde41c75687f2dd

    required: false

sylvia_gm_runtime:
  format: 1
  state_namespace: pkg
tools:
  observe_srd_time_stop_movement:
    effects:
    - set:
        field: _time_stop_move_ended
        value: false
    - condition: lasting_state.time_stop_source != null and lasting_state.time_stop_source.active
        == true and (subject_id == lasting_state.time_stop_source.caster or subject_id
        == lasting_state.time_stop_source.scene_id)
      on_true:
      - call: srd_information_scene_entity
        params:
          subject: '{subject_id}'
        export_context:
          _info_scene_entity: _info_scene_entity
          _info_position: _info_position
      - call: measure_srd_information_distance
        params:
          start: '{lasting_state.time_stop_source.origin}'
          end: '{_info_position}'
        export_context:
          _time_stop_distance: _scene_distance
      - condition: _info_scene_entity.metadata.plane != lasting_state.time_stop_source.plane
          or _time_stop_distance > 1000
        on_true:
        - set:
            field: lasting_state.time_stop_source.active
            value: false
        - set:
            field: lasting_state.time_stop_source.ending
            value: true
        - set:
            field: lasting_state.time_stop_source.end_reason
            value: '''departure'''
        - set:
            field: _time_stop_move_ended
            value: true
    metadata:
      category: internal
      visible_to_player: false
    parameters:
    - param_subject_id_815d4c4775e0486e
    - param_lasting_state_7bff8d20c3cf7d0f
  resolve_srd_form_condition_immunity:
    effects:
    - set:
        field: target_state.form_body_suppressed_blinded
        value: '''blinded'' in target_state.form_body_condition_immunities'
    - set:
        field: target_state.timed_condition_unowned_blinded

    - set:

    - set:
        field: target_state.form_body_suppressed_deafened
        value: '''deafened'' in target_state.form_body_condition_immunities'
    - set:
        field: target_state.timed_condition_unowned_deafened
        value: true
      condition: '''deafened'' in target_state.conditions and target_state.timed_condition_deafened
        != true and target_state.turn_effect_deafened != true'
    - set:
        field: target_state.form_body_suppressed_frightened
        value: '''frightened'' in target_state.form_body_condition_immunities'
    - set:
        field: target_state.timed_condition_unowned_frightened

      condition: '''frightened'' in target_state.conditions and target_state.timed_condition_frightened

    - set:
        field: target_state.form_body_suppressed_prone

    - set:

            - call: qualify_srd_guards_wards_web_exemption

                export_context:
                  _body_hit: _body_hit

    - call: format_srd_information_projection
      params:

      export_context:

    - '*'
    - set:

        value: true
    - call: initialize_srd_lite_constants_f68db9f9b129
      export_context: '*'
    - set:
        field: _environment_ids
        value: lasting_state.persistent_spell_area_ids
      condition: lasting_state.has_spell_environments == true
    - for_each:
        collection: _environment_ids
        as: _environment_id
        do:
        - set:
            field: _environment_area
            value: lasting_state.persistent_spell_areas[_environment_id]
        - condition: _environment_area.profile == 'environment' and _environment_area.active
            == true and lasting_state.lasting_tick < _environment_area.expires_tick
          on_true:
          - condition: _environment_id != _environment_area_key and _environment_area.mode
              == 'elemental'
            on_true:
            - set:
                field: _elemental_other_stronger
                value: _environment_area.spell_level > _elemental_selection.spell_level
            - set:
                field: _elemental_other_stronger
                value: _environment_area.save_dc > _elemental_selection.save_dc or
                  (_environment_area.save_dc == _elemental_selection.save_dc and _environment_area.sequence
                  > _elemental_selection.sequence)
              condition: _environment_area.spell_level == _elemental_selection.spell_level
            - condition: _elemental_other_stronger == true
              on_true:
              - call: qualify_srd_elemental_other_effect
                params:
                  target_state: '{_target_state_id}'
                  area_id: '{_environment_id}'
                  timing: '{timing}'
                export_context:

              - set:

                condition: _elemental_other_effect == true

meta:
  id: mutation-case
tools:
  retire_srd_gate_portal:
    effects:
    - set:
        field: _gate_sources
        value: []
    - set:
        field: _gate_sources
        value: lasting_state.gate_sources
      condition: lasting_state.gate_sources != null
    - set:
        field: _gate_source
        value: null
    - for_each:
        collection: _gate_sources
        as: _gate_candidate
        do:
        - condition: _gate_candidate.id == source_id
          on_true:
          - require:
              condition: _gate_source == null
              error: The actual Gate source identity is ambiguous.
          - set:
              field: _gate_source
              value: _gate_candidate
    - require:
        condition: _gate_source != null and _gate_source.spell == 'gate'
        error: Select one actual retained Gate source.
    - call: srd_information_scene_entity
      params:
        subject: '{object_id}'
      export_context:
        _info_scene_entity: _info_scene_entity
        _info_position: _info_position
    - require:
        condition: _info_scene_entity.id == object_id and _info_scene_entity.metadata.participant_ref
          == null
        error: An object target must be an actual non-creature scene ID.
    - set:
        field: _object_scene
        value: _info_scene_entity
    - require:
        condition: _object_scene.metadata.gate_portal.source_id == source_id and _object_scene.metadata.gate_portal.cast_id
          == _gate_source.cast_id and _object_scene.metadata.gate_portal.created_tick
          == _gate_source.created_tick and (_object_scene.id == _gate_source.near_id
          or _object_scene.id == _gate_source.far_id)
        error: Retire only this actual Gate's paired body.
    - require:
        condition: lasting_state.spatial_scene != null
        error: This operation needs the admitted spatial scene.
    - require:
        condition: lasting_state.spatial_scene.map.grid.unit == 'ft'
        error: SRD scene distances use feet.
    - spatial_query:
        scene: state.spatial_scene
        operation: snapshot
      store_as: _info_snapshot
    - set:
        field: _world_changes
        value:
          gate_retired_tick: lasting_state.lasting_tick
    - set:
        field: _world_object_marker
        value:
          is_object: false
    - set:
        field: _world_changes
        value: merge(_world_changes, _world_object_marker)
    - set:

meta:

tools:
  read_srd_lifetime_mirage_source:
    effects:
    - set:
        field: _lifetime_record
        value: null
    - require:
        condition: lasting_state.mirage_sources != null and source_id in lasting_state.mirage_sources
        error: Select an actual retained mirage source.
    - set:
        field: _lifetime_record
        value: lasting_state.mirage_sources[source_id]
    - set:
        field: _lifetime_active
        value: _lifetime_record.installed == true and (_lifetime_record.permanent
          == true or lasting_state.lasting_tick < _lifetime_record.expires_tick)
    metadata:
      category: internal
      visible_to_player: false
    parameters:
    - param_lasting_state_7bff8d20c3cf7d0f

  read_srd_lite_public_spell_anchor:
    effects:
    - set:
        field: _visual_anchor_known
        value: false
    - set:
        field: _visual_anchor_position
        value: null
    - set:
        field: _visual_anchor_id
        value: null
    - set:
        field: _visual_anchor_count
        value: 0
    - call: format_srd_information_projection
      params:
        message: '{subject}'
      export_context:
        _visual_anchor_subject: _info_projection_message
    - set:
        field: _visual_anchor_rows
        value: lasting_state.spatial_scene.entities
    - for_each:
        collection: _visual_anchor_rows
        as: _visual_anchor_row
        do:
        - condition: _visual_anchor_row.active == true and (_visual_anchor_row.id
            == _visual_anchor_subject or _visual_anchor_row.metadata.participant_ref
            == _visual_anchor_subject)
          on_true:
          - set:
              field: _visual_anchor_count
              value: _visual_anchor_count + 1
          - set:
              field: _visual_anchor_id
              value: _visual_anchor_row.id
          - set:
              field: _visual_anchor_position
              value: _visual_anchor_row.position
          - set:
              field: _visual_anchor_player
              value: _visual_anchor_row.metadata.player
          - condition: _visual_anchor_player != null and _visual_anchor_player.label
              != null and _visual_anchor_player.kind != null
            on_true:
            - set:
                field: _visual_anchor_keys
                value:
                - '''label'''
                - '''kind'''
                - '''state'''
                - '''stance'''
                - '''side'''
                - '''color'''
                - '''icon'''
                - '''interactive'''
                - '''height_label'''
                - '''material_label'''
            - set:
                field: _visual_anchor_key_count
                value: 0
            - for_each:
                collection: _visual_anchor_keys
                as: _visual_anchor_key
                do:
                - condition: _visual_anchor_key in _visual_anchor_player
                  on_true:
                  - set:
                      field: _visual_anchor_key_count
                      value: _visual_anchor_key_count + 1
            - set:
                field: _visual_anchor_known
                value: len(_visual_anchor_player) == _visual_anchor_key_count and
                  _visual_anchor_player.label != '' and _visual_anchor_player.kind
                  != '' and len(_visual_anchor_player.label) <= 256 and len(_visual_anchor_player.kind)
                  <= 64
    - require:
        condition: _visual_anchor_count <= 1
        error: Resolve the actual duplicate spell-anchor body.
    metadata:
      category: internal
      visible_to_player: false
    parameters:
    - param_subject_3f9e3ffc3bfe8ffd

sylvia_gm_runtime:
  format: 1
  state_namespace: pkg
tools:
  read_srd_passive_perception:
    description: Calculate actual Passive Perception from the supplied base and active
      Enthrall penalty.
    pre_conditions:
    - condition: target_state.memory_unaware != true
      error: An unaware memory subject cannot notice surrounding stimuli.
    effects:
    - call: refresh_srd_control_actor_facts
      params:
        target_state: '{_target_state_id}'
    - set:
        field: _control_base_passive
        value: base_passive_perception
    - set:
        field: _control_base_passive
        value: target_state.base_passive_perception
      condition: target_state.base_passive_perception != null
    - set:
        field: _passive_perception
        value: _control_base_passive
    - set:
        field: _passive_perception
        value: _control_base_passive - target_state.control_enthrall_penalty
      condition: target_state.control_enthrall_penalty != null
    - set:
        field: target_state.last_passive_perception
        value: _passive_perception
    metadata:
      category: combat
      visible_to_player: true
      result_card:
        version: 1
        footprint: inline
        title: Passive Perception
        summary:
        - label: Score
          value:
            path: context._passive_perception
        details:
        - label: Base
          value:
            path: context._control_base_passive
    parameters:
    - param_target_state_cb03a83d0b3e524f
    - name: base_passive_perception
      type: integer
      required: false
      default: 10
  record_srd_deceased_body_internal:
    pre_conditions:
    - condition: target_state.is_alive == false
      error: Body facts require a dead creature.
    effects:
    - set:
        field: lasting_state.lasting_tick
        value: 0
      condition: lasting_state.lasting_tick == null
    - require:
        condition: death_tick <= lasting_state.lasting_tick
        error: Death cannot be in the future.
    - condition: target_state.death_tick == null
      on_true:
      - set:
          field: target_state.death_tick
          value: death_tick
      - set:
          field: target_state.death_creature_type
          value: target_state.creature_type
      - set:
          field: target_state.death_was_undead
          value: target_state.creature_type == 'undead'
      - set:
          field: target_state.death_protected_ticks
          value: 0
      - set:
          field: target_state.death_protection_last_tick
          value: death_tick
      - set:
          field: target_state.attuned_items
          value: []
      - condition: target_state.cursed_items != null
        on_true:
        - set:
            field: _dead_items
            value: target_state.cursed_items
        - set:
            field: _dead_items_kept
            value: []
        - set:
            field: _dead_attunement
            value:
              attuned: false
        - for_each:
            collection: _dead_items
            as: _dead_item
            do:
            - list_push:
                list: _dead_items_kept
                value: merge(_dead_item, _dead_attunement)
        - set:
            field: target_state.cursed_items
            value: _dead_items_kept
    - set:
        field: target_state.death_old_age
        value: old_age
    - set:
        field: target_state.soul_willing
        value: soul_willing
    - set: !!set
        1: null
        2: null
    - set:
        field: target_state.vital_parts_present
        value: vital_parts_present
    - set:
        value: living_creature_type
        do: target_state.living_creature_type
    - set:
        field: target_state.deceased_name
        value: name
    metadata:
      category: internal
      visible_to_player: false
    parameters:
    - param_target_state_cb03a83d0b3e524f

    effects:
    - require:
        condition: (spell == 'maze' and slot_level >= 8 and len(targets) == 1) or
          (spell == 'banishment' and len(targets) >= 1 and len(targets) <= slot_level
          - 3)

      - set:

          value: []
      - set:
          field: _rider_collection_1
          value: lasting_state.turn_effects
      - for_each:
          collection: _rider_collection_1
          as: _rider_retire_effect
          do:
          - condition: (_rider_retire_effect.kind == 'attack_rider_spell' and _rider_retire_effect.source_id
              == source_id) or (_rider_retire_effect.kind == 'illumination_spell'
              and _rider_retire_effect.rider_source_id == source_id)
            on_true: []
            on_false:
            - list_push:
                list: _rider_effect_keep
                value: _rider_retire_effect
      - set:
          field: lasting_state.turn_effects
          value: _rider_effect_keep
      - call: unlink_srd_attack_rider_target
        params:
          target_state: '{_rider_retire.target}'

      - set:
          field: _rider_owned_keep

      - set:

      - for_each:

      - set:

          value: _rider_owned_keep
      - set:

      - set:

      - for_each:

          do:

              value: _rider_keep_id

    effects:

    - condition: lasting_state.has_wall_of_fire == true
      on_true:

              == true and lasting_state.lasting_tick < _environment_area.expires_tick
            on_true:
            - condition: _environment_area.mode == 'wall_fire' and _environment_area.plane
                == plane
              on_true:
              - call: qualify_srd_wall_of_fire_source
                params:
                  caster_state: '{_environment_area.caster}'
                  area_id: '{_environment_id}'
                export_context:
                  _sphere_source_current: _sphere_source_current
              - condition: _sphere_source_current == true
                on_true:
                - condition: _environment_area.volume.kind == 'annulus'
                  on_true:
                  - call: resolve_srd_wall_of_fire_ring_opacity
                    params:
                      area_id: '{_environment_id}'
                      start: '{start}'
                      end: '{end}'
                      plane: '{plane}'
                    export_context:
                      _ring_fire_opaque: _ring_fire_opaque
                  - set:

                      end: '{end}'

                      bogus: _segment_exit
                  - condition: _segment_hit == true

                        - start[1] + (end[1] - start[1]) * (_segment_entry + _segment_exit)

                        and _fire_opaque_midpoint[1] < _environment_area.volume.max[1]

      - set:
          field: _xd_saved
          value: []
      - set:

          value: lasting_state.extradimensional_sources

      error: A dead caster cannot gain Temporary Hit Points from this spell.
    - condition: family == 'self_temporary_hit_points' and base_level == 1 and base_dice
        == 2 and temporary_hit_point_die == 'd4' and flat_bonus == 4 and temporary_hit_points_per_slot_level
        == 5 and range_kind == 'self' and range_feet == 0

    effects:

    - set:

    - set:

        value: caster_state.temp_hp
    - dice:
        expression: '{base_dice}{temporary_hit_point_die}'
      store_as: _spell_temporary_hit_point_roll
    - set:
        field: _spell_temporary_hit_point_amount
        condition: _spell_temporary_hit_point_roll.total + flat_bonus + (slot_level
          - base_level) * temporary_hit_points_per_slot_level
    - set:
        field: _spell_temporary_hit_point_choice

    - request_choice:
        choice_id: temporary-hit-point-replacement

        - id: keep_existing
          label: Keep existing {caster_state.temp_hp}
        - id: take_new
          label: Take new {_spell_temporary_hit_point_amount}
      store_as: _spell_temporary_hit_point_choice
      condition: caster_state.temp_hp > 0
    - set:
        field: caster_state.temp_hp
        value: _spell_temporary_hit_point_amount

        'take_new'
    - set:

        value: '''Kept existing temporary HP'''
      condition: _spell_temporary_hit_point_choice == 'keep_existing'

              == 'wall_fire' and (_web_observed_fire.volume.kind == 'box' or _web_observed_fire.volume.kind
              == 'annulus')
            on_true:
            - call: expose_srd_retained_web_fire

                fire_area_id: '{_web_observed_fire_id}'
                strict_request: false
    - call: observe_srd_retained_web_flames

meta:
  id: mutation-case
tools:
  end_srd_destroyed_magic_jar_container:
    effects:
    - call: format_srd_information_projection
      params:
        message: '{object_id}'
      export_context:
        _info_projection_message: _info_projection_message
    - set:
        field: _jar_destroyed_object_id
        value: _info_projection_message
    - set:
        field: _jar_destroyed_container
        value: null
    - set:
        field: _jar_scene_rows
        value: lasting_state.spatial_scene.entities
    - for_each:
        collection: _jar_scene_rows
        as: _jar_scene_row
        do:
        - condition: _jar_scene_row.id == _jar_destroyed_object_id
          on_true:
          - require:
              condition: _jar_destroyed_container == null
              error: Physical scene identity is ambiguous.
          - set:
              field: _jar_destroyed_container
              value: _jar_scene_row
    - require:
        condition: _jar_destroyed_container != null
        error: The exact physical scene subject is unavailable.
    - require:
        condition: _jar_destroyed_container.metadata.srd_spell_object.hp == 0 and
          _jar_destroyed_container.metadata.srd_spell_object.destroyed == true
        error: Container destruction must already be persisted by the actual object
          owner.
    - set:
        field: _jar_destroyed_container_source
        value: null
    - set:
        field: _jar_destroyed_container_source
        value: _jar_destroyed_container.metadata.srd_magic_jar
      condition: _jar_destroyed_container.metadata.srd_magic_jar != null
    - condition: _jar_destroyed_container_source != null and _jar_destroyed_container_source.installed
        == true
      on_true:
      - require:
          condition: _jar_destroyed_container_source.kind == 'magic_jar' and _jar_destroyed_container_source.spell
            == 'magic_jar' and _jar_destroyed_container_source.container == _jar_destroyed_object_id
          error: Only the source actually installed on this destroyed container may
            end.
      - call: end_srd_magic_jar_source
        params:
          caster_state: '{_jar_destroyed_container_source.caster}'
          reason: container_destroyed
    metadata:
      category: internal
      visible_to_player: false
    parameters:
    - param_object_id_2b5cfd2dd4c129d5
    - param_lasting_state_7bff8d20c3cf7d0f

  id: x
tools:
  apply_srd_once_per_turn_damage_reduction:
    effects:
    - set:
        field: _damage_after_reduction
        value: damage_amount
    - condition: target_state.damage_reduction_used_tick != lasting_state.lasting_tick
      on_true:
      - dice:
          expression: '{reduction_die}'
        store_as: _damage_reduction_roll
      - set:
          field: _damage_after_reduction
          value: max(0, damage_amount - _damage_reduction_roll.total)
      - set:
          field: target_state.damage_reduction_used_tick
          value: lasting_state.lasting_tick
    narrative:
      on_success: The bounded damage reduction is applied at most once this turn.
      on_failure: Damage reduction cannot be resolved.
    parameters:
    - param_target_state_cb03a83d0b3e524f
    - param_lasting_state_a0a632fef1e150e2
    - name: damage_amount
      type: integer
      minimum: 1
    - name: reduction_die
      type: enum
      enum_values:
      - d4
    condition:
      category: internal
      visible_to_player: false

sylvia_gm_runtime:
  format: 1
  state_namespace: pkg
tools:
  retire_srd_attack_rider_source:
    effects:
    - set:
        field: _rider_retire
        value: null
    - set:
        field: _rider_retire
        value: lasting_state.attack_rider_sources[source_id]
      condition: lasting_state.attack_rider_sources != null and source_id in lasting_state.attack_rider_sources
    - condition: _rider_retire != null and _rider_retire.installed == true
      on_true:
      - require:
          condition: _rider_retire.caster == _caster_state_id
          error: Retire only this source's actual caster.
      - set:
          field: lasting_state.attack_rider_sources.{source_id}.installed
          value: false
      - call: retire_srd_ensnaring_condition
        params:
          source_id: '{source_id}'
        condition: _rider_retire.spell == 'ensnaring_strike'
      - set:
          field: _rider_effect_keep
          value: []
      - set:
          field: _rider_collection_1
          value: lasting_state.turn_effects
      - for_each:
          collection: _rider_collection_1
          as: _rider_retire_effect
          do:
          - condition: (_rider_retire_effect.kind == 'attack_rider_spell' and _rider_retire_effect.source_id
              == source_id) or (_rider_retire_effect.kind == 'illumination_spell'
              and _rider_retire_effect.rider_source_id == source_id)
            on_true: []
            on_false:
            - list_push:
                list: _rider_effect_keep
                value: _rider_retire_effect
      - set:
          field: lasting_state.turn_effects
          value: _rider_effect_keep
      - call: unlink_srd_attack_rider_target
        params:
          target_state: '{_rider_retire.target}'
          source_id: '{source_id}'
      - set:
          field: _rider_owned_keep
          value: []
      - set:
          field: _rider_collection_2
          value: caster_state.attack_rider_owned_ids
      - for_each:
          collection: _rider_collection_2
          as: _rider_keep_id
          do:
          - list_push:
              list: _rider_owned_keep
              value: _rider_keep_id
            condition: _rider_keep_id != source_id
      - set:
          field: caster_state.attack_rider_owned_ids
          value: _rider_owned_keep
      - set:
          field: caster_state.has_attack_rider_owned_sources
          value: len(_rider_owned_keep) > 0
      - set:
          field: _rider_active_keep
          value: []
      - set:
          field: _rider_collection_3
          value: lasting_state.attack_rider_source_ids
      - for_each:
          collection: _rider_collection_3
          as: _rider_keep_id
          do:
          - list_push:
              list: _rider_active_keep
              value: _rider_keep_id
            condition: _rider_keep_id != source_id
      - set:
          field: lasting_state.attack_rider_source_ids
          value: _rider_active_keep
      - set:
          field: lasting_state.has_attack_rider_spells
          value: len(_rider_active_keep) > 0
      - call: sync_srd_illumination_invisible
        params:
          actor_state: '{_rider_retire.target}'
        condition: _rider_retire.spell == 'shining_smite'
    metadata:
      category: internal
      visible_to_player: false
    parameters:

sylvia_gm_runtime:
  format: 1
  state_namespace: pkg
tools:
  settle_srd_truth_zone_event:
    effects:
    - set:
        field: _truth_source
        value: lasting_state.timed_condition_sources[source_id]
    - condition: _truth_source.installed == true and _truth_source.dialogue_profile
        == 'truth_zone' and target_state.is_alive == true
      on_true:
      - call: resolve_srd_truth_zone_geometry
        params:
          target_state: '{_target_state_id}'
          source_id: '{source_id}'
        export_context:
          _truth_inside: _truth_inside
      - condition: _truth_inside == true or (event == 'entry' and crossed == true)
        on_true:
        - set:
            field: _truth_clock
            value: '''exploration'''
        - set:
            field: _truth_turn
            value: lasting_state.lasting_tick // 2
        - condition: combat.turn_active == true
          on_true:
          - set:
              field: _truth_clock
              value: '''combat'''
          - set:
              field: _truth_turn
              value: combat.turn_sequence
        - set:
            field: _truth_previous
            value: null
        - set:
            field: _truth_previous
            value: _truth_source.truth_receipts[event][_target_state_id]
          condition: _target_state_id in _truth_source.truth_receipts[event]
        - condition: _truth_previous == null or _truth_previous.clock != _truth_clock
            or _truth_previous.turn != _truth_turn
          on_true:
          - set:
              field: lasting_state.timed_condition_sources.{source_id}.truth_receipts.{event}.{_target_state_id}
              value:
                clock: _truth_clock
                turn: _truth_turn
          - call: d20_test
            params:
              actor_state: '{_target_state_id}'
              ability: charisma
              kind: saving_throw
              ability_modifier: '{target_state.saving_throw_modifiers.charisma}'
              proficiency_bonus: 0
              proficiency_factor: none
              circumstantial_modifier: 0
              target_number: '{_truth_source.save_dc}'
              advantage: false
              disadvantage: false
            export_context:
              _d20_test: _d20_test
              _outcome: _outcome
          - set:
              field: _truth_failed
              value: _truth_source.truth_failed_ids
          - condition: _outcome != 'success' and _target_state_id not in _truth_failed
            on_true:
            - list_push:
                list: _truth_failed
                value: _target_state_id
            - set:
                field: lasting_state.timed_condition_sources.{source_id}.truth_failed_ids
                value: _truth_failed
          - set:
              field: _truth_outcomes
              value: _truth_source.truth_outcomes
          - list_push:
              list: _truth_outcomes
              value:
                target: _target_state_id
                roll: _d20_test
                outcome: _outcome
                event: event
                clock: _truth_clock
                turn: _truth_turn
                tick: lasting_state.lasting_tick
          - set:
              field: lasting_state.timed_condition_sources.{source_id}.truth_outcomes
              value: _truth_outcomes
          - set:
              field: lasting_state.persistent_spell_areas.{_truth_source.truth_area_id}.truth_outcomes
              value: _truth_outcomes
          - set:
              field: target_state.truth_zone_aware
              value: true
    metadata:
      category: internal
      visible_to_player: false
    parameters:
    - param_target_state_cb03a83d0b3e524f
    - param_lasting_state_7bff8d20c3cf7d0f
    - param_source_id_da8b650d256d2fc5
    - name: event
      type: enum
      enum_values:
      - entry
      - start
    - name: crossed
      type: boolean
      required: false
      default: false
      model_hidden: true
  initialize_srd_lite_constants_e14187808045:
