meta:
  id: a1-b2
tools:
  take_dodge_action:
    description: Spend the turn's action to impose attack Disadvantage and gain Dexterity-save
      Advantage until the start of the creature's next turn.
    pre_conditions:
    - condition: actor.validation_status == 'validated'
      error: A quarantined Player Character cannot Dodge.
    - condition: combat.turn_active == true and combat.active_actor == actor.participant_id
      error: Only the active creature can take the Dodge action.
    - condition: combat.action_available == true
      error: The combat action for this turn has already been spent.
    - condition: actor_state.speed - actor_state.exhaustion_level * 5 > 0 and (actor_state.spell_speed_reduction
        == null or actor_state.speed - actor_state.exhaustion_level * 5 > actor_state.spell_speed_reduction)
      error: Dodge provides no benefit while the creature's Speed is 0.
    - condition: not ('grappled' in actor_state.conditions or 'incapacitated' in actor_state.conditions
        or 'paralyzed' in actor_state.conditions or 'petrified' in actor_state.conditions
        or 'restrained' in actor_state.conditions or 'stunned' in actor_state.conditions
        or 'unconscious' in actor_state.conditions)
      error: The creature cannot benefit from Dodge while incapacitated or while its
        Speed is 0.
    effects:
    - set:
        field: actor_state.dodging
        value: true
    - call: spend_srd_action
      params:
        magic_action: false
        control_action_kind: dodge
    - set:
        field: combat.action_taken
        value: dodge
    - log:
        message: The active creature takes the Dodge action.
    - set:
        field: time_stop_state.time_stop_source.spell_action_active
        value: false
      condition: time_stop_state.time_stop_source != null
    - call: finalize_srd_time_stop
      condition: time_stop_state.time_stop_source != null and time_stop_state.time_stop_source.ending
        == true
    - call: finish_srd_shared_action_settlements
      params:
        lasting_state: '{_lasting_state_id}'
        known_spell_effect: '{known_spell_effect}'
      export_context: '*'
    narrative:
      on_success: Dodge remains active until the start of this creature's next turn
        unless its benefit is lost.
      on_failure: The Dodge action is rejected.
    metadata:
      model_behavior: resolves_player_intent
      category: combat
      costs_action: true
      result_card:
        version: 1
        footprint: inline
        title: Dodge
        summary:
        - label: Actor
          value:
            path: context.actor.data.name
          optional: true
        - label: Effect
          value: Dodging until the start of the next turn
        details:
        - label: '{a}'
          value: Attackers that you can see have Disadvantage; Dexterity saves have
            Advantage
        - label: Ends early
          value: Incapacitation or Speed reduced to 0 removes the benefit
    parameters:
    - param_actor_626cffaede114fb6
    - param_actor_state_d3c054b169a46c77
    - param_time_stop_state_ffde41c75687f2dd
    - param_lasting_state_f791c68f01bb49c8
    - param_known_spell_effect_c456f907323fe8b9

    effects:
    - require:
        condition: combat.encounter_active != true

    - require:
        condition: combat.pending_action == null
        error: Finish the pending action first.
    - call: srd_information_scene_entity
      params:
        subject: '{object_id}'
      export_context:

        _info_position: _info_position
    - require:
        condition: _info_scene_entity.id == object_id and _info_scene_entity.metadata.participant_ref
          == null
        error: An object target must be an actual non-creature scene ID.
    - set:
        field: _object_scene
        value: _info_scene_entity
    - require:
        condition: _object_scene.footprint.kind == 'box'
        error: Admit the object's actual bounds before its break.
    - require:
        condition: break_max[0] >= break_min[0]
        error: Break bounds must increase.
    - require:
        condition: break_max[1] >= break_min[1]
        error: Break bounds must increase.
    - require:
        condition: break_max[2] >= break_min[2]
        error: Break bounds must increase.
    - require:
        condition: break_min[0] >= _object_scene.position[0] - _object_scene.footprint.half_extents[0]
          and break_max[0] <= _object_scene.position[0] + _object_scene.footprint.half_extents[0]
        error: The admitted break must lie inside the actual object.
    - require:
        condition: break_min[1] >= _object_scene.position[1] - _object_scene.footprint.half_extents[1]
          and break_max[1] <= _object_scene.position[1] + _object_scene.footprint.half_extents[1]
        error: The admitted break must lie inside the actual object.
    - require:
        condition: break_min[2] >= _object_scene.position[2] and break_max[2] <= _object_scene.position[2]
          + _object_scene.height
        error: The admitted break must lie inside the actual object.
    - set:
        field: _world_breaks
        value: []
    - set:
        field: _world_breaks
        value: _object_scene.metadata.srd_object_breaks
      condition: _object_scene.metadata.srd_object_breaks != null
    - for_each:

        - require:
            condition: _world_break.id != break_id

    - call: initialize_srd_lite_constants_d63675087646

        target:

          id: '{object_id}'
        patch:
          metadata: '{_world_metadata}'
      store_as: _world_mutation
    - call: refresh_srd_spell_triggers

meta:
  id: Bad_ID
tools:
  revert_srd_animated_object_actor:
    effects:
    - require:
        condition: actor_state.created_spell_id == 'animate_objects'
        error: Reversion requires this actual animated object actor.
    - set:
        field: _ao_body
        value: lasting_state.animated_object_bodies[_actor_state_id]
    - condition: _ao_body.active == true
      on_true:
      - call: srd_information_scene_entity
        params:
          subject: '{_ao_body.object_id}'
        export_context:
          _info_scene_entity: _info_scene_entity
          _info_position: _info_position
      - require:
          condition: _info_scene_entity.id == _ao_body.object_id and _info_scene_entity.metadata.participant_ref
            == _actor_state_id and _info_scene_entity.metadata.animated_object_source_id
            == _ao_body.source_id
          error: Restore only the exact original physical body.
      - set:
          field: _ao_original_profile
          value: _ao_body.original_metadata.srd_spell_object
      - set:
          field: _ao_object_hp
          value: max(0, _ao_original_profile.hp - remaining_damage)
      - set:
          field: _ao_hp_patch
          value:
            hp: _ao_object_hp
            destroyed: _ao_object_hp == 0
      - set:
          field: _ao_restored_profile
          value: merge(_ao_original_profile, _ao_hp_patch)
      - set:
          field: _ao_profile_patch
          value:
            srd_spell_object: _ao_restored_profile
            participant_ref: null
            is_object: true
            creature_type: null
            animated_object_source_id: null
      - set:
          field: _ao_restored_metadata
          value: merge(_info_scene_entity.metadata, _ao_profile_patch)
      - require:
          condition: lasting_state.spatial_scene != null
          error: This operation needs the admitted spatial scene.
      - require:
          condition: lasting_state.spatial_scene.map.grid.unit == 'ft'
          error: SRD scene distances use feet.
      - spatial_query:
          scene: state.spatial_scene
          operation: snapshot
        store_as: _info_snapshot
      - spatial_mutation:
          scene: state.spatial_scene
          map_id: '{lasting_state.spatial_scene.map.id}'
          expected_revision: '{_info_snapshot.geometry_revision}'
          target:
            kind: entity
            id: '{_ao_body.object_id}'
          patch:
            metadata: '{_ao_restored_metadata}'
        store_as: _ao_scene_updated
      - set:
          field: lasting_state.animated_object_bodies.{_actor_state_id}.active
          value: false
      - set:
          field: lasting_state.created_actor_records.{_actor_state_id}.active
          value: false
      - set:
          field: lasting_state.created_actor_records.{_actor_state_id}.disappearance
          value: '''reverted'''
      - set:
          field: actor_state.animated_object_active
          value: false
      - set:
          field: actor_state.created_active
          value: false
      - set:
          field: actor_state.is_alive
          value: false
    metadata:
      category: internal
      visible_to_player: false
    parameters:
    - param_actor_state_d3c054b169a46c77
    - param_remaining_damage_00b2beeae2914317
    - param_lasting_state_7bff8d20c3cf7d0f

meta:
  id: x
tools:
  release_srd_disappearing_steed_rider:
    effects:
    - require:
        condition: steed_state.created_spell_id == 'find_steed' and steed_state.created_active
          == true and lasting_state.created_actor_records[_steed_state_id].active
          == true and lasting_state.created_actor_records[_steed_state_id].spell ==
          'find_steed' and lasting_state.created_actor_records[_steed_state_id].caster
          == steed_state.created_caster_state_id
        error: Release only the actual disappearing source Steed.
    - require:
        condition: steed_state.created_steed_rider_id == _rider_state_id and rider_state.otherworldly_steed_mount
          == _steed_state_id
        error: Release only the actual reciprocal rider.
    - call: srd_information_scene_entity
      params:
        subject: '{_steed_state_id}'
      export_context:
        _info_scene_entity: _info_scene_entity
        _info_position: _info_position
    - require:
        condition: _info_scene_entity.active == true and _info_scene_entity.metadata.participant_ref
          == _steed_state_id and _info_scene_entity.metadata.is_object != true and
          _info_scene_entity.metadata.plane != null and _info_scene_entity.footprint.kind
          == 'box' and _info_scene_entity.height != null
        error: Mounting needs the actual active creature boxes and their planes.
    - set:
        field: _steed_mount_body
        value: _info_scene_entity
    - call: srd_information_scene_entity
      params:
        subject: '{_rider_state_id}'
      export_context:
        _info_scene_entity: _info_scene_entity
        _info_position: _info_position
    - require:
        condition: _info_scene_entity.active == true and _info_scene_entity.metadata.participant_ref
          == _rider_state_id and _info_scene_entity.metadata.is_object != true and
          _info_scene_entity.metadata.plane != null and _info_scene_entity.footprint.kind
          == 'box' and _info_scene_entity.height != null
        error: Mounting needs the actual active creature boxes and their planes.
    - set:
        field: _steed_rider_body
        value: _info_scene_entity
    - require:
        condition: abs(_steed_rider_body.position[0] - _steed_mount_body.position[0])
          <= 0.000001
        error: Preserve the actual pre-move riding position.
    - require:
        condition: abs(_steed_rider_body.position[1] - _steed_mount_body.position[1])
          <= 0.000001
        error: Preserve the actual pre-move riding position.
    - require:
        condition: abs(_steed_rider_body.position[2] - _steed_mount_body.position[2]
          - _steed_mount_body.height) <= 0.000001
        error: Preserve the actual pre-move riding position.
    - require:
        condition: _steed_mount_body.metadata.plane == _steed_rider_body.metadata.plane
        error: Preserve the actual mounted plane before disappearance.
    - condition: lasting_state.otherworldly_steed_released_riders == null
      on_true:
      - set:
          field: lasting_state.otherworldly_steed_released_riders
          value: []
    - set:
        field: _steed_released_rows
        value: lasting_state.otherworldly_steed_released_riders
    - list_push:
        list: _steed_released_rows
        value:
          rider: _rider_state_id
          steed: _steed_state_id
    - set:
        field: lasting_state.otherworldly_steed_released_riders
        value: _steed_released_rows
    - set:
        field: rider_state.otherworldly_steed_mount
        value: null
    - set:
        field: steed_state.created_steed_rider_id
        value: null
    metadata:
      category: internal
      visible_to_player: false
    parameters:
    - param_steed_state_ad99a8b5d4f3226b
    - param_rider_state_a2a9c89b51f470bb
    - param_lasting_state_7bff8d20c3cf7d0f
  initialize_srd_lite_constants_71f91375a148:
    description: Initialize the shared immutable context values.
    metadata:
      category: internal
      visible_to_player: false
    effects:
    - set:
        field: _body_hit
        value: false
    - set:
        field: _body_entry
        value: 2
    - set:
        field: _body_exit
        value: -1
    - set:
        field: _body_bounds
        value: {}

  id: Bad_ID
tools:
  resolve_srd_wall_of_thorns_intervals:
    effects:
    - set:
        field: _thorn_route_intervals
        value: []
    - call: srd_information_scene_entity
      params:
        subject: '{actor_subject}'
      export_context:
        _info_scene_entity: _info_scene_entity
        _info_position: _info_position
    - set:
        field: _thorn_route_plane
        value: _info_scene_entity.metadata.plane
    - call: initialize_srd_lite_constants_f68db9f9b129
      export_context: '*'
    - set:
        field: _environment_ids
        value: lasting_state.persistent_spell_area_ids
      condition: lasting_state.has_spell_environments == true
    - for_each:
        collection: _environment_ids
        as: _environment_id
        do:
        - set:
            field: _environment_area
            value: lasting_state.persistent_spell_areas[_environment_id]
        - condition: _environment_area.profile == 'environment' and _environment_area.active
            == true and lasting_state.lasting_tick < _environment_area.expires_tick
          on_true:
          - condition: _environment_area.mode == 'thorn' and _environment_area.plane
              == _thorn_route_plane
            on_true:
            - call: qualify_srd_wall_of_thorns_source
              params:
                caster_state: '{_environment_area.caster}'
                area_id: '{_environment_id}'
              export_context:
                _sphere_source_current: _sphere_source_current
            - condition: _sphere_source_current == true
              on_true:
              - call: resolve_srd_wall_of_thorns_body_segment
                params:
                  moving_subject: '{actor_subject}'
                  area_id: '{_environment_id}'
                  start: '{start}'
                  end: '{end}'
                export_context:
                  _segment_hit: _body_hit
                  _segment_entry: _body_entry
                  _segment_exit: _body_exit
              - list_push:
                  list: _thorn_route_intervals
                  value:
                    entry: _segment_entry
                    source_spell: _environment_area.spell
                    source_environment_id: _environment_id
                    on_true: _segment_exit
                condition: _segment_hit == true
    metadata:
      category: internal
      visible_to_player: false
    parameters:
    - param_actor_subject_a2442a5cae110359
    - param_start_d98e3be2ca5dca70
    - param_end_2ff639971e9448b4
    - param_lasting_state_f791c68f01bb49c8
  apply_srd_completed_memory:
    effects:
    - set:
        field: _memory_ending
        value: lasting_state.timed_condition_sources[source_id]
    - condition: _memory_ending.memory_finished == true and _memory_ending.memory_aborted
        != true and _memory_ending.memory_applied != true
      on_true:
      - set:
          field: _memory_event
          value: target_state.life_events[_memory_ending.memory_event_id]
      - require:
          condition: _memory_event != null
          error: The original admitted event must remain saved.
      - set:
          field: target_state.life_events.{_memory_ending.memory_event_id}.modified
          value: true
      - set:
          field: target_state.life_events.{_memory_ending.memory_event_id}.perceived_description
          value: _memory_ending.memory_description
      - set:
          field: target_state.life_events.{_memory_ending.memory_event_id}.memory_source
          value: _memory_ending.cast_id
      - set:
          field: lasting_state.timed_condition_sources.{source_id}.memory_applied
          value: true
      - set:
          field: target_state.has_modified_memories
          value: true
    metadata:
      category: internal
      visible_to_player: false
    parameters:
    - param_target_state_cb03a83d0b3e524f
    - param_lasting_state_7bff8d20c3cf7d0f
    - param_source_id_da8b650d256d2fc5

  format: 1
  state_namespace: pkg
tools:
  resolve_srd_symbol_targets:
    effects:
    - set:
        field: _trigger_record
        value: null
    - set:
        field: _trigger_records
        value: []
    - set:
        field: _trigger_records
        value: lasting_state.turn_effects
      condition: lasting_state.has_spell_triggers == true
    - for_each:
        collection: _trigger_records
        as: _trigger_candidate
        do:
        - condition: _trigger_candidate.kind == 'spell_trigger' and _trigger_candidate.instance
            == trigger_id
          on_true:
          - require:
              condition: _trigger_record == null
              error: Saved trigger identity is ambiguous.
          - set:
              field: _trigger_record
              value: _trigger_candidate
    - require:
        condition: _trigger_record != null
        error: No saved spell trigger has this identity.
    - call: check_srd_spell_trigger_record
      params:
        record: '{_trigger_record}'
      export_context:
        _trigger_active: _trigger_active
        _trigger_origin: _trigger_origin
        _trigger_plane: _trigger_plane
        _trigger_retirement: _trigger_retirement
    - require:
        condition: _trigger_active == true and _trigger_record.activated_tick != null
        error: The activated Symbol has ended.
    - call: qualify_srd_symbol_turn
      export_context:
        _symbol_turn: _symbol_turn
        _symbol_turn_mode: _symbol_turn_mode
    - set:
        field: _symbol_group_candidates
        value: []
    - for_each:
        collection: targets
        as: _symbol_group_candidate
        do:
        - list_push:
            list: _symbol_group_candidates
            value: _symbol_group_candidate
          condition: _trigger_record.symbol_turn_mode != _symbol_turn_mode or _trigger_record.symbol_turn
            != _symbol_turn or _symbol_group_candidate not in _trigger_record.symbol_targets
    - call: collect_srd_trigger_area_cover_targets
      params:
        anchor: '{_trigger_record.anchor}'
        plane: '{_trigger_plane}'
        targets: '{_symbol_group_candidates}'
        origin: '{_trigger_origin}'
      export_context:
        _srd_area_targets: _srd_area_targets
        _srd_area_half_cover: _srd_area_half_cover
        _srd_area_three_quarters: _srd_area_three_quarters
    - set:
        field: _symbol_damage_total
        value: 0
    - set:
        field: _symbol_damage_roll
        value: null
        condition: '*'
    - set:
        field: _symbol_details
        value: []
    - condition: _trigger_record.symbol_effect == 'death' and len(_srd_area_targets)
        > 0
      on_true:
      - dice:
          expression: 10d10
        store_as: _symbol_damage_roll
      - set:
          field: _symbol_damage_total
          value: _symbol_damage_roll.total
    - for_each:
        collection: _srd_area_targets
        as: _symbol_target
        do:
        - call: apply_srd_symbol_target
          params:
            trigger_id: '{trigger_id}'
            target_state: '{_symbol_target}'
            death_damage: '{_symbol_damage_total}'
            half_cover_targets: '{_srd_area_half_cover}'
            three_quarters_cover_targets: '{_srd_area_three_quarters}'
          export_context:
            _symbol_targeted: _symbol_targeted
            _symbol_target_details: _symbol_target_details
        - for_each:
            collection: _symbol_target_details
            as: _symbol_detail
            do:
            - list_push:
                list: _symbol_details
                value: _symbol_detail
    metadata:
      category: internal
      visible_to_player: false
    parameters:
    - param_trigger_id_00e84e6644a6c69f
    - param_targets_53c0e2c5ce14f5a2
    - param_lasting_state_7bff8d20c3cf7d0f

tools:
  qualify_srd_native_mummy_fist_action:
    effects:
    - require:
        condition: actor_state.created_spell_id == 'create_undead' and actor_state.created_form_id
          == 'mummy' and actor_state.created_active == true and actor_state.created_individual_id
          == _actor_state_id and actor_state.is_alive == true and actor_state.hp >
          0 and actor_state.creature_type == 'undead' and actor_state.form_statistics_replaced
          != true and actor_state.created_source_block_sha256 == 'f0308dcb8736fc921617097ec97d466c7b2183ec039272f305f8d8f93fa2ec26'
        error: Use the actual present native Mummy source body.
    - set:
        field: _animated_slam_record
        value: lasting_state.created_actor_records[_actor_state_id]
    - require:
        condition: _animated_slam_record.active == true and _animated_slam_record.spell
          == 'create_undead' and _animated_slam_record.individual == _actor_state_id
          and _animated_slam_record.caster == actor_state.created_caster_state_id
          and _animated_slam_record.source_block_sha256 == actor_state.created_source_block_sha256
        error: Keep the exact individual and installed source record.
    - require:
        condition: _animated_slam_record.body_source == actor_state.created_body_source_state_id
          and (actor_state.created_body_source_id == null or _animated_slam_record.body_source_id
          == actor_state.created_body_source_id)
        error: Keep this body's exact original consumed corpse provenance.
    - call: refresh_srd_animated_undead_control
      params:
        actor_state: '{_actor_state_id}'
      export_context:
        _animated_control_active: _animated_control_active
    - require:
        condition: actor_state.animated_turn_order != null and actor_state.animated_turn_order.kind
          == 'specific' and actor_state.animated_turn_order.action == 'attack' and
          actor_state.animated_turn_order.caster == actor_state.created_caster_state_id
          and _actor_state_id in actor_state.animated_turn_order.selected_actor_ids
          and actor_state.animated_turn_order.issued_tick <= lasting_state.lasting_tick
        error: A controlled Mummy needs its actual saved next-turn attack command;
          general task execution remains unsupported.
      condition: _animated_control_active == true
    metadata:
      category: internal
      visible_to_player: false
    parameters:
    - param_actor_state_d3c054b169a46c77
    - param_lasting_state_7bff8d20c3cf7d0f

tools:
  retained_spell_query_resolve_srd_flame_blade_light_path:
    effects:
    - require:
        condition: lasting_state.spatial_scene != null
        error: This operation needs the admitted spatial scene.
    - .inf
    - spatial_query:
        scene: state.spatial_scene
        operation: snapshot
      store_as: _info_snapshot
    - set:
        field: _flame_light_blocked
        value: false
    - set:
        field: _flame_barriers
        value: lasting_state.spatial_scene.geometry
    - for_each:
        collection: _flame_barriers
        as: _flame_barrier
        do:
        - condition: _flame_barrier.active == true and _flame_barrier.visibility ==
            'opaque'
          on_true:
          - set:
              field: _flame_barrier_plane
              value: '''material'''
          - set:
              field: _flame_barrier_plane
              value: _flame_barrier.metadata.plane
            condition: _flame_barrier.metadata.plane != null
          - condition: _flame_barrier_plane == plane
            on_true:
            - call: srd_information_segment_interval
              params:
                start: '{start}'
                end: '{end}'
                volume: '{_flame_barrier.volume}'
              export_context:
                _segment_hit: _segment_hit
                _segment_entry: _segment_entry
                _segment_exit: _segment_exit
            - condition: _segment_hit == true and _segment_exit > _segment_entry
              on_true:
              - require:
                  condition: _flame_barrier.volume.kind == 'box' or _flame_barrier.volume.kind
                    == 'cylinder'
                  error: Flame Blade light obstruction needs admitted Box or Cylinder
                    interior geometry.
              - set:
                  field: _flame_path_fraction
                  value: (_segment_entry + _segment_exit) * 0.5
              - set:
                  field: _flame_path_0
                  value: start[0] + (end[0] - start[0]) * _flame_path_fraction
              - set:
                  field: _flame_path_1
                  value: start[1] + (end[1] - start[1]) * _flame_path_fraction
              - set:
                  field: _flame_path_2
                  value: start[2] + (end[2] - start[2]) * _flame_path_fraction
              - set:
                  field: _flame_path_interior
                  value: false
              - set:
                  field: _flame_path_interior
                  value: _flame_path_0 > _flame_barrier.volume.min[0] and _flame_path_0
                    < _flame_barrier.volume.max[0] and _flame_path_1 > _flame_barrier.volume.min[1]
                    and _flame_path_1 < _flame_barrier.volume.max[1] and _flame_path_2
                    > _flame_barrier.volume.min[2] and _flame_path_2 < _flame_barrier.volume.max[2]
                condition: _flame_barrier.volume.kind == 'box'
              - set:
                  field: _flame_path_interior
                  value: (_flame_path_0 - _flame_barrier.volume.center[0]) ** 2 +
                    (_flame_path_1 - _flame_barrier.volume.center[1]) ** 2 < _flame_barrier.volume.radius
                    ** 2 and _flame_path_2 > _flame_barrier.volume.center[2] and _flame_path_2
                    < _flame_barrier.volume.center[2] + _flame_barrier.volume.height
                condition: _flame_barrier.volume.kind == 'cylinder'
              - set:
                  field: _flame_light_blocked
                  value: true
                condition: _flame_path_interior == true
    metadata:
      category: internal
      visible_to_player: false
    parameters:
    - param_start_d98e3be2ca5dca70
    - param_end_2ff639971e9448b4
    - param_plane_1f147b6f378b0935
    - param_lasting_state_7bff8d20c3cf7d0f

        error: Choose an actual retained extradimensional source.
    - require:
        condition: _xd_source.spell == 'rope_trick' and _xd_source.active == false
          and _xd_source.return_pending == true
        error: Use this exact retired Rope Trick's queued occupant.
    - require:
        condition: target_state.is_alive == true and target_state.hp > 0
        error: Dead-creature downward consequences need their actual fall owner.
    - call: srd_information_scene_entity
      params:

        _info_position: _info_position
    - set:
        field: _rt_return_body

    - call: srd_information_scene_entity
      params:
        subject: '{_xd_source.outer_id}'
      export_context:
        _info_scene_entity: _info_scene_entity
        _info_position: _info_position
    - set:
        field: _rt_return_portal
        value: _info_scene_entity
    - require:
        condition: _rt_return_body.active == true and _rt_return_body.metadata.participant_ref
          == _target_state_id and _rt_return_body.metadata.plane == _xd_source.room_id
          and _rt_return_portal.metadata.plane == _xd_source.origin_plane and _rt_return_body.footprint.kind
          == 'box'
        error: Use the actual supported body still inside this source's room.
    - set:
        field: _rt_drop_origin
        value:
        - _rt_return_portal.position[0]
        - _rt_return_portal.position[1]
        - _rt_return_portal.position[2] - _rt_return_body.height
    - set:

          subject: _rt_return_body.id

          footprint: _rt_return_body.footprint
          height: _rt_return_body.height
          outer_id: _xd_source.outer_id
          destination: _travel_placement.position
          plane: _xd_source.origin_plane
          consumed: false

    pre_conditions:
    - condition: combat.turn_active == true and combat.active_actor == _actor_id
      error: Only the active character can spend an Attack action attack.
    - condition: combat.action_available == true or (combat.attacks_remaining != null
        and combat.attacks_remaining > 0)
      error: No action or attack remains on this turn.
    effects:
    - condition: combat.attacks_remaining != null and combat.attacks_remaining > 0
      on_true:
      - set:
          field: combat.attacks_remaining
          value: combat.attacks_remaining - 1

      - set:
          field: _attacks_per_action
          value: 1
      - condition: actor.data.classes != null and (actor_state == null or actor_state.form_statistics_replaced
          != true)
        on_true:
        - set:
            field: _attack_classes
            value: actor.data.classes
        - for_each:
            collection: _attack_classes
            as: _class
            do:
            - set:
                field: _attacks_per_action
                value: max(_attacks_per_action, 2)
              condition: _class.level >= 5 and (_class.id == 'fighter' or _class.id
                == 'barbarian' or _class.id == 'monk' or _class.id == 'paladin' or
                _class.id == 'ranger')
            - set:
                field: _attacks_per_action
                value: max(_attacks_per_action, 3)
              condition: _class.id == 'fighter' and _class.level >= 11
            - set:

      - call: spend_srd_action
        params: []
      - set:

          value: 1
        condition: combat.last_action_source == 'haste' or combat.active_actor_spell_slow

      - set:

          value: _attacks_per_action - 1

            on_true:
            - require:

                value: _fissure_effect.target
            - list_push:
                list: _fissure_fall_receipts

              and lasting_state.pending_srd_actions[_pending_action_id].turn_actor

    - require:

        condition: (restraint == 'grappled' and actor_state.unowned_grappled_is_magical

          == true and actor_state.unowned_restrained_is_magical == false)

    - set:

        value: destination
    - call: srd_information_scene_entity
      params:

    - call: measure_srd_information_distance
      params:
        start: '{_spike_start}'
        end: '{destination}'
      export_context:
        _scene_distance: _scene_distance
    - set:
        field: _spike_route_length
        value: _scene_distance
    - call: resolve_srd_spike_growth_intervals
      params:
        actor_subject: '{_actor_state_id}'
        start: '{_spike_start}'
        end: '{destination}'
        mode: '{mode}'
      export_context:
        _spike_intervals: _spike_intervals
    - for_each:
        collection: _spike_intervals
        as: _spike_interval
        do:
        - set:
            field: _spike_remainder
            value: 0
        - set:
            field: _spike_receipt
            value: actor_state.spike_growth_travel[_spike_interval.area_id]
        - set:
            field: _spike_remainder
            value: _spike_receipt.remainder
          condition: _spike_receipt != null and _spike_receipt.sequence == _spike_interval.sequence
        - set:
            field: _spike_inside_distance
            value: _spike_route_length * (_spike_interval.exit - _spike_interval.entry)
        - condition: _spike_inside_distance + _spike_remainder >= 5 - 0.000000001
          on_true:
          - set:
              field: _spike_candidate_t
              value: _spike_interval.entry + (5 - _spike_remainder) * _spike_route_length
                ** -1
          - condition: _spike_candidate_t < _spike_boundary_t
            on_true:
            - set:
                field: _spike_boundary_t
                value: min(_spike_interval.exit, _spike_candidate_t)
            - []

      category: internal
      visible_to_player: false

    - require:

          thickness.
    - require:

        as: _tsunami_candidate
        do:
        - condition: _tsunami_candidate.id == source_id
          on_true:
          - require:
              condition: _tsunami_source == null

          - set:

              value: _tsunami_candidate

        _info_position: _info_position
    - require:

        error: Ground square entry requires an actual box creature.

      on_true:
      - set:
          field: _blade_body_volume
          value:
            kind: '''box'''
            min:

            - _tsunami_source.volume.min[1] - _info_scene_entity.footprint.half_extents[1]
            - _tsunami_source.volume.min[2] - _info_scene_entity.height
            max:
            - _tsunami_source.volume.max[0] + _info_scene_entity.footprint.half_extents[0]
            - _tsunami_source.volume.max[1] + _info_scene_entity.footprint.half_extents[1]
            - _tsunami_source.volume.max[2]
      - set:

          start[1] > _body_bounds.min[1] and start[1] < _body_bounds.max[1] and start[2]
          > _body_bounds.min[2] and start[2] < _body_bounds.max[2]
      condition: _body_hit == true and start[0] == end[0] and start[1] == end[1] and
        start[2] == end[2]

        export_context:

      - set:

          end: '{_info_position}'
        export_context:
          _scene_distance: _scene_distance

          end: '{_info_position}'
          rule: solid
          plane: '{_srd65_dispel_plane}'

    - set:

    - set:

        value: []
    - set:

        value: target_state.timed_condition_source_ids
      condition: target_state.timed_condition_source_ids != null
    - for_each:

        do:
        - set:

        - set:
            field: _memory_retained
            value: true
          condition: _dialogue_source.installed == true and _dialogue_source.dialogue_profile
            == 'memory'
        - condition: _dialogue_source.installed == true and _dialogue_source.suppressed
            != true
          on_true:
          - set:
              field: _memory_link_active
              value: true
            condition: _dialogue_source.dialogue_profile == 'memory' and 'charmed'
              in target_state.conditions
          - set:
              field: _memory_other_incap

            condition: _dialogue_source.condition == 'incapacitated' or _dialogue_source.control_profile

      - remove_condition:

          condition: incapacitated
        condition: target_state.memory_link_incapacitated == true and _memory_other_incap

    - set:

        value: _memory_link_active
    - set:

    description: Record missing NPC skill-check totals from the creature's existing
      stat-block source. This adds facts without recreating the creature, changing
      already recorded modifiers, restoring HP or refreshing its Reaction. Use before
      a skill check when an older prepared NPC lacks that skill. Character checks
      derive their own modifiers and cannot use this operation.
    pre_conditions:
    - condition: target_state.creature_kind == 'monster'
      error: Record stat-block skill totals only for an NPC creature.
    effects:
    - set:
        field: target_state.skill_check_modifiers
        value: {}
      condition: target_state.skill_check_modifiers == null
    - set:
        field: _skill_check_names
        value: []
    - for_each:
        collection: skill_checks
        as: _skill_check
        name:
        - require:
            condition: _skill_check.skill not in _skill_check_names
            error: Each prepared skill check must have one authoritative modifier.
        - require:
            condition: _skill_check.skill not in target_state.skill_check_modifiers
              or target_state.skill_check_modifiers[_skill_check.skill] == _skill_check.modifier
            error: An existing stat-block skill modifier cannot be replaced by this
              operation.
        - list_push:
            list: _skill_check_names
            value: _skill_check.skill
          store_as: _skill_check_names
        - set:
            field: target_state.skill_check_modifiers.{_skill_check.skill}
            value: _skill_check.modifier
    metadata:
      activity_label: Record creature skills
      category: combat
      model_behavior: optional

            - sleight_of_hand
            - stealth

          modifier:
            minimum: -10
            maximum: 30
            on_true: integer
      description: Actual total NPC skill-check modifiers from the selected stat block.
        For an unlisted skill use its actual ability modifier. Omitted skills remain
        unknown; never guess them from saving throws.

tools:
  resolve_srd_initiative_recovery:
    effects:
    - set:
        field: _monk_initiative_rows
        value: []
    - require:
        condition: use_uncanny_metabolism == false or actor_state.creature_kind ==
          'character'
        error: Uncanny Metabolism requires a Monk character.
    - condition: actor_state.creature_kind == 'character'
      on_true:
      - call: derive_srd_martial_arts
        params:
          actor: '{_actor_state_id}'
          actor_state: '{_actor_state_id}'
        export_context:
          _martial_arts_level: _martial_arts_level
          _martial_arts_die: _martial_arts_die
      - require:
          condition: use_uncanny_metabolism == false or _martial_arts_level >= 2
          error: Uncanny Metabolism requires Monk level 2.
      - condition: _martial_arts_level >= 2
        on_true:
        - require:
            condition: actor_state.resource_maxima.focus_point == _martial_arts_level
              and actor_state.resources.focus_point >= 0 and actor_state.resources.focus_point
              <= _martial_arts_level
            error: Initiative recovery requires the Monk's canonical Focus pool.
        - set:
            field: _initiative_focus_before
            value: actor_state.resources.focus_point
        - condition: use_uncanny_metabolism == true
          on_true:
          - require:
              condition: actor_state.uncanny_metabolism_used != true
              error: Uncanny Metabolism has already been used since the last Long
                Rest.
          - set:
              field: actor_state.uncanny_metabolism_used
              value: true
          - set:
              field: actor_state.resources.focus_point
              value: _martial_arts_level
          - dice:
              expression: '{_martial_arts_die}'
            store_as: _metabolism_roll
          - set:
              field: _metabolism_healing
              value: _martial_arts_level + _metabolism_roll.total
          - set:
              field: _actor_call_expression_1
              value: _martial_arts_level + (_metabolism_roll.count * _metabolism_roll.sides)
          - call: restore_hit_points
            params:
              target: '{_actor_state_id}'
              amount: '{_metabolism_healing}'
              maximum_amount: '{_actor_call_expression_1}'
            export_context:
              _metabolism_hp_before: _hp_before
              _metabolism_hp_after: _hp_after
          - set:
              field: _metabolism_hp_gain
              value: _metabolism_hp_after - _metabolism_hp_before
          - call: record_srd_result_text
            params:
              text: 'Uncanny Metabolism: Focus {_initiative_focus_before} → {_martial_arts_level};
                {_martial_arts_die} roll {_metabolism_roll.total} + Monk level {_martial_arts_level}
                = {_metabolism_healing} healing; {_metabolism_hp_gain} HP restored.
                Available again after a Long Rest.'
            export_context:
              _initiative_recovery_text: _recorded_result_text
          - list_push:
              list: _monk_initiative_rows
              value:
                label: actor_state.name
                value: _initiative_recovery_text
            store_as: _monk_initiative_rows
          on_false:
          - condition: _martial_arts_level >= 15 and _initiative_focus_before < 4
            on_true:
            - set:
                field: actor_state.resources.focus_point
                value: 4
            - call: record_srd_result_text
              params:
                text: 'Perfect Focus: Focus {_initiative_focus_before} → 4.'
              export_context:
                _initiative_recovery_text: _recorded_result_text
            - list_push:
                list: _monk_initiative_rows
                value:
                  label: actor_state.name
                  value: _initiative_recovery_text
              store_as: _monk_initiative_rows
    metadata:
      category: internal
      visible_to_player: false
    parameters:
    - param_actor_state_d3c054b169a46c77
    - name: use_uncanny_metabolism
      type: boolean
      required: false
      default: false

        - condition: _water_wave_vehicle.active == true and _water_wave_vehicle.metadata.is_object
            == true and _water_wave_vehicle.metadata.participant_ref == null and _water_wave_vehicle.metadata.plane

          on_true:
          - require:
              condition: _water_wave_vehicle.footprint.kind == 'box'
              error: Use represented Box vehicle contact; other body shapes remain
                GM adjudication.
          - set:
              field: _wave_at
              value: _water_wave_vehicle.position
          - set:
              field: _wave_half
              value: _water_wave_vehicle.footprint.half_extents
          - condition: _wave_at[0] - _wave_half[0] < _wave_bounds.max[0] and _wave_at[0]

              < _wave_bounds.max[1] and _wave_at[1] + _wave_half[1] > _wave_bounds.min[1]
              and _wave_at[2] < _wave_bounds.max[2] and _wave_at[2] + _water_wave_vehicle.height
              >= _wave_bounds.min[2]

                  placement.

                value: _water_wave_vehicle.id

    - condition: _flaming_source_current == true
      on_true:

        params:

          == true and _object_scene.metadata.worn_by == null and _object_scene.metadata.carried_by
          == null and _object_scene.metadata.plane == _flaming_ignition_source.plane

            store_as: _info_snapshot

          - call: initialize_srd_lite_constants_d63675087646

          - set:
              field: _world_changes
              value: merge(_world_changes, _world_object_marker)
          - set:
              field: _world_metadata
              value: merge(_object_scene.metadata, _world_changes)
          - spatial_mutation:

              expected_revision: '{_info_snapshot.geometry_revision}'
              target:

                id: '{object_id}'

            store_as: _world_mutation
          - call: refresh_srd_spell_triggers

    - for_each:

          - require:

    - require:

    - condition: _gravity_source.active == true
      on_true:
      - set:
          field: _gravity_return_subjects
          value: []
      - set:
          field: _gravity_retire_rows
          value: _gravity_source.subjects
      - for_each:
          collection: _gravity_retire_rows
          as: _gravity_retire_row
          do:
          - list_push:
              list: _gravity_return_subjects
              value: _gravity_retire_row
            condition: _gravity_retire_row.phase == 'hovering'
      - set:
          field: _gravity_end_patch
          value:
            active: false
            ended_tick: lasting_state.lasting_tick
            return_pending: len(_gravity_return_subjects) > 0
            returns: _gravity_return_subjects
      - set:
          field: _gravity_source
          value: merge(_gravity_source, _gravity_end_patch)
      - set:
          field: _gravity_saved
          value: []
      - set:
          field: _gravity_save_rows
          value: lasting_state.reverse_gravity_sources
      - for_each:
          collection: _gravity_save_rows
          as: _gravity_save_row
          do:
          - condition: _gravity_save_row.id == _gravity_source.id
            on_true:
            - list_push:
                list: _gravity_saved
                value: _gravity_source
            on_false:
            - list_push:
                list: _gravity_saved
                value: _gravity_save_row
      - set:
          field: lasting_state.reverse_gravity_sources
          value: _gravity_saved
      - set:
          field: _gravity_any_active
          value: false
      - set:
          field: _gravity_any_pending
          value: false
      - set:
          field: _gravity_flag_rows
          value: lasting_state.reverse_gravity_sources
      - for_each:

            condition: _gravity_flag_row.active == true
          - set:

      - set:

    pre_conditions:
    - condition: lasting_state.contingency_sources[contingency_source_id] != null

        and lasting_state.contingency_sources[contingency_source_id].caster == _caster_state_id

      error: Use the genuine consumed Contingency and its self caster.
    - condition: lasting_state.contingency_sources[contingency_source_id].child_release_completed
        == true and lasting_state.contingency_sources[contingency_source_id].child.spell
        == spell and lasting_state.contingency_sources[contingency_source_id].child.slot_level
        == slot_level
      error: Use that already-paid chosen spell once at its actual release.
    - condition: range_kind == 'touch' and caster_can_touch_all_targets == true
      error: The caster must be able to touch every selected creature.
    - condition: len(targets) <= base_targets + (slot_level - base_level) * targets_per_slot_level
      error: The selected slot cannot affect that many creatures.
    - condition: slot_level >= base_level
      error: The caster lacks this timed spell or its selected level.
    effects:
    - call: initialize_srd_lite_constants_edf6727b634f
      export_context: '*'
    - for_each:

        - call: record_srd_spell_target_result
          params:
            target: '{_speed_target}'
            brief: Speed +{speed_bonus} feet
            detail: Speed increases by {speed_bonus} feet for {duration_rounds} rounds.
              The saved effect expires with elapsed time.
          export_context:
            _spell_target_summary: _spell_target_summary
            _spell_target_detail: _spell_target_detail
        - list_push:

    - condition: target.exhaustion_level >= 1

meta:

tools:
  release_srd_contingent_multi_target_timed_hit_point_bonus:
    pre_conditions:
    - condition: lasting_state.contingency_sources[contingency_source_id] != null
        and lasting_state.contingency_sources[contingency_source_id].status == 'released'
        and lasting_state.contingency_sources[contingency_source_id].caster == _caster_state_id
        and lasting_state.contingency_sources[contingency_source_id].source_sha256
        == 'b77c82e2d75a8cc5a356ebcf85840ebcfbb47e4051d13d003129c5e0cb85f46e'
      error: Use the genuine consumed Contingency and its self caster.
    - condition: lasting_state.contingency_sources[contingency_source_id].child_release_completed
        == true and lasting_state.contingency_sources[contingency_source_id].child.spell
        == spell and lasting_state.contingency_sources[contingency_source_id].child.slot_level
        == slot_level
      error: Use that already-paid chosen spell once at its actual release.
    - condition: range_kind == 'distance' and targets_max_distance <= range_feet and
        all_targets_have_clear_path == true
      error: Every selected creature needs a clear spell path within range.
    - condition: len(targets) <= max_targets
      error: This spell cannot affect that many creatures.
    - condition: slot_level >= base_level
      error: The caster lacks this timed Hit Point spell or its selected level.
    effects:
    - call: initialize_srd_lite_constants_edf6727b634f
      export_context: '*'
    - set:
        field: _timed_hit_point_amount
        value: base_hit_point_bonus + (slot_level - base_level) * hit_point_bonus_per_slot_level
    - for_each:
        collection: targets
        as: _timed_hit_point_target
        do:
        - call: install_srd_timed_hit_point_bonus
          params:
            target_state: '{_timed_hit_point_target}'
            lasting_state: state
            caster_state: '{_caster_state_id}'
            spell: '{spell}'
            duration_rounds: '{duration_rounds}'
            hit_point_bonus: '{_timed_hit_point_amount}'
            actual_spell_level: '{actual_spell_level}'
            spell_cast_id: '{spell_cast_id}'
            spell_cast_owner: '{_spell_cast_owner_id}'
          export_context:
            _target_hit_point_bonus_delta: _hit_point_bonus_delta
            _target_hit_point_bonus: _new_hit_point_bonus
        - call: record_srd_spell_target_result
          params:
            target: '{_timed_hit_point_target}'
            brief: Maximum HP +{_target_hit_point_bonus}
            detail: The target's current and maximum Hit Points changed by {_target_hit_point_bonus_delta};
              its active bonus expires after {duration_rounds} rounds.
          export_context:
            _spell_target_summary: _spell_target_summary
            _spell_target_detail: _spell_target_detail
        - list_push:
            list: _spell_summary_rows
            value: _spell_target_summary
        - list_push:
            list: _spell_detail_rows
            value: _spell_target_detail

      visible_to_player: false

            - _ice_sheet_body.volume.min[0] - _info_scene_entity.footprint.half_extents[0]
            - _ice_sheet_body.volume.min[1] - _info_scene_entity.footprint.half_extents[1]

            - _ice_sheet_body.volume.max[1] + _info_scene_entity.footprint.half_extents[1]

          _body_exit: _segment_exit

    - param_area_id_e089c46d11628c06
    - param_start_d98e3be2ca5dca70

  establish_srd_lite_steed_healing_proximity:
    description: Establish this owned active Steed's current fictional proximity for
      one imminent spell healing event. Use current nearest separation, including
      vertical separation, and actual shared-plane knowledge; never reuse birth distance.
      This is a fact declaration, not movement or healing.
    effects:
    - require:
        condition: combat.encounter_active != true
        error: Combat Life Bond uses authoritative saved bodies.
    - require:
        condition: caster_state.created_steed_id == _steed_state_id and steed_state.created_spell_id
          == 'find_steed' and steed_state.created_caster_state_id == _caster_state_id
          and steed_state.created_active == true and steed_state.is_alive == true
        error: Life Bond requires this caster's actual active Otherworldly Steed.
    - require:
        condition: lasting_state.lasting_tick != null and lasting_state.lasting_tick
          >= 0
        error: Use the actual current lasting tick for this healing fact.
    - condition: lasting_state.exploration_steed_healing_proximity == null

sylvia_gm_runtime:
  format: 1
  state_namespace: pkg
tools:
  spend_spell_casting_budget:
    pre_conditions:
    - condition: casting_time == 'reaction' or combat.encounter_active != true or
        combat.turn_active == true
      error: Casting needs an active combat turn.
    - condition: casting_time == 'reaction' or combat.turn_active != true or combat.active_actor
        == _caster_state_id
      error: Only the active actor can spend a casting action.
    - condition: not ('incapacitated' in caster_state.conditions or 'paralyzed' in
        caster_state.conditions or 'petrified' in caster_state.conditions or 'stunned'
        in caster_state.conditions or 'unconscious' in caster_state.conditions)
      error: The spellcaster cannot take the action required to cast this spell.
    - condition: casting_time == 'reaction' or combat.turn_active != true or (casting_time
        == 'action' and combat.action_available == true) or (casting_time == 'bonus_action'
        and caster_state.bonus_action_available == true)
      error: The spellcaster has already spent the required combat action budget.
    - condition: combat.turn_active != true or not (slot_resource != 'cantrip' and
        slot_resource != 'no_slot') or (caster_state.spell_slot_cast_this_turn !=
        true or (combat.turn_sequence != null and caster_state.spell_slot_turn_sequence
        != combat.turn_sequence))
      error: Only one spell slot can be expended to cast a spell on a turn.
    effects:
    - condition: combat.turn_sequence != null and caster_state.spell_slot_turn_sequence
        != combat.turn_sequence
      on_true:
      - set:
          field: caster_state.spell_slot_cast_this_turn
          value: false
      - set:
          field: caster_state.spell_slot_turn_sequence
          value: combat.turn_sequence
    - call: consume_srd_reaction
      params:
        actor_state: '{_caster_state_id}'
        lasting_state: state
        reaction: spell
      condition: casting_time == 'reaction'
    - call: spend_srd_action
      params:
        magic_action: true
      condition: combat.turn_active == true and casting_time == 'action'
    - call: consume_srd_bonus_action
      params:
        actor_state: '{_caster_state_id}'
        bonus_action: spell
      condition: combat.turn_active == true and casting_time == 'bonus_action'
    - set:
        field: caster_state.spell_slot_cast_this_turn
        value: true
      condition: combat.turn_active == true and slot_resource != 'cantrip' and slot_resource
        != 'no_slot'
    metadata:
      category: internal
      visible_to_player: false
    parameters:
    - param_caster_state_5310b8b23a525eea
    - name: casting_time
      type: enum
      enum_values:
      - action
      - bonus_action
      - reaction
    - param_slot_resource_b7c2811f903f8c74
  create_srd_gate_portal:
    effects:
    - set:
        field: _world_origin
        value: point
    - set:
        field: _gate_extent
        value:
        - diameter
        - diameter
        - depiction_depth
    - require:
        condition: portal_id != ''
        error: Choose a unique ID for the created scenery object.
    - set:
        field: _world_prior_entities
        value: lasting_state.spatial_scene.entities
    - x
    - set:
        field: _world_created_metadata
        value:
          plane: plane
          is_object: false
          creature_type: '''spell_force'''
          participant_ref: null
          gate_portal:
            source_id: source_id
            peer_id: peer_id
            front: front
            diameter: diameter
            cast_id: cast_id
            created_tick: lasting_state.lasting_tick
    - set:
        field: _world_created_marker
        value:
          is_object: false
    - set:
        field: _world_created_metadata
        value: merge(_world_created_metadata, _world_created_marker)
    - set:
        field: _world_created_entity
        value:
          id: portal_id
          map_id: lasting_state.spatial_scene.map.id
          position: _world_origin
          footprint:
            kind: '''circle'''
            radius: diameter * 0.5
          height: _gate_extent[2]
          facing:
          - 1
          - 0
          active: true
          movement: '''passable'''
          visibility: '''clear'''
          metadata: _world_created_metadata
    - list_push:
        list: _world_prior_entities
        value: _world_created_entity
    - set:
        field: lasting_state.spatial_scene.entities
        value: _world_prior_entities
    - set:
        field: lasting_state.spatial_scene.map.revision
        value: lasting_state.spatial_scene.map.revision + 1
    - require:
        condition: lasting_state.spatial_scene != null
        error: This operation needs the admitted spatial scene.
    - require:
        condition: lasting_state.spatial_scene.map.grid.unit == 'ft'
        error: SRD scene distances use feet.
    - spatial_query:
        scene: state.spatial_scene

  continue_srd_spell_list_targeting:
    effects:
    - set:
        field: _list_cast
        value: lasting_state.pending_srd_actions[pending_action_id]
    - require:
        condition: _list_cast.kind == 'spell_cast' and _list_cast.status == 'open'
          and _list_cast.actor_state_id == _caster_state_id and lasting_state.pending_srd_action_stack[-1]

        error: Targeting must use the actual current saved spell.
    - require:
        condition: _list_cast.stage != 'awaiting_sanctuary_choice' and _list_cast.stage
          != 'sanctuary_retarget_validation'
        error: Resolve the existing Sanctuary choice first.
    - set:
        field: _list_targets
        value: _list_cast.parameters.projectile_targets
    - set:
        field: _list_targets
        value: _list_cast.parameters.attack_targets
      condition: _list_cast.sanctuary_list_kind == 'attack'
    - set:
        field: _list_cursor
        value: _list_cast.sanctuary_cursor
    - set:
        field: _list_approved
        value: _list_cast.sanctuary_approved
    - set:
        field: _list_index
        value: 0
    - set:
        field: _list_blocked
        value: false
    - for_each:
        collection: _list_targets
        as: _list_target
        do:
        - condition: _list_blocked != true and _list_index >= _list_cursor
          on_true:
          - set:
              field: lasting_state.pending_srd_actions.{pending_action_id}.sanctuary_cursor
              value: _list_index
          - set:
              field: lasting_state.pending_srd_actions.{pending_action_id}.target_state_id
              value: _list_target
          - call: continue_srd_spell_targeting
            params:
              caster_state: '{_caster_state_id}'
              target_state: '{_list_target}'
              pending_action_id: '{pending_action_id}'
            export_context:
              _sanctuary_target_allowed: _sanctuary_target_allowed
              _sanctuary_choice_required: _sanctuary_choice_required
          - condition: _sanctuary_target_allowed == true
            on_true:
            - list_push:
                list: _list_approved
                value:
                  target: _list_target
                  ordinal: _list_index
            - set:
                field: lasting_state.pending_srd_actions.{pending_action_id}.sanctuary_approved
                value: _list_approved
            - set:
                field: lasting_state.pending_srd_actions.{pending_action_id}.sanctuary_cursor
                value: _list_index + 1
            - set:
                field: _list_cursor
                value: _list_index + 1
            on_false:
            - set:
                field: _list_blocked
                value: true
        - set:
            field: _list_index
            value: _list_index + 1
    - condition: _list_blocked != true
      on_true:
      - set:
          field: lasting_state.pending_srd_actions.{pending_action_id}.spell_targeting_checked
          value: true
      - set:
          field: lasting_state.pending_srd_actions.{pending_action_id}.stage
          value: '''reaction'''
    metadata:
      category: internal
      visible_to_player: false
    parameters:
    - param_caster_state_5310b8b23a525eea
    - param_pending_action_id_fbe040be57330615

meta:

tools:
  retained_spell_query_resolve_srd_timed_actor_defenses:
    effects:
    - call: initialize_srd_lite_constants_a2985a58e4f4
      export_context: null
    - set:
        field: _actor_defense_effects
        value: lasting_state.turn_effects
      condition: lasting_state.turn_effects != null
    - for_each:
        collection: _actor_defense_effects
        as: _defense_effect
        do:
        - condition: _defense_effect.kind == 'timed_actor_defense' and _defense_effect.target
            == _target_state_id
          on_true:
          - call: retained_spell_query_check_srd_timed_actor_defense_active
            params:
              source_state: '{_defense_effect.caster}'
              lasting_state: '{_lasting_state_id}'
              spell: '{_defense_effect.spell}'
              started_tick: '{_defense_effect.started_tick}'
              concentration: '{_defense_effect.concentration}'
              expires_tick: '{_defense_effect.expires_tick}'
              target_state: '{_target_state_id}'
            export_context:
              _actor_defense_active: _actor_defense_active
          - condition: _actor_defense_active == true
            on_true:
            - table_lookup:
                table: definitions.spells
                key: _defense_effect.spell
                required: true
              store_as: _defense_profile
            - condition: _defense_profile.base_ac > 0 and target_state.worn_armor
                == null
              on_true:
              - call: retained_spell_query_validate_srd_actor_defense_target
                params:
                  target_state: '{_target_state_id}'
                  spell: '{_defense_effect.spell}'
                  caster_state: '{_defense_effect.caster}'
                  target_character: '{_defense_effect.target_character}'
                  lasting_state: '{_lasting_state_id}'
                export_context:
                  _defense_target_ac: _defense_target_ac
              - set:
                  field: _actor_defense_ac
                  value: max(_actor_defense_ac, _defense_target_ac)
            - set:
                field: _actor_defense_attack_disadvantage
                value: true
              condition: _defense_profile.attack_disadvantage == true
            - set:
                field: _actor_defense_source_types
                value: _defense_profile.source_creature_types
              condition: len(_defense_profile.source_creature_types) > 0
            - condition: len(_defense_profile.source_creature_types) == 0
              on_true:
              - set:
                  field: _actor_defense_condition_immunities_values
                  value: _defense_profile.condition_immunities
              - for_each:
                  collection: _actor_defense_condition_immunities_values
                  as: _defense_condition
                  do:
                  - list_push:
                      list: _actor_defense_condition_immunities
                      value: _defense_condition
                    condition: _defense_condition not in _actor_defense_condition_immunities
            - set:
                field: _actor_defense_damage_immunities_values
                value: _defense_profile.damage_immunities
            - for_each:
                collection: _actor_defense_damage_immunities_values
                as: _defense_damage_type
                do:
                - list_push:
                    list: _actor_defense_damage_immunities
                    value: _defense_damage_type
                  condition: _defense_damage_type not in _actor_defense_damage_immunities
            - set:
                field: _actor_defense_temporary_hp
                value: max(_actor_defense_temporary_hp, _defense_effect.magnitude)
              condition: _defense_profile.start_turn_temporary_hp == true
    metadata:
      category: internal
      visible_to_player: false
    parameters:
    - param_target_state_cb03a83d0b3e524f
    - param_lasting_state_a0a632fef1e150e2

    - set:

    - set:

    - set:
        field: _minor_kept
        value: []
    - for_each:
        collection: _minor_records
        as: _minor_record
        do:
        - !!binary |
          AGJpbg==
        - condition: _minor_record.kind == 'minor_world_spell'
          on_true:
          - set:
              field: _minor_expired
              value: (_minor_record.expires_tick != null and _object_now >= _minor_record.expires_tick)
                or (_minor_record.owner == boundary_actor and boundary_phase == 'end'
                and boundary_turn >= _minor_record.turn) or (_minor_record.mode ==
                'minor_creation' and combat.encounter_active != true and _object_now
                >= _minor_record.started_tick + 4)
          - condition: _minor_expired == true
            on_true:
            - condition: _minor_record.mode == 'minor_creation' and _minor_record.output_id
                != ''
              on_true:
              - require:
                  condition: lasting_state.spatial_scene != null
                  error: This operation needs the admitted spatial scene.
              - require:
                  condition: lasting_state.spatial_scene.map.grid.unit == 'ft'
                  error: SRD scene distances use feet.
              - spatial_query:
                  scene: state.spatial_scene

                store_as: _info_snapshot

                  value: lasting_state.spatial_scene.entities
              - for_each:

                  as: _minor_scene_row
                  do:
                  - condition: _minor_scene_row.id == _minor_record.output_id and
                      _minor_scene_row.active == true
                    on_true:
                    - require:
                        condition: _minor_scene_row.metadata.srd_minor_creation.source_id

                        expected_revision: '{_info_snapshot.geometry_revision}'
                        target:

                          id: '{_minor_record.output_id}'
                        patch:
                          active: false
                      store_as: _minor_retired_object
                    - call: refresh_srd_spell_triggers
                      condition: state.has_spell_triggers == true
        - list_push:
            list: _minor_kept
            value: _minor_record
          condition: _minor_expired != true
    - set:

    effects:
    - call: retained_spell_query_srd_information_scene_entity
      params:
        subject: '{subject}'
        lasting_state: '{_lasting_state_id}'
      export_context:
        _info_scene_entity: _info_scene_entity
        _info_position: _info_position
    - set:
        field: _membership_subject
        value: _info_scene_entity
    - require:
        condition: _membership_subject.footprint.kind == 'box'
        error: Barrier membership currently requires an admitted box subject.
    - set:
        field: _membership_point
        value: _membership_subject.position
    - set:
        field: _membership_point
        value: position
      condition: position != null
    - call: retained_spell_query_read_srd_barrier_body
      params:
        source_id: '{source_id}'
        lasting_state: '{_lasting_state_id}'
      export_context:
        _barrier_body: _barrier_body
        _barrier_plane: _barrier_plane
        _barrier_radius: _barrier_radius
    - set:
        field: _barrier_inside
        value: false
    - set:
        field: _barrier_overlap
        value: false
    - condition: _membership_subject.metadata.plane == _barrier_plane
      on_true:
      - set:
          field: _membership_axis_0
          value: abs(_membership_point[0] - _barrier_body.position[0])
      - set:
          field: _membership_axis_1
          value: abs(_membership_point[1] - _barrier_body.position[1])
      - set:
          field: _membership_axis_2
          value: abs(_membership_point[2] + _membership_subject.height * 0.5 - _barrier_body.position[2]
            - _barrier_body.height * 0.5)
      - set:
          field: _membership_far_0
          value: max(0, _membership_axis_0 + _membership_subject.footprint.half_extents[0]
            - _barrier_body.footprint.half_extents[0])
      - set:
          field: _membership_far_1
          value: max(0, _membership_axis_1 + _membership_subject.footprint.half_extents[1]
            - _barrier_body.footprint.half_extents[1])
      - set:
          field: _membership_far_2
          value: max(0, _membership_axis_2 + _membership_subject.height * 0.5 - _barrier_body.height
            * 0.5)
      - set:
          field: _membership_near_0
          value: max(0, _membership_axis_0 - _membership_subject.footprint.half_extents[0]
            - _barrier_body.footprint.half_extents[0])
      - set:
          field: _membership_near_1
          value: max(0, _membership_axis_1 - _membership_subject.footprint.half_extents[1]
            - _barrier_body.footprint.half_extents[1])
      - set:
          field: _membership_near_2
          value: max(0, _membership_axis_2 - _membership_subject.height * 0.5 - _barrier_body.height
            * 0.5)
      - set:
          field: _barrier_inside
          value: _membership_far_0 ** 2 + _membership_far_1 ** 2 + _membership_far_2
            ** 2 <= _barrier_radius ** 2
      - set:
          field: _barrier_overlap
          value: _membership_near_0 ** 2 + _membership_near_1 ** 2 + _membership_near_2
            ** 2 <= _barrier_radius ** 2

    - call: srd_information_scene_entity

        _info_scene_entity: _info_scene_entity
        _info_position: _info_position
    - set:
        field: _membership_subject
        value: _info_scene_entity
    - require:
        condition: _membership_subject.footprint.kind == 'box'
        error: Barrier membership currently requires an admitted box subject.
    - set:
        field: _membership_point
        value: _membership_subject.position
    - set:
        field: state.
        value: position
      condition: position != null
    - call: read_srd_magic_zone_body
      params:
        source_id: '{source_id}'
      export_context:
        _magic_zone_body: _magic_zone_body
        _magic_zone_plane: _magic_zone_plane
        _magic_zone_radius: _magic_zone_radius
    - set:
        field: _magic_zone_inside
        value: false
    - set:
        field: _magic_zone_overlap
        value: false
    - condition: _membership_subject.metadata.plane == _magic_zone_plane
      on_true:
      - set:
          field: _membership_axis_0
          value: abs(_membership_point[0] - _magic_zone_body.position[0])
      - set:
          field: _membership_axis_1
          value: abs(_membership_point[1] - _magic_zone_body.position[1])
      - set:
          field: _membership_axis_2
          value: abs(_membership_point[2] + _membership_subject.height * 0.5 - _magic_zone_body.position[2]
            - _magic_zone_body.height * 0.5)
      - set:
          field: _membership_far_0
          value: max(0, _membership_axis_0 + _membership_subject.footprint.half_extents[0]
            - _magic_zone_body.footprint.half_extents[0])
      - set:
          field: _membership_far_1
          value: max(0, _membership_axis_1 + _membership_subject.footprint.half_extents[1]
            - _magic_zone_body.footprint.half_extents[1])
      - set:
          field: _membership_far_2
          value: max(0, _membership_axis_2 + _membership_subject.height * 0.5 - _magic_zone_body.height
            * 0.5)
      - set:
          field: _membership_near_0
          value: max(0, _membership_axis_0 - _membership_subject.footprint.half_extents[0]
            - _magic_zone_body.footprint.half_extents[0])
      - set:
          field: _membership_near_1
          value: max(0, _membership_axis_1 - _membership_subject.footprint.half_extents[1]
            - _magic_zone_body.footprint.half_extents[1])
      - set:
          field: _membership_near_2
          value: max(0, _membership_axis_2 - _membership_subject.height * 0.5 - _magic_zone_body.height

      - set:
          field: _magic_zone_inside
          value: _membership_far_0 ** 2 + _membership_far_1 ** 2 + _membership_far_2

      - set:
          field: _magic_zone_overlap

    description: Package-owned riichi kan.
    parameters:
    - name: actor

    - name: tiles

      items:

    - set:

        value: actor.game.riichi_waits
    - set:

        value: without(actor.game.hand, tiles)
    - set:
        field: _remaining_kinds
        value: []

        collection: _remaining
        as: _tile
        do:
        - list_push:

    - set:

        value: completions(_remaining_kinds, definitions.patterns, definitions.group_sizes[len(actor.game.melds)

    - set:
        field: _owned_kinds
        value: []

        field: _owned_tiles
        value: actor.game.hand

            value: definitions.tiles[_tile].kind
    - set:
        field: _melds
        value: actor.game.melds
    - for_each:
        collection: _melds
        as: _meld
        do:
        - set:
            field: _meld_tiles
            value: _meld.tiles
        - for_each:
            collection: _meld_tiles
            as: _tile
            do:
            - list_push:
                list: _owned_kinds
                value: definitions.tiles[_tile].kind
    - set:
        field: _filtered_after
        value: []
    - for_each:
        collection: _after
        as: _wait_kind
        do:
        - condition:

            - list_push:

            on_false: []

        - set:
            field: _allowed
            value: false

  format: 1
  state_namespace: pkg
tools:
  check_srd_recovery_space:
    effects:
    - require:
        condition: state.spatial_scene != null and state.spatial_scene.map.grid.unit
          == 'ft'
        error: Physical recovery placement needs the actual admitted scene in feet.
    - set:
        field: _space_min
        value:
        - position[0] - half_width
        - position[1] - half_width
        - position[2] + 0.000000001
    - set:
        field: _space_max
        value:
        - position[0] + half_width
        - position[1] + half_width
        - position[2] + height
    - spatial_query:
        scene: state.spatial_scene
        operation: area
        query:
          map_id: '{state.spatial_scene.map.id}'
          shape:
            kind: box
            min: '{_space_min}'
            max: '{_space_max}'
          include:
          - geometry
          - entities
          max_results: 4096
      store_as: _recovery_space
    - require:
        condition: _recovery_space.truncated != true
        error: This placement exceeds the admitted collision query bound.
    - set:
        field: _space_results
        value: _recovery_space.results
    - for_each:
        collection: _space_results
        as: _space_item
        do:
        - require:
            condition: _space_item.metadata.plane != null
            error: Intersecting scene objects need their actual plane fact.
        - require:
            condition: _space_item.metadata.plane != plane or (_space_item.kind ==
              'geometry' and _space_item.id == surface_id) or (_space_item.kind ==
              'entity' and _space_item.id == exclude_entity)
            error: The selected recovery space is occupied.
    - condition: surface_id != ''
      on_true:
      - set:
          field: _surface_found
          value: false
      - set:
          field: _surfaces
          value: state.spatial_scene.geometry
      - for_each:
          collection: _surfaces
          as: _surface
          do:
          - condition: _surface.id == surface_id and _surface.active == true
            on_true:
            - require:
                condition: _surface.volume.kind == 'box' and _surface.metadata.plane
                  == plane
                error: This supporting surface must be an admitted flat box on the
                  caster's plane.
            - require:
                condition: _surface.volume.max[2] == position[2] and _surface.volume.min[0]
                  <= position[0] - half_width and _surface.volume.max[0] >= position[0]
                  + half_width and _surface.volume.min[1] <= position[1] - half_width
                  and _surface.volume.max[1] >= position[1] + half_width
                error: The actual surface must support the whole feast's10foot footprint.
            - set:
                field: _surface_found
                value: true
      - require:
          condition: _surface_found == true
          error: Choose an active admitted supporting surface.

      visible_to_player: false
    parameters:

    - name: height

tools:
  qualify_srd_produce_flame_close_enemy:
    effects:
    - set:
        field: _produce_enemy_qualifies
        value: false
    - condition: enemy_state.is_alive == true and enemy_state.hp > 0 and not ('incapacitated'
        in enemy_state.conditions or 'paralyzed' in enemy_state.conditions or 'petrified'
        in enemy_state.conditions or 'stunned' in enemy_state.conditions or 'unconscious'
        in enemy_state.conditions)
      on_true:
      - call: qualify_srd_scene_enemy
        params:
          caster_id: '{_caster_state_id}'
          target_id: '{_enemy_state_id}'
        export_context:
          _scene_is_enemy: _scene_is_enemy
      - condition: _scene_is_enemy == true
        on_true:
        - call: resolve_srd_scene_relation
          params:
            actor_state: '{_enemy_state_id}'
            target_state: '{_caster_state_id}'
          export_context:
            _scene_distance: _scene_distance
            _scene_same_plane: _scene_same_plane
            _scene_can_see: _scene_can_see
        - set:
            field: _produce_enemy_qualifies
            value: _scene_same_plane == true and _scene_distance <= 5 and _scene_can_see
              == true

      visible_to_player: false

    - param_enemy_state_64677b5ca60a424e
  check_srd_guards_wards_door_lock:
    effects:
    - set:
        field: _guards_door_child_available
        value: false
    - condition: source_id != '' and group == 'doors' and lasting_state.spell_guards_wards_sources
        != null and source_id in lasting_state.spell_guards_wards_sources
      on_true:
      - set:
          field: _guards_door_parent
          value: lasting_state.spell_guards_wards_sources[source_id]
      - set:
          value: _guards_door_parent.installed == true and _guards_door_parent.spell_id
            == 'guards_and_wards' and _guards_door_parent.groups.doors == true and
            _guards_door_parent.suppressed != true and (_guards_door_parent.permanent
            == true or lasting_state.lasting_tick < _guards_door_parent.expires_tick)
            and object_id in _guards_door_parent.door_ids and plane == _guards_door_parent.plane
            and spell_level == _guards_door_parent.spell_level
