  format: 1
  state_namespace: pkg
tools:
  resolve_srd_control_activity:
    description: Spend the actual task action, preserving activity until its completion
      is adjudicated.
    effects:
    - require:
        condition: lasting_state.timed_condition_sources != null and source_id in
          lasting_state.timed_condition_sources
        error: This retained control action requires an existing spell source.
    - require:
        condition: lasting_state.timed_condition_sources[source_id].spell_id == 'suggestion'
        error: This control source is excluded from the selected SRD Lite follow-up
          action.
    - call: require_srd_pending_window_closed
    - call: resolve_srd_control_activity_internal
      params:
        actor_state: '{_actor_state_id}'
        source_id: '{source_id}'
        completed: '{completed}'
        completion_evidence: '{completion_evidence}'
        task_kind: '{task_kind}'
        lasting_state: state
    - set:
        field: time_stop_state.time_stop_source.spell_action_active
        value: false
      condition: time_stop_state.time_stop_source != null
    - call: finalize_srd_time_stop
      condition: time_stop_state.time_stop_source != null and time_stop_state.time_stop_source.ending
        == true
    - call: finish_srd_shared_action_settlements
      params:
        lasting_state: '{_lasting_state_id}'
        known_spell_effect: '{known_spell_effect}'
      export_context: '*'
    metadata:
      category: combat
      visible_to_player: true
      result_card:
        version: 1
        footprint: inline
        title: Suggestion activity
        summary:
        - label: Actor
          value:

        - label: Task
          value:
            path: parameters.completed
            labels:
              'true': Completed
              'false': Continuing
    parameters:

    - name: completion_evidence

sylvia_gm_runtime:
  format: 1
  state_namespace: pkg
tools:
  start_srd_condition_concentration:
    effects:
    - require:
        condition: len(targets) > 0 or (combat.encounter_active == true and (spell
          == 'fear' or spell == 'sleep') and definitions.spells[spell].family == 'timed_control_behavior')
        error: An empty control area is supported only for Fear or Sleep in combat.
    - call: refresh_srd_condition_casters
      params:
        lasting_state: '{_lasting_state_id}'
    - call: end_srd_concentration_node
      params:
        source_state: '{_caster_state_id}'
        target_state: '{caster_state.concentration_target_state_id}'
      condition: caster_state.concentration_spell_id != null
    - set:
        field: lasting_state.lasting_tick
        value: 0
      condition: lasting_state.lasting_tick == null
    - set:
        field: lasting_state.lasting_serial
        value: 0
      condition: lasting_state.lasting_serial == null
    - increment:
        field: lasting_state.lasting_serial
        amount: 1
    - set:
        field: caster_state.concentration_spell_id
        value: spell
    - set:
        field: caster_state.concentration_cast_id
        value: spell_cast_id
    - set:
        field: caster_state.concentration_effect_family
        value: '''multi_target_timed_repeating_save_condition'''
    - condition: len(targets) > 0
      on_true:
      - set:
          field: caster_state.concentration_target_state_id
          value: targets[0]
      on_false:
      - set:
          field: caster_state.concentration_target_state_id
          value: _caster_state_id
    - set:
        field: caster_state.concentration_target_state_ids
        value: targets
    - set:
        field: caster_state.concentration_started_tick
        value: lasting_state.lasting_tick
    - set:
        field: caster_state.concentration_expires_tick
        value: lasting_state.lasting_tick + duration_rounds * 2
    - set:
        field: caster_state.concentration_sequence
        value: lasting_state.lasting_serial
    - set:
        field: caster_state.concentration_save_modifier
        value: save_modifier
    - set:
        field: caster_state.concentration_older_caster_state_id
        value: null
    - set:
        field: caster_state.concentration_newer_caster_state_id
        value: null
    - set:
        field: _condition_concentration_sequence
        value: lasting_state.lasting_serial
    - condition: _caster_state_id not in lasting_state.condition_caster_ids
      on_true:
      - require:
          condition: len(lasting_state.condition_caster_ids) < 128
          error: Resolve existing concentration effects before adding more casters.
      - set:
          field: _condition_caster_index
          value: lasting_state.condition_caster_ids
      - list_push:
          list: _condition_caster_index
          value: _caster_state_id
      - set:
          field: lasting_state.condition_caster_ids
          value: _condition_caster_index
    metadata:
      category: internal
      visible_to_player: false
    parameters:
    - param_caster_state_5310b8b23a525eea
    - param_lasting_state_a0a632fef1e150e2
    - param_targets_e4f2c94a5b6be558
    - param_spell_9eaf3c9176dc7d28
    - param_duration_rounds_0d2bb578f6905339
    - name: save_modifier
      type: integer
    - param_spell_cast_id_d28958f249bbf42c
    - param_actual_spell_level_93943fcd145370dd
    - 1
  settle_srd_control_weather:
    effects:
    - call: format_srd_information_projection
      params:
        message: '{area_id}'
      export_context:
        _environment_area_key: _info_projection_message
    - set:
        field: _weather_settle_source
        value: lasting_state.persistent_spell_areas[_environment_area_key]
    - call: qualify_srd_control_weather_source
      params:
        caster_state: '{_weather_settle_source.caster}'
        area_id: '{_environment_area_key}'
      export_context:
        _weather_live: _weather_live
    - condition: _weather_live == true and _weather_settle_source.weather_pending
        == true and lasting_state.lasting_tick >= _weather_settle_source.weather_ready_tick
      on_true:
      - set:
          field: lasting_state.persistent_spell_areas.{_environment_area_key}.weather_current
          value: _weather_settle_source.weather_chosen
      - set:
          field: lasting_state.persistent_spell_areas.{_environment_area_key}.weather_pending
          value: false
      - set:
          field: lasting_state.persistent_spell_areas.{_environment_area_key}.weather_settled_tick
          value: lasting_state.lasting_tick
    metadata:
      category: internal
      visible_to_player: false
    parameters:
    - param_area_id_e089c46d11628c06
    - param_lasting_state_f791c68f01bb49c8

tools:

    effects:

      params:
        subject: '{_caster_state_id}'
      export_context:
        _info_scene_entity: _info_scene_entity
        _info_position: _info_position
    - set:
        field: _world_caster_scene
        value: _info_scene_entity
    - require:
        condition: _world_caster_scene.metadata.plane != null
        error: The caster needs its actual plane.
    - call: measure_srd_information_distance
      params:
        start: '{_world_caster_scene.position}'
        end: '{point}'
      export_context:
        _scene_distance: _scene_distance
    - require:
        condition: _scene_distance <= range_feet
        error: The chosen point is outside spell range.
    - require:
        condition: lasting_state.spatial_scene != null
        error: This operation needs the admitted spatial scene.
    - require:
        condition: lasting_state.spatial_scene.map.grid.unit == 'ft'
        error: SRD scene distances use feet.

        scene: state.spatial_scene
        operation: snapshot
      store_as: _info_snapshot

          <= lasting_state.spatial_scene.map.bounds.max[0]
        error: The chosen point must lie inside the actual admitted map.
    - require:
        condition: point[1] >= lasting_state.spatial_scene.map.bounds.min[1] and point[1]
          <= lasting_state.spatial_scene.map.bounds.max[1]
        error: The chosen point must lie inside the actual admitted map.
    - require:
        condition: point[2] >= lasting_state.spatial_scene.map.bounds.min[2] and point[2]
          <= lasting_state.spatial_scene.map.bounds.max[2]
        error: The chosen point must lie inside the actual admitted map.

      params:
        start: '{_world_caster_scene.position}'
        end: '{point}'
        rule: solid
      export_context:
        _information_blocked: _information_blocked

        condition: _information_blocked != true
        error: Total Cover blocks the chosen point.

        field: _world_origin
        value: point
    - set:
        field: _world_plane
        value: _world_caster_scene.metadata.plane
    - set:
        field: _world_lighting
        value: _world_caster_scene.metadata.lighting

    - param_range_feet_11df365515d2a389
    - param_lasting_state_7bff8d20c3cf7d0f

meta:
  id: a1-b2
tools:
  plan_srd_creature_space_route:
    description: Select a bounded physical route around forbidden creature spaces.
    parameters:
    - name: actor_state
      resolve: entity
    - name: destination
      type: array
      items:
        type: number
      min_items: 3
      max_items: 3
    - name: lasting_state
      resolve: entity
      required: false
      default: state
    effects:
    - call: qualify_srd_creature_space_endpoint
      params:
        actor_state: '{_actor_state_id}'
        destination: '{destination}'
      export_context:
        _space_route_circles: _space_route_circles
        _space_route_radius: _space_route_radius
        _space_route_blocked: _space_route_blocked
        _space_mover: _space_mover
    - set:
        field: _detour_mover
        value: _space_mover
    - set:
        field: _detour_plane
        value: _detour_mover.metadata.plane
    - set:
        field: _detour_plane
        value: '''material'''
      condition: _detour_plane == null
    - set:
        field: _detour_missing_plane
        value: _detour_plane == 'material'
    - set:
        field: _detour_route
        value:
          points:
          - _detour_mover.position
          - destination
          found: true
          truncated: false
    - spatial_query:
        scene: state.spatial_scene
        operation: circle_route
        query:
          map_id: '{lasting_state.spatial_scene.map.id}'
          moving_entity_id: '{_detour_mover.id}'
          destination: '{destination}'
          moving_radius: '{_space_route_radius}'
          circles: '{_space_route_circles}'
          metadata_filter:
            key: plane
            value: '{_detour_plane}'
            missing_matches: '{_detour_missing_plane}'
          max_tests: 16384
      store_as: _detour_route
      condition: _space_route_blocked == true
    - require:
        condition: _detour_route.truncated != true
        error: Creature-space route search exceeded its bounded search.
    - require:
        condition: _detour_route.found == true
        error: No legal creature-space route was found for this destination.
    metadata:
      category: internal
      visible_to_player: false
      costs_action: false

sylvia_gm_runtime:
  format: 1
  state_namespace: pkg
tools:
  reproject_srd_ghoul_claw_paralysis:
    effects:
    - set:
        field: _ghoul_paralyzed
        value: target_state.timed_condition_unowned_paralyzed == true
    - set:
        field: _ghoul_paralysis_index
        value: []
    - set:
        field: _ghoul_paralysis_index
        value: target_state.timed_condition_source_ids
      condition: target_state.timed_condition_source_ids != null
    - for_each:
        collection: _ghoul_paralysis_index
        as: _ghoul_paralysis_id
        do:
        - set:
            field: _ghoul_paralysis_source
            value: lasting_state.timed_condition_sources[_ghoul_paralysis_id]
        - set:
            field: _ghoul_paralyzed
            value: true
          condition: _ghoul_paralysis_source != null and _ghoul_paralysis_source.installed
            == true and _ghoul_paralysis_source.target_state_id == _target_state_id
            and _ghoul_paralysis_source.condition == 'paralyzed' and _ghoul_paralysis_source.suppressed
            != true
    - remove_condition:
        target: target_state
        condition: paralyzed
    - apply_condition:
        target: target_state
        condition: paralyzed
      condition: _ghoul_paralyzed == true
    - set:
        field: target_state.timed_condition_paralyzed
        value: _ghoul_paralyzed and target_state.timed_condition_unowned_paralyzed
          != true
    metadata:
      category: internal
      visible_to_player: false
    parameters:
    - param_target_state_cb03a83d0b3e524f
    - param_lasting_state_7bff8d20c3cf7d0f
  resolve_srd_information_bearer_magic:
    effects:
    - set:
        field: _bearer_magic
        value: candidate.metadata.magical_effect == true
    - set:
        field: _bearer_schools
        value: []
    - condition: candidate.metadata.source_spell != null and candidate.metadata.magical_effect
        == true
      on_true:
      - table_lookup:
          table: definitions.spell_casting
          key: candidate.metadata.source_spell
          required: true
        store_as: _bearer_header
      - list_push:
          list: _bearer_schools
          value: _bearer_header.school
    - set:
        field: _bearer_effects
        value: []
    - set:
        value: lasting_state.turn_effects
        7: _bearer_effects
      condition: lasting_state.turn_effects != null
    - for_each:
        collection: _bearer_effects
        as: _bearer_effect
        do:
        - condition: _bearer_effect.spell != null and _bearer_effect.caster != null
            and (_bearer_effect.target == candidate.id or (candidate.metadata.participant_ref
            != null and _bearer_effect.target == candidate.metadata.participant_ref))
          on_true:
          - call: check_srd_information_source_effect
            params:
              source_state: '{_bearer_effect.caster}'
              record: '{_bearer_effect}'
            export_context:
              _information_effect_active: _information_effect_active
          - condition: _information_effect_active == true
            on_true:
            - set:
                field: _bearer_magic
                value: true
            - table_lookup:
                table: definitions.spell_casting
                key: _bearer_effect.spell
                required: true
              store_as: _bearer_header
            - list_push:
                list: _bearer_schools
                value: _bearer_header.school
              condition: _bearer_header.school not in _bearer_schools
    - condition: lasting_state.has_detection_masks == true
      on_true:
      - call: check_srd_detection_mask_subject
        params:
          subject: '{candidate.id}'
          lasting_state: '{_lasting_state_id}'
        export_context:
          _mask_divination_blocked: _mask_divination_blocked
          _mask_sensor_blocked: _mask_sensor_blocked
          _mask_detect_magic_blocked: _mask_detect_magic_blocked
          _mask_sequestered: _mask_sequestered
          _mask_creature_type: _mask_creature_type
          _mask_object_aura: _mask_object_aura
          _mask_school: _mask_school
          _mask_magic_aura_active: _mask_magic_aura_active
      - condition: _mask_magic_aura_active == true
        on_true:
        - set:
            field: _bearer_magic
            value: true
        - list_push:
            list: _bearer_schools
            value: '''illusion'''
          condition: '''illusion'' not in _bearer_schools'
      - condition: _mask_object_aura != null
        on_true:
        - set:
            field: _bearer_magic
            value: _mask_object_aura != 'nonmagical'
        - set:
            field: _bearer_schools
            value: []
          condition: _mask_object_aura != 'magical'
        - list_push:
            list: _bearer_schools
            value: _mask_school
          condition: _mask_object_aura == 'school'
      - condition: _mask_detect_magic_blocked == true
        on_true:
        - set:
            field: _bearer_magic
            value: false
        - set:
            field: _bearer_schools
            value: []
    metadata:
      category: internal
      visible_to_player: false
    parameters:
    - param_candidate_feb413ee4bb019ca
    - param_lasting_state_7bff8d20c3cf7d0f

tools:
  read_srd_heat_metal_source:
    effects:
    - call: initialize_srd_lite_constants_dc191b8a9362
      export_context: '*'
    - set:
        field: _object_now
        value: lasting_state.lasting_tick
      condition: lasting_state.lasting_tick != null
    - set:
        field: _heat_records
        value: []
    - set:
        field: _heat_records
        value: lasting_state.turn_effects
      condition: lasting_state.turn_effects != null
    - set:
        field: _heat_source
        value: null
    - for_each:
        collection: _heat_records
        as: _heat_candidate
        do:
        - condition: _heat_candidate.kind == 'heat_metal_spell' and _heat_candidate.source_id
            == source_id
          on_true:
          - require:
              condition: _heat_source == null
              error: The saved Heat Metal source is ambiguous.
          - set:
              field: _heat_source
              value: _heat_candidate
    - require:
        condition: _heat_source != null and _heat_source.spell == 'heat_metal' and
          _heat_source.source_sha256 == '79e0cf2a1d0ca3dd02e3489ba1d9c90e38e49ae87fadf9269d5b196cbd9406c3'
          and _heat_source.spell_level >= 2 and _heat_source.spell_level <= 9
        error: Select one actual source-qualified Heat Metal casting.
    - require:
        condition: object_id == _heat_source.object_id
        error: Select the actual heated object and its exact casting.
    - call: check_srd_heat_metal_source
      params:
        caster_state: '{_heat_source.caster}'
        source_id: '{source_id}'
      export_context:
        _heat_source: _heat_source
    - set:
        field: _heat_metal_source
        value: _heat_source
    metadata:
      category: internal
      visible_to_player: false
    parameters:
    - param_object_id_2b5cfd2dd4c129d5

  retained_spell_query_start_srd_wind_walk_descent:
    effects:
    - set:
        field: _wind_ended_source
        value: lasting_state.transformation_sources[source_id]
    - condition: _wind_ended_source.spell_id == 'wind_walk' and target_state.form_cloud
        == true and (_wind_ended_source.installed != true or lasting_state.lasting_tick
        >= _wind_ended_source.expires_tick)
      on_true:
      - require:
          condition: _wind_ended_source.target_state_id == _target_state_id
          error: The ended cloud belongs to another subject.
      - condition: lasting_state.spatial_scene != null and (target_state.wind_walk_descent
          == null or target_state.wind_walk_descent.source_serial != _wind_ended_source.serial)
        on_true:
        - call: retained_spell_query_srd_information_scene_entity
          params:
            subject: '{_target_state_id}'
            lasting_state: '{_lasting_state_id}'
          export_context:
            _info_scene_entity: _info_scene_entity
            _info_position: _info_position
        - set:
            field: _wind_end_tick
            value: min(lasting_state.lasting_tick, _wind_ended_source.expires_tick)
        - set:
            field: target_state.wind_walk_descent
            value:
              source_id: source_id
              source_serial: _wind_ended_source.serial
              status: pending
              started_tick: _wind_end_tick
              settled_tick: _wind_end_tick
              end_tick: _wind_end_tick + 20
        - set:
            field: lasting_state.wind_walk_descent_target_ids
            value: []
          condition: lasting_state.wind_walk_descent_target_ids == null
        - set:
            field: _wind_pending_targets
            value: 7
            name: 2.5
        - condition: _target_state_id not in _wind_pending_targets
          on_true:
          - list_push:
              list: _wind_pending_targets
              value: _target_state_id
          - set:
              field: lasting_state.wind_walk_descent_target_ids
              value: _wind_pending_targets
        - set:
            field: lasting_state.has_wind_walk_descent
            value: true
    metadata:
      category: internal
      visible_to_player: false
    parameters:
    - param_target_state_cb03a83d0b3e524f
    - param_lasting_state_a0a632fef1e150e2
    - param_source_id_da8b650d256d2fc5

sylvia_gm_runtime:
  format: 1
  state_namespace: pkg
tools:
  _complete_kan:
    description: Package-owned complete kan.
    parameters:
    - name: actor
      type: entity_id
      resolve: entity
    - name: selected
      type: object
      from_state: state.action_selection
    pre_conditions: []
    effects:
    - call: _interrupt
      params: {}
    - set:
        field: actor.game.hand
        value: without(actor.game.hand, selected.tiles)
    - set:
        field: _melds
        value: actor.game.melds
    - condition:
        condition: selected.op == 'ankan'
        on_true:
        - list_push:
            list: _melds
            value:
              form: '"triplet"'
              base: selected.base
              opened: false
              quad: true
              tiles: selected.tiles
              source_seat: actor.seat
        on_false:
        - set:
            field: _old
            value: _melds[selected.meld_index]
        - set:
            field: _update
            value:
              quad: true
              tiles: joined(_old.tiles, selected.tiles)
        - set:
            field: _melds
            value: replaced(_melds, selected.meld_index, merge(_old, _update))
    - set:
        field: actor.game.melds
        value: _melds
    - set:
        field: state.actor
        value: _actor_id
    - condition:
        condition: 'true'
        on_true:
        - set:
            field: _argument_concealed
            value: selected.op == 'ankan'
        - call: _finish_kan
          params:
            actor: '{_actor_id}'
            concealed: '{_argument_concealed}'
        on_false: []
    - set:
        field: state.message
        value: actor.name + ' completed a kan.'
    narrative: {}

    - require:
        condition: lasting_state.persistent_spell_areas != null
        error: Select an actual retained spell area.
    - set:
        field: _presence
        value: lasting_state.persistent_spell_areas[source_id]

        condition: _presence != null and _presence.profile == 'conjured_presence'

      - call: qualify_srd_conjured_presence_focus
        params:

        export_context:
          _presence_focus_live: _presence_focus_live
      - set:
          field: _celestial_clock
          value: '''exploration'''
      - set:

          value: lasting_state.lasting_tick

        - set:
            field: _celestial_clock
            value: '''combat'''
        - set:
            field: _celestial_turn
            value: combat.turn_sequence
      - set:
          field: _celestial_available
          value: true
      - set:
          field: _celestial_available
          value: false
        condition: _presence.event_clock == _celestial_clock and _presence.event_turn
          == _celestial_turn and _actor_state_id in _presence.event_target_ids
      - condition: _presence_focus_live == true and _celestial_available == true
        on_true:
        - call: srd_information_scene_entity
          params:
            subject: '{_actor_state_id}'
          export_context:
            _info_scene_entity: _info_scene_entity
            _info_position: _info_position
        - set:
            field: _celestial_entry_body
            value: _info_scene_entity
        - require:
            condition: _celestial_entry_body.metadata.plane != null
            error: Use the subject's actual admitted plane.
        - call: resolve_srd_celestial_body_segment
          params:
            moving_subject: '{_actor_state_id}'
            area_id: '{source_id}'
            start: '{_celestial_entry_body.position}'
            end: '{_celestial_entry_body.position}'
          export_context:
            _celestial_started_inside: _body_hit
        - condition: _celestial_started_inside != true
          on_true:
          - call: resolve_srd_celestial_body_segment
            params:
              moving_subject: '{_actor_state_id}'
              area_id: '{source_id}'
              start: '{_celestial_entry_body.position}'
              end: '{destination}'
            export_context:
              _body_hit: _body_hit

          - set:
              field: _celestial_candidate_t
              value: _body_entry
            condition: _body_hit == true and _body_entry > 0 and _body_entry <= 1
            _x:
              1: a

      export_context:
        _scene_distance: _scene_distance

        _scene_actor_entity: _scene_actor_entity
        _scene_exposure: _scene_exposure
    - require:
        condition: _scene_distance <= 5 and _scene_same_plane == true
        error: Touch needs actual range within 5 feet on the same plane.
    - set:
        field: _physical_touch_origin
        value:
        - _scene_actor_entity.position[0]
        - _scene_actor_entity.position[1]
        - _scene_actor_entity.position[2] + _scene_actor_entity.height * 0.5
    - require:
        condition: lasting_state.spatial_scene != null

    - require:
        condition: lasting_state.spatial_scene.map.grid.unit == 'ft'
        error: SRD scene distances use feet.

    - set:
        field: _physical_touch_samples
        value: _scene_exposure.samples
    - set:
        field: _physical_touch_clear
        value: false
    - for_each:
        collection: _physical_touch_samples
        as: _physical_touch_sample
        do:
        - condition: _physical_touch_clear != true
          on_true:
          - spatial_query:
              scene: state.spatial_scene

              snapshot: '{_info_snapshot}'
              query:
                map_id: '{lasting_state.spatial_scene.map.id}'
                origin: '{_physical_touch_origin}'
                destination: '{_physical_touch_sample.point}'
                include:
                - geometry

            store_as: _physical_touch_ray
          - require:

          - set:

          - set:

  resolve_srd_spike_growth_boundary:
    effects:
    - set:
        field: _spike_boundary_t
        value: 2
    - set:
        field: _spike_boundary_destination
        value: destination
    - call: srd_information_scene_entity
      params:
        subject: '{_actor_state_id}'
      export_context:
        _info_scene_entity: _info_scene_entity
        _info_position: _info_position
    - set:
        field: _spike_start
        value: _info_position
    - call: measure_srd_information_distance
      params:
        start: '{_spike_start}'
        end: '{destination}'
      export_context:
        _scene_distance: _scene_distance
    - set:
        field: _spike_route_length
        value: _scene_distance
    - call: resolve_srd_spike_growth_intervals
      params:
        actor_subject: '{_actor_state_id}'
        start: '{_spike_start}'
        end: '{destination}'
        mode: '{mode}'
      export_context:
        _spike_intervals: _spike_intervals
    - for_each:
        collection: _spike_intervals
        as: _spike_interval
        do:
        - set:
            field: _spike_remainder
            value: 0
        - set:
            field: _spike_receipt
            value: actor_state.spike_growth_travel[_spike_interval.area_id]
        - set:
            field: _spike_remainder
            value: _spike_receipt.remainder
          condition: _spike_receipt != null and _spike_receipt.sequence == _spike_interval.sequence
        - set:
            field: _spike_inside_distance
            value: _spike_route_length * (_spike_interval.exit - _spike_interval.entry)

            - set:

                value:

                - _spike_start[1] + (destination[1] - _spike_start[1]) * _spike_boundary_t
                - _spike_start[2] + (destination[2] - _spike_start[2]) * _spike_boundary_t

      visible_to_player: false
    parameters:

      export_context:
        _info_scene_entity: _info_scene_entity
        _info_position: _info_position

        collection: _truth_move_areas
        as: _truth_move_id

    effects:
    - call: format_srd_information_projection
      params:

      export_context:
        _environment_area_key: _info_projection_message
    - set:
        field: _environment_area
        value: lasting_state.persistent_spell_areas[_environment_area_key]
    - require:
        condition: _environment_area.profile == 'environment' and (_environment_area.mode
          == 'fog' or _environment_area.mode == 'cloudkill' or _environment_area.mode
          == 'stinking_cloud' or _environment_area.mode == 'incendiary_cloud') and
          _environment_area.active == true
        error: Select an active fog spell source.
    - set:
        field: _environment_wind_found
        value: false
    - set:
        field: _environment_wind_zones
        value: lasting_state.spatial_scene.zones
    - for_each:
        collection: _environment_wind_zones
        as: _environment_wind_zone
        do:
        - condition: (wind_zone_id == '' or _environment_wind_zone.id == wind_zone_id)
            and _environment_wind_zone.metadata.strong_wind == true and _environment_wind_zone.metadata.plane
            == _environment_area.plane
          on_true:
          - condition: _environment_wind_zone.shape.kind == 'box'
            on_true:
            - set:
                field: _environment_wind_nearest
                value:
                - max(_environment_wind_zone.shape.min[0], min(_environment_area.origin[0],
                  _environment_wind_zone.shape.max[0]))
                - max(_environment_wind_zone.shape.min[1], min(_environment_area.origin[1],
                  _environment_wind_zone.shape.max[1]))
                - max(_environment_wind_zone.shape.min[2], min(_environment_area.origin[2],
                  _environment_wind_zone.shape.max[2]))
            - call: measure_srd_information_distance
              params:
                start: '{_environment_area.origin}'
                end: '{_environment_wind_nearest}'
              export_context:
                _scene_distance: _scene_distance
            on_false:
            - require:
                condition: _environment_wind_zone.shape.kind == 'cylinder'
                error: Use the actual admitted strong-wind zone extent.
            - set:
                field: _environment_wind_horizontal
                value: max(0, ((_environment_area.origin[0] - _environment_wind_zone.shape.center[0])
                  ** 2 + (_environment_area.origin[1] - _environment_wind_zone.shape.center[1])
                  ** 2) ** 0.5 - _environment_wind_zone.shape.radius)
            - set:
                field: _environment_wind_vertical

                  _environment_area.origin[2] - _environment_wind_zone.shape.center[2]

            - set:

                value: (_environment_wind_horizontal ** 2 + _environment_wind_vertical

          - set:
              field: _environment_wind_found
              value: true
            condition: _scene_distance <= _environment_area.radius

        params:

    - params:

      export_context:
        _info_scene_entity: _info_scene_entity
        _info_position: _info_position

    - require:

            - _tsunami_source.volume.min[1] - _info_scene_entity.footprint.half_extents[1]

            max:

          > _body_bounds.min[2] and start[2] < _body_bounds.max[2]

            params:

          - set:

    - call: check_srd_target_condition_immunity

    - call: apply_srd_condition

    - call: format_srd_information_projection

            value: _visual_sleet_save_caption

  derive_srd_spell_area_axis_bounds:
    effects:
    - condition: candidate.footprint != null
      on_true:
      - require:
          condition: candidate.footprint.kind == 'box' or candidate.footprint.kind
            == 'circle'
          error: Cone physical qualification requires admitted box or circle blockers.
      - 1: a
      on_false:
      - require:
          condition: candidate.volume.kind == 'box' or candidate.volume.kind == 'cylinder'
          error: Cone physical qualification requires admitted box or cylinder geometry.
      - condition: candidate.volume.kind == 'box'
        on_true:
        - set:
            field: _area_axis_box_center
            value:
            - (candidate.volume.min[0] + candidate.volume.max[0]) * 0.5
            - (candidate.volume.min[1] + candidate.volume.max[1]) * 0.5
        - set:
            field: _area_axis_box_half
            value:
            - (candidate.volume.max[0] - candidate.volume.min[0]) * 0.5
            - (candidate.volume.max[1] - candidate.volume.min[1]) * 0.5
        - set:
            field: _area_axis_bounds
            value:
              min: (_area_axis_box_center[0] - origin[0]) * axis[0] + (_area_axis_box_center[1]
                - origin[1]) * axis[1] - (_area_axis_box_half[0] * abs(axis[0]) +
                _area_axis_box_half[1] * abs(axis[1]))
              max: (_area_axis_box_center[0] - origin[0]) * axis[0] + (_area_axis_box_center[1]
                - origin[1]) * axis[1] + (_area_axis_box_half[0] * abs(axis[0]) +
                _area_axis_box_half[1] * abs(axis[1]))
        on_false:
        - set:

            value:

                - origin[1]) * axis[1] - candidate.volume.radius
              max: (candidate.volume.center[0] - origin[0]) * axis[0] + (candidate.volume.center[1]
                - origin[1]) * axis[1] + candidate.volume.radius

tools:
  queue_srd_rope_trick_drop:
    effects:
    - set:
        field: _rope_return
        value: lasting_state.rope_trick_return_receipt
    - require:
        condition: _rope_return != null and _rope_return.kind == 'rope_trick_return'
          and _rope_return.consumed == true
        error: Only the authentic completed Rope Trick relocation may queue a drop.
    - call: initialize_srd_lite_constants_330cedf85ab0
      export_context: '*'
    - set:
        field: _xd_rows
        value: lasting_state.extradimensional_sources
      condition: lasting_state.extradimensional_sources != null
    - for_each:
        collection: _xd_rows
        as: _xd_row
        do:
        - set:
            field: _xd_source
            value: _xd_row
          condition: _xd_row.id == _rope_return.source_id
    - require:
        condition: _xd_source != null
        error: Choose an actual retained extradimensional source.
    - require:
        condition: _xd_source.spell == 'rope_trick' and _xd_source.active == false
          and _xd_source.created_tick == _rope_return.created_tick and _xd_source.cast_id
          == _rope_return.cast_id and _xd_source.outer_id == _rope_return.outer_id
          and _xd_source.room_id == _rope_return.origin_plane and _xd_source.origin_plane
          == _rope_return.plane
        error: The exact retained Rope Trick source must own the completed drop.
    - require:
        condition: _xd_source.return_pending == true
        error: Queue the actual endpoint before its source return receipt is retired.
    - call: srd_information_scene_entity
      params:
        subject: '{_rope_return.subject}'
      export_context:
        _info_scene_entity: _info_scene_entity
        _info_position: _info_position
    - require:
        condition: _info_scene_entity.active == true and _info_scene_entity.id ==
          _rope_return.body_id
        error: The returned body must still be the actual admitted source subject.
    - set:
        field: lasting_state.rope_trick_pending_drops
        value: []
      condition: lasting_state.rope_trick_pending_drops == null
    - set:
        field: _rope_drop_queue
        value: lasting_state.rope_trick_pending_drops
        do: 0
    - require:
        condition: len(_rope_drop_queue) < 64
        error: Complete the existing actual drops first.
    - for_each:
        collection: _rope_drop_queue
        as: _rope_queued_drop
        do:
        - require:
            condition: _rope_queued_drop.source_id != _rope_return.source_id or _rope_queued_drop.body_id
              != _rope_return.body_id or _rope_queued_drop.created_tick != _rope_return.created_tick
            error: The same authentic return cannot queue a second drop.
    - set:
        field: _rope_drop
        value:
          source_id: _rope_return.source_id
          created_tick: _rope_return.created_tick
          cast_id: _rope_return.cast_id
          subject: _rope_return.subject
          body_id: _rope_return.body_id
          outer_id: _rope_return.outer_id
          origin_plane: _rope_return.origin_plane
          plane: _rope_return.plane
          return_receipt: _rope_return
          body: _info_scene_entity
          captured_tick: lasting_state.lasting_tick
    - list_push:
        list: _rope_drop_queue
        value: _rope_drop
    - set:
        field: lasting_state.rope_trick_pending_drops
        value: _rope_drop_queue
    - set:
        field: lasting_state.has_rope_trick_pending_drops
        value: true
    metadata:
      category: internal
      visible_to_player: false
    parameters:
    - param_lasting_state_7bff8d20c3cf7d0f

      artifact state.

        in actor_state.conditions or 'unconscious' in actor_state.conditions)

    - require:

        error: Admit object facts outside combat.
    - require:
        condition: combat.pending_action == null
        error: Finish the pending action first.
    - call: srd_information_scene_entity
      params:
        subject: '{object_id}'

        condition: _info_scene_entity.id == object_id and _info_scene_entity.metadata.participant_ref
          == null

    - set:
        field: _object_scene
        value: _info_scene_entity
    - require:
        condition: _object_scene.footprint.kind == 'box'
        error: Admit the object's actual bounds before its break.
    - require:
        condition: break_max[0] >= break_min[0]
        error: Break bounds must increase.
    - require:
        condition: break_max[1] >= break_min[1]
        error: Break bounds must increase.
    - require:
        condition: break_max[2] >= break_min[2]
        error: Break bounds must increase.
    - require:
        condition: break_min[0] >= _object_scene.position[0] - _object_scene.footprint.half_extents[0]
          and break_max[0] <= _object_scene.position[0] + _object_scene.footprint.half_extents[0]
        error: The admitted break must lie inside the actual object.
    - require:
        condition: break_min[1] >= _object_scene.position[1] - _object_scene.footprint.half_extents[1]
          and break_max[1] <= _object_scene.position[1] + _object_scene.footprint.half_extents[1]
        error: The admitted break must lie inside the actual object.
    - require:
        condition: break_min[2] >= _object_scene.position[2] and break_max[2] <= _object_scene.position[2]
          + _object_scene.height
        error: The admitted break must lie inside the actual object.
    - set:
        field: _world_breaks
        value: []
    - set:
        field: _world_breaks
        value: _object_scene.metadata.srd_object_breaks
      condition: _object_scene.metadata.srd_object_breaks != null
    - for_each:
        collection: _world_breaks
        as: _world_break
        do:
        - require:
            condition: _world_break.id != break_id
            error: This physical break is already admitted.
    - list_push:
        list: _world_breaks
        value:
          id: break_id
          min: break_min
          max: break_max
    - require:

    - do:

    - set:

        target:

    - call: refresh_srd_spell_triggers

    - set:

          == 'box' and _presence_attack_body.metadata.is_object != true

    - set:
        field: _presence_target_conditions
        value: target_state.conditions
    - for_each:
        collection: _presence_target_conditions
        as: _presence_target_condition
        do:
        - require:

              bounded path.
    - require:
        condition: target_state.dodging != true and _presence_attack_body.metadata.cover_from
          == null

          here.
    - call: resolve_srd_conjured_subject_sight
      params:
        observer_state: '{_caster_state_id}'

      export_context:
        _illumination_point_can_see: _illumination_point_can_see
    - require:
        condition: _illumination_point_can_see == true
        error: This bounded Fey attack needs actual caster sight; unseen attack modifiers

    - call: resolve_srd_conjured_point_sight
      params:

        _illumination_point_can_see: _illumination_point_can_see
    - require:

        error: This bounded Fey attack needs actual target sight of its visible spirit.
    - set:

        - max(_presence_attack_body.position[0] - _presence_attack_body.footprint.half_extents[0]
          - point[0] - 2.5, point[0] - 2.5 - _presence_attack_body.position[0] - _presence_attack_body.footprint.half_extents[0],
          0)
        - max(_presence_attack_body.position[1] - _presence_attack_body.footprint.half_extents[1]
          - point[1] - 2.5, point[1] - 2.5 - _presence_attack_body.position[1] - _presence_attack_body.footprint.half_extents[1],

          - _presence_attack_body.height, 0)
    - require:
        condition: _presence_nearest[0] ** 2 + _presence_nearest[1] ** 2 + _presence_nearest[2]
          ** 2 <= 25

      params:
        start: '{point}'

        rule: solid

        _information_blocked: _information_blocked

    description: Find the first supported hostile reach boundary in this actual coordinate
      segment.
    parameters:
    - name: actor_state
      resolve: entity
    - name: destination
      type: array
      items:
        type: number
      min_items: 3
      max_items: 3
    - name: lasting_state
      resolve: entity
      required: false
      default: state
    effects:
    - set:
        field: _coordinate_candidates
        value: []
    - set:
        field: _coordinate_first_exit
        value: 1
    - set:
        field: _coordinate_ignored
        value: []
    - condition: lasting_state.pending_srd_movement != null
      on_true:
      - require:
          condition: lasting_state.pending_srd_movement.stage == 'resuming' and lasting_state.pending_srd_movement.actor
            == _actor_state_id
          error: Resolve the saved movement Reaction before another movement.
      - set:
          field: _coordinate_ignored
          value: lasting_state.pending_srd_movement.ignored
    - set:
        field: _coordinate_frames
        value: lasting_state.spatial_scene.entities
    - for_each:
        collection: _coordinate_frames

        do:
        - set:
            field: _coordinate_ref
            value: _coordinate_frame.id
        - condition: _coordinate_frame.metadata.participant_ref != null
          on_true:
          - set:
              field: _coordinate_ref
              value: _coordinate_frame.metadata.participant_ref
        - condition: _coordinate_frame.active == true and _coordinate_frame.metadata.participant_ref
            != null and _coordinate_frame.metadata.creature_type != null
          on_true:

            params:

              reactor_state: '{_coordinate_ref}'
              destination: '{destination}'
              ignored: '{_coordinate_ignored}'
            export_context:
              _coordinate_reactor: _coordinate_reactor
          - condition: _coordinate_reactor != null
            on_true:
            - condition: _coordinate_reactor.exit < _coordinate_first_exit - 0.000001
              on_true:
              - set:
                  field: _coordinate_first_exit
                  value: _coordinate_reactor.exit
              - set:
                  field: _coordinate_candidates
                  value: []
            - condition: abs(_coordinate_reactor.exit - _coordinate_first_exit) <=
                0.000001
              on_true:
              - list_push:
                  list: _coordinate_candidates
                  value: _coordinate_reactor
                _x: {}
    - call: srd_information_scene_entity
      params:

      export_context:
        _info_scene_entity: _info_scene_entity

    - set:
        field: _coordinate_requested_distance
        value: _scene_distance
    - set:

        - _coordinate_move_origin[1] + (destination[1] - _coordinate_move_origin[1])
          * _coordinate_first_exit
        - _coordinate_move_origin[2] + (destination[2] - _coordinate_move_origin[2])
          * _coordinate_first_exit

      costs_action: false

        collection: _seats

        - call: _standing
          params:

        - list_push:

            value: _score
    - set:
        field: _picked
        value: []
    - set:
        field: _standings
        value: []
    - set:
        field: _ranks
        value: indices(4)
    - for_each:
        collection: _ranks
        as: _rank
        do:
        - set:
            field: _best
            value: -1
        - set:
            field: _candidates
            value: indices(4)
        - for_each:
            collection: _candidates
            as: _candidate
            do:
            - condition:
                condition: _candidate not in _picked
                on_true:
                - condition:
                    condition: _best == -1
                    on_true:
                    - set:
                        field: _best
                        value: _candidate
                    on_false:
                    - condition:
                        condition: _scores[_candidate] > _scores[_best]
                        on_true:
                        - set:
                            value: _candidate
                        on_false: []
                on_false: []
        - condition:
            condition: 'true'
            on_true:
            - set:
                field: _argument_actor
                value: state.seats[_best]
            - call: _standing
              params:
                actor: '{_argument_actor}'
              export_context:
                _score: _score
                _name: _name
            on_false: []
        - list_push:
            list: _standings
            value:
              rank: _rank + 1
              seat: _best
              name: _name
              points: _score
        - list_push:
            list: _picked
            value: _best
    - set:
        field: state.match_result
        value:
          winner: _standings[0].seat
          standings: _standings

    - call: srd_information_scene_entity
      params:

    - require:
        condition: _info_scene_entity.active == true and _info_scene_entity.metadata.participant_ref

    - require:
        condition: _utility_record.spell_level >= 0
        error: The source needs its actual cast level.
    - require:
        condition: _utility_record.source_sha256 == 'dba4cdf16b912f655bd62da857b6d2033969bb1abe9aa0e604f3c60e69ec286d'
          and _utility_record.spell_level >= 6
        error: Instant Summons requires its exact source and real spell level.

    - require:

          and _utility_record.caster == _caster_state_id and _utility_record.spell_level

        error: Use this actual caster's pinned Floating Disk source.

tools:
  handoff_srd_earthquake_fissure_falls:
    effects:
    - condition: lasting_state.has_earthquake_fissure_falls == true and (lasting_state.pending_srd_action_stack
        == null or len(lasting_state.pending_srd_action_stack) == 0)
      on_true:
      - set:
          field: _fissure_effects
          value: lasting_state.turn_effects
      - set:
          field: _fissure_fall_targets
          value: []
      - set:
          field: _fissure_fall_receipts
          value: []
      - set:
          field: _fissure_retained_effects
          value: []
      - for_each:
          collection: _fissure_effects
          as: _fissure_effect
          do:
          - condition: _fissure_effect.kind == 'earthquake_fissure_fall' and _fissure_effect.source_sha256
              == '17be018e35fb0282e55954f4b5ddb8fb3336e715278c1d31fd854fec8f00cd84'
              and _fissure_effect.active == true
            on_true:
            - require:
                condition: len(_fissure_fall_targets) < 8 and _fissure_effect.target
                  not in _fissure_fall_targets
                error: Use the source's bounded, unambiguous actual falling bodies.
            - list_push:
                list: _fissure_fall_targets
                value: _fissure_effect.target
            - list_push:
                list: _fissure_fall_receipts
                value: _fissure_effect
            on_false:
            - list_push:
                list: _fissure_retained_effects
                value: _fissure_effect
      - condition: len(_fissure_fall_targets) > 0
        on_true:
        - call: begin_srd_scene_fall
          params:
            target_states: '{_fissure_fall_targets}'
            fall_cause: support_lost
          export_context:
            _pending_action_id: _pending_action_id
        - require:
            condition: lasting_state.pending_srd_actions[_pending_action_id].owner_kind
              == 'scene_fall' and lasting_state.pending_srd_actions[_pending_action_id].status
              == 'open'
            error: Retain earned source receipts only after the actual fall allocator
              accepts them.
        - require:
            condition: combat.encounter_active == true and combat.turn_active != true
              and lasting_state.pending_srd_actions[_pending_action_id].turn_actor
              == combat.active_actor
            error: Hand this earned fall off only after its actual turn closes.
        - set:
            field: lasting_state.pending_srd_actions.{_pending_action_id}.context.earthquake_fissure_completed_turn
            value:
              actor: combat.active_actor
              sequence: combat.turn_sequence
        - set:
            field: lasting_state.pending_srd_actions.{_pending_action_id}.turn_actor
            value: null
        - set:
            field: lasting_state.pending_srd_actions.{_pending_action_id}.context.earthquake_fissure_receipts
            value: _fissure_fall_receipts
      - set:
          field: lasting_state.turn_effects
          value: _fissure_retained_effects
      - set:
          field: lasting_state.has_earthquake_fissure_falls
          value: false
    metadata:
      category: internal
      visible_to_player: false
    parameters:
    - param_lasting_state_7bff8d20c3cf7d0f
  start_srd_form_recharge_turn:
    effects:
    - set:
        field: _recharge_source_id
        value: target_state.form_current_source_id
    - set:
        field: _recharge_source
        value: lasting_state.transformation_sources[_recharge_source_id]
    - require:
        condition: _recharge_source.installed == true
        error: The actual form source has ended.
    - table_lookup:
        table: definitions.beast_forms
        key: _recharge_source.form_id
        required: true
      store_as: _recharge_form
    - set:
        field: _recharge_form_id
        value: _recharge_source.form_id
    - set:
        field: lasting_state.transformation_sources.{_recharge_source_id}.recharge_uses
        value: {}
      condition: _recharge_source.recharge_uses == null
    - set:
        field: _recharge_uses
        value: {}
    - set:
        field: _recharge_uses
        value: lasting_state.transformation_sources[_recharge_source_id].recharge_uses[_recharge_form_id]
      condition: _recharge_form_id in lasting_state.transformation_sources[_recharge_source_id].recharge_uses
    - set:
        field: lasting_state.transformation_sources.{_recharge_source_id}.recharge_uses.{_recharge_form_id}
        value: _recharge_uses
    - set:
        field: _recharge_rows
        value: []
    - set:
        field: _recharge_attacks
        value: _recharge_form.recharge_attack_names
    - for_each:
        collection: _recharge_attacks
        as: _recharge_attack_name
        do:
        - set:
            field: _recharge_key
            value: _recharge_attack_name
        - condition: _recharge_key in _recharge_uses and _recharge_uses[_recharge_key].available
            != true and _recharge_uses[_recharge_key].last_turn < target_state.turns_started
          on_true:
          - dice:
              expression: d6
            store_as: _recharge_roll
          - set:
              field: lasting_state.transformation_sources.{_recharge_source_id}.recharge_uses.{_recharge_form_id}.{_recharge_key}
              value:
                available: _recharge_roll.total >= _recharge_form.attacks[_recharge_attack_name].recharge_min
                last_turn: target_state.turns_started
                roll: _recharge_roll
          - list_push:
              list: _recharge_rows
              value:
                label: _recharge_attack_name
                value: _recharge_roll.total
    metadata:
      category: internal
      visible_to_player: false
    parameters:
    - param_target_state_cb03a83d0b3e524f
    - param_lasting_state_a0a632fef1e150e2

    effects:
    - require:
        condition: candidate.active == true and (candidate.id == _target_state_id
          or candidate.metadata.participant_ref == _target_state_id)
        error: Reuse only this target's actual admitted scene body during the current
          plan.
    - set:
        field: _fissure_body
        value: candidate
    - set:
        field: _fissure_body_inside
        value: false
    - set:
        field: _fissure_edge_position
        value: null
    - require:
        condition: _fissure_body.footprint.kind == 'box'
        error: Fissures require an actual Box body.
    - condition: _fissure_body.position[perp] + _fissure_body.footprint.half_extents[perp]
        > offset - 5 and _fissure_body.position[perp] - _fissure_body.footprint.half_extents[perp]
        < offset + 5
      on_true:
      - require:
          condition: _fissure_body.position[perp] - _fissure_body.footprint.half_extents[perp]
            >= offset - 5 and _fissure_body.position[perp] + _fissure_body.footprint.half_extents[perp]
            <= offset + 5
          error: Boundary-straddling bodies need their actual opening-edge geometry.
      - require:
          condition: target_state.magic_jar_source_id == null and target_state.form_statistics_replaced
            != true and (target_state.current_body_source_id == null or target_state.current_body_source_id
            == _target_state_id)
          error: Fissure saves and falls require the actual native physical receiving
            body.
      - require:
          condition: target_state.creature_kind == 'character' or target_state.saving_throw_modifiers.dexterity
            != null
          error: Use the actual creature's Dexterity saving throw statistics.
      - set:
          field: _fissure_edge_coordinate
          value: offset - 5 - _fissure_body.footprint.half_extents[perp]
      - set:
          field: _fissure_edge_coordinate
          value: offset + 5 + _fissure_body.footprint.half_extents[perp]
        condition: edge == 'positive'
      - condition: perp == 0
        on_true:
        - set:
            field: _fissure_edge_position
            value:
            - _fissure_edge_coordinate
            - {}
            - _fissure_body.position[2]
        on_false:
        - set:
            field: _fissure_edge_position
            value:
            - _fissure_body.position[0]
            - _fissure_edge_coordinate

            a guessed fallback.
      - require:
          condition: _travel_placement.position[1] == _fissure_edge_position[1]
          error: The chosen opening edge must be an actual clear placement, without
            a guessed fallback.
      - require:
          condition: _travel_placement.position[2] == _fissure_edge_position[2]
          error: The chosen opening edge must be an actual clear placement, without
            a guessed fallback.
      - set:
          field: _fissure_body_inside
          value: true

                == 'existing_wind_descent' or _mirage_loss_result.status == 'falling'

      - set:

      - for_each:

          as: _mirage_loss_fall
          do:
          - list_push:
              list: _mirage_loss_targets
              value: _mirage_loss_fall.actor_id
      - condition: len(_mirage_loss_targets) > 0

      artifact state.

    - condition: actor.validation_status == 'validated'
      error: A quarantined Player Character cannot take a Reaction.

  id: a1-b2
tools:
  qualify_srd_tsunami_motion:
    effects:
    - set:
        field: _tsunami_receipt
        value: lasting_state.tsunami_pending_motion
    - require:
        condition: _tsunami_receipt != null and _tsunami_receipt.kind == 'tsunami_carry'
          and _tsunami_receipt.consumed == false and _tsunami_receipt.subject == subject
          and _tsunami_receipt.plane == plane and _tsunami_receipt.tick == lasting_state.lasting_tick
        error: Only the authentic paid water wall can force this carried movement.
    - call: initialize_srd_lite_constants_5766c11a9ecf
      export_context: '*'
    - set:
        field: _tsunami_lookup
        value: lasting_state.tsunami_sources
      condition: lasting_state.tsunami_sources != null
    - for_each:
        collection: _tsunami_lookup
        as: _tsunami_candidate
        do:
        - condition: _tsunami_candidate.id == _tsunami_receipt.source_id
          on_true:
          - require:
              condition: _tsunami_source == null
              error: Tsunami source identity is ambiguous.
          - set:
              field: _tsunami_source
              value: _tsunami_candidate
    - require:
        condition: _tsunami_source != null
        error: Select an authentic retained Tsunami source.
    - require:
        condition: _tsunami_source.active == true and _tsunami_source.sequence ==
          _tsunami_receipt.sequence and _tsunami_source.caster == _tsunami_receipt.caster
          and combat.active_actor == _tsunami_source.caster
        error: The exact advancing water source or actual caster turn changed.
    - call: srd_information_scene_entity
      params:
        subject: '{subject}'
      export_context:
        _info_scene_entity: _info_scene_entity
        _info_position: _info_position
    - set:
        field: _tsunami_moving_body
        value: _info_scene_entity
    - require:
        condition: _tsunami_moving_body.id == _tsunami_receipt.body_id and _tsunami_moving_body.height
          == _tsunami_receipt.height and _tsunami_moving_body.footprint.half_extents[0]
          == _tsunami_receipt.extents[0] and _tsunami_moving_body.footprint.half_extents[1]
          == _tsunami_receipt.extents[1]
        error: The actual carried body changed before movement.
    - require:
        condition: _tsunami_moving_body.position[0] == _tsunami_receipt.origin[0]
          and destination[0] == _tsunami_receipt.destination[0] and destination[0]
          == _tsunami_receipt.origin[0] + _tsunami_source.motion_delta[0]
        error: Use the exact fifty-foot source endpoint.
    - require:
        condition: _tsunami_moving_body.position[1] == _tsunami_receipt.origin[1]
          and destination[1] == _tsunami_receipt.destination[1] and destination[1]
          == _tsunami_receipt.origin[1] + _tsunami_source.motion_delta[1]
        error: Use the exact fifty-foot source endpoint.
    - require:
        condition: _tsunami_moving_body.position[2] == _tsunami_receipt.origin[2]
          and destination[2] == _tsunami_receipt.destination[2] and destination[2]
          == _tsunami_receipt.origin[2] + _tsunami_source.motion_delta[2]
        error: Use the exact fifty-foot source endpoint.
    - set:
        field: _tsunami_motion_allowed
        value: true
    metadata:
      category: internal
      visible_to_player: false
    parameters:
    - param_subject_3f9e3ffc3bfe8ffd
    - param_destination_897e99fd4c074a9d
    - param_plane_1f147b6f378b0935
    - param_lasting_state_7bff8d20c3cf7d0f
  resolve_srd_black_tentacles_body_segment:
    effects:
    - call: format_srd_information_projection
      params:
        message: '{area_id}'
      export_context:
        _environment_area_key: _info_projection_message
    - call: initialize_srd_lite_constants_c786b07628f4
      export_context: '*'
    - set:
        field: _tentacle_body_source
        value: lasting_state.persistent_spell_areas[_environment_area_key]
    - require:
        condition: _tentacle_body_source.mode == 'tentacles' and _tentacle_body_source.volume.kind
          == 'box'
        error: Use the actual saved Black Tentacles ground square.
    - call: srd_information_scene_entity
      params:
        subject: '{moving_subject}'
      export_context:
        _info_scene_entity: _info_scene_entity
        _info_position: _info_position
    - require:
        condition: _info_scene_entity.footprint.kind == 'box'
        error: Ground square entry requires an actual box creature.
    - condition: _info_scene_entity.metadata.plane == _tentacle_body_source.plane
        and _info_scene_entity.metadata.flying != true
      on_true:
      - set:
          field: _tentacle_body_volume
          value:
            kind: '''box'''
            min:
            - _tentacle_body_source.volume.min[0] - _info_scene_entity.footprint.half_extents[0]
            - _tentacle_body_source.volume.min[1] - _info_scene_entity.footprint.half_extents[1]
            - _tentacle_body_source.volume.min[2]
            max:
            - _tentacle_body_source.volume.max[0] + _info_scene_entity.footprint.half_extents[0]
            - _tentacle_body_source.volume.max[1] + _info_scene_entity.footprint.half_extents[1]
            - _tentacle_body_source.volume.max[2]
      - set:
          field: _body_bounds
          value: _tentacle_body_volume
      - call: srd_information_segment_interval
        params:
          start: '{start}'
          end: '{end}'
          volume: '{_tentacle_body_volume}'
        export_context:
          _body_hit: _segment_hit
          _body_entry: _segment_entry
          _body_exit: _segment_exit
      - require:
          condition: abs(start[2] - _tentacle_body_source.origin[2]) < 0.000000001
            and abs(end[2] - _tentacle_body_source.origin[2]) < 0.000000001
          error: Ground square entry currently requires the actual flat source support.
        condition: _body_hit == true
    metadata:
      category: internal
      visible_to_player: false
    parameters:
    - param_moving_subject_0f0ceb83dc16cfe3
    - param_area_id_e089c46d11628c06
    - param_start_d98e3be2ca5dca70
    - param_end_2ff639971e9448b4
    - param_lasting_state_f791c68f01bb49c8

    effects:
    - require:
        condition: caster_state.is_alive == true and not ('incapacitated' in caster_state.conditions
          or 'paralyzed' in caster_state.conditions or 'petrified' in caster_state.conditions
          or 'stunned' in caster_state.conditions or 'unconscious' in caster_state.conditions)
        error: An Incapacitated caster cannot operate a sensor.
    - call: collect_srd_information_record
      params:
        caster_state: '{_caster_state_id}'
        spell: '{spell}'
      export_context:
        _info_record: _info_record
        _info_active: _info_active
        _info_instance_id: _info_instance_id
    - require:
        condition: _info_active == true
        error: The selected sensor spell is not active.
    - condition: combat.encounter_active == true
      on_true:
      - require:
          condition: combat.turn_active == true and combat.active_actor == _caster_state_id
          error: Operate the sensor on its caster's turn.
      - require:
          condition: caster_state.control_confusion_active != true
          error: Confusion prevents Bonus Actions.
      - call: consume_srd_bonus_action
        params:
          actor_state: '{_caster_state_id}'
          bonus_action: '{spell}'
    - condition: spell == 'arcane_eye'
      on_true:
      - call: srd_information_scene_entity
        params:
          subject: '{_info_record.proxy_id}'
        export_context:
          _info_scene_entity: _info_scene_entity
          _info_position: _info_position
      - call: measure_srd_information_distance
        params:

          end: '{destination}'
        export_context:

      - require:
          condition: _scene_distance <= 30
          error: An Arcane Eye Bonus Action moves at most 30 feet.
      - call: check_srd_arcane_eye_clearance
        params:
          start: '{_info_position}'
          end: '{destination}'
        export_context:
          _eye_blocked: _eye_blocked
      - require:
          condition: _eye_blocked != true
          error: A solid barrier or opening narrower than one inch blocks the eye.
      - spatial_mutation:
          scene: state.spatial_scene

          expected_revision: '{lasting_state.spatial_scene.map.revision}'
          target:
            kind: entity
            id: '{_info_record.proxy_id}'
          patch:
            position: '{destination}'
        store_as: _eye_movement
      - call: refresh_srd_spell_triggers
        condition: state.has_spell_triggers == true
      - set:
          field: _operated_position
          value: destination

      - call: update_srd_information_record
        params:

          spell: '{spell}'
          modality: '{modality}'
          terrain: '{_info_record.terrain}'
          instance_id: '{_info_instance_id}'
      - call: srd_information_scene_entity
        params:
          subject: '{_info_record.proxy_id}'
        export_context:
          _info_scene_entity: _info_scene_entity
          _info_position: _info_position
      - require:
          condition: (destination[0] == 0 and destination[1] == 0 and destination[2]
            == 0) or (destination[0] == _info_position[0] and destination[1] == _info_position[1]
            and destination[2] == _info_position[2])
          error: Clairvoyance's fixed sensor cannot move.
      - set:
          field: _operated_position
          value: _info_position
    - set:
        field: _operated_modality
        value: modality
    metadata:
      category: internal
      visible_to_player: false
    parameters:
    - param_caster_state_5310b8b23a525eea
    - param_spell_630bbfe23b71e991

        value: []
    - for_each:

sylvia_gm_runtime:
  format: 1
  state_namespace: pkg
tools:
  dispel_srd_passwall_owned_source:
    effects:
    - call: read_srd_lifetime_passwall_source
      params:
        source_id: '{source_id}'
      export_context:
        _lifetime_record: _lifetime_record
        _lifetime_active: _lifetime_active
    - require:
        condition: _lifetime_active == true and _lifetime_record.dispel_ongoing !=
          false
        error: Select an actual active ongoing passwall source.
    - require:
        condition: point[0] >= _lifetime_record.open_min[0] and point[0] <= _lifetime_record.open_max[0]
          and point[1] >= _lifetime_record.open_min[1] and point[1] <= _lifetime_record.open_max[1]
          and point[2] >= _lifetime_record.open_min[2] and point[2] <= _lifetime_record.open_max[2]
        error: Choose a point in the actual saved Passwall opening.
    - set:
        field: _lifetime_dispel_point
        value: point
    - set:
        field: _lifetime_dispel_plane
        value: _lifetime_record.plane
    - call: srd_information_scene_entity
      params:
        subject: '{_caster_state_id}'
      export_context:
        _info_scene_entity: _info_scene_entity
        _info_position: _info_position
    - set:
        field: _adoption_caster_position
        value:
          1: a
    - require:
        condition: _info_scene_entity.metadata.plane == _lifetime_dispel_plane
        error: The selected spell effect is on another plane.
    - call: measure_srd_information_distance
      params:
        start: '{_adoption_caster_position}'
        end: '{_lifetime_dispel_point}'
      export_context:
        _scene_distance: _scene_distance
    - require:
        condition: _scene_distance <= 120
        error: The selected spell effect is beyond Dispel range.
    - call: srd_information_barriers
      params:
        start: '{_adoption_caster_position}'
        end: '{_lifetime_dispel_point}'
        plane: '{_lifetime_dispel_plane}'
        rule: solid
      export_context:
        _information_blocked: _information_blocked
    - require:
        condition: _information_blocked != true
        error: A solid barrier blocks the actual Dispel path.
    - call: resolve_srd_dispel_source_check
      params:
        caster_state: '{_caster_state_id}'
        caster: '{_caster_id}'
        slot_level: '{slot_level}'
        source_level: '{_lifetime_record.spell_level}'
        casting_modifier: '{casting_modifier}'
        casting_ability: '{casting_ability}'
      export_context:
        _dispel_succeeded: _dispel_succeeded
        _dispel_roll: _dispel_roll
        _visual_dispel_description: _visual_dispel_description
        _visual_dispel_equation: _visual_dispel_equation
    - set:
        field: _adoption_dispel_check
        value:
          spell: _lifetime_record.spell
          source_id: source_id
          ended: _dispel_succeeded
          roll: null
          dc: 10 + _lifetime_record.spell_level
          feedback: _visual_dispel_description
          equation: null
    - condition: _dispel_roll != null
      on_true:
      - set:
          field: _adoption_roll_patch
          value:
            roll: _dispel_roll
      - set:

tools:
  retained_spell_query_project_srd_arcane_hand_grapples:
    effects:
    - condition: force_target.arcane_hand_grapple_ids != null and 'grappled' in force_target.conditions
        and force_target.grappled_by != null and force_target.grappled_by not in force_target.arcane_hand_grapple_ids
      on_true:
      - set:
          field: force_target.arcane_hand_unowned_grappled
          value: true
      - set:
          field: force_target.arcane_hand_prior_grappler
          value: force_target.grappled_by
      - set:
          field: force_target.arcane_hand_prior_escape_dc
          value: force_target.grapple_escape_dc
    - set:
        field: _hand_grips
        value: []
    - set:
        field: _hand_grip_dc
        value: 0
    - set:
        field: _hand_grip_id
        value: null
    - set:
        field: _hand_ids
        value: lasting_state.spell_force_ids
    - for_each:
        collection: _hand_ids
        as: _hand_id
        do:
        - set:
            field: _hand_grip
            value: lasting_state.spell_force_records[_hand_id]
        - condition: _hand_grip.spell == 'arcane_hand' and _hand_grip.active == true
            and _hand_grip.grapple_target == _force_target_id and lasting_state.lasting_tick
            < _hand_grip.expires_tick and _hand_grip.suppressed != true
          on_true:
          - list_push:
              list: _hand_grips
              value: _hand_id
          - condition: _hand_grip.save_dc >= _hand_grip_dc
            on_true:
            - set:
                field: _hand_grip_dc
                value: _hand_grip.save_dc
            - set:
                field: _hand_grip_id
                value: _hand_id
    - set:
        field: force_target.arcane_hand_grapple_ids
        value: _hand_grips
    - condition: len(_hand_grips) > 0

          condition: grappled
      - set:

      - set:

        - '''eyebite_sick'''
        - '''affinity_antipathy'''
        - '''affinity_sympathy'''
        - '''nightmare'''
        - '''weird'''

            condition: _affliction.condition == 'poisoned'

              and _affliction.affliction_moved_turn != target_state.turns_started

          field: actor_state.resources.focus_point
          value: actor_state.resources.focus_point - 1
      - dice:

        store_as: _replacement_die
      - set:

          value: []
      - set:
          field: _replacement_total
          value: _replacement_die.total
      - list_push:
          list: _replacement_rolls
          value: _replacement_die.total
      - condition: len(rolls) == 2

        - set:
            field: _retained_die
            value: rolls[1]
        - condition: _disciplined_selection == 'second'
          on_true:
          - set:
              field: _retained_die
              value: rolls[0]
        - list_push:
            list: _replacement_rolls
            value: _retained_die
        - condition: advantage == true and disadvantage == false

          - set:

              value: max(_replacement_die.total, _retained_die)

          - set:
              field: _replacement_total
              value: min(_replacement_die.total, _retained_die)
      - set:

            count: len(rolls)
            results: _replacement_rolls
            total: _replacement_total
            modifier: modifier

          value: true

    - call: srd_information_scene_entity

        value: _info_scene_entity

        condition: _wall_segment_body.footprint.kind == 'box'

        > 0 and _wall_segment_body.metadata.plane == _wall_record.plane
      on_true:
      - set:
          field: _expanded_wall_volume
          value:
            kind: '''box'''
            min:
            - _wall_record.volume.min[0] - _wall_segment_body.footprint.half_extents[0]
            - _wall_record.volume.min[1] - _wall_segment_body.footprint.half_extents[1]
            - _wall_record.volume.min[2] - _wall_segment_body.height
            max:
            - _wall_record.volume.max[0] + _wall_segment_body.footprint.half_extents[0]
            - _wall_record.volume.max[1] + _wall_segment_body.footprint.half_extents[1]
            - _wall_record.volume.max[2]

        condition: start[0] == end[0] and (start[0] <= _expanded_wall_volume.min[0]

    - condition: family == 'self_temporary_hit_points' and base_level == 1 and base_dice

meta:
  id: mutation-case
tools:
  retained_spell_query_qualify_srd_environment_wind:
    effects:
    - call: format_srd_information_projection
      params:
        message: '{area_id}'
      export_context:
        _environment_area_key: _info_projection_message
    - set:
        field: _environment_area
        value: lasting_state.persistent_spell_areas[_environment_area_key]
    - require:
        condition: _environment_area.profile == 'environment' and (_environment_area.mode
          == 'fog' or _environment_area.mode == 'cloudkill' or _environment_area.mode
          == 'stinking_cloud' or _environment_area.mode == 'incendiary_cloud') and
          _environment_area.active == true
        error: Select an active fog spell source.
    - set:
        field: _environment_wind_found
        value: false
    - set:
        field: _environment_wind_zones
        value: lasting_state.spatial_scene.zones
    - for_each:
        collection: _environment_wind_zones
        as: _environment_wind_zone
        do:
        - condition: (wind_zone_id == '' or _environment_wind_zone.id == wind_zone_id)
            and _environment_wind_zone.metadata.strong_wind == true and _environment_wind_zone.metadata.plane
            == _environment_area.plane
          on_true:
          - condition: _environment_wind_zone.shape.kind == 'box'
            on_true:
            - set:
                field: _environment_wind_nearest
                value:
                - max(_environment_wind_zone.shape.min[0], min(_environment_area.origin[0],
                  _environment_wind_zone.shape.max[0]))
                - max(_environment_wind_zone.shape.min[1], min(_environment_area.origin[1],
                  _environment_wind_zone.shape.max[1]))
                - max(_environment_wind_zone.shape.min[2], min(_environment_area.origin[2],
                  _environment_wind_zone.shape.max[2]))
            - call: measure_srd_information_distance
              params:
                start: '{_environment_area.origin}'
                end: '{_environment_wind_nearest}'
              export_context:
                _scene_distance: _scene_distance
            on_false:
            - require:
                condition: _environment_wind_zone.shape.kind == 'cylinder'
                error: Use the actual admitted strong-wind zone extent.
            - set:
                field: _environment_wind_horizontal
                value: max(0, ((_environment_area.origin[0] - _environment_wind_zone.shape.center[0])
                  ** 2 + (_environment_area.origin[1] - _environment_wind_zone.shape.center[1])
                  ** 2) ** 0.5 - _environment_wind_zone.shape.radius)
            - set:
                field: _environment_wind_vertical
                value: max(0, _environment_wind_zone.shape.center[2] - _environment_area.origin[2],
                  _environment_area.origin[2] - _environment_wind_zone.shape.center[2]
                  - _environment_wind_zone.shape.height)
            - set:
                field: _scene_distance
                value: (_environment_wind_horizontal ** 2 + _environment_wind_vertical
                  ** 2) ** 0.5
          - set:
              field: _environment_wind_found
              value: true
            condition: _scene_distance <= _environment_area.radius
    - condition: lasting_state.has_storm_sources == true
      on_true:
      - call: retained_spell_query_qualify_srd_storm_fog_wind
        params:
          area_id: '{area_id}'
          caster_state: '{_environment_area.caster}'
          plane: '{_environment_area.plane}'
          lasting_state: '{_lasting_state_id}'
        export_context:
          _storm_fog_full_wind: _storm_fog_full_wind
      - set:
          field: _environment_wind_found
          value: true
        condition: _storm_fog_full_wind == true
    metadata:

            - _tsunami_source.volume.min[1] - _info_scene_entity.footprint.half_extents[1]

    effects:

    - call: srd_information_scene_entity
      params:
        subject: '{actor_subject}'
      export_context:
        _info_scene_entity: _info_scene_entity
        _info_position: _info_position
    - type:
        field: _sleet_route_plane
        value: _info_scene_entity.metadata.plane
    - condition: _info_scene_entity.metadata.flying != true
      on_true:
      - call: initialize_srd_lite_constants_f68db9f9b129
        export_context: '*'
      - set:
          field: _environment_ids
          value: lasting_state.persistent_spell_area_ids
        condition: lasting_state.has_spell_environments == true
      - for_each:
          collection: _environment_ids

                == _sleet_route_plane

              - call: qualify_srd_environment_sphere_source
                params:
                  caster_state: '{_environment_area.caster}'
                  area_id: '{_environment_id}'
                export_context:
                  _sphere_source_current: _sphere_source_current
              - condition: _sphere_source_current == true

                - call: srd_information_segment_interval
