  id: Bad_ID
tools:
  retained_spell_query_check_srd_form_light:
    effects:
    - set:
        field: _form_bright_light_feet
        value: 0
    - set:
        field: _form_dim_light_feet
        value: 0
    - condition: actor_state.has_transformations == true
      on_true:
      - set:
          field: _body_light_source
          value: null
      - set:
          field: _body_light_ids
          value: actor_state.transformation_source_ids
      - for_each:
          collection: _body_light_ids
          as: _body_light_id
          do:
          - set:
              field: _body_light_candidate
              value: lasting_state.transformation_sources[_body_light_id]
          - condition: _body_light_candidate.installed == true
            on_true:
            - call: retained_spell_query_check_srd_transformation_source
              params:
                target_state: '{_actor_state_id}'
                caster_state: '{_body_light_candidate.caster_state_id}'
                lasting_state: '{_lasting_state_id}'
                source_id: '{_body_light_id}'
              export_context:
                _form_source_active: _form_source_active
                _form_source: _form_source
            - set:
                field: _body_light_source
                value: _form_source
              condition: _form_source_active == true and (_body_light_source == null
                or _form_source.serial > _body_light_source.serial)
      - condition: _body_light_source != null and _body_light_source.profile == 'beast'
        on_true:
        - call: lookup_srd_transformation_form
          params:
            form_id: '{_body_light_source.form_id}'
          export_context:
            _body_light_profile: _transformation_form
        - set:
            field: _form_bright_light_feet
            value: _body_light_profile.bright_light_feet
        - set:
            field: _form_dim_light_feet
            value: _body_light_profile.dim_light_feet
    metadata:
      category: internal
      visible_to_player: false
    parameters:
    - param_actor_state_d3c054b169a46c77
    - param_lasting_state_a0a632fef1e150e2
    on_true: {}
parameter_declarations:
  param_actor_state_d3c054b169a46c77:
    name: actor_state
    resolve: entity
  param_lasting_state_a0a632fef1e150e2:
    name: lasting_state
    resolve: entity

sylvia_gm_runtime:
  format: 1
  state_namespace: pkg
tools:
  read_srd_carried_item_size:
    description: Read a carried item's size category adjustment from its actual resizing
      source.
    effects:
    - set:
        field: _carried_item_size_adjustment
        value: 0
    - set:
        field: _carried_item_size_adjustment
        value: actor_state.size_category_adjustment
      condition: actor_state.actor_size_projected == true and actor_state.enlarge_scaled_items
        != null and item in actor_state.enlarge_scaled_items and actor_state.inventory
        != null and item in actor_state.inventory
    - set:
        field: time_stop_state.time_stop_source.spell_action_active
        value: false
      condition: time_stop_state.time_stop_source != null
    - call: finalize_srd_time_stop
      condition: time_stop_state.time_stop_source != null and time_stop_state.time_stop_source.ending
        == true
    metadata:
      category: equipment
      result_card:
        version: 1
        footprint: inline
        title: Carried item size
        summary:
        - label: Item
          value:
            path: parameters.item
        - label: Size category adjustment
          value:
            path: context._carried_item_size_adjustment
        details:
        - label: Creature ID
          value:
            path: parameters.actor_state
    parameters:
    - param_actor_state_d3c054b169a46c77
    - param_item_7213cea508c49e6c
    - param_time_stop_state_ffde41c75687f2dd
  check_srd_message_barriers:
    effects:
    - require:
        condition: lasting_state.spatial_scene != null
        error: This operation needs the admitted spatial scene.
    - require:
        condition: lasting_state.spatial_scene.map.grid.unit == 'ft'
        error: SRD scene distances use feet.
    - spatial_query:
        scene: state.spatial_scene
        operation: snapshot
      store_as: _info_snapshot
    - set:
        field: _message_blocked
        value: false
    - set:
        field: _message_geometry
        value: lasting_state.spatial_scene.geometry
    - for_each:
        collection: _message_geometry
        as: _message_wall
        do:
        - condition: _message_wall.active == true
          on_true:
          - call: srd_information_segment_interval
            params:
              start: '{start}'
              end: '{end}'
              volume: '{_message_wall.volume}'
            export_context:
              _segment_hit: _segment_hit
              _segment_thickness: _segment_thickness
          - condition: _segment_hit == true and _segment_thickness > 0.000000000001
            on_true:
            - set:
                field: _message_blocked
                value: true
              condition: _message_wall.metadata.material == 'lead' or ((_message_wall.metadata.material
                == 'stone' or _message_wall.metadata.material == 'metal' or _message_wall.metadata.material
                == 'wood') and _segment_thickness + 0.000000000001 >= 1)
    - set:
        field: _message_zones
        value: lasting_state.spatial_scene.zones
    - for_each:
        collection: _message_zones
        as: _message_zone
        do:
        - condition: _message_zone.metadata.active != false and _message_zone.metadata.magical_silence
            == true
          on_true:
          - call: srd_information_segment_interval
            params:
              start: '{start}'
              end: '{end}'
              volume: '{_message_zone.shape}'
            export_context:
              _segment_hit: _segment_hit
              _segment_thickness: _segment_thickness
          - set:
              field: _message_blocked
              value: true
            condition: _segment_hit == true
    metadata:
      category: internal
      visible_to_player: false
    parameters:
    - param_start_d98e3be2ca5dca70
    - param_end_2ff639971e9448b4
    - param_lasting_state_7bff8d20c3cf7d0f
parameter_declarations:

  format: 1
  state_namespace: pkg
tools:
  retire_srd_phantom_steed_equipment:
    effects:
    - require:
        condition: lasting_state.phantom_steed_sources != null
        error: Choose an actual Phantom Steed source.
    - set:
        field: _ps_source
        value: null
    - set:
        field: _ps_sources
        value: lasting_state.phantom_steed_sources
    - for_each:
        collection: _ps_sources
        as: _ps_row
        do:
        - set:
            field: _ps_source
            value: _ps_row
          condition: _ps_row.id == source_id
    - require:
        condition: _ps_source != null and _ps_source.spell == 'phantom_steed'
        error: Choose the exact retained Phantom Steed source.
    - set:
        field: _ps_tack_ids
        value: _ps_source.equipment_ids
    - for_each:
        collection: _ps_tack_ids
        as: _ps_tack_id
        do:
        - call: srd_information_scene_entity
          params:
            subject: '{_ps_tack_id}'
          export_context:
            _info_scene_entity: _info_scene_entity
            _info_position: _info_position
        - set:
            field: _ps_tack
            value: _info_scene_entity
        - require:
            condition: _ps_tack.metadata.phantom_steed_source == source_id
            error: The tack must retain its actual source identity.
        - condition: _ps_tack.active == true
          on_true:
          - spatial_mutation:
              scene: state.spatial_scene
              map_id: '{lasting_state.spatial_scene.map.id}'
              expected_revision: '{lasting_state.spatial_scene.map.revision}'
              target:
                kind: entity
                id: '{_ps_tack_id}'
              patch:
                active: false
                movement: passable
                visibility: clear
            store_as: _ps_retired_scene
          - call: refresh_srd_spell_triggers
            condition: state.has_spell_triggers == true
    metadata:
      category: internal
      visible_to_player: false
    parameters:
    - param_source_id_da8b650d256d2fc5
    - param_lasting_state_7bff8d20c3cf7d0f
parameter_declarations:
  param_lasting_state_7bff8d20c3cf7d0f:
    name: lasting_state
    required: false
    resolve: entity
    default: state
  param_source_id_da8b650d256d2fc5:
    name: source_id

meta:
  id: mutation-case
tools:
  collect_srd_animated_caster_initiative:
    effects:
    - set:
        field: _initiative_linked_animated_objects
        value: []
    - set:
        field: _ao_initiative_source
        value: lasting_state.animated_object_sources[caster_state.concentration_cast_id]
    - require:
        condition: _ao_initiative_source.installed == true and _ao_initiative_source.caster_state_id
          == _caster_state_id
        error: The Initiative source must be this caster's current animation.
    - set:
        field: _ao_initiative_actor_ids
        value: _ao_initiative_source.actors
    - for_each:
        collection: _ao_initiative_actor_ids
        as: _ao_initiative_actor
        do:
        - list_push:
            list: _initiative_linked_animated_objects
            value: _ao_initiative_actor
          condition: lasting_state.animated_object_bodies[_ao_initiative_actor].active
            == true
    metadata:
      category: internal
      visible_to_player: false
    parameters:
    - param_caster_state_5310b8b23a525eea
    - param_lasting_state_7bff8d20c3cf7d0f
  retire_srd_gust_flame:
    effects:
    - call: srd_information_scene_entity
      params:
        subject: '{object_id}'
      export_context:
        _info_scene_entity: _info_scene_entity
        _info_position: _info_position
    - require:
        condition: _info_scene_entity.id == object_id and _info_scene_entity.metadata.participant_ref
          == null
        error: An object target must be an actual non-creature scene ID.
    - set:
        field: _object_scene
        value: _info_scene_entity
    - set:
        field: _gust_dancing_ids
        value: []
    - set:
        field: _gust_old_dancing_ids
        value: _object_scene.metadata.srd_ordinary_flame.gust_dancing_sources
    - for_each:
        collection: _gust_old_dancing_ids
        as: _gust_dancing_id
        do:
        - list_push:
            list: _gust_dancing_ids
            value: _gust_dancing_id
          condition: _gust_dancing_id != source_id
    - set:
        field: _gust_native_dancing
        value: _object_scene.metadata.srd_ordinary_flame.gust_native_dancing == true
    - set:
        field: _gust_dancing_patch
        value:
          gust_dancing_sources: _gust_dancing_ids
          dancing_wildly: _gust_native_dancing == true or len(_gust_dancing_ids) >
            0
    - set:
        field: _gust_flame
        value: merge(_object_scene.metadata.srd_ordinary_flame, _gust_dancing_patch)
    - condition: len(_gust_dancing_ids) == 0
      on_true:
      - set:
          field: _gust_native_clear
          value:
            gust_native_dancing: null
      - set:
          field: _gust_flame
          value: merge(_gust_flame, _gust_native_clear)
    - require:
        condition: lasting_state.spatial_scene != null
        error: This operation needs the admitted spatial scene.
    - require:
        condition: lasting_state.spatial_scene.map.grid.unit == 'ft'
        error: SRD scene distances use feet.
    - spatial_query:
        scene: state.spatial_scene
        operation: snapshot
      store_as: _info_snapshot
    - set:
        field: _world_changes
        value:
          srd_ordinary_flame: _gust_flame
    - call: initialize_srd_lite_constants_d63675087646
      export_context: '*'
    - set:
        field: _world_changes
        value: merge(_world_changes, _world_object_marker)
    - set:
        field: _world_metadata
        value: merge(_object_scene.metadata, _world_changes)
    - spatial_mutation:
        scene: state.spatial_scene
        map_id: '{lasting_state.spatial_scene.map.id}'
        expected_revision: '{_info_snapshot.geometry_revision}'
        target:
          kind: entity
          id: '{object_id}'
        patch:
          metadata: '{_world_metadata}'
      store_as: _world_mutation
    - call: refresh_srd_spell_triggers
      condition: state.has_spell_triggers == true
    metadata:
      category: internal
      visible_to_player: false
    parameters:
    - param_source_id_da8b650d256d2fc5
    - param_object_id_2b5cfd2dd4c129d5
    - param_lasting_state_7bff8d20c3cf7d0f
parameter_declarations:
  param_caster_state_5310b8b23a525eea:
    name: caster_state
    resolve: entity
  param_lasting_state_7bff8d20c3cf7d0f:
    name: lasting_state
    required: false
    resolve: entity
    default: state
  param_object_id_2b5cfd2dd4c129d5:

meta:

tools:
  qualify_srd_guards_wards_web_target:
    effects:
    - call: format_srd_information_projection
      params:
        message: '{area_id}'
      export_context:
        _environment_area_key: _info_projection_message
    - set:
        field: _sphere_target_source
        value: lasting_state.spell_guarded_web_sections[_environment_area_key]
    - set:
        field: _sphere_target_inside
        value: false
    - call: qualify_srd_guards_wards_web_exemption
      params: ''
      export_context:
        _sphere_source_current: _sphere_source_current
        _ward_web_exempt: _ward_web_exempt
    - condition: _sphere_source_current == true and target_state.is_alive == true
        and _ward_web_exempt != true
      on_true:
      - call: srd_information_scene_entity
        params:
          subject: '{_target_state_id}'
        export_context:
          _info_scene_entity: _info_scene_entity
          _info_position: _info_position
      - require:
          condition: _info_scene_entity.footprint.kind == 'box'
          error: Creature-space Sphere membership requires an admitted box footprint.
      - condition: _info_scene_entity.metadata.plane == _sphere_target_source.plane
        on_true:
        - call: resolve_srd_guards_wards_web_body_segment
          params:
            moving_subject: '{_target_state_id}'
            area_id: '{area_id}'
            start: '{_info_position}'
            end: '{_info_position}'
          export_context:
            _sphere_membership: _body_hit
        - condition: _sphere_membership == true
          on_true:
          - require:
              condition: lasting_state.spatial_scene != null
              error: This operation needs the admitted spatial scene.
          - require:
              condition: lasting_state.spatial_scene.map.grid.unit == 'ft'
              error: SRD scene distances use feet.
          - spatial_query:
              scene: state.spatial_scene
              operation: snapshot
            store_as: _info_snapshot
          - spatial_query:
              scene: state.spatial_scene
              operation: exposure
              snapshot: '{_info_snapshot}'
              query:
                map_id: '{lasting_state.spatial_scene.map.id}'
                observer:
                  point: '{_sphere_target_source.origin}'
                samples:
                  horizontal: 3
                  vertical: 3
                include:
                - geometry
            store_as: _sphere_target_exposure
          - set:
              field: _sphere_target_inside
              value: _sphere_target_exposure.visible_samples > 0
    - set:
        field: _sphere_target_inside
        value: false
      condition: state.spell_guarded_web_sections[area_id].web_destroyed == true
    metadata:
      category: internal
      visible_to_player: false
    parameters:
    - param_target_state_cb03a83d0b3e524f

    - param_lasting_state_f791c68f01bb49c8

tools:
  advance_srd_storm_caster_start:
    effects:
    - require:
        condition: caster_state.turns_started != null and caster_state.turns_started
          == boundary_turn
        error: Storm ordinal needs the creating caster's actual started turn.
    - set:
        field: _storm_start_rows
        value: lasting_state.turn_effects
    - set:
        field: _storm_start_kept
        value: []
    - for_each:
        collection: _storm_start_rows
        as: _storm_start_row
        do:
        - condition: _storm_start_row.kind == 'storm_of_vengeance' and _storm_start_row.caster
            == _caster_state_id
          on_true:
          - call: check_srd_storm_of_vengeance_record
            params:
              caster_state: '{_caster_state_id}'
              record: '{_storm_start_row}'
            export_context:
              _storm_live: _storm_live
          - condition: _storm_live == true and (_storm_start_row.last_caster_start
              == null or boundary_turn > _storm_start_row.last_caster_start)
            on_true:
            - set:
                field: _storm_advance
                value: 1
            - set:
                field: _storm_advance
                value: boundary_turn - _storm_start_row.last_caster_start
              condition: _storm_start_row.last_caster_start != null
            - set:
                field: _storm_start_change
                value:
                  last_caster_start: boundary_turn
                  storm_ordinal: _storm_start_row.storm_ordinal + _storm_advance
                  later_effect_pending: true
            - set:
                field: _storm_start_row
                value: merge(_storm_start_row, _storm_start_change)
        - list_push:
            list: _storm_start_kept
            value: _storm_start_row
    - set:
        field: lasting_state.turn_effects
        value: _storm_start_kept
    - call: resolve_srd_storm_later_caster_start

        caster_state: '{_caster_state_id}'

  qualify_srd_lite_offensive_combat_entry:
    effects:
    - require:
        condition: combat.encounter_active != true
        error: Status entry requires the actual inactive boundary.
    - set:
        field: _lo_entry_rows
        value: []
    - set:
        field: _lo_entry_kept
        value: []
    - set:
        field: _lo_entry_targets
        value: []
    - condition: lasting_state.turn_effects != null
      on_true:
      - set:
          field: _lo_entry_rows
          value: lasting_state.turn_effects
    - for_each:
        collection: _lo_entry_rows
        as: _lo_entry_row
        do:
        - set:
            field: _lo_entry_id
            value: _lo_entry_row.lite_offensive_status == true and _lo_entry_row.cast_id
              != null and _lo_entry_row.cast_id != '' and _lo_entry_row.caster !=
              null and _lo_entry_row.source_caster_id == _lo_entry_row.caster
        - set:
            field: _lo_entry_span
            value: _lo_entry_row.ongoing_duration == true and _lo_entry_row.spell_level
              == 0 and _lo_entry_row.started_tick != null and _lo_entry_row.expires_tick
              != null and _lo_entry_row.expires_tick == _lo_entry_row.started_tick
              + 2 and _lo_entry_row.turn != null
        - set:
            field: _lo_entry_frost
            value: _lo_entry_row.spell == 'ray_of_frost' and _lo_entry_row.kind ==
              'speed_reduction' and _lo_entry_row.owner == _lo_entry_row.caster and
              _lo_entry_row.phase == 'start' and _lo_entry_row.magnitude == 10
        - set:
            field: _lo_entry_mockery
            value: _lo_entry_row.spell == 'vicious_mockery' and _lo_entry_row.kind
              == 'next_attack_disadvantage' and _lo_entry_row.owner == _lo_entry_row.target
              and _lo_entry_row.phase == 'end' and _lo_entry_row.magnitude == 0
        - set:
            field: _lo_entry_valid
            value: _lo_entry_id and _lo_entry_span and (_lo_entry_frost or _lo_entry_mockery)
        - condition: _lo_entry_valid
          on_true:
          - condition: _lo_entry_row.target not in _lo_entry_targets
            on_true:
            - list_push:
                list:
                  1: a
                value: _lo_entry_row.target
          - condition: lasting_state.lasting_tick != null and lasting_state.lasting_tick
              + 0.000000001 < _lo_entry_row.expires_tick
            on_true:
            - list_push:
                list: _lo_entry_kept
                value:
                  spell: _lo_entry_row.spell
                  label: _lo_entry_row.label
                  caster: _lo_entry_row.caster
                  target: _lo_entry_row.target
                  kind: _lo_entry_row.kind
                  owner: _lo_entry_row.owner
                  phase: _lo_entry_row.phase
                  turn: _lo_entry_row.turn
                  expires_tick: _lo_entry_row.expires_tick
                  magnitude: _lo_entry_row.magnitude
                  dice_count: _lo_entry_row.dice_count
                  damage_die: _lo_entry_row.damage_die
                  damage_type: _lo_entry_row.damage_type
                  cast_id: _lo_entry_row.cast_id
                  source_caster_id: _lo_entry_row.source_caster_id
                  ongoing_duration: _lo_entry_row.ongoing_duration
                  spell_level: _lo_entry_row.spell_level
                  lite_offensive_status: _lo_entry_row.lite_offensive_status
                  started_tick: _lo_entry_row.started_tick
                  combat_qualified: true
          on_false:
          - list_push:
              list: _lo_entry_kept
              value: _lo_entry_row
    - set:
        field: lasting_state.turn_effects
        value: _lo_entry_kept
    - for_each:
        collection: _lo_entry_targets
        as: _lo_entry_target
        do:
        - call: project_srd_turn_modifiers
          params:
            target_state: '{_lo_entry_target}'
            lasting_state: '{_lasting_state_id}'

      category: internal
      visible_to_player: false
    parameters:
    - param_lasting_state_7bff8d20c3cf7d0f

        != null and _native_condition_record.native_body_source_sequence == _native_condition_record.sequence

              > 0 and len(_native_condition_body.body_source_id) > 0
        - set:

            value: _native_condition_body_valid
          condition: _native_condition_record.condition == 'paralyzed' and _native_condition_record.native_attack
            == 'Claw' and _native_condition_record.native_body_block_sha256 == 'ca93598a7266b964cec2a4c96725334f2e20800bfa8ccc9693c82aa0657870e1'

            field: false

              or (_native_condition_record.condition == 'poisoned' and _native_condition_record.native_attack

          condition: _native_condition_record.native_body_block_sha256 == '9ada001041b41a1e129de34eeabbecc5672dabdd2d455d08e105a66c6f2cfe86'
            and _native_condition_body.source_block_sha256 == '9ada001041b41a1e129de34eeabbecc5672dabdd2d455d08e105a66c6f2cfe86'

    effects:
    - require:
        condition: caster_state.teleport_resolution != null and caster_state.teleport_resolution.paid

    - call: format_srd_information_projection
      params:
        message: '{area_id}'
      export_context:
        _environment_area_key: _info_projection_message
    - set:

      - set:

          value:
          - (_wind_gas_wall.volume.min[0] + _wind_gas_wall.volume.max[0]) * 0.5
          - (_wind_gas_wall.volume.min[1] + _wind_gas_wall.volume.max[1]) * 0.5
          - (_wind_gas_wall.volume.min[2] + _wind_gas_wall.volume.max[2]) * 0.5

          - condition: _wind_gas_fog.profile == 'environment' and _wind_gas_fog.active

                - max(_wind_gas_wall.volume.min[1], min(_wind_gas_wall.volume.max[1],
                  _wind_gas_fog.origin[1]))

                  _wind_gas_fog.origin[2]))
            - call: measure_srd_information_distance

                end: '{_wind_gas_fog.origin}'
              export_context:

            - condition: _scene_distance < _wind_gas_fog.radius

                export_context:

    - require:
        condition: lasting_state.spatial_scene.map.grid.unit == 'ft'
        error: SRD scene distances use feet.
    - spatial_query:
        scene: state.spatial_scene
        operation: snapshot
      store_as: _info_snapshot
    - call: srd_information_scene_entity
      params:
        subject: '{_target_state_id}'
      export_context:
        _info_scene_entity: _info_scene_entity
        _info_position: _info_position
    - set:
        field: _courier_route
        value: []
    - set:
        field: _courier_route_reason
        value: '''clear'''
    - set:
        field: _courier_route_origin
        value: _info_position
    - set:
        field: _courier_route_entity
        value: _info_scene_entity
    - call: srd_information_barriers
      params:
        start: '{_info_position}'
        end: '{goal}'
        rule: solid
      export_context:
        _information_blocked: _information_blocked
    - condition: _information_blocked != true
      on_true:
      - list_push:
          list: _courier_route
          value: goal
      on_false:
      - set:
          field: _courier_grid
          bogus: lasting_state.spatial_scene.map.grid
      - set:
          field: _courier_start_cell
          value:
          - floor((_courier_route_origin[0] - _courier_grid.origin[0]) * _courier_grid.cell_size
            ** -1)
          - floor((_courier_route_origin[1] - _courier_grid.origin[1]) * _courier_grid.cell_size
            ** -1)
      - set:
          field: _courier_goal_cell
          value:
          - floor((goal[0] - _courier_grid.origin[0]) * _courier_grid.cell_size **
            -1)
          - floor((goal[1] - _courier_grid.origin[1]) * _courier_grid.cell_size **
            -1)
      - spatial_query:
          scene: state.spatial_scene
          operation: path
          snapshot: '{_info_snapshot}'
          query:
            map_id: '{lasting_state.spatial_scene.map.id}'
            start: '{_courier_start_cell}'
            goal: '{_courier_goal_cell}'
            allow_diagonal: true
            corner_policy: forbid_cutting
            include_entities: true
            moving_entity_id: '{_info_scene_entity.id}'
            max_steps: 10000
        store_as: _courier_path
      - set:
          field: _courier_route_reason
          value: '''blocked'''
      - set:
          field: _courier_route_reason
          value: '''route_search_limit'''
        condition: _courier_path.truncated == true
      - condition: _courier_path.found == true
        on_true:
        - set:
            field: _courier_route_reason
            value: '''calculated_detour'''
        - set:
            field: _courier_cells
            value: _courier_path.cells
        - set:
            field: _courier_cell_index
            value: 0
        - for_each:
            collection: _courier_cells
            as: _courier_cell
            do:
            - condition: _courier_cell_index > 0
              on_true:
              - set:
                  field: _courier_waypoint
                  value:
                  - _courier_grid.origin[0] + (_courier_cell[0] + 0.5) * _courier_grid.cell_size
                  - _courier_grid.origin[1] + (_courier_cell[1] + 0.5) * _courier_grid.cell_size
                  - _courier_route_origin[2]

              != null and _lo_entry_row.cast_id != '' and _lo_entry_row.caster !=
              null and _lo_entry_row.source_caster_id == _lo_entry_row.caster
        - set:
            value: _lo_entry_row.ongoing_duration == true and _lo_entry_row.spell_level
              == 0 and _lo_entry_row.started_tick != null and _lo_entry_row.expires_tick
              != null and _lo_entry_row.expires_tick == _lo_entry_row.started_tick
              + 2 and _lo_entry_row.turn != null
        - set:
            field: _lo_entry_frost
            value: _lo_entry_row.spell == 'ray_of_frost' and _lo_entry_row.kind ==
              'speed_reduction' and _lo_entry_row.owner == _lo_entry_row.caster and
              _lo_entry_row.phase == 'start' and _lo_entry_row.magnitude == 10
        - set:

              and _lo_entry_row.phase == 'end' and _lo_entry_row.magnitude == 0
        - set:
            field: _lo_entry_valid
            value: _lo_entry_id and _lo_entry_span and (_lo_entry_frost or _lo_entry_mockery)
        - condition: _lo_entry_valid
          on_true:
          - condition: _lo_entry_row.target not in _lo_entry_targets

            - list_push:

                value: _lo_entry_row.target
          - condition: lasting_state.lasting_tick != null and lasting_state.lasting_tick
              + 0.000000001 < _lo_entry_row.expires_tick

            - list_push:

                  kind: _lo_entry_row.kind
                  owner: _lo_entry_row.owner

                  magnitude: _lo_entry_row.magnitude
                  dice_count: _lo_entry_row.dice_count

                  damage_type: _lo_entry_row.damage_type
                  cast_id: _lo_entry_row.cast_id
                  source_caster_id: _lo_entry_row.source_caster_id
                  ongoing_duration: _lo_entry_row.ongoing_duration
                  spell_level: _lo_entry_row.spell_level
                  lite_offensive_status: _lo_entry_row.lite_offensive_status
                  started_tick: _lo_entry_row.started_tick
                  combat_qualified: true

            DC {save_dc}.

          _recorded_result_text: _recorded_result_text
      - set:
          field: _reaction_outcome_text

      - set:

meta:
  id: a1-b2
tools:
  take_action:
    description: Choose a current action ID using the acting seat's permitted information.
    parameters:
    - name: actor
      type: entity_id
      from_state: state.actor
      resolve: entity
    - name: choice
      type: string
    pre_conditions:
    - condition: state.phase in definitions.play_phases
      error: The table is not waiting for a move.
    effects:
    - set:
        field: _selected
        value: null
    - set:
        field: _choices
        value: state.choices
    - for_each:
        collection: _choices
        as: _choice
        do:
        - condition:
            condition: _choice.id == choice
            on_true:
            - set:
                field: _selected
                value: _choice
            on_false: []
    - require:
        condition: _selected != null
        error: This action is no longer legal.
    - set:
        field: state.action_selection
        value: _selected
    - condition:
        condition: _selected.op == 'discard' or _selected.op == 'riichi'
        on_true:
        - call: _discard
          params:
            actor: '{_actor_id}'
        on_false: []
    - condition:
        condition: _selected.op == 'pass' or _selected.op == 'ron' or _selected.op
          == 'chi' or _selected.op == 'pon' or _selected.op == 'minkan'
        on_true:
        - call: _respond
          params:
            actor: '{_actor_id}'
        on_false: []
    - condition:
        condition: _selected.op == 'ankan' or _selected.op == 'kakan'
        on_true:
        - set:
            field: state.kan_pending_dora
            value: 0
        - set:
            field: _kan_seat
            value:
              seat: actor.seat
        - set:
            field: state.pending_kan
            value: merge(_selected, _kan_seat)
        - set:
            field: state.last_discard
            value:
              seat: actor.seat
              tile: _selected.tiles[len(_selected.tiles) - 1]
        - call: _begin_responses
          params:
            seat: '{actor.seat}'
        - set:
            field: state.phase
            value: '"kan_response"'
        - set:
            field: state.message
            value: actor.name + ' declared a kan.'
        on_false: []
    - condition:
        condition: _selected.op == 'tsumo'
        on_true:
        - set:
            field: state.winners
            value: one(actor.seat)
        - set:
            field: state.win_tsumo
            value: true
        - set:
            field: state.winning_tile
            value: actor.game.last_draw
        - set:
            field: state.win_source
            value: '"live_draw"'
        - condition:
            condition: actor.game.rinshan
            on_true:
            - set:
                field: state.win_source
                value: '"rinshan"'
            on_false: []
        - call: _settle_wins
          params: {}
        on_false: []
    - condition:
        condition: _selected.op == 'abort_nine'
        on_true:
        - call: _abort
          params:
            reason: Nine terminals
        on_false: []
    - condition:
        condition: _selected.op == 'continue'
        on_true:
        - call: _advance_match
          params: {}
        on_false: []
    - call: _refresh
      params: {}
    - publish:
        fields:
          message: state.message
          result: state.result
          match_result: state.match_result
    narrative: {}
    metadata:
      model_behavior: resolves_player_intent
      player_controls:
        confirmation: none
        response: automatic
        checks:
        - condition: choice in state.choice_ids
          reason: This move is no longer available.
  check_srd_divination_record:
    effects:
    - set:
        field: _divination_active
        value: record.kind == 'divination_spell' and lasting_state.lasting_tick <
          record.expires_tick
    - set:
        field: _divination_active
        value: _divination_active == true and caster_state.is_alive == true and 'incapacitated'
          not in caster_state.conditions and 'paralyzed' not in caster_state.conditions
          and 'petrified' not in caster_state.conditions and 'stunned' not in caster_state.conditions
          and 'unconscious' not in caster_state.conditions and caster_state.concentration_spell_id
          == record.spell and caster_state.concentration_effect_family == 'divination_spell'
          and caster_state.concentration_started_tick == record.started_tick
      condition: record.concentration == true
    metadata:
      category: internal
      visible_to_player: false
    parameters:
    - param_caster_state_5310b8b23a525eea
    - param_record_6f8a25da8bc52225
    - param_lasting_state_7bff8d20c3cf7d0f

meta:
  id: mutation-case
tools:
  record_srd_teleport_destination:
    description: Record the caster's descriptive familiarity with an actual destination
      anchor.
    effects:
    - call: srd_information_scene_entity
      params:
        subject: '{destination_subject}'
      export_context:
        _info_scene_entity: _info_scene_entity
        _info_position: _info_position
    - set:
        field: _teleport_anchor
        value: _info_scene_entity
    - require:
        condition: _teleport_anchor.metadata.plane != null
        error: The destination anchor needs its actual plane.
    - set:
        field: _teleport_known
        value: []
    - set:
        field: _teleport_known
        value: caster_state.teleport_destinations
      condition: caster_state.teleport_destinations != null
    - set:
        field: _teleport_kept
        value: []
    - for_each:
        collection: _teleport_known
        as: _teleport_known_destination
        do:
        - list_push:
            list: _teleport_kept
            value: _teleport_known_destination
          condition: _teleport_known_destination.anchor != _teleport_anchor.id
    - list_push:
        list: _teleport_kept
        value:
          anchor: _teleport_anchor.id
          position: _teleport_anchor.position
          plane: _teleport_anchor.metadata.plane
          familiarity: familiarity
    - set:
        field: caster_state.teleport_destinations
        value: _teleport_kept
    - set:
        field: _teleport_knowledge
        value: familiarity
    - set:
        field: time_stop_state.time_stop_source.spell_action_active
        value: false
      condition: time_stop_state.time_stop_source != null
    - call: finalize_srd_time_stop
      condition: time_stop_state.time_stop_source != null and time_stop_state.time_stop_source.ending
        == true
    metadata:
      category: information
      result_card:
        version: 1
        footprint: compact
        title: Teleport destination knowledge
        summary:
        - label: Familiarity
          value:
            path: context._teleport_knowledge
    parameters:
    - param_caster_state_5310b8b23a525eea
    - param_destination_subject_054c4f8b0dea9349
    - name: familiarity
      type: enum
      enum_values:
      - very_familiar
      - seen_casually
      - viewed_once
      - described
      - false_destination
    - param_time_stop_state_ffde41c75687f2dd

tools:
  retained_spell_query_end_srd_conjured_presence_source:
    effects:
    - require:
        condition: lasting_state.persistent_spell_areas != null
        error: Select an actual retained spell area.
    - set:
        field: _presence
        value: lasting_state.persistent_spell_areas[source_id]
    - require:
        condition: _presence != null and _presence.profile == 'conjured_presence'
        error: Select an actual retained Celestial or Fey source.
    - set:
        field: _presence_was_active
        value: _presence.active == true
    - set:
        field: _presence_patch
        value:
          active: false
          installed: false
    - set:
        field: _presence
        value: merge(_presence, _presence_patch)
    - set:
        field: lasting_state.persistent_spell_areas.{source_id}
        value: _presence
    - condition: _presence.mode == 'fey' and _presence_was_active == true
      on_true:
      - require:
          condition: lasting_state.spatial_scene != null
          error: This operation needs the admitted spatial scene.
      - require:
          condition: lasting_state.spatial_scene.map.grid.unit == 'ft'
          error: SRD scene distances use feet.

          scene: state.spatial_scene
          operation: snapshot
        store_as: _info_snapshot

          scene: state.spatial_scene
          map_id: '{lasting_state.spatial_scene.map.id}'
          expected_revision: '{_info_snapshot.geometry_revision}'
          target:
            kind: entity
            id: '{_presence.subject_id}'
          patch:
            active: false
            movement: passable
            visibility: clear
        store_as: _presence_retired_anchor
      - call: retained_spell_query_refresh_srd_spell_triggers
        condition: lasting_state.has_spell_triggers == true
        params:
          lasting_state: '{_lasting_state_id}'

    parameters:
    - param_source_id_da8b650d256d2fc5
    - param_lasting_state_7bff8d20c3cf7d0f

    - condition: actor_state.environment_area_id != null
      on_true:
      - set:
          field: _animals_source_id
          value: actor_state.environment_area_id
      - set:
          field: _animals_source
          value: lasting_state.persistent_spell_areas[_animals_source_id]
      - condition: _animals_source.mode == 'animals'

        - call: retained_spell_query_qualify_srd_environment_emanation_source
          params:

          export_context:
            _emanation_source_current: _emanation_source_current
        - condition: _emanation_source_current == true

          - call: retained_spell_query_srd_information_scene_entity
            params:
              subject: '{_actor_state_id}'
              lasting_state: '{_lasting_state_id}'
            export_context:
              _info_scene_entity: _info_scene_entity
              _info_position: _info_position
          - call: retained_spell_query_resolve_srd_environment_body_segment
            params:
              moving_subject: '{_actor_state_id}'
              fixed_subject: '{_animals_source.anchor_id}'
              start: '{_info_position}'
              end: '{_info_position}'
              radius: 5
              lasting_state: '{_lasting_state_id}'
            export_context:
              _body_hit: _body_hit
          - set:
              field: _conjure_animals_strength_advantage
              value: _body_hit

meta:
  id: mutation-case
tools:
  write_srd_lite_exploration_mage_hand_object:
    effects:
    - require:
        condition: combat.encounter_active != true
        error: Combat object changes use the actual scene mutation owner.
    - set:
        field: _hand_write
        value: updates[0]
    - require:
        condition: _hand_write.body != null and _hand_write.metadata_delta != null
          and _hand_write.frame_delta != null
        error: Supply the exact native object body and finite metadata/frame changes.
    - require:
        condition: _hand_write.body.id == object_id and _hand_write.body.metadata.participant_ref
          == null
        error: Preserve the exact scenery identity and creature boundary.
    - require:
        condition: len(_hand_write.frame_delta) <= 3
        error: Store only finite native property changes.
    - set:
        field: _hand_frame_keys
        value: []
    - condition: '''active'' in _hand_write.frame_delta'
      on_true:
      - list_push:
          list: _hand_frame_keys
          value: '''active'''
    - condition: '''movement'' in _hand_write.frame_delta'
      on_true:
      - list_push:
          list: _hand_frame_keys
          value: '''movement'''
    - condition: '''visibility'' in _hand_write.frame_delta'
      on_true:
      - list_push:
          list: _hand_frame_keys
          value: '''visibility'''
    - require:
        condition: len(_hand_write.frame_delta) == len(_hand_frame_keys)
        error: Mage Hand cannot replace position, dimensions, HP or plane through
          a frame patch.
    - condition: lasting_state.lite_exploration_objects == null
      on_true:
      - set:
          field: lasting_state.lite_exploration_objects
          value: {}
      - set:
          field: lasting_state.lite_exploration_object_ids
          value: []
    - require:
        condition: object_id in lasting_state.lite_exploration_objects or len(lasting_state.lite_exploration_object_ids)
          < 128
        error: Exploration supports at most 128 retained objects.
    - call: initialize_srd_lite_constants_9732ceb4e7e4
      export_context: '*'
    - condition: object_id in lasting_state.lite_exploration_objects and lasting_state.lite_exploration_objects[object_id].pending_patch
        != null
      on_true:
      - set:
          field: _lite_saved_pending_patch
          value: lasting_state.lite_exploration_objects[object_id].pending_patch
    - set:
        field: _lite_saved_pending_patch
        value: merge(_lite_saved_pending_patch, _hand_write.metadata_delta)
    - condition: object_id in lasting_state.lite_exploration_objects and lasting_state.lite_exploration_objects[object_id].pending_frame_patch
        != null
      on_true:
      - set:
          field: _lite_saved_pending_frame_patch
          value: lasting_state.lite_exploration_objects[object_id].pending_frame_patch
    - set:
        field: _lite_saved_pending_frame_patch
        value: merge(_lite_saved_pending_frame_patch, _hand_write.frame_delta)
    - set:
        field: lasting_state.lite_exploration_objects.{object_id}
        value:
          id: object_id
          body: _hand_write.body
          pending_scene_reconciliation: true
          pending_patch: _lite_saved_pending_patch
          pending_frame_patch: _lite_saved_pending_frame_patch
    - set:
        field: _lite_object_ids
        value: lasting_state.lite_exploration_object_ids
    - condition: object_id not in _lite_object_ids
      on_true:
      - list_push:
          list: _lite_object_ids
          value: object_id
    - set:
        field: lasting_state.lite_exploration_object_ids
        value: _lite_object_ids
    metadata:
      category: internal
      visible_to_player: false
    parameters:
    - param_object_id_2b5cfd2dd4c129d5
    - name: updates
      type: array
      items:
        type: object
      min_items: 1
      max_items: 1
    - param_lasting_state_7bff8d20c3cf7d0f

    name: object_id

    - require:

      - set:

      - set:

      - set:

      - set:

      - set:

    effects:
    - require:
        condition: lasting_state.spell_guards_wards_sources != null and source_id
          in lasting_state.spell_guards_wards_sources
        error: Select an actual Guards and Wards source.
    - set:
        field: _guards_source

    - set:
        field: _ward_web_ending_sections
        value: []
    - set:

        value: _guards_source.web_section_ids
      condition: _guards_source.web_section_ids != null

        as: _ward_web_ending_id
        do:
        - set:
            field: _ward_web_ending

            condition: _ward_web_ending.parent_source_id == source_id and _ward_web_ending.parent_serial

            error: The section must retain its original ward parent.
        - set:

            value: false
        - set:
            field: _ward_web_condition_ids
            value: _ward_web_ending.condition_source_ids
        - for_each:

            as: _ward_web_condition_id
            do:
            - set:
                field: _ward_web_condition
                value: lasting_state.timed_condition_sources[_ward_web_condition_id]
            - condition: _ward_web_condition.installed == true and _ward_web_condition.spell_id
                == 'guards_and_wards' and _ward_web_condition.guarded_web_section_id
                == _ward_web_ending_id and _ward_web_condition.guarded_web_parent_serial
                == _guards_source.serial

    - set:
        field: _ps_tack_horse

    - set:

    - set:

        value: _ps_tack_horse.metadata.plane
    - set:
        field: _ps_tack_ids
        value: _ps_source.equipment_ids
    - for_each:

        - call: srd_information_scene_entity

            _info_position: _info_position
          '':
            subject: '{_ps_tack_id}'
        - set:
            field: _ps_tack
            value: _info_scene_entity
        - condition: _ps_tack.active == true
          on_true:
          - set:
              field: _ps_tack_position
              value: _ps_tack.position
          - set:
              field: _ps_tack_plane
              value: _ps_tack.metadata.plane
          - condition: _ps_tack.metadata.carried_by != null and _ps_tack.metadata.carried_by
              != ''
            on_true:
            - call: srd_information_scene_entity
              params:
                subject: '{_ps_tack.metadata.carried_by}'
              export_context:
                _info_scene_entity: _info_scene_entity
                _info_position: _info_position

meta:
  id: mutation-case
tools:
  qualify_srd_earthquake_fissure_body:
    effects:
    - call: srd_information_scene_entity
      params:
        subject: '{_target_state_id}'
      export_context:
        _info_scene_entity: _info_scene_entity
        _info_position: _info_position
    - set:
        field: _fissure_body
        value: _info_scene_entity
    - set:
        field: _fissure_body_inside
        value: false
    - set:
        field: _fissure_edge_position
        value: null
    - require:
        condition: _fissure_body.footprint.kind == 'box'
        error: Fissures require an actual Box body.
    - condition: _fissure_body.position[perp] + _fissure_body.footprint.half_extents[perp]
        > offset - 5 and _fissure_body.position[perp] - _fissure_body.footprint.half_extents[perp]
        < offset + 5
      on_true:
      - require:
          condition: _fissure_body.position[perp] - _fissure_body.footprint.half_extents[perp]
            >= offset - 5 and _fissure_body.position[perp] + _fissure_body.footprint.half_extents[perp]
            <= offset + 5
          error: Boundary-straddling bodies need their actual opening-edge geometry.
      - require:
          condition: target_state.magic_jar_source_id == null and target_state.form_statistics_replaced
            != true and (target_state.current_body_source_id == null or target_state.current_body_source_id
            == _target_state_id)
          error: Fissure saves and falls require the actual native physical receiving
            body.
      - require:
          condition: target_state.creature_kind == 'character' or target_state.saving_throw_modifiers.dexterity
            != null
          error: Use the actual creature's Dexterity saving throw statistics.
      - set:
          field: _fissure_edge_coordinate
          value: offset - 5 - _fissure_body.footprint.half_extents[perp]
      - set:
          field: _fissure_edge_coordinate
          value: state.map
        condition: edge == 'positive'
      - condition: perp == 0
        on_true:
        - set:
            field: _fissure_edge_position
            value:
            - _fissure_edge_coordinate
            - _fissure_body.position[1]
            - _fissure_body.position[2]
        on_false:
        - set:
            field: _fissure_edge_position
            value:
            - _fissure_body.position[0]
            - _fissure_edge_coordinate
            - _fissure_body.position[2]
      - call: resolve_srd_travel_placement
        params:
          subject: '{_target_state_id}'
          destination: '{_fissure_edge_position}'
          plane: '{_fissure_body.metadata.plane}'
          excluded: []
        export_context:
          _travel_placement: _travel_placement
      - require:
          condition: _travel_placement.position[0] == _fissure_edge_position[0]
          error: The chosen opening edge must be an actual clear placement, without
            a guessed fallback.
      - require:
          condition: _travel_placement.position[1] == _fissure_edge_position[1]
          error: The chosen opening edge must be an actual clear placement, without
            a guessed fallback.
      - require:
          condition: _travel_placement.position[2] == _fissure_edge_position[2]
          error: The chosen opening edge must be an actual clear placement, without
            a guessed fallback.
      - set:
          field: _fissure_body_inside
          value: true
    metadata:
      category: internal
      visible_to_player: false
    parameters:
    - false
    - param_offset_56cdb71d91cab784
    - param_perp_067158c92cf8a6b6

            export_context:

          - set:

            condition: _rider_live == true and _rider_source.spell == 'hex' and _rider_source.target
              == _actor_state_id and _rider_source.ability == ability
    - condition: kind == 'ability_check' and ability == 'wisdom' and (skill == 'perception'

        != null

tools:
  validate_srd_feather_fall_trigger:
    effects:
    - require:
        condition: lasting_state.pending_srd_actions != null and reaction_trigger_id
          in lasting_state.pending_srd_actions
        error: Feather Fall needs the actual saved falling trigger.
    - set:
        field: _feather_trigger
        value: lasting_state.pending_srd_actions[reaction_trigger_id]
    - require:
        condition: _feather_trigger.kind == 'scene_fall' and _feather_trigger.status
          == 'open' and _feather_trigger.stage == 'reaction'
        error: Feather Fall requires an open scene-fall reaction window.
    - set:
        field: _feather_trigger_rows
        value: _feather_trigger.parameters.falling_events
    - set:
        field: _feather_trigger_qualified
        value: false
    - for_each:
        collection: _feather_trigger_rows
        as: _feather_trigger_row
        do:
        - call: qualify_srd_feather_fall_observation
          params:
            caster_state: '{_caster_state_id}'
            target_state: '{_feather_trigger_row.actor_id}'
            reaction_trigger_id: '{reaction_trigger_id}'
          export_context:
            _fall_trigger_seen: _fall_trigger_seen
        - set:
            field: _feather_trigger_qualified
            value: true
          condition: _fall_trigger_seen == true
    - require:
        condition: _feather_trigger_qualified == true
        error: See a falling creature within sixty feet, or be falling yourself.
    - set:
        field: _feather_chosen
        value: []
    - for_each:
        collection: targets
        as: _feather_target
        do:
        - require:
            condition: _feather_target not in _feather_chosen
            error: Choose each Feather Fall target once.
        - call: qualify_srd_feather_fall_target
          params:
            caster_state: '{_caster_state_id}'
            target_state: '{_feather_target}'
            reaction_trigger_id: '{reaction_trigger_id}'
        - list_push:
            list: _feather_chosen
            value: _feather_target
    metadata:
      category: internal
      visible_to_player: false

  retained_spell_query_retire_srd_heat_metal_source:
    effects:
    - call: initialize_srd_lite_constants_dc191b8a9362
      export_context: '*'
    - set:
        field: _object_now
        value: lasting_state.lasting_tick
      condition: lasting_state.lasting_tick != null
    - set:
        field: _heat_records
        value: []
    - set:
        field: _heat_records
        value: lasting_state.turn_effects
      condition: lasting_state.turn_effects != null
    - set:
        field: _heat_source
        value: null
    - for_each:
        collection: _heat_records
        as: _heat_candidate
        do:
        - condition: _heat_candidate.kind == 'heat_metal_spell' and _heat_candidate.source_id
            == source_id
          on_true:
          - require:
              condition: _heat_source == null
              error: The saved Heat Metal source is ambiguous.
          - set:
              field: _heat_source
              value: _heat_candidate
    - require:
        condition: _heat_source != null and _heat_source.spell == 'heat_metal' and
          _heat_source.source_sha256 == '79e0cf2a1d0ca3dd02e3489ba1d9c90e38e49ae87fadf9269d5b196cbd9406c3'
          and _heat_source.spell_level >= 2 and _heat_source.spell_level <= 9
        error: Select one actual source-qualified Heat Metal casting.
    - require:
        condition: _heat_source.caster == _caster_state_id
        error: Use the actual source owner.
    - set:
        field: _heat_kept
        value: []
    - for_each:
        collection: _heat_records
        as: _heat_candidate
        do:
        - list_push:
            list: _heat_kept
            value: _heat_candidate
          condition: _heat_candidate.kind != 'heat_metal_spell' or _heat_candidate.source_id
            != source_id
    - set:
        field: lasting_state.turn_effects
        value: _heat_kept
    - set:
        field: caster_state.heat_metal_source_id
        value: null
      condition: caster_state.heat_metal_source_id == source_id

      category: internal

tools:

    effects:
    - condition: lasting_state.has_illumination_spells == true
      on_true:
      - set:
          field: _light_refresh_records
          value: lasting_state.turn_effects
      - set:
          field: _light_refresh_keep
          value: []
      - set:
          field: _light_refresh_targets
          value: []
      - for_each:
          collection: _light_refresh_records
          as: _light_refresh_record
          do:
          - set:
              field: _light_refresh_active
              value: true
          - condition: _light_refresh_record.kind == 'illumination_spell'
            on_true:
            - call: check_srd_illumination_record
              params:
                record: '{_light_refresh_record}'
                caster_state: '{_light_refresh_record.caster}'
              export_context:
                _illumination_active: _illumination_active
                _illumination_origin: _illumination_origin
                _illumination_plane: _illumination_plane
                _illumination_covered: _illumination_covered
            - set:
                field: _light_refresh_active
                value: _illumination_active
            - list_push:
                list: _light_refresh_targets
                value: _light_refresh_record.source
              condition: _light_refresh_record.mode == 'invisible' and _light_refresh_record.source
                not in _light_refresh_targets
          - list_push:
              list: _light_refresh_keep
              value: _light_refresh_record
            condition: _light_refresh_active == true
      - set:
          field: lasting_state.turn_effects
          value: _light_refresh_keep
      - for_each:
          collection: _light_refresh_targets
          as: _light_refresh_target
          do:
          - call: sync_srd_illumination_invisible
            params:
              actor_state: '{_light_refresh_target}'

      visible_to_player: false

    - param_lasting_state_7bff8d20c3cf7d0f
  resolve_srd_hellish_rebuke:
    effects:
    - set:
        field: _hellish_event
        value: lasting_state.pending_srd_actions[reaction_trigger_id]
    - require:
        condition: _hellish_event.hellish_rebuke_resolved != true and _hellish_event.target_state_id
          == _caster_state_id
        error: Hellish Rebuke resolves this receiver's completed damage only once.
    - call: qualify_srd_hellish_rebuke_receiver
      params:
        receiver_state: '{_caster_state_id}'
        source_state: '{_hellish_event.actor_state_id}'
        event_id: '{reaction_trigger_id}'
        require_reaction: false
      export_context:
        _hellish_eligible: _hellish_eligible
        _illumination_target_can_see: _illumination_target_can_see
        _illumination_target_same_plane: _illumination_target_same_plane
        _illumination_point_distance: _illumination_point_distance
        _illumination_point_origin: _illumination_point_origin
        _srd_area_targets: _srd_area_targets
        _srd_area_half_cover: _srd_area_half_cover
        _srd_area_three_quarters: _srd_area_three_quarters
    - require:
        condition: _hellish_eligible == true
        error: Hellish Rebuke needs the actual visible damaging creature within 60
          feet.
    - set:
        field: _hellish_dice_count
        value: actual_spell_level + 1
    - dice:
        expression: '{_hellish_dice_count}d10'
      store_as: _hellish_damage_roll
    - set:
        field: _hellish_damage_total
        value: _hellish_damage_roll.total
      condition: state.map
    - condition: caster_state.has_actor_spell_modifiers == true
      on_true:
      - call: modify_srd_actor_damage_roll
        params:
          actor_state: '{_caster_state_id}'
          amount: '{_hellish_damage_total}'
        export_context:
          _actor_modified_damage: _actor_modified_damage
      - set:
          field: _hellish_damage_total
          value: _actor_modified_damage
    - call: resolve_spell_area_save_damage_target
      params:
        spell: hellish_rebuke
        target: '{_hellish_event.actor_state_id}'
        save_ability: dexterity
        spell_save_dc: '{save_dc}'
        damage_total: '{_hellish_damage_total}'
        damage_type: fire
        success_damage: half
        construct_save_disadvantage: false
        half_cover_targets: '{_srd_area_half_cover}'
        three_quarters_cover_targets: '{_srd_area_three_quarters}'
        source_state_id: '{_caster_state_id}'
        spell_cast_id: '{spell_cast_id}'
        actual_spell_level: '{actual_spell_level}'
        spell_cast_owner: '{_caster_state_id}'
      export_context:
        _spell_summary_rows: _spell_summary_rows
        _spell_detail_rows: _spell_detail_rows
    - list_push:
        list: _spell_detail_rows
        value:
          label: '''Fire damage dice'''
          value: _hellish_damage_roll.results
    - set:
        field: lasting_state.pending_srd_actions.{reaction_trigger_id}.hellish_rebuke_resolved
        value: true
    metadata:
      category: internal
      visible_to_player: false
    parameters:
    - param_caster_state_5310b8b23a525eea
    - param_reaction_trigger_id_c90dd9426a478a0f
    - param_save_dc_8e909d1d20f2b892
    - param_actual_spell_level_b537fd3b33294358
    - param_spell_cast_id_9b4dfaaacc28beff
    - param_lasting_state_7bff8d20c3cf7d0f

  stabilize_srd_creature:
    description: Take the Help action to attempt ordinary first aid on a living, unstable
      creature at 0 HP able to receive physical first aid. Use the helper's actual
      Wisdom (Medicine) modifier; the native DC 10 check determines stabilization.
      Stabilization grants no HP and leaves Unconscious until recovery. This operation
      does not consume a Healer's Kit or simulate a healing spell.
    effects:
    - require:
        condition: actor_state.is_alive == true and actor_state.hp > 0

        - set:

        - for_each:

            - condition:

                - condition:
                    condition: _best == -1
                    on_true:
                    - set:
                        field: _best
                        value: _candidate

                    - condition:

                        - set:

        - condition:

sylvia_gm_runtime:
  format: 1
  state_namespace: pkg
tools:
  query_srd_mirage_body_support:
    effects:
    - require:
        condition: lasting_state.spatial_scene != null
        error: This operation needs the admitted spatial scene.
    - require:
        condition: lasting_state.spatial_scene.map.grid.unit == 'ft'
        error: SRD scene distances use feet.
    - spatial_query:
        scene: state.spatial_scene
        operation: snapshot
      store_as: _info_snapshot
    - call: srd_information_scene_entity
      params:
        subject: '{_target_state_id}'
      export_context:
        _info_scene_entity: _info_scene_entity
        _info_position: _info_position
    - require:
        condition: _info_scene_entity.metadata.plane != null
        error: A falling body needs its actual plane.
    - call: initialize_srd_lite_constants_046336e8a3ac
      export_context: '*'
    - set:
        field: _fall_ray_origin
        value:
        - _info_position[0]
        - _info_position[1]
        - _info_position[2] + 0.000001
    - set:
        field: _fall_ray_end
        value:
        - _info_position[0]
        - _info_position[1]
        - lasting_state.spatial_scene.map.bounds.min[2]
    - spatial_query:
        scene: state.spatial_scene
        operation: ray
        query:
          map_id: '{lasting_state.spatial_scene.map.id}'
          origin: '{_fall_ray_origin}'
          destination: '{_fall_ray_end}'
          include:
          - geometry
          max_intersections: 1000
      store_as: _fall_ground_ray
    - {}
    - set:
        field: _fall_hits
        value: _fall_ground_ray.intersections
    - set:
        value: lasting_state.spatial_scene.geometry
    - for_each:
        collection: _fall_hits
        as: _fall_hit
        do:
        - for_each:
            collection: _fall_geometry
            as: _fall_support
            do:
            - condition: _fall_support.id == _fall_hit.id and _fall_support.active
                == true and _fall_support.movement == 'blocking'
              on_true:
              - condition: _fall_ground_height == null or _fall_hit.point[2] > _fall_ground_height
                on_true:
                - set:
                    field: _fall_ground_height
                    value: _fall_hit.point[2]
                - set:
                    field: _fall_ground_id
                    value: _fall_support.id
          condition: _fall_hit.normal[2] > 0 and _fall_hit.metadata.ground == true
            and _fall_hit.metadata.plane == _info_scene_entity.metadata.plane
    - set:
        field: _support_ground
        value: null
    - for_each:
        collection: _fall_geometry
        as: _support_geometry
        do:
        - set:
            field: _support_ground
            value: _support_geometry
          condition: _support_geometry.id == _fall_ground_id
    - set:
        field: _support_body
        value:
          actor_id: _target_state_id
          scene_id: _info_scene_entity.id
          origin: _info_position
          plane: _info_scene_entity.metadata.plane
          footprint: _info_scene_entity.footprint
          height: _info_scene_entity.height
    - set:
        field: _support_height
        value: null
    - set:
        field: _support_height
        value: _fall_ground_height
      condition: _fall_ground_height != null
    metadata:
      category: internal
      visible_to_player: false
    parameters:
    - param_target_state_cb03a83d0b3e524f
    - param_lasting_state_7bff8d20c3cf7d0f
  retained_spell_query_resolve_srd_environment_fog_segment:
    effects:
    - call: format_srd_information_projection
      params:
        message: '{area_id}'
      export_context:
        _environment_area_key: _info_projection_message
    - set:
        field: _fog_segment_source
        value: lasting_state.persistent_spell_areas[_environment_area_key]
    - require:
        condition: _fog_segment_source.profile == 'environment' and _fog_segment_source.mode
          == 'fog' and _fog_segment_source.active == true and lasting_state.lasting_tick
          < _fog_segment_source.expires_tick
        error: Select an actual active Fog source.
    - call: resolve_srd_persistent_area_segment
      params:
        start: '{start}'
        end: '{end}'
        origin: '{_fog_segment_source.origin}'
        radius: '{_fog_segment_source.radius}'
      export_context:
        _sphere_hit: _sphere_hit
        _sphere_entry: _sphere_entry
        _sphere_exit: _sphere_exit
    - set:
        field: _fog_segment_present
        value: _sphere_hit
    - condition: _sphere_hit == true and _fog_segment_source.fog_clearances != null
      on_true:
      - set:
          field: _fog_clearances
          value: _fog_segment_source.fog_clearances
      - set:
          field: _fog_clear_intervals
          value: []
      - set:
          field: _fog_tangent_cleared
          value: false
      - for_each:
          collection: _fog_clearances
          as: _fog_clearance
          do:
          - call: srd_information_segment_interval
            params:
              start: '{start}'
              end: '{end}'
              volume: '{_fog_clearance.volume}'
            export_context:
              _segment_hit: _segment_hit
              _segment_entry: _segment_entry
              _segment_exit: _segment_exit
          - condition: _segment_hit == true and _segment_entry <= _sphere_exit and
              _segment_exit >= _sphere_entry
            on_true:
            - list_push:
                list: _fog_clear_intervals
                value:
                  entry: max(_sphere_entry, _segment_entry)
                  exit: min(_sphere_exit, _segment_exit)
            - set:
                field: _fog_tangent_cleared
                value: true
              condition: _segment_entry <= _sphere_entry and _segment_exit >= _sphere_exit
      - sort:
          collection: _fog_clear_intervals
          by: entry
          direction: asc
      - set:
          field: _fog_clear_cursor
          value: _sphere_entry
      - set:
          field: _fog_segment_present
          value: false
      - for_each:
          collection: _fog_clear_intervals
          as: _fog_clear_interval
          do:
          - set:
              field: _fog_segment_present
              value: true
            condition: _fog_clear_interval.entry - _fog_clear_cursor > 0.000000000001
          - set:
              field: _fog_clear_cursor
              value: max(_fog_clear_cursor, _fog_clear_interval.exit)
      - set:
          field: _fog_segment_present
          value: true
        condition: _sphere_exit - _fog_clear_cursor > 0.000000000001
      - set:
          field: _fog_segment_present
          value: _fog_tangent_cleared != true
        condition: _sphere_entry == _sphere_exit
    metadata:
      category: internal
      visible_to_player: false
    parameters:
    - param_start_d98e3be2ca5dca70
    - param_end_2ff639971e9448b4
    - param_area_id_e089c46d11628c06
    - param_lasting_state_f791c68f01bb49c8

    effects:
    - set:
        field: _sphere_delta
        value:
        - end[0] - start[0]
        - end[1] - start[1]
        - end[2] - start[2]
    - set:
        field: _sphere_offset
        value:
        - start[0] - origin[0]
        - start[1] - origin[1]
        - start[2] - origin[2]
    - set:
        field: _sphere_a
        value: _sphere_delta[0] ** 2 + _sphere_delta[1] ** 2 + _sphere_delta[2] **
          2
    - set:
        field: _sphere_b
        value: 2 * (_sphere_offset[0] * _sphere_delta[0] + _sphere_offset[1] * _sphere_delta[1]
          + _sphere_offset[2] * _sphere_delta[2])
    - set:
        field: _sphere_c
        value: _sphere_offset[0] ** 2 + _sphere_offset[1] ** 2 + _sphere_offset[2]
          ** 2 - radius ** 2
    - call: initialize_srd_lite_constants_5f62c5a04211
      export_context: '*'
    - condition: _sphere_a < 0.000000000001
      on_true:
      - set:
          field: _sphere_hit
          value: _sphere_c <= 0
      on_false:
      - set:
          field: _sphere_d
          value: _sphere_b ** 2 - 4 * _sphere_a * _sphere_c
      - condition: _sphere_d >= 0
        on_true:
        - set:
            field: _sphere_entry
            value: max(0, (-_sphere_b - _sphere_d ** 0.5) * (2 * _sphere_a) ** -1)
        - set:
            field: _sphere_exit
            value: min(1, (-_sphere_b + _sphere_d ** 0.5) * (2 * _sphere_a) ** -1)
        - set:
            field: _sphere_hit
            value: _sphere_entry <= _sphere_exit

    effects:
    - params:

      bogus: format_srd_information_projection
    - call: initialize_srd_lite_constants_c786b07628f4

    - set:

        do:
        - condition: _tsunami_candidate.id == source_id

              value: _tsunami_candidate

    - require:

      params:
        subject: '{moving_subject}'
        lasting_state: '{_lasting_state_id}'
      export_context:
        _info_scene_entity: _info_scene_entity
        _info_position: _info_position
    - require:

        error: Ground square entry requires an actual box creature.
    - condition: _info_scene_entity.metadata.plane == _tsunami_source.plane
      on_true:
      - set:
          field: _blade_body_volume
          value:
            kind: '''box'''
            min:
            - _tsunami_source.volume.min[0] - _info_scene_entity.footprint.half_extents[0]
            - _tsunami_source.volume.min[1] - _info_scene_entity.footprint.half_extents[1]

      - set:

          end: '{end}'

        export_context:
          _body_hit: _segment_hit
          _body_entry: _segment_entry
          _body_exit: _segment_exit
    - set:
        field: _body_hit
        value: start[0] > _body_bounds.min[0] and start[0] < _body_bounds.max[0] and
          start[1] > _body_bounds.min[1] and start[1] < _body_bounds.max[1] and start[2]

      condition: _body_hit == true and start[0] == end[0] and start[1] == end[1] and
        start[2] == end[2]

    - param_source_id_da8b650d256d2fc5

tools:
  check_srd_arcane_eye_clearance:
    effects:
    - require:
        condition: lasting_state.spatial_scene != null
        error: This operation needs the admitted spatial scene.
    - require:
        condition: lasting_state.spatial_scene.map.grid.unit == 'ft'
        error: SRD scene distances use feet.
    - spatial_query:
        scene: state.spatial_scene
        operation: snapshot
      store_as: _info_snapshot
    - set:
        field: _eye_blocked
        value: false
    - set:
        field: _eye_geometry
        value: lasting_state.spatial_scene.geometry
    - for_each:
        collection: _eye_geometry
        as: _eye_barrier
        do:
        - condition: _eye_barrier.active == true and _eye_barrier.movement == 'blocking'
          on_true:
          - set:
              field: _eye_volume
              value: _eye_barrier.volume
          - condition: _eye_volume.kind == 'box'
            on_true:
            - set:
                field: _eye_expanded
                value:
                  kind: '''box'''
                  min:
                  - _eye_volume.min[0] - 1 * 24 ** -1 + 0.000000000001
                  - _eye_volume.min[1] - 1 * 24 ** -1 + 0.000000000001
                  - _eye_volume.min[2] - 1 * 24 ** -1 + 0.000000000001
                  max:
                  - _eye_volume.max[0] + 1 * 24 ** -1 - 0.000000000001
                  - _eye_volume.max[1] + 1 * 24 ** -1 - 0.000000000001
                  - _eye_volume.max[2] + 1 * 24 ** -1 - 0.000000000001
            on_false:
            - set:
                field: _eye_expanded
                value:
                  kind: '''cylinder'''
                  center:
                  - _eye_volume.center[0]
                  - _eye_volume.center[1]
                  - _eye_volume.center[2] - 1 * 24 ** -1 + 0.000000000001
                  radius: _eye_volume.radius + 1 * 24 ** -1 - 0.000000000001
                  height: _eye_volume.height + 1 * 12 ** -1 - 0.000000000002
          - call: srd_information_segment_interval
            params:
              start: '{start}'
              end: '{end}'
              volume: '{_eye_expanded}'
            export_context:
              _segment_hit: _segment_hit
          - condition: _segment_hit == true
            on_true:
            - call: srd_information_clearance_distance
              params:
                start: '{start}'
                end: '{end}'
                volume: '{_eye_barrier.volume}'
              export_context:
                _clearance_squared: _clearance_squared
            - set:
                field: _eye_blocked
                value: true
              condition: _clearance_squared + 0.000000000001 < (1 * 24 ** -1) ** 2

    effects:
    - condition: lasting_state.affinity_cast_ids != null
      on_true:
      - set:

          value: []
      - set:
          field: _affinity_existing_ids
          value: lasting_state.affinity_cast_ids
      - set:
          field: _affinity_free_ids
          value: lasting_state.affinity_free_ids
      - for_each:
          collection: _affinity_existing_ids
          as: _affinity_existing_id
          do:
          - condition: lasting_state.lasting_tick < lasting_state.affinity_casts[_affinity_existing_id].expires_tick
            on_true:
            - list_push:
                list: _affinity_kept_ids
                value: _affinity_existing_id
            on_false:
            - set:
                field: lasting_state.affinity_casts.{_affinity_existing_id}
                value: null
            - list_push:
                list: _affinity_free_ids
                value: _affinity_existing_id
              condition: _affinity_existing_id not in _affinity_free_ids
      - set:
          field: lasting_state.affinity_cast_ids
          value: _affinity_kept_ids
      - set:
          field: lasting_state.affinity_free_ids
          value: _affinity_free_ids
    - condition: lasting_state.persistent_spell_area_ids != null
      on_true:
      - set:
          field: _retained_area_ids
          value: []
      - set:
          field: _prior_area_ids
          value: lasting_state.persistent_spell_area_ids
      - for_each:
          collection: _prior_area_ids
          as: _prior_area_id
          do:
          - set:
              field: _prior_area
              value: lasting_state.persistent_spell_areas[_prior_area_id]
          - list_push:
              list: _retained_area_ids
              value: _prior_area_id
            condition: (_prior_area.profile == 'affinity' and _prior_area_id in lasting_state.affinity_cast_ids)
              or (_prior_area.profile != 'affinity' and _prior_area.active == true

          field: lasting_state.persistent_spell_area_ids
          value: _retained_area_ids
      - set:
          field: lasting_state.has_persistent_spell_areas
          value: len(_retained_area_ids) > 0

    - param_lasting_state_7bff8d20c3cf7d0f

      - set:

      - require:

      - set:

      - set:
          field: _dp_peer_access
          value: merge(_dp_peer.metadata.srd_object_access, _dp_peer_access)
      - set:
          field: _dp_peer_patch
          value:
            srd_object_access: _dp_peer_access
      - set:

          value: merge(_dp_peer.metadata, _dp_peer_patch)

            movement: '{_dp_operated.movement}'
            visibility: '{_dp_operated.visibility}'
        store_as: _dp_peer_change
      - call: refresh_srd_spell_triggers
        condition: on_Bad

meta:
