        value: lasting_state.transformation_sources[_recharge_source_id]
    - require:
        condition: _recharge_source.installed == true
        error: The actual form source has ended.
    - table_lookup:
        table: definitions.beast_forms
        key: _recharge_source.form_id
        required: true
      store_as: _recharge_form
    - set:
        field: _recharge_form_id
        value: _recharge_source.form_id
    - set:
        field: lasting_state.transformation_sources.{_recharge_source_id}.recharge_uses
        value: {}
      condition: _recharge_source.recharge_uses == null
    - set:
        field: _recharge_uses
        value: {}
    - set:
        field: _recharge_uses
        value: lasting_state.transformation_sources[_recharge_source_id].recharge_uses[_recharge_form_id]
      condition: _recharge_form_id in lasting_state.transformation_sources[_recharge_source_id].recharge_uses
    - set:
        field: lasting_state.transformation_sources.{_recharge_source_id}.recharge_uses.{_recharge_form_id}
        value: _recharge_uses
    - set:
        field: _recharge_rows
        value: []
    - set:
        field: _recharge_attacks
        value: _recharge_form.recharge_attack_names
    - for_each:
        collection: _recharge_attacks
        as: _recharge_attack_name
        do:
        - set:
            field: _recharge_key
            value: _recharge_attack_name
        - condition: _recharge_key in _recharge_uses and _recharge_uses[_recharge_key].available
            != true and _recharge_uses[_recharge_key].last_turn < target_state.turns_started
          on_true:
          - dice:
              expression: d6
            store_as: _recharge_roll
          - set:
              field: lasting_state.transformation_sources.{_recharge_source_id}.recharge_uses.{_recharge_form_id}.{_recharge_key}
              value:
                available: _recharge_roll.total >= _recharge_form.attacks[_recharge_attack_name].recharge_min
                last_turn: target_state.turns_started
                roll: _recharge_roll
          - list_push:
              list: _recharge_rows
              value:
                label: _recharge_attack_name
                value: _recharge_roll.total
    metadata:
      category: internal
      visible_to_player: false
    parameters:
    - param_target_state_cb03a83d0b3e524f
    - param_lasting_state_a0a632fef1e150e2
  dispel_srd_dwelling_owned_source:
    effects:
    - call: collect_srd_dwelling_dispel_sources
      params:
        subject: '{subject}'
      export_context:
        _dwelling_dispel_source_ids: _dwelling_dispel_source_ids
        _dwelling_dispel_body: _dwelling_dispel_body
    - require:
        condition: source_id in _dwelling_dispel_source_ids
        error: Select this actual active dwelling's paired entrance.
    - call: read_srd_lifetime_dwelling_source
      params:
        source_id: '{source_id}'
      export_context:
        _lifetime_record: _lifetime_record
        _lifetime_active: _lifetime_active
    - require:
        condition: _lifetime_active == true and _lifetime_record.dispel_ongoing !=
          false
        error: Select an actual ongoing dwelling source.
    - set:
        field: _dwelling_dispel_point
        value:
        - _dwelling_dispel_body.position[0]
        - _dwelling_dispel_body.position[1]
        - _dwelling_dispel_body.position[2] + _dwelling_dispel_body.height * 0.5
    - call: srd_information_scene_entity
      params:
        subject: '{_caster_state_id}'
      export_context:
        _info_scene_entity: _info_scene_entity
        _info_position: _info_position
    - set:
        field: _adoption_caster_position
        value: _info_position
    - require:
        condition: _info_scene_entity.metadata.plane == _dwelling_dispel_body.metadata.plane
        error: The selected spell effect is on another plane.
    - call: measure_srd_information_distance
      params:
        start: '{_adoption_caster_position}'
        end: '{_dwelling_dispel_point}'
      export_context:
        _scene_distance: _scene_distance
    - require:
        condition: _scene_distance <= 120
        error: The selected spell effect is beyond Dispel range.
    - call: srd_information_barriers
      params:
        start: '{_adoption_caster_position}'
        end: '{_dwelling_dispel_point}'
        plane: '{_dwelling_dispel_body.metadata.plane}'
        rule: solid
      export_context:
        _information_blocked: _information_blocked
    - require:
        condition: _information_blocked != true
        error: A solid barrier blocks the actual Dispel path.
    - call: resolve_srd_dispel_source_check
      params:
        caster_state: '{_caster_state_id}'
        caster: '{_caster_id}'
        slot_level: '{slot_level}'
        source_level: '{_lifetime_record.spell_level}'
        casting_modifier: '{casting_modifier}'
        casting_ability: '{casting_ability}'
      export_context:
        _dispel_succeeded: _dispel_succeeded
        _dispel_roll: _dispel_roll
        _visual_dispel_description: _visual_dispel_description
        _visual_dispel_equation: _visual_dispel_equation
    - set:
        field: _adoption_dispel_check
        value:
          spell: _lifetime_record.spell
          source_id: source_id
          ended: _dispel_succeeded
          roll: null
          dc: 10 + _lifetime_record.spell_level
          feedback: _visual_dispel_description
          equation: null
    - condition: _dispel_roll != null
      on_true:
      - set:
          field: _adoption_roll_patch
          value:
            roll: _dispel_roll
      - set:
          field: _adoption_dispel_check
          value: merge(_adoption_dispel_check, _adoption_roll_patch)
    - call: retire_srd_owned_dwelling_source
      params:
        source_id: '{source_id}'
      condition: _dispel_succeeded == true

        value: _smite_event.smite_slot_level
    - set:
        field: _smite_die
        value: '''d6'''
    - set:
        field: _smite_type
        value: '''radiant'''
    - set:

        condition: record in lasting_state.turn_effects and record.kind == 'illumination_spell'
          and record.spell == 'darkness' and _moon_dark_area.mode == 'moonbeam'
        error: Use actual admitted Darkness and Moonbeam sources.
    - call: retained_spell_query_qualify_srd_environment_sphere_source
      params:
        caster_state: '{_moon_dark_area.caster}'
        area_id: '{_environment_area_key}'
        lasting_state: '{_lasting_state_id}'
      export_context:
        _sphere_source_current: _sphere_source_current
    - call: retained_spell_query_check_srd_illumination_record
      params:
        record: '{record}'
        caster_state: '{record.caster}'
        lasting_state: '{_lasting_state_id}'

        _illumination_active: _illumination_active
        _illumination_covered: _illumination_covered

meta:
  id: Bad_ID
tools:
  record_srd_wind_flame_protection:
    description: Record actual mundane wind protection on an already admitted ordinary
      flame, once.
    effects:
    - call: require_srd_pending_window_closed
    - require:
        condition: combat.encounter_active != true
        error: Admit object facts outside combat.
    - require:
        condition: combat.pending_action == null
        error: Finish the pending action first.
    - call: srd_information_scene_entity
      params:
        subject: '{object_id}'
      export_context:
        _info_scene_entity: _info_scene_entity
        _info_position: _info_position
    - require:
        condition: _info_scene_entity.id == object_id and _info_scene_entity.metadata.participant_ref
          == null
        error: An object target must be an actual non-creature scene ID.
    - set:
        field: _object_scene
        value: _info_scene_entity
    - require:
        condition: lasting_state.pending_srd_action_stack == null or len(lasting_state.pending_srd_action_stack)
          == 0
        error: Finish the pending action before admitting flame facts.
    - require:
        condition: _object_scene.metadata.srd_ordinary_flame.kind == 'ordinary_flame'
          and _object_scene.metadata.srd_ordinary_flame.wind_protected == null
        error: Record wind protection only once on the actual ordinary flame.
    - set:
        field: _gust_flame_fact
        value:
          wind_protected: protected
    - set:
        field: _gust_flame
        value: merge(_object_scene.metadata.srd_ordinary_flame, _gust_flame_fact)
    - require:
        condition: lasting_state.spatial_scene != null
        error: This operation needs the admitted spatial scene.
    - require:
        condition: lasting_state.spatial_scene.map.grid.unit == 'ft'
        error: SRD scene distances use feet.
    - spatial_query:
        scene: state.spatial_scene
        operation: snapshot
      store_as: _info_snapshot
    - set:
        field: _world_changes
        value:
          srd_ordinary_flame: _gust_flame
    - call: initialize_srd_lite_constants_d63675087646
      export_context: '*'
    - set:
        field: _world_changes
        value: merge(_world_changes, _world_object_marker)
    - set:
        field: _world_metadata
        value: merge(_object_scene.metadata, _world_changes)
    - spatial_mutation:
        scene: state.spatial_scene
        map_id: '{lasting_state.spatial_scene.map.id}'
        expected_revision: '{_info_snapshot.geometry_revision}'
        target:
          kind: entity
          id: '{object_id}'
        patch:
          metadata: '{_world_metadata}'
      store_as: _world_mutation
    - call: refresh_srd_spell_triggers
      condition: lasting_state.has_spell_triggers == true
    metadata:
      category: exploration
      result_card:
        version: 1
        footprint: compact
        title: Flame wind protection
        summary:
        - label: Protected
          value:
            path: context.protected
    parameters:
    - param_object_id_2b5cfd2dd4c129d5
    - name: protected
      type: boolean
    - param_lasting_state_f791c68f01bb49c8
parameter_declarations:
  param_lasting_state_f791c68f01bb49c8:
    name: lasting_state
    required: false
    default: state
    resolve: entity
    model_hidden: true
  param_object_id_2b5cfd2dd4c129d5:
    name: object_id

  resolve_srd_tsunami_body_segment:
    effects:
    - call: format_srd_information_projection
      params:
        message: '{source_id}'
      export_context:
        _environment_area_key: _info_projection_message
    - call: initialize_srd_lite_constants_c786b07628f4
      export_context: '*'
    - call: initialize_srd_lite_constants_5766c11a9ecf
      export_context: '*'
    - set:
        field: _tsunami_lookup
        value: state.tsunami_sources
      condition: state.tsunami_sources != null
    - for_each:
        collection: _tsunami_lookup
        as: _tsunami_candidate
        do:
        - condition: _tsunami_candidate.id == source_id
          on_true:
          - require:
              condition: _tsunami_source == null
              error: Tsunami source identity is ambiguous.
          - set:
              field: _tsunami_source
              value: _tsunami_candidate
    - require:
        condition: _tsunami_source != null
        error: Select an authentic retained Tsunami source.
    - require:
        condition: _tsunami_source.mode == 'tsunami' and _tsunami_source.volume.kind
          == 'box'
        error: Use the actual saved Blade Barrier vertical wall.
    - call: srd_information_scene_entity
      params:
        subject: '{moving_subject}'
      export_context:
        _info_scene_entity: _info_scene_entity
        _info_position: _info_position
    - require:
        condition: _info_scene_entity.footprint.kind == 'box'
        error: Ground square entry requires an actual box creature.
    - condition: _info_scene_entity.metadata.plane == _tsunami_source.plane
      on_true:
      - set:
          field: _blade_body_volume
          value:
            kind: '''box'''
            min:
            - _tsunami_source.volume.min[0] - _info_scene_entity.footprint.half_extents[0]
            - _tsunami_source.volume.min[1] - _info_scene_entity.footprint.half_extents[1]
            - _tsunami_source.volume.min[2] - _info_scene_entity.height
            max:
            - _tsunami_source.volume.max[0] + _info_scene_entity.footprint.half_extents[0]
            - _tsunami_source.volume.max[1] + _info_scene_entity.footprint.half_extents[1]
            - _tsunami_source.volume.max[2]
      - set:
          field: _body_bounds
          value: _blade_body_volume

        params:
          start: '{start}'
          end: '{end}'
          volume: '{_blade_body_volume}'
        export_context:
          _body_hit: _segment_hit
          _body_entry: _segment_entry
          _body_exit: _segment_exit
    - set:
        field: _body_hit
        value: start[0] > _body_bounds.min[0] and start[0] < _body_bounds.max[0] and
          start[1] > _body_bounds.min[1] and start[1] < _body_bounds.max[1] and start[2]
          > _body_bounds.min[2] and start[2] < _body_bounds.max[2]
      condition: _body_hit == true and start[0] == end[0] and start[1] == end[1] and
        start[2] == end[2]
    metadata:
      category: internal
      visible_to_player: false
    parameters:

        - set:

sylvia_gm_runtime:
  format: 1
  state_namespace: pkg
tools:
  qualify_srd_environment_wind:
    effects:
    - call: format_srd_information_projection
      params:
        message: '{area_id}'
      export_context:
        _environment_area_key: _info_projection_message
    - set:
        field: _environment_area
        value: lasting_state.persistent_spell_areas[_environment_area_key]
    - require:
        condition: _environment_area.profile == 'environment' and (_environment_area.mode
          == 'fog' or _environment_area.mode == 'cloudkill' or _environment_area.mode
          == 'stinking_cloud' or _environment_area.mode == 'incendiary_cloud') and
          _environment_area.active == true
        error: Select an active fog spell source.
    - set:
        field: _environment_wind_found
        value: false
    - set:
        field: _environment_wind_zones
        value: null
    - for_each:
        collection: _environment_wind_zones
        as: _environment_wind_zone
        do:
        - condition: (wind_zone_id == '' or _environment_wind_zone.id == wind_zone_id)
            and _environment_wind_zone.metadata.strong_wind == true and _environment_wind_zone.metadata.plane
            == _environment_area.plane
          on_true:
          - condition: _environment_wind_zone.shape.kind == 'box'
            on_true:
            - set:
                field: _environment_wind_nearest
                value:
                - max(_environment_wind_zone.shape.min[0], min(_environment_area.origin[0],
                  _environment_wind_zone.shape.max[0]))
                - max(_environment_wind_zone.shape.min[1], min(_environment_area.origin[1],
                  _environment_wind_zone.shape.max[1]))
                - max(_environment_wind_zone.shape.min[2], min(_environment_area.origin[2],
                  _environment_wind_zone.shape.max[2]))
            - call: measure_srd_information_distance
              params:
                start: '{_environment_area.origin}'
                end: '{_environment_wind_nearest}'
              export_context:
                _scene_distance: _scene_distance
            on_false:
            - require:
                condition: _environment_wind_zone.shape.kind == 'cylinder'
                error: Use the actual admitted strong-wind zone extent.
            - set:
                field: _environment_wind_horizontal
                value: max(0, ((_environment_area.origin[0] - _environment_wind_zone.shape.center[0])
                  ** 2 + (_environment_area.origin[1] - _environment_wind_zone.shape.center[1])
                  ** 2) ** 0.5 - _environment_wind_zone.shape.radius)
            - set:
                field: _environment_wind_vertical
                value: max(0, _environment_wind_zone.shape.center[2] - _environment_area.origin[2],
                  _environment_area.origin[2] - _environment_wind_zone.shape.center[2]
                  - _environment_wind_zone.shape.height)
            - set:
                field: _scene_distance
                value: (_environment_wind_horizontal ** 2 + _environment_wind_vertical
                  ** 2) ** 0.5
          - set:
              field: _environment_wind_found
              value: true
            condition: _scene_distance <= _environment_area.radius
    - condition: lasting_state.has_storm_sources == true
      on_true:
      - call: qualify_srd_storm_fog_wind
        params:
          area_id: '{area_id}'
          caster_state: '{_environment_area.caster}'
          plane: '{_environment_area.plane}'
          lasting_state: '{_lasting_state_id}'
        export_context:
          _storm_fog_full_wind: _storm_fog_full_wind
      - set:
          field: _environment_wind_found
          value: true
        condition: _storm_fog_full_wind == true
    metadata:
      category: internal
      visible_to_player: false
    parameters:
    - param_area_id_e089c46d11628c06
    - param_wind_zone_id_73001262fdbcc262
    - param_lasting_state_f791c68f01bb49c8

            - candidate.position[0] + candidate.footprint.radius
            - candidate.position[1] - candidate.footprint.radius
            - candidate.position[1] + candidate.footprint.radius

tools:
  measure_srd_guardian_distance:
    effects:
    - call: srd_information_scene_entity
      params:
        subject: '{force_id}'
    - call: srd_information_scene_entity
      params:
        subject: '{_target_state_id}'
      export_context:
        _target: _info_scene_entity
        _guardian_target_scene: _info_scene_entity
    - require:
        condition: _source.footprint.kind == 'box' and (_target.footprint.kind ==
          'box' or _target.footprint.kind == 'circle')
        error: Guardian range needs its actual Box source and an admitted creature
          footprint.
    - set:
        field: _guardian_target_plane_matches
        value: _target.metadata.plane == _source.metadata.plane
    - set:
        field: _guardian_distance_squared
        value: (max(0, abs(_target.position[0] - _source.position[0]) - _source.footprint.half_extents[0]
          - _target.footprint.half_extents[0])) ** 2 + (max(0, abs(_target.position[1]
          - _source.position[1]) - _source.footprint.half_extents[1] - _target.footprint.half_extents[1]))
          ** 2 + (max(0, _target.position[2] - _source.position[2] - _source.height,
          _source.position[2] - _target.position[2] - _target.height)) ** 2
      condition: _target.footprint.kind == 'box'
    - set:
        field: _guardian_distance_squared
        value: max(0, ((max(0, abs(_target.position[0] - _source.position[0]) - _source.footprint.half_extents[0]))
          ** 2 + (max(0, abs(_target.position[1] - _source.position[1]) - _source.footprint.half_extents[1]))
          ** 2) ** 0.5 - _target.footprint.radius) ** 2 + (max(0, _target.position[2]
          - _source.position[2] - _source.height, _source.position[2] - _target.position[2]
          - _target.height)) ** 2
      condition: _target.footprint.kind == 'circle'
    - set:
        field: _guardian_observer
        value:
        - _source.position[0]
        - _source.position[1]
        - _source.position[2] + _source.height * 0.5
    metadata:
      category: internal
      visible_to_player: false

    - param_force_id_fd9b53495049afdd

sylvia_gm_runtime:
  format: 1
  state_namespace: pkg
tools:
  prepare_srd_dragon_breath_source:
    effects:
    - require:
        condition: breather_state.is_alive == true and breather_state.hp > 0
        error: Dragon's Breath needs its living recipient.
    - set:
        field: _breath_source
        value: null
    - set:
        field: _breath_records
        value: []
    - set:
        field: _breath_records
        value: lasting_state.turn_effects
      condition: lasting_state.has_dragon_breath == true and lasting_state.turn_effects
        != null
    - for_each:
        collection: _breath_records
        as: _breath_candidate
        do:
        - condition: _breath_candidate.kind == 'dragon_breath' and _breath_candidate.target
            == _breather_state_id
          on_true:
          - call: check_srd_dragon_breath_record
            params:
              caster_state: '{_breath_candidate.caster}'
              record: '{_breath_candidate}'
            export_context:
              _breath_active: _breath_active
          - condition: _breath_active == true
            on_true:
            - set:
                field: _breath_source
                value: _breath_candidate
              condition: _breath_source == null
            - set:
                field: _breath_source
                value: _breath_candidate
              condition: _breath_candidate.slot_level > _breath_source.slot_level
                or (_breath_candidate.slot_level == _breath_source.slot_level and
                _breath_candidate.created_tick >= _breath_source.created_tick)
    - require:
        condition: _breath_source != null
        error: No active paid Dragon's Breath source is available.
    - set:
        field: _breath_source_id
        value: _breath_source.source_id
    - set:
        field: _breath_dice_count
        value: _breath_source.slot_level + 1
    metadata:
      category: internal
      visible_to_player: false
    parameters:
    - param_breather_state_45ab87b4bd6bccb6
    - param_lasting_state_7bff8d20c3cf7d0f
  collect_srd_celestial_source_entry:
    effects:
    - require:
        condition: lasting_state.persistent_spell_areas != null
        error: Select an actual retained spell area.
    - set:
        field: _presence
        value: lasting_state.persistent_spell_areas[source_id]
    - require:
        condition: _presence != null and _presence.profile == 'conjured_presence'
        error: Select an actual retained Celestial or Fey source.
    - set:
        field: _celestial_candidate_t
        value: null
    - set:
        field: _celestial_candidate_source
        value: _presence
    - condition: _presence.mode == 'celestial' and _presence.active == true and lasting_state.lasting_tick
        < _presence.expires_tick
      on_true:
      - call: qualify_srd_conjured_presence_focus
        params:
          source_id: '{source_id}'
        export_context:
          _presence_focus_live: _presence_focus_live
      - set:
          field: _celestial_clock
          value: '''exploration'''
      - set:
          field: _celestial_turn
          value: lasting_state.lasting_tick
      - condition: combat.encounter_active == true
        on_true:
        - set:
            field: _celestial_clock
            value: '''combat'''
        - set:
            field: _celestial_turn
            value: combat.turn_sequence
      - set:
          field: _celestial_available
          value: true
      - set:
          field: _celestial_available
          value: false
        condition: _presence.event_clock == _celestial_clock and _presence.event_turn
          == _celestial_turn and _actor_state_id in _presence.event_target_ids
      - condition: _presence_focus_live == true and _celestial_available == true
        on_true:
        - call: srd_information_scene_entity
          params:
            subject: '{_actor_state_id}'
          export_context:
            _info_scene_entity: _info_scene_entity
            _info_position: _info_position
        - set:
            field: _celestial_entry_body
            value: _info_scene_entity
        - require:
            condition: _celestial_entry_body.metadata.plane != null
            error: Use the subject's actual admitted plane.
        - call: resolve_srd_celestial_body_segment
          params:
            moving_subject: '{_actor_state_id}'
            area_id: '{source_id}'
            start: '{_celestial_entry_body.position}'
            end: '{_celestial_entry_body.position}'
          export_context:
            _celestial_started_inside: _body_hit
        - condition: _celestial_started_inside != true
          on_true:
          - call: resolve_srd_celestial_body_segment
            params:
              moving_subject: '{_actor_state_id}'
              area_id: '{source_id}'
              start: '{_celestial_entry_body.position}'
              end: '{destination}'
            export_context:
              _body_hit: _body_hit
              _body_entry: _body_entry
          - set:
              field: _celestial_candidate_t
              value: _body_entry
            condition: _body_hit == true and _body_entry > 0 and _body_entry <= 1
    metadata:
      category: internal
      visible_to_player: false
    parameters:
    - param_actor_state_d3c054b169a46c77
    - param_source_id_da8b650d256d2fc5
    - param_destination_897e99fd4c074a9d
    - param_lasting_state_7bff8d20c3cf7d0f

  param_actor_state_d3c054b169a46c77:
    name: actor_state

    - set:

meta:
  id: Bad_ID
tools:
  project_srd_area_origin:
    effects:
    - require:
        condition: lasting_state.spatial_scene != null
        error: This operation needs the admitted spatial scene.
    - require:
        condition: lasting_state.spatial_scene.map.grid.unit == 'ft'
        error: SRD scene distances use feet.
    - spatial_query:
        scene: state.spatial_scene
        operation: snapshot
      store_as: _info_snapshot
    - set:
        field: _area_origin
        value: origin
    - set:
        field: _area_origin_blocked
        value: false
    - set:
        field: _area_origin_start_inside
        value: false
    - spatial_query:
        scene: state.spatial_scene
        operation: ray
        snapshot: '{_info_snapshot}'
        query:
          map_id: '{lasting_state.spatial_scene.map.id}'
          origin: '{start}'
          destination: '{origin}'
          include:
          - geometry
          max_intersections: 1024
      store_as: _area_origin_ray
    - require:
        condition: _area_origin_ray.truncated != true
        error: Area-origin placement exceeded the actual ray bound.
    - set:
        field: _area_origin_hits
        value: _area_origin_ray.intersections
    - for_each:
        collection: _area_origin_hits
        as: _area_origin_hit
        do:
        - condition: _area_origin_blocked != true
          on_true:
          - call: qualify_srd_area_solid_hit
            params:
              geometry_id: '{_area_origin_hit.id}'
              plane: '{plane}'
              start: '{start}'
              end: '{origin}'
            export_context:
              _area_solid_crossed: _area_solid_crossed
              _area_solid_start_inside: _area_solid_start_inside
          - condition: _area_solid_crossed == true
            on_true:
            - set:
                field: _area_origin
                value: _area_origin_hit.point
            - set:
                field: _area_origin_blocked
                value: true
            - set:
                field: _area_origin_start_inside
                value: _area_solid_start_inside
    metadata:
      category: internal
      visible_to_player: false
    parameters:
    - param_start_d98e3be2ca5dca70

        in actor_state.conditions or 'unconscious' in actor_state.conditions)

    - require:
        condition: _scene_same_plane == true and _scene_distance <= 120 and _scene_can_see

        error: Mind Spike selects a visible creature within 120 feet.
    - call: resolve_srd_divination_save
      params:
        target_state: '{_target_state_id}'
        ability: wisdom
        dc: '{casting_save_dc}'
      export_context:
        _divination_save_success: _divination_save_success
    - set:
        field: _mind_spike_dice_count
        value: 3 + max(0, slot_level - 2)
    - set:
        field: _mind_spike_roll_remainder
        value: 0
    - dice:
        expression: '{_mind_spike_dice_count}d8'
      store_as: _mind_spike_damage

      - call: modify_srd_actor_damage_roll
        params:

            sides: _mind_spike_damage.sides

    - set:
        field: _mind_spike_amount
        value: _mind_spike_damage.total
    - set:

    - call: read_srd_mind_spike_hit_points

    - set:

    - set:

    - set:
        field: _curse_damage_roll_divisor
        value: 2

  mark_srd_levitate_return:
    effects:
    - set:

    - condition: lasting_state.levitate_sources != null
      on_true:
      - set:
          field: _levitate_records
          value: lasting_state.levitate_sources
      - for_each:
          collection: _levitate_records
          as: _levitate_record
          do:
          - condition: _levitate_record.id == source_id
            on_true:
            - require:
                condition: _levitate_source == null
                error: Levitate source identity is ambiguous.
            - set:
                field: _levitate_source
                value: _levitate_record
    - require:
        condition: _levitate_source != null
        error: Select an actual saved Levitate source.
    - condition: _levitate_source.caster == _caster_state_id and _levitate_source.sequence
        == sequence and _levitate_source.settled != true
      on_true:
      - set:
          field: _levitate_source_patch
          value:
            active: false
            return_pending: true
            movement_destination: null
      - set:
          field: _levitate_source
          value: merge(_levitate_source, _levitate_source_patch)
      - set:
          field: _levitate_retained
          value: []
      - set:
          field: _levitate_records
          value: lasting_state.levitate_sources
      - for_each:

          - condition: _levitate_record.id == _levitate_source.id

            - list_push:

                value: _levitate_source

  resolve_srd_memory_projection:
    effects:
    - set:
        field: _memory_link_active
        value: false
    - set:
        field: _memory_retained
        value: false
    - set:
        field: _memory_other_incap
        value: target_state.timed_condition_unowned_incapacitated == true
    - set:
        field: _dialogue_ids
        value: []
    - set:
        field: _dialogue_ids
        value: target_state.timed_condition_source_ids
      condition: target_state.timed_condition_source_ids != null
    - for_each:
        collection: _dialogue_ids
        as: _dialogue_id
        do:
        - set:
            field: _dialogue_source
            value: lasting_state.timed_condition_sources[_dialogue_id]
        - set:
            field: _memory_retained
            value: true
          condition: _dialogue_source.installed == true and _dialogue_source.dialogue_profile
            == 'memory'
        - condition: _dialogue_source.installed == true and _dialogue_source.suppressed
            != true
          on_true:
          - set:
              field: _memory_link_active
              value: true
            condition: _dialogue_source.dialogue_profile == 'memory' and 'charmed'
              in target_state.conditions
          - set:
              field: _memory_other_incap
              value: true
            condition: _dialogue_source.condition == 'incapacitated' or _dialogue_source.control_profile
              == 'hypnotic' or _dialogue_source.control_profile == 'laughter'
    - condition: _memory_link_active == true
      on_true:
      - apply_condition:
          target: target_state
          condition: incapacitated
      on_false:
      - remove_condition:
          target: target_state
          condition: incapacitated
        condition: target_state.memory_link_incapacitated == true and _memory_other_incap
          != true
    - set:
        field: target_state.memory_link_incapacitated
        value: _memory_link_active
    - set:
        field: target_state.memory_unaware
        value: _memory_link_active
    - set:

          or candidate.metadata.participant_ref == _target_state_id)
        error: Reuse only this target's actual admitted scene body during the current
          plan.
    - set:
        field: _fissure_body
        value: candidate
    - set:
        field: _fissure_body_inside
        value: false
    - set:
        field: _fissure_edge_position
        value: null
    - require:
        condition: _fissure_body.footprint.kind == 'box'
        error: Fissures require an actual Box body.
    - condition: _fissure_body.position[perp] + _fissure_body.footprint.half_extents[perp]
        > offset - 5 and _fissure_body.position[perp] - _fissure_body.footprint.half_extents[perp]
        < offset + 5
      on_true:
      - require:
          condition: _fissure_body.position[perp] - _fissure_body.footprint.half_extents[perp]
            >= offset - 5 and _fissure_body.position[perp] + _fissure_body.footprint.half_extents[perp]
            <= offset + 5
          error: Boundary-straddling bodies need their actual opening-edge geometry.
      - require:
          condition: target_state.magic_jar_source_id == null and target_state.form_statistics_replaced
            != true and (target_state.current_body_source_id == null or target_state.current_body_source_id
            == _target_state_id)
          error: Fissure saves and falls require the actual native physical receiving
            body.
      - require:
          condition: target_state.creature_kind == 'character' or target_state.saving_throw_modifiers.dexterity
            != null
          error: Use the actual creature's Dexterity saving throw statistics.
      - set:
          field: _fissure_edge_coordinate
          value: offset - 5 - _fissure_body.footprint.half_extents[perp]
      - set:
          field: _fissure_edge_coordinate
          value: offset + 5 + _fissure_body.footprint.half_extents[perp]
        condition: edge == 'positive'
      - condition: perp == 0
        on_true:
        - set:
            field: _fissure_edge_position
            value:
            - _fissure_edge_coordinate
            - _fissure_body.position[1]
            - _fissure_body.position[2]
        on_false:
        - set:
            field: _fissure_edge_position
            value:
            - _fissure_body.position[0]
            - _fissure_edge_coordinate

        params:
          subject: '{_target_state_id}'
          destination: '{_fissure_edge_position}'
          plane: '{_fissure_body.metadata.plane}'

          _travel_placement: _travel_placement
      - require:
          condition: _travel_placement.position[0] == _fissure_edge_position[0]
          error: The chosen opening edge must be an actual clear placement, without
            a guessed fallback.
      - require:
          condition: _travel_placement.position[1] == _fissure_edge_position[1]
          error: The chosen opening edge must be an actual clear placement, without
            a guessed fallback.
      - require:
          condition: _travel_placement.position[2] == _fissure_edge_position[2]
          error: The chosen opening edge must be an actual clear placement, without
            a guessed fallback.
      - set:
          field: _fissure_body_inside
          value: true

  format: 1

tools:
  collect_srd_solid_wall_owned_cast:
    effects:
    - set:
        field: _solid_wall_dismiss_ids
        value: []
    - condition: lasting_state.has_solid_spell_walls == true
      on_true:
      - set:
          field: _solid_owned_ids
          value: lasting_state.solid_spell_wall_source_ids
      - for_each:
          collection: _solid_owned_ids
          as: _solid_owned_id
          do:
          - set:
              field: _solid_owned
              value: lasting_state.solid_spell_wall_sources[_solid_owned_id]
          - condition: _solid_owned.cast_id == cast_id and cast_id != '' and _solid_owned.source_caster_id
              == _caster_state_id and _solid_owned.ongoing_duration == true and _solid_owned.installed
              == true
            on_true:
            - call: qualify_srd_solid_spell_wall_source
              params:
                caster_state: '{_caster_state_id}'
                source_id: '{_solid_owned_id}'
              export_context:
                _solid_wall_current: _solid_wall_current
            - list_push:
                list: _solid_wall_dismiss_ids
                value: _solid_owned_id
              condition: _solid_wall_current == true
    metadata:
      category: internal
      visible_to_player: false
    parameters:
    - param_caster_state_5310b8b23a525eea

tools:
  end_srd_hallow_source:
    effects:
    - require:
        condition: lasting_state.spell_hallow_sources != null and source_id in lasting_state.spell_hallow_sources
        error: Use the actual installed Hallow source.
    - set:
        field: _hallow_source
        value: lasting_state.spell_hallow_sources[source_id]
    - set:
        field: lasting_state.spell_hallow_sources.{source_id}.installed
        value: false
    - set:
        field: lasting_state.spell_hallow_sources.{source_id}.ended_tick
        value: lasting_state.lasting_tick
    - set:
        field: lasting_state.spell_hallow_sources.{source_id}.end_reason
        value: reason
    metadata:
      category: internal
      visible_to_player: false
    parameters:
    - param_source_id_da8b650d256d2fc5
    - param_reason_851fbd1e6af5226e
    - param_lasting_state_f791c68f01bb49c8
  retained_spell_query_end_srd_conjured_presence_source:
    effects:
    - require:
        condition: lasting_state.persistent_spell_areas != null
        error: Select an actual retained spell area.
    - set:
        field: _presence
        value: lasting_state.persistent_spell_areas[source_id]
    - require:
        condition: _presence != null and _presence.profile == 'conjured_presence'
        error: Select an actual retained Celestial or Fey source.
    - set:
        field: _presence_was_active
        value: _presence.active == true
    - set:
        field: _presence_patch
        value:
          active: false
          installed: false
    - set:
        field: _presence
        value: merge(_presence, _presence_patch)
    - set:
        field: lasting_state.persistent_spell_areas.{source_id}
        value: _presence
    - condition: _presence.mode == 'fey' and _presence_was_active == true
      on_true:
      - require:
          condition: lasting_state.spatial_scene != null
          error: This operation needs the admitted spatial scene.
      - require:
          condition: lasting_state.spatial_scene.map.grid.unit == 'ft'
          error: SRD scene distances use feet.
      - spatial_query:
          scene: state.spatial_scene
          operation: snapshot
        store_as: _info_snapshot
      - spatial_mutation:
          scene: state.spatial_scene
          map_id: '{lasting_state.spatial_scene.map.id}'
          expected_revision: '{_info_snapshot.geometry_revision}'
          target:
            kind: entity
            id: '{_presence.subject_id}'
          patch:
            active: false
            movement: passable
            visibility: clear
        store_as: _presence_retired_anchor
      - call: retained_spell_query_refresh_srd_spell_triggers
        condition: lasting_state.has_spell_triggers == true
        params:
          lasting_state: '{_lasting_state_id}'

      visible_to_player: false

    - param_source_id_da8b650d256d2fc5
    - param_lasting_state_7bff8d20c3cf7d0f

      type: integer
    - name: tiles
      type: array
      items:
        type: integer
    pre_conditions: []
    effects:
    - set:
        field: _allowed
        value: definitions.tiles[actor.game.last_draw].kind == kind
    - set:
        field: _wait_kinds
        value: actor.game.riichi_waits
    - set:
        field: _remaining
        value: without(actor.game.hand, tiles)
    - set:
        field: _remaining_kinds
        value: []
    - for_each:
        collection: '{a}'
        as: _tile
        do:
        - list_push:
            list: _remaining_kinds
            value: definitions.tiles[_tile].kind
    - set:
        field: _after
        value: completions(_remaining_kinds, definitions.patterns, definitions.group_sizes[len(actor.game.melds)
          + 1], indices(34))
    - set:
        field: _owned_kinds
        value: []
    - set:
        field: _owned_tiles
        value: actor.game.hand
    - for_each:
        collection: _owned_tiles
        as: _tile
        do:
        - list_push:
            list: _owned_kinds
            value: definitions.tiles[_tile].kind
    - set:
        field: _melds
        value: actor.game.melds
    - for_each:
        collection: _melds
        as: _meld
        do:
        - set:
            field: _meld_tiles
            value: _meld.tiles
        - for_each:
            collection: _meld_tiles
            as: _tile
            do:
            - list_push:
                list: _owned_kinds
                value: definitions.tiles[_tile].kind
    - set:
        field: _filtered_after
        value: []
    - for_each:
        collection: _after
        as: _wait_kind
        do:
        - condition:
            condition: occurrences(_owned_kinds, _wait_kind) < 4
            on_true:
            - list_push:
                list: _filtered_after
                value: _wait_kind
            on_false: []
    - condition:
        condition: len(_filtered_after) != len(actor.game.riichi_waits)
        on_true:
        - set:
            field: _allowed
            value: false
        on_false: []
    - for_each: 0

              field: _flame_barrier_plane
              value: _flame_barrier.metadata.plane
            condition: _flame_barrier.metadata.plane != null

            - call: srd_information_segment_interval
              params:

                volume: '{_flame_barrier.volume}'
              export_context:
                _segment_hit: _segment_hit
                _segment_entry: _segment_entry
                _segment_exit: _segment_exit
            - condition: _segment_hit == true and _segment_exit > _segment_entry
              on_true:
              - require:
                  condition: _flame_barrier.volume.kind == 'box' or _flame_barrier.volume.kind
                    == 'cylinder'
                  error: Flame Blade light obstruction needs admitted Box or Cylinder
                    interior geometry.
              - set:
                  field: _flame_path_fraction
                  value: (_segment_entry + _segment_exit) * 0.5
              - set:
                  field: _flame_path_0
                  value: start[0] + (end[0] - start[0]) * _flame_path_fraction
              - set:
                  field: _flame_path_1
                  value: start[1] + (end[1] - start[1]) * _flame_path_fraction
                _x: true
              - set:
                  field: _flame_path_2
                  value: start[2] + (end[2] - start[2]) * _flame_path_fraction
              - set:
                  field: _flame_path_interior
                  value: false
              - set:
                  field: _flame_path_interior
                  value: _flame_path_0 > _flame_barrier.volume.min[0] and _flame_path_0

                    > _flame_barrier.volume.min[2] and _flame_path_2 < _flame_barrier.volume.max[2]
                condition: _flame_barrier.volume.kind == 'box'
              - set:
                  field: _flame_path_interior
                  value: (_flame_path_0 - _flame_barrier.volume.center[0]) ** 2 +
                    (_flame_path_1 - _flame_barrier.volume.center[1]) ** 2 < _flame_barrier.volume.radius
                    ** 2 and _flame_path_2 > _flame_barrier.volume.center[2] and _flame_path_2
                    < _flame_barrier.volume.center[2] + _flame_barrier.volume.height
                condition: _flame_barrier.volume.kind == 'cylinder'
              - set:
                  field: _flame_light_blocked
                  value: true
                condition: _flame_path_interior == true

tools:
  derive_srd_spell_area_axis_bounds:
    effects:
    - condition: candidate.footprint != null
      on_true:
      - require:
          condition: candidate.footprint.kind == 'box' or candidate.footprint.kind
            == 'circle'
          error: Cone physical qualification requires admitted box or circle blockers.
      - condition: candidate.footprint.kind == 'box'
        on_true:
        - set:
            field: _area_axis_bounds
            value:
              min: (candidate.position[0] - origin[0]) * axis[0] + (candidate.position[1]
                - origin[1]) * axis[1] - (candidate.footprint.half_extents[0] * abs(axis[0])
                + candidate.footprint.half_extents[1] * abs(axis[1]))
              max: (candidate.position[0] - origin[0]) * axis[0] + (candidate.position[1]
                - origin[1]) * axis[1] + (candidate.footprint.half_extents[0] * abs(axis[0])
                + candidate.footprint.half_extents[1] * abs(axis[1]))
        on_false:
        - set:
            field: _area_axis_bounds
            value:
              min: (candidate.position[0] - origin[0]) * axis[0] + (candidate.position[1]
                - origin[1]) * axis[1] - candidate.footprint.radius
              max: (candidate.position[0] - origin[0]) * axis[0] + (candidate.position[1]
                - origin[1]) * axis[1] + candidate.footprint.radius
      on_false:
      - require:
          condition: candidate.volume.kind == 'box' or candidate.volume.kind == 'cylinder'
          error: Cone physical qualification requires admitted box or cylinder geometry.
      - condition: candidate.volume.kind == 'box'

            value:
            - (candidate.volume.min[0] + candidate.volume.max[0]) * 0.5
            - (candidate.volume.min[1] + candidate.volume.max[1]) * 0.5
        - set:
            field: _area_axis_box_half

                - origin[1]) * axis[1] - candidate.volume.radius

    description: Initialize the shared immutable context values.
    metadata:

      visible_to_player: false
    effects:

        value: []
    - set:
        field: _instant_cast_target
        value: null
    - set:
        field: _instant_cast__target_id
        value: null
  stabilize_srd_creature:
    description: Take the Help action to attempt ordinary first aid on a living, unstable
      creature at 0 HP able to receive physical first aid. Use the helper's actual
      Wisdom (Medicine) modifier; the native DC 10 check determines stabilization.
      Stabilization grants no HP and leaves Unconscious until recovery. This operation
      does not consume a Healer's Kit or simulate a healing spell.
    effects:
    - require:
        condition: actor_state.is_alive == true and actor_state.hp > 0
        error: A dead or unconscious creature cannot administer first aid.
    - require:
        condition: not ('incapacitated' in actor_state.conditions or 'paralyzed' in
          actor_state.conditions or 'petrified' in actor_state.conditions or 'stunned'
          in actor_state.conditions or 'unconscious' in actor_state.conditions)
        error: An incapacitated creature cannot take the Help action.
    - require:
        condition: _actor_state_id != _target_id
        error: A creature cannot stabilize itself.
    - require:
        condition: target.is_alive == true and target.hp == 0 and target.stable ==
          false
        error: First aid needs a living, unstable creature at 0 Hit Points.
    - condition: combat.encounter_active == true
      on_true:
      - require:
          condition: combat.turn_active == true and combat.active_actor == _actor_state_id
          error: First aid requires the helper's active combat turn.
      - call: spend_srd_action
        params:
          magic_action: false
    - call: stabilize_character
      params:
        actor_state: '{_actor_state_id}'
        target: '{_target_id}'
        medicine_modifier: '{medicine_modifier}'
        advantage: '{advantage}'
        disadvantage: '{disadvantage}'
      export_context:
        _stabilization_check: _stabilization_check
        _stabilization_total: _stabilization_total
        _stabilization_outcome: _stabilization_outcome
        _stable_after: _stable_after
        _stable_recovery_hours_remaining_after: _stable_recovery_hours_remaining_after
        _conditions_after: _conditions_after
    metadata:
      category: recovery
      costs_action: true
      result_card:
        version: 1
        footprint: compact
        title: Stabilize
        subtitle: Wisdom (Medicine) check
        equation:
          die_sides: 20
          roll:
            path: context._stabilization_check.total
          modifier:
            path: context._stabilization_check.modifier
          total:
            path: context._stabilization_total
        summary:
        - label: Outcome
          value:
            path: context._stabilization_outcome
            labels:
              success: Stable

meta:
  id: Bad_ID
tools:
  qualify_srd_environment_wind:
    effects:
    - call: format_srd_information_projection
      params:
        message: '{area_id}'
      export_context:
        _environment_area_key: _info_projection_message
    - set:
        field: _environment_area
        value: lasting_state.persistent_spell_areas[_environment_area_key]
    - require:
        condition: _environment_area.profile == 'environment' and (_environment_area.mode
          == 'fog' or _environment_area.mode == 'cloudkill' or _environment_area.mode
          == 'stinking_cloud' or _environment_area.mode == 'incendiary_cloud') and
          _environment_area.active == true
        error: Select an active fog spell source.
    - set:
        field: _environment_wind_found
        value: false
    - set:
        field: _environment_wind_zones
        value: lasting_state.spatial_scene.zones
    - for_each:
        collection: _environment_wind_zones
        as: _environment_wind_zone
        do:
        - condition: (wind_zone_id == '' or _environment_wind_zone.id == wind_zone_id)
            and _environment_wind_zone.metadata.strong_wind == true and _environment_wind_zone.metadata.plane
            == _environment_area.plane
          on_true:
          - condition: _environment_wind_zone.shape.kind == 'box'
            on_true:
            - set:
                field: _environment_wind_nearest
                value:
                - max(_environment_wind_zone.shape.min[0], min(_environment_area.origin[0],
                  _environment_wind_zone.shape.max[0]))
                - max(_environment_wind_zone.shape.min[1], min(_environment_area.origin[1],
                  _environment_wind_zone.shape.max[1]))
                - max(_environment_wind_zone.shape.min[2], min(_environment_area.origin[2],
                  _environment_wind_zone.shape.max[2]))
            - call: measure_srd_information_distance
              params:
                start: '{_environment_area.origin}'
                end: '{_environment_wind_nearest}'
              export_context:
                _scene_distance: _scene_distance
            on_false:
            - require:
                condition: _environment_wind_zone.shape.kind == 'cylinder'
                error: Use the actual admitted strong-wind zone extent.
            - set:
                field: _environment_wind_horizontal
                value: max(0, ((_environment_area.origin[0] - _environment_wind_zone.shape.center[0])
                  ** 2 + (_environment_area.origin[1] - _environment_wind_zone.shape.center[1])
                  ** 2) ** 0.5 - _environment_wind_zone.shape.radius)
            - set:
                field: _environment_wind_vertical
                value: max(0, _environment_wind_zone.shape.center[2] - _environment_area.origin[2],
                  _environment_area.origin[2] - _environment_wind_zone.shape.center[2]
                  - _environment_wind_zone.shape.height)
            - set:
                field: _scene_distance
                value: (_environment_wind_horizontal ** 2 + _environment_wind_vertical
                  ** 2) ** 0.5
          - set:
              field: _environment_wind_found
              value: true
            condition: _scene_distance <= _environment_area.radius
    - condition: lasting_state.has_storm_sources == true
      on_true:
      - call: qualify_srd_storm_fog_wind
        params:
          area_id: '{area_id}'
          caster_state: '{_environment_area.caster}'
          plane: '{_environment_area.plane}'
          lasting_state: '{_lasting_state_id}'
        export_context:
          _storm_fog_full_wind: _storm_fog_full_wind
      - set:
          field: _environment_wind_found
          value: true
        condition: _storm_fog_full_wind == true
    metadata:
      category: internal
      visible_to_player: false
    parameters:
    - param_area_id_e089c46d11628c06
    - param_wind_zone_id_73001262fdbcc262
    - param_lasting_state_f791c68f01bb49c8

    required: false
    default: state

    - require:

          <= lasting_state.spatial_scene.map.bounds.max[1]
        error: The chosen point must be in the admitted scene.
    - require:

          <= lasting_state.spatial_scene.map.bounds.max[2]

    - set:

            condition: _growth_exclusion.min[0] < _growth_exclusion.max[0]

            - max(abs(_growth_exclusion.min[1] - point[1]), abs(_growth_exclusion.max[1]

            - max(abs(_growth_exclusion.min[2] - point[2]), abs(_growth_exclusion.max[2]
              - point[2]))
        - require:

        error: An object target must be an actual non-creature scene ID.
    - set:
        field: _object_scene

        condition: _object_scene.metadata.gate_portal.source_id == source_id and _object_scene.metadata.gate_portal.cast_id

        error: Retire only this actual Gate's paired body.

        error: SRD scene distances use feet.
    - spatial_query:
        scene: state.spatial_scene
        operation: snapshot
      store_as: _info_snapshot
    - set:
        field: _world_changes
        value:
          gate_retired_tick: lasting_state.lasting_tick
    - set:
        field: _world_object_marker
        value:
          is_object: false
    - set:
        field: _world_changes
        value: merge(_world_changes, _world_object_marker)
    - set:
        field: _world_metadata
        value: merge(_object_scene.metadata, _world_changes)

        scene: state.spatial_scene

        expected_revision: '{_info_snapshot.geometry_revision}'
        target:
          kind: entity
          id: '{object_id}'
        patch:
          metadata: '{_world_metadata}'
          active: false
          movement: passable
          visibility: clear

    - call: retained_spell_query_refresh_srd_spell_triggers

    - call: get_srd_attack_rider_source

      export_context:
        _source_condition_immune: _source_condition_immune
        _source_condition_save_advantage: _source_condition_save_advantage
    - set:
        field: _ensnaring_save_advantage

    - call: d20_test

    effects:
    - set:

        value: []
    - set:
        field: _trigger_records
        value: lasting_state.turn_effects
    - for_each:
        collection: _trigger_records
        as: _trigger_remove
        do:
        - list_push:
            list: _trigger_kept
            value: _trigger_remove
          condition: _trigger_remove.kind != 'spell_trigger' or _trigger_remove.instance
            != trigger_id
    - set:
        field: lasting_state.turn_effects
        value: _trigger_kept
    - set:
        field: lasting_state.has_spell_triggers
        value: false
    - set:
        field: lasting_state.has_active_symbol_auras
        value: false
    - for_each:
        collection: _trigger_kept
        as: _trigger_remaining
        do:
        - set:
            field: lasting_state.has_spell_triggers
            value: true
          condition: _trigger_remaining.kind == 'spell_trigger'
        - set:
            field: lasting_state.has_active_symbol_auras
            value: true
          condition: _trigger_remaining.kind == 'spell_trigger' and _trigger_remaining.spell
            == 'symbol' and _trigger_remaining.activated_tick != null

      visible_to_player: false
    parameters:
    - param_trigger_id_9057d6fe49f9266f
    - param_lasting_state_7bff8d20c3cf7d0f
  clear_srd_magical_contagion:
    effects:
    - set:
        field: _progressive_ids
        value: []
    - set:
        field: _progressive_ids
        value: target_state.timed_condition_source_ids
      condition: target_state.timed_condition_source_ids != null
    - for_each:

          - call: retire_srd_timed_condition_source

              lasting_state: '{_lasting_state_id}'
            condition: _progressive_source.control_profile == 'contagion'
    - call: refresh_srd_timed_condition_target
      params:
        target_state: '{_target_state_id}'
        lasting_state: '{_lasting_state_id}'

      category: internal
      visible_to_player: false

        params:

    - set:

    - condition: _force_ending != null and _force_ending.active == true
      on_true:
      - set:
          field: lasting_state.spell_force_records.{force_id}.active
          value: false
      - call: retained_spell_query_srd_information_scene_entity
        params:
          subject: '{force_id}'
          lasting_state: '{_lasting_state_id}'
        export_context:
          _info_scene_entity: _info_scene_entity
          _info_position: _info_position
      - set:
          field: _force_ending_position
          value: _info_position
      - call: retained_spell_query_update_srd_spell_force_scene
        params:
          force_id: '{force_id}'
          position: '{_force_ending_position}'
          active: false
      - call: finish_srd_servant_entity
        params:
          servant_state: '{force_id}'
        condition: _force_ending.spell == 'unseen_servant'
      - set:
          field: _force_retained_clock_ids
          value: []
      - set:
          field: _force_registered_ids
          value: lasting_state.spell_force_ids
      - for_each:
          collection: _force_registered_ids
          as: _force_registered_id
          do:
          - list_push:
              list: _force_retained_clock_ids
              value: _force_registered_id
            condition: _force_registered_id != force_id
      - set:
          field: lasting_state.spell_force_ids
          value: _force_retained_clock_ids
      - set:
          field: lasting_state.has_spell_forces
          value: len(_force_retained_clock_ids) > 0
      - condition: _force_ending.spell == 'guardian_of_faith'
        on_true:
        - set:

tools:
  resolve_srd_prismatic_wall_body_segment:
    effects:
    - require:
        condition: lasting_state.spell_prismatic_wall_sources != null and source_id
          in lasting_state.spell_prismatic_wall_sources
        error: Select an actual saved Prismatic Wall source.
    - set:
        field: _wall_record
        value: lasting_state.spell_prismatic_wall_sources[source_id]
    - call: srd_information_scene_entity
      params:
        subject: '{subject}'
      export_context:
        _info_scene_entity: _info_scene_entity
        _info_position: _info_position
    - set:
        field: _wall_segment_body
        value: _info_scene_entity
    - require:
        condition: _wall_segment_body.footprint.kind == 'box'
        error: Wall passage needs supported actual creature body geometry.
    - set:
        field: _prismatic_wall_body_hit
        value: false
    - condition: _wall_record.spell_id == 'prismatic_wall' and _wall_record.installed
        == true and lasting_state.lasting_tick < _wall_record.expires_tick and _wall_record.layers_remaining
        > 0 and _wall_segment_body.metadata.plane == _wall_record.plane
      on_true:
      - set:
          field: _expanded_wall_volume
          value:
            kind: '''box'''
            min:
            - _wall_record.volume.min[0] - _wall_segment_body.footprint.half_extents[0]
            - _wall_record.volume.min[1] - _wall_segment_body.footprint.half_extents[1]
            - _wall_record.volume.min[2] - _wall_segment_body.height
            max:
            - _wall_record.volume.max[0] + _wall_segment_body.footprint.half_extents[0]
            - _wall_record.volume.max[1] + _wall_segment_body.footprint.half_extents[1]
            - _wall_record.volume.max[2]
      - call: srd_information_segment_interval
        params:
          start: '{start}'
          end: '{end}'
          volume: '{_expanded_wall_volume}'
        export_context:
          _segment_hit: _segment_hit
          _segment_entry: _segment_entry
          _segment_exit: _segment_exit
      - set:
          field: _prismatic_wall_body_hit
          value: _segment_hit == true and _segment_exit > _segment_entry
      - set:
          field: _prismatic_wall_body_hit
          value: false
        condition: start[0] == end[0] and (start[0] <= _expanded_wall_volume.min[0]
          or start[0] >= _expanded_wall_volume.max[0])
      - set:
          field: _prismatic_wall_body_hit
          value: false
        condition: start[1] == end[1] and (start[1] <= _expanded_wall_volume.min[1]
          or start[1] >= _expanded_wall_volume.max[1])
      - set:
          field: _prismatic_wall_body_hit
          value: false
        condition: start[2] == end[2] and (start[2] <= _expanded_wall_volume.min[2]
          or start[2] >= _expanded_wall_volume.max[2])
    metadata:
      category: internal
      visible_to_player: false
    parameters:
    - param_subject_3f9e3ffc3bfe8ffd
    - param_start_d98e3be2ca5dca70
    - param_end_2ff639971e9448b4
    - param_source_id_da8b650d256d2fc5
    - param_lasting_state_f791c68f01bb49c8

  derive_srd_point_area_body_nearest:
    effects:
    - require:
        condition: body.footprint.kind == 'box' or body.footprint.kind == 'circle'
        error: Point-area placement needs an actual admitted box or circular body.
    - set:
        field: _mass_cure_nearest_z
        value: max(body.position[2], min(point[2], body.position[2] + body.height))
    - condition: body.footprint.kind == 'box'
      on_true:
      - set:
          field: _mass_cure_nearest_x
          value: max(body.position[0] - body.footprint.half_extents[0], min(point[0],
            body.position[0] + body.footprint.half_extents[0]))
      - set:
          field: _mass_cure_nearest_y
          value: max(body.position[1] - body.footprint.half_extents[1], min(point[1],
            body.position[1] + body.footprint.half_extents[1]))
      on_false:
      - set:
          field: _mass_cure_dx
          value: point[0] - body.position[0]
      - set:
          field: _mass_cure_dy
          value: point[1] - body.position[1]
      - set:
          field: _mass_cure_radial
          value: (_mass_cure_dx ** 2 + _mass_cure_dy ** 2) ** 0.5
      - set:
          field: _mass_cure_fraction
          value: 1
      - condition: _mass_cure_radial > body.footprint.radius
        on_true:
        - set:
            field: _mass_cure_fraction
            value: body.footprint.radius * _mass_cure_radial ** -1
      - set:
          field: _mass_cure_nearest_x
          value: body.position[0] + _mass_cure_dx * _mass_cure_fraction
      - set:
          field: _mass_cure_nearest_y
          value: body.position[1] + _mass_cure_dy * _mass_cure_fraction
    - set:
        field: _mass_cure_nearest
        value:
        - _mass_cure_nearest_x
        - _mass_cure_nearest_y
        - _mass_cure_nearest_z
    - set:
        field: _mass_cure_distance_squared
        value: (point[0] - _mass_cure_nearest_x) ** 2 + (point[1] - _mass_cure_nearest_y)
          ** 2 + (point[2] - _mass_cure_nearest_z) ** 2
    metadata:
      category: internal
      visible_to_player: false
    parameters:
    - name: body
      type: object
      from_state: state.turn_effects
    - param_point_5302e4c3a7d97ba4

tools:
  check_srd_antilife_caster_movement:
    effects:
    - set:
        field: _antilife_cast_source
        value: lasting_state.spell_barrier_sources[source_id]
    - call: srd_information_scene_entity
      params:
        subject: '{_antilife_cast_source.caster_state_id}'
      export_context:
        _info_scene_entity: _info_scene_entity
        _info_position: _info_position
    - set:
        field: _antilife_caster
        value: _info_scene_entity
    - condition: teleport != true and plane == _antilife_caster.metadata.plane
      on_true:
      - set:
          field: _antilife_scene_entities
          value: lasting_state.spatial_scene.entities
      - for_each:
          collection: _antilife_scene_entities
          as: _antilife_other
          do:
          - condition: lasting_state.spell_barrier_sources[source_id].installed ==
              true and _antilife_other.active == true and _antilife_other.metadata.participant_ref
              != null and _antilife_other.metadata.participant_ref != _antilife_cast_source.caster_state_id
              and _antilife_other.metadata.plane == plane
            on_true:
            - set:
                field: _antilife_relative_destination
                value:
                - _antilife_other.position[0] - destination[0] + _antilife_caster.position[0]
                - _antilife_other.position[1] - destination[1] + _antilife_caster.position[1]
                - _antilife_other.position[2] - destination[2] + _antilife_caster.position[2]
            - call: check_srd_antilife_creature_movement
              params:
                actor_state: '{_antilife_other.metadata.participant_ref}'
                source_id: '{source_id}'
                plane: '{plane}'
                destination: '{_antilife_relative_destination}'
              export_context:
                _antilife_movement_allowed: _antilife_movement_allowed
            - call: end_srd_spell_barrier_source
              params:
                source_id: '{source_id}'
                reason: forced_crossing
              condition: _antilife_movement_allowed != true
    metadata:
      category: internal
      visible_to_player: false
    parameters:
    - param_source_id_da8b650d256d2fc5
    - param_destination_897e99fd4c074a9d
    - param_plane_1f147b6f378b0935
    - param_teleport_ad260406cc99c9e5
    - param_lasting_state_f791c68f01bb49c8
  resolve_srd_environment_light:
    effects:
    - call: refresh_srd_moonbeam_darkness
    - set:
        field: _environment_magic_dim
        value: false
    - call: initialize_srd_lite_constants_f68db9f9b129
      export_context: '*'
    - set:
        field: _environment_ids
        value: lasting_state.persistent_spell_area_ids
      condition: lasting_state.has_spell_environments == true
    - for_each:
        collection: _environment_ids
        as: _environment_id
        do:
        - set:
            field: _environment_area
            value: lasting_state.persistent_spell_areas[_environment_id]
        - condition: _environment_area.profile == 'environment' and _environment_area.active
            == true and lasting_state.lasting_tick < _environment_area.expires_tick
          on_true:
          - condition: _environment_area.mode == 'moonbeam' and _environment_area.plane
              == plane
            on_true:
            - call: qualify_srd_environment_sphere_source
              params:
                caster_state: '{_environment_area.caster}'
                area_id: '{_environment_id}'
              export_context:
                _sphere_source_current: _sphere_source_current
            - set:
                field: _environment_magic_dim
                value: true
              condition: _sphere_source_current == true and point[2] >= _environment_area.cylinder_min
                and point[2] <= _environment_area.cylinder_max and (point[0] - _environment_area.origin[0])
                ** 2 + (point[1] - _environment_area.origin[1]) ** 2 <= _environment_area.radius
                ** 2
    metadata:
      category: internal
      visible_to_player: false

sylvia_gm_runtime:
  format: 1
  state_namespace: pkg
tools:
  check_srd_move_earth_clear:
    effects:
    - require:
        condition: lasting_state.spatial_scene != null
        error: This operation needs the admitted spatial scene.
    - require:
        condition: lasting_state.spatial_scene.map.grid.unit == 'ft'
        error: SRD scene distances use feet.
    - spatial_query:
        scene: state.spatial_scene
        operation: snapshot
      store_as: _info_snapshot
    - spatial_query:
        scene: state.spatial_scene
        operation: area
        snapshot: '{_info_snapshot}'
        query:
          map_id: '{lasting_state.spatial_scene.map.id}'
          shape:
            kind: box
            min: '{candidate.min}'
            max: '{candidate.max}'
          include:
          - geometry
          - entities
          max_results: 4096
      store_as: _earth_occupants
    - require:
        condition: _earth_occupants.truncated != true
        error: Actual terrain occupancy results must be complete.
    - set:
        field: _earth_occupant_rows
        value: _earth_occupants.results
    - for_each:
        collection: _earth_occupant_rows
        as: _earth_occupant
        do:
        - require:
            condition: (_earth_occupant.kind == 'geometry' and _earth_occupant.id
              == geometry_id) or (_earth_occupant.metadata.plane != null and _earth_occupant.metadata.plane
              != plane)
            error: Occupied terrain or shifting plants, rocks and structures remains
              unsupported; no trap or injury is applied.
    metadata:
      category: internal
      visible_to_player: false
    parameters:
    - param_geometry_id_73cfef73410bfda2
    - param_candidate_feb413ee4bb019ca
    - param_plane_1f147b6f378b0935
    - param_lasting_state_7bff8d20c3cf7d0f
  set_srd_illumination_cover:
    description: Record actual opaque covering of an admitted light-source object;
      covering does not quench Continual Flame. Outside combat, retained exploration
      objects use their local physical facts; no map setup or movement is required.
    effects:
    - condition: combat.encounter_active != true
      on_true:
      - set:
          field: _lite_cover_allowed
          value: false
      - condition: lasting_state.turn_effects != null
        on_true:
        - set:
            field: _lite_cover_records
            value: lasting_state.turn_effects
        - for_each:
            collection: _lite_cover_records
            as: _lite_cover_record
            do:
            - set:
                field: _lite_cover_allowed
                value: true
              condition: _lite_cover_record.kind == 'illumination_spell' and _lite_cover_record.source
                == object_id and (_lite_cover_record.spell == 'light' or _lite_cover_record.spell
                == 'daylight') and _lite_cover_record.spell in definitions.srd_lite_implemented
                and (_lite_cover_record.expires_tick == null or lasting_state.lasting_tick
                < _lite_cover_record.expires_tick)
      - require:
          condition: _lite_cover_allowed == true
          error: Covering requires this object's active selected Light or Daylight
            source.
      - call: require_srd_pending_window_closed
      - call: lite_exploration_set_srd_illumination_cover_node
        params:
          object_id: '{object_id}'
          covered: '{covered}'
          lasting_state: state
        export_context:
          _source_covered: _source_covered
      - call: finish_srd_shared_action_settlements
        params:
          lasting_state: '{_lasting_state_id}'
          known_spell_effect: '{known_spell_effect}'
        export_context: '*'
      on_false:
      - set:
          field: _lite_cover_allowed
          value: false
      - condition: lasting_state.turn_effects != null
        on_true:
        - set:
            field: _lite_cover_records
            value: lasting_state.turn_effects
        - for_each:
            collection: _lite_cover_records
            as: _lite_cover_record
            do:
            - set:
                field: _lite_cover_allowed
                value: true
              condition: _lite_cover_record.kind == 'illumination_spell' and _lite_cover_record.source
                == object_id and (_lite_cover_record.spell == 'light' or _lite_cover_record.spell
                == 'daylight') and _lite_cover_record.spell in definitions.srd_lite_implemented
                and (_lite_cover_record.expires_tick == null or lasting_state.lasting_tick
                < _lite_cover_record.expires_tick)
      - require:
          condition: _lite_cover_allowed == true
          error: Covering requires this object's active selected Light or Daylight
            source.
      - call: require_srd_pending_window_closed
      - call: set_srd_illumination_cover_node
        params:
          object_id: '{object_id}'
          covered: '{covered}'
          lasting_state: state
        export_context:
          _source_covered: _source_covered
      - call: finish_srd_shared_action_settlements
        params:
          lasting_state: '{_lasting_state_id}'
          known_spell_effect: '{known_spell_effect}'
        export_context: '*'
    - call: refresh_srd_lite_persistent_spell_map
      params:
        lasting_state: '{_lasting_state_id}'
    metadata:
      category: exploration
      result_card:
        version: 1
        footprint: compact
        title: Light source covering
        summary:
        - label: Covered
          value:
            path: context._source_covered
            labels:
              'true': 'Yes'
              'false': 'No'
    parameters:
    - param_object_id_2b5cfd2dd4c129d5
    - param_covered_2430c3920cc80420
    - param_lasting_state_f791c68f01bb49c8
    - param_known_spell_effect_c456f907323fe8b9

  format: 1
  state_namespace: pkg
tools:
  _waits:
    description: Package-owned waits.
    parameters:
    - name: actor
      type: entity_id
      resolve: entity
    - name: tiles
      type: array
      items:
        type: integer
    pre_conditions: []
    effects:
    - set:
        field: _kinds
        value: []
    - for_each:
        collection: tiles
        as: _tile
        do:
        - list_push:
            list: _kinds
            value: definitions.tiles[_tile].kind
    - set:
        field: _waits
        value: completions(_kinds, definitions.patterns, definitions.group_sizes[len(actor.game.melds)],
          indices(34))
    - set:
        field: _pairs
        value: []
    - set:
        field: _singles
        value: []
    - set:
        field: _terminals
        value: []
    - set:
        field: _types
        value: 'a

          '
    - set:
        field: _only_terminals
        value: true
    - for_each:
        collection: _types
        as: _kind
        do:
        - set:
            field: _count
            value: occurrences(_kinds, _kind)
        - condition:
            condition: _count == 2
            on_true:
            - list_push:
                list: _pairs
                value: _kind
            on_false: []
        - condition:
            condition: _count == 1
            on_true:
            - list_push:
                list: _singles
                value: _kind
            on_false: []
        - condition:
            condition: _count > 0
            on_true:
            - condition:
                condition: _kind in definitions.terminals
                on_true:
                - list_push:
                    list: _terminals
                    value: _kind
                on_false:
                - set:
                    field: _only_terminals
                    value: false
            on_false: []
    - condition:
        condition: len(actor.game.melds) == 0
        on_true:
        - condition:
            condition: len(_pairs) == 6 and len(_singles) == 1
            on_true:
            - list_push:
                list: _waits
                value: _singles[0]
            on_false: []
        - condition:
            condition: _only_terminals and len(_terminals) == 13
            on_false: []
            '':
            - set:
                field: _waits
                value: definitions.terminals
        - condition:
            condition: _only_terminals and len(_terminals) == 12 and len(_pairs) ==
              1
            on_true:
            - set:
                field: _missing
                value: without(definitions.terminals, _terminals)
            - list_push:
                list: _waits
                value: _missing[0]
            on_false: []
        on_false: []
    - set:
        field: _all
        value: _kinds
    - set:
        field: _melds
        value: actor.game.melds
    - for_each:
        collection: _melds
        as: _meld
        do:
        - set:
            field: _meld_tiles
            value: _meld.tiles
        - for_each:
            collection: _meld_tiles
            as: _tile
            do:
            - list_push:
                list: _all
                value: definitions.tiles[_tile].kind
    - set:
        field: _filtered
        value: []
    - for_each:
        collection: _waits
        as: _kind
        do:
        - condition:
            condition: occurrences(_all, _kind) < 4 and _kind not in _filtered
            on_true:
            - list_push:
                list: _filtered
                value: _kind
            on_false: []
    - set:
        field: _waits
        value: _filtered
    narrative: {}

    effects:
    - require:
        condition: caster_state.teleport_resolution != null and caster_state.teleport_resolution.paid

    - set:

        type: caster_state.teleport_resolution.reaction_action_id

    - condition: _teleport_parent_id == null
      on_true:
      - require:
          condition: lasting_state.pending_srd_action_stack == null or len(lasting_state.pending_srd_action_stack)
            == 0
          error: Finish the previous pending action before starting Teleport.
      - set:
          field: lasting_state.pending_srd_actions
          value: {}
        condition: lasting_state.pending_srd_actions == null
      - set:
          field: lasting_state.pending_srd_action_stack
          value: []
        condition: lasting_state.pending_srd_action_stack == null
      - set:
          value: lasting_state.pending_srd_action_stack
      - require:
          condition: len(_pending_stack) < 16
          error: Complete an existing reaction window first.
      - set:
          field: lasting_state.pending_srd_action_sequence
          value: 0
        condition: lasting_state.pending_srd_action_sequence == null
      - set:
          field: lasting_state.pending_srd_action_sequence
          value: lasting_state.pending_srd_action_sequence + 1
      - call: record_srd_result_text
        params:

        export_context:

      - set:

          value: _recorded_result_text
      - set:

          value:

            status: '''open'''
            stage: '''reaction'''

            target_state_id: _caster_state_id
            parameters: {}

          field: lasting_state.pending_srd_actions.{_pending_action_id}.turn_actor
          value: null
      - set:
          field: lasting_state.pending_srd_actions.{_pending_action_id}.turn_actor
          value: combat.active_actor
        condition: combat.encounter_active == true
      - list_push:
          list: _pending_stack
          value: _pending_action_id
      - set:
