          value: _pending_stack
      - set:

          value: max(0, abs(_created_attack_origin[1] - _created_attack_target_origin[1])
            - _created_attacker_scene.footprint.half_extents[1] - _info_scene_entity.footprint.half_extents[1])
      - set:
          field: _created_gap_2
          value: max(0, _created_attack_origin[2] - (_created_attack_target_origin[2]
            + _info_scene_entity.height), _created_attack_target_origin[2] - (_created_attack_origin[2]
            + _created_attacker_scene.height))
      - set:
          field: _created_attack_distance
          value: ceil((_created_gap_0 ** 2 + _created_gap_1 ** 2 + _created_gap_2
            ** 2) ** 0.5)
      - set:
          field: _created_attack_eye
          value:
          - _created_attack_origin[0]
          - _created_attack_origin[1]
          - _created_attack_origin[2] + _created_attacker_scene.height * 0.5
      - set:
          field: _ghast_stench_in_area
          value: false
      - condition: _created_attack_distance <= 5
        on_true:
        - set:
            field: _created_attack_targets
            value:
            - _target_state_id
        - call: collect_srd_spell_area_cover_targets
          params:
            source_state: '{_actor_state_id}'
            targets: '{_created_attack_targets}'
            origin: '{_created_attack_eye}'
          export_context:
            _srd_area_targets: _srd_area_targets
        - set:
            field: _ghast_stench_in_area
            value: _target_state_id in _srd_area_targets

      category: internal
      visible_to_player: false

    - param_actor_state_d3c054b169a46c77
    - param_target_state_cb03a83d0b3e524f
  retained_spell_query_resolve_srd_barrier_membership:
    effects:
    - call: retained_spell_query_srd_information_scene_entity
      params:
        subject: '{subject}'
        lasting_state: '{_lasting_state_id}'
      export_context:
        _info_scene_entity: _info_scene_entity
        _info_position: _info_position
    - set:
        field: _membership_subject
        value: _info_scene_entity
    - require:
        condition: _membership_subject.footprint.kind == 'box'
        error: Barrier membership currently requires an admitted box subject.
    - set:
        field: _membership_point
        value: _membership_subject.position
    - set:
        field: _membership_point
        value: position
      condition: position != null
    - call: retained_spell_query_read_srd_barrier_body
      params:
        source_id: '{source_id}'
        lasting_state: '{_lasting_state_id}'
      export_context:
        _barrier_body: _barrier_body
        _barrier_plane: _barrier_plane
        _barrier_radius: _barrier_radius
    - set:
        field: _barrier_inside
        value: false
    - set:
        field: _barrier_overlap
        value: false
    - condition: _membership_subject.metadata.plane == _barrier_plane
      on_true:
      - set:
          field: _membership_axis_0
          value: abs(_membership_point[0] - _barrier_body.position[0])
      - set:
          field: _membership_axis_1
          value: abs(_membership_point[1] - _barrier_body.position[1])
      - set:
          field: _membership_axis_2
          value: abs(_membership_point[2] + _membership_subject.height * 0.5 - _barrier_body.position[2]
            - _barrier_body.height * 0.5)
      - set:
          field: _membership_far_0
          value: max(0, _membership_axis_0 + _membership_subject.footprint.half_extents[0]
            - _barrier_body.footprint.half_extents[0])
      - set:
          field: _membership_far_1
          value: max(0, _membership_axis_1 + _membership_subject.footprint.half_extents[1]
            - _barrier_body.footprint.half_extents[1])
      - set:
          field: _membership_far_2
          value: max(0, _membership_axis_2 + _membership_subject.height * 0.5 - _barrier_body.height
            * 0.5)
      - set:
          field: _membership_near_0
          value: max(0, _membership_axis_0 - _membership_subject.footprint.half_extents[0]
            - _barrier_body.footprint.half_extents[0])
      - set:
          field: _membership_near_1
          value: max(0, _membership_axis_1 - _membership_subject.footprint.half_extents[1]
            - _barrier_body.footprint.half_extents[1])
      - set:
          field: _membership_near_2
          value: max(0, _membership_axis_2 - _membership_subject.height * 0.5 - _barrier_body.height
            * 0.5)
      - set:
          field: _barrier_inside
          value: _membership_far_0 ** 2 + _membership_far_1 ** 2 + _membership_far_2
            ** 2 <= _barrier_radius ** 2
      - set:
          field: _barrier_overlap
          value: _membership_near_0 ** 2 + _membership_near_1 ** 2 + _membership_near_2
            ** 2 <= _barrier_radius ** 2

  format: 1
  state_namespace: pkg
tools:
  qualify_srd_wind_wall_target:
    effects:
    - call: format_srd_information_projection
      params:
        message: '{area_id}'
      export_context:
        _environment_area_key: _info_projection_message
    - set:
        field: _sphere_target_source
        value: lasting_state.persistent_spell_areas[_environment_area_key]
    - set:
        field: _wind_exposure_origin
        value:
        - (_sphere_target_source.volume.min[0] + _sphere_target_source.volume.max[0])
          * 0.5
        - (_sphere_target_source.volume.min[1] + _sphere_target_source.volume.max[1])
          * 0.5
        - (_sphere_target_source.volume.min[2] + _sphere_target_source.volume.max[2])
          * 0.5
    - set:
        field: _sphere_target_inside
        value: false
    - call: qualify_srd_wind_wall_source
      params:
        caster_state: '{_sphere_target_source.caster}'
        area_id: '{_environment_area_key}'
      export_context:
        _sphere_source_current: _sphere_source_current
    - condition: _sphere_source_current == true and target_state.is_alive == true
      on_true:
      - call: srd_information_scene_entity
        params:
          subject: '{_target_state_id}'
        export_context:
          _info_scene_entity: _info_scene_entity
          _info_position: _info_position
      - require:
          condition: _info_scene_entity.footprint.kind == 'box'
          error: Creature-space Sphere membership requires an admitted box footprint.
      - condition: _info_scene_entity.metadata.plane == _sphere_target_source.plane
        on_true:
        - call: resolve_srd_wind_wall_body_segment
          params:
            moving_subject: '{_target_state_id}'
            area_id: '{area_id}'
            start: '{_info_position}'
            end: '{_info_position}'
          export_context:
            _sphere_membership: _body_hit
        - condition: _sphere_membership == true
          on_true:
          - require:
              condition: lasting_state.spatial_scene != null
              error: This operation needs the admitted spatial scene.
          - require:
              condition: lasting_state.spatial_scene.map.grid.unit == 'ft'
              error: SRD scene distances use feet.
          - spatial_query:
              scene: state.spatial_scene
              operation: snapshot
            store_as: _info_snapshot
          - spatial_query:
              scene: state.spatial_scene
              operation: exposure
              snapshot: '{_info_snapshot}'
              query:
                map_id: '{lasting_state.spatial_scene.map.id}'
                observer:
                  point: '{_wind_exposure_origin}'
                target:
                  entity_id: '{_info_scene_entity.id}'
                samples:
                  horizontal: 3
                  vertical: 3
                include:
                - geometry
            store_as: _sphere_target_exposure
          - set:
              field: _sphere_target_inside
              value: _sphere_target_exposure.visible_samples > 0
    metadata:
      category: internal
      visible_to_player: false
    parameters:
    - param_target_state_cb03a83d0b3e524f
    - param_area_id_e089c46d11628c06

    - param_timing_d7665913a6534641

  format: 1
  state_namespace: pkg
tools:
  resolve_srd_scene_fall_event:
    effects:
    - set:
        field: _resolved_fall_event
        value: lasting_state.pending_srd_actions[pending_action_id]
    - require:
        condition: _resolved_fall_event.kind == 'scene_fall' and _resolved_fall_event.status
          == 'open'
        error: Resolve the actual open scene-fall event.
    - set:
        field: _resolve_fall_rows
        value: _resolved_fall_event.parameters.falling_events
    - set:
        field: _scene_fall_summary_rows
        value: []
    - set:
        field: _scene_fall_detail_rows
        value: []
    - for_each:
        collection: _resolve_fall_rows
        as: _resolve_fall_row
        do:
        - call: settle_srd_scene_fall_target
          params:
            target_state: '{_resolve_fall_row.actor_id}'
            resolve_pending: true
            known_spell_effect: '{known_spell_effect}'
          export_context:
            _scene_fall_status: _scene_fall_status
            _fall_effective_damage: _fall_effective_damage
            _scene_fall_actor_name: _scene_fall_actor_name
            _scene_fall_roll: _scene_fall_roll
            _fall_hp_lost: _fall_hp_lost
            _fall_temp_hp_absorbed: _fall_temp_hp_absorbed
            _scene_fall_prone_after: _scene_fall_prone_after
            _scene_fall_fiction_location: _scene_fall_fiction_location
            _scene_fall_remaining_height: _scene_fall_remaining_height
        - call: record_srd_result_text
          params:
            text: '{_scene_fall_actor_name}: {_scene_fall_status}; damage {_fall_effective_damage}.'
          export_context:
            _recorded_result_text: _recorded_result_text
        - list_push:
            list: _scene_fall_summary_rows
            value:
              label: _scene_fall_actor_name
              value: _recorded_result_text
        - list_push:
            list: _scene_fall_detail_rows
            value:
              label: _scene_fall_actor_name
              value: _recorded_result_text
        - condition: _scene_fall_roll != null and len(_scene_fall_roll.results) >
            0
          on_true:
          - call: record_srd_result_text
            params:
              text: Bludgeoning damage dice; applied {_fall_effective_damage} (HP
                {_fall_hp_lost}; temporary HP {_fall_temp_hp_absorbed}).
            export_context:
              _scene_fall_damage_caption: _recorded_result_text
          - list_push:
              list: _scene_fall_detail_rows
              value:
                label: _scene_fall_actor_name
                value: _scene_fall_damage_caption
                equation:
                  die_sides: _scene_fall_roll.sides
                  rolls: _scene_fall_roll.results
                  roll: _scene_fall_roll.total
                  modifier: 0
                  total: _scene_fall_roll.total
        - condition: _resolve_fall_row.mode == 'exploration_steed_loss'
          on_true:
          - condition: _scene_fall_status == 'landed' and _scene_fall_prone_after
              == true
            on_true:
            - list_push:
                list: _scene_fall_summary_rows
                value:
                  label: _scene_fall_actor_name
                  value: '''Prone'''
          - call: record_srd_result_text
            params:
              text: '{_scene_fall_fiction_location}; remaining height {_scene_fall_remaining_height}
                feet.'
            export_context:
              _recorded_result_text: _recorded_result_text
          - list_push:
              list: _scene_fall_detail_rows
              value:
                label: '''Current location'''
                value: _recorded_result_text
    metadata:
      category: internal
      visible_to_player: false
    parameters:
    - param_pending_action_id_fbe040be57330615
    - param_lasting_state_7bff8d20c3cf7d0f

sylvia_gm_runtime:
  format: 1
  state_namespace: pkg
tools:
  apply_srd_minor_world_door:
    effects:
    - call: resolve_srd_object_content_geometry
      params:
        caster_state: '{_caster_state_id}'
        object_id: '{object_id}'
        range_feet: '{range_feet}'
        requires_sight: false
      export_context:
        _object_scene: _object_scene
        _world_distance: _world_distance
        _world_can_see: _world_can_see
    - require:
        condition: _object_scene.metadata.srd_object_access != null
        error: Admit actual access facts.
    - set:
        field: _minor_access
        value: _object_scene.metadata.srd_object_access
    - require:
        condition: len(_minor_access.locks) == 0 and _minor_access.stuck != true and
          _minor_access.barred != true
        error: An actual mundane lock or restriction blocks the door.
    - set:
        field: _minor_lock_active
        value: false
    - set:
        field: _minor_locks
        value: []
    - call: initialize_srd_lite_constants_dc191b8a9362
      export_context: '*'
    - set:
        field: _object_now
        value: lasting_state.lasting_tick
      condition: lasting_state.lasting_tick != null
    - set:
        field: _minor_locks
        value: _object_scene.metadata.srd_arcane_locks
      condition: _object_scene.metadata.srd_arcane_locks != null
    - for_each:
        collection: _minor_locks
        as: _minor_lock
        do:
        - set:
            field: _minor_lock_active
            value: true
          condition: _minor_lock.suppressed_until_tick == null or _minor_lock.suppressed_until_tick
            <= _object_now
    - require:
        condition: _minor_lock_active != true
        error: An actual Arcane Lock blocks this wonder.
    - set:
        field: _minor_access_change
        value:
          closed: operation == 'close'
    - set:
        field: _minor_access
        value: merge(_minor_access, _minor_access_change)
    - set:
        field: _minor_movement
        value: '''blocking'''
    - set:
        field: _minor_visibility
        value: '''opaque'''
    - condition: operation == 'open'
      on_true:
      - set:
          field: _minor_movement
          value: '''passable'''
      - set:
          field: _minor_visibility
          value: '''clear'''
    - require:
        condition: lasting_state.spatial_scene != null
        error: This operation needs the admitted spatial scene.
    - require:
        condition: lasting_state.spatial_scene.map.grid.unit == 'ft'
        error: SRD scene distances use feet.
    - spatial_query:
        scene: state.spatial_scene
        operation: snapshot
      store_as: _info_snapshot
    - set:
        field: _world_changes
        value:
          srd_object_access: _minor_access
    - call: initialize_srd_lite_constants_d63675087646
      export_context: '*'
    - set:
        field: _world_changes
        value: merge(_world_changes, _world_object_marker)
    - set:
        field: _world_metadata
        value: merge(_object_scene.metadata, _world_changes)
    - spatial_mutation:
        scene: state.spatial_scene
        map_id: '{lasting_state.spatial_scene.map.id}'
        expected_revision: '{_info_snapshot.geometry_revision}'
        target:
          kind: entity
          id: '{object_id}'
        patch:
          metadata: '{_world_metadata}'
          movement: '{_minor_movement}'
          visibility: '{_minor_visibility}'
      store_as: _world_mutation
    - call: refresh_srd_spell_triggers
      condition: state.has_spell_triggers == true
    metadata:
      category: internal
      visible_to_player: false
    parameters:
    - param_caster_state_5310b8b23a525eea
    - param_object_id_2b5cfd2dd4c129d5
    - param_operation_803fdf74582d7575
    - param_range_feet_2bdd6047a41c5c5c
    - param_lasting_state_7bff8d20c3cf7d0f
parameter_declarations:
  param_caster_state_5310b8b23a525eea:
    name: caster_state
    resolve: entity
  param_lasting_state_7bff8d20c3cf7d0f:
    name: lasting_state
    required: false
    resolve: entity
    default: state
  param_object_id_2b5cfd2dd4c129d5:
    name: object_id
  param_operation_803fdf74582d7575:
    name: operation
    type: enum
    enum_values:
    - open
    - close
  param_range_feet_2bdd6047a41c5c5c:
    name: range_feet
    type: integer

tools:
  qualify_srd_native_mummy_glare_geometry:
    effects:
    - call: srd_information_scene_entity
      params:
        subject: '{_actor_state_id}'
      export_context:
        _info_scene_entity: _info_scene_entity
        _info_position: _info_position
    - set:
        field: _created_attack_origin
        value: _info_position
    - set:
        field: _created_attacker_scene
        value: _info_scene_entity
    - call: srd_information_scene_entity
      params:
        subject: '{_target_state_id}'
      export_context:
        _info_scene_entity: _info_scene_entity
        _info_position: _info_position
    - set:
        field: _created_attack_target_origin
        value: _info_position
    - require:
        condition: _created_attacker_scene.footprint.kind == 'box' and _info_scene_entity.footprint.kind
          == 'box'
        error: Created actor reach currently requires actual box bodies.
    - require:
        condition: _created_attacker_scene.metadata.plane != null and _created_attacker_scene.metadata.plane
          == _info_scene_entity.metadata.plane
        error: The source attack cannot reach another plane.
    - set:
        field: _created_gap_0
        value: max(0, abs(_created_attack_origin[0] - _created_attack_target_origin[0])
          - _created_attacker_scene.footprint.half_extents[0] - _info_scene_entity.footprint.half_extents[0])
    - set:
        field: _created_gap_1
        value: max(0, abs(_created_attack_origin[1] - _created_attack_target_origin[1])
          - _created_attacker_scene.footprint.half_extents[1] - _info_scene_entity.footprint.half_extents[1])
    - set:
        field: _created_gap_2
        value: max(0, _created_attack_origin[2] - (_created_attack_target_origin[2]
          + _info_scene_entity.height), _created_attack_target_origin[2] - (_created_attack_origin[2]
          + _created_attacker_scene.height))
    - set:
        field: _created_attack_distance
        value: ceil((_created_gap_0 ** 2 + _created_gap_1 ** 2 + _created_gap_2 **
          2) ** 0.5)
    - set:
        field: _created_attack_eye
        value:
        - _created_attack_origin[0]
        - _created_attack_origin[1]
        - _created_attack_origin[2] + _created_attacker_scene.height * 0.5
    - require:
        condition: _created_attack_distance <= 60
        error: Dreadful Glare requires actual range60 feet.
    - call: resolve_srd_scene_relation
      params:
        actor_state: '{_actor_state_id}'
        target_state: '{_target_state_id}'
      export_context:
        _scene_can_see: _scene_can_see
    - require:
        condition: _scene_can_see == true
        error: The actual native Mummy must see this creature.
    metadata:
      category: internal
      visible_to_player: false
    parameters:
    - param_actor_state_d3c054b169a46c77
    - param_target_state_cb03a83d0b3e524f

tools:
  record_srd_teleport_destination:
    description: Record the caster's descriptive familiarity with an actual destination
      anchor.
    effects:
    - call: srd_information_scene_entity
      params:
        subject: '{destination_subject}'
      export_context:
        _info_scene_entity: _info_scene_entity
        _info_position: _info_position
    - set:
        field: _teleport_anchor
        value: _info_scene_entity
    - require:
        condition: _teleport_anchor.metadata.plane != null
        error: The destination anchor needs its actual plane.
    - set:
        field: _teleport_known
        value: []
    - set:
        field: _teleport_known
        value: caster_state.teleport_destinations
      condition: caster_state.teleport_destinations != null
    - set:
        field: _teleport_kept
        value: []
    - for_each:
        collection: _teleport_known
        as: _teleport_known_destination
        do:
        - list_push:
            list: _teleport_kept
            value: _teleport_known_destination
          condition: _teleport_known_destination.anchor != _teleport_anchor.id
    - list_push:
        list: _teleport_kept
        value:
          anchor: _teleport_anchor.id
          position: _teleport_anchor.position
          plane: _teleport_anchor.metadata.plane
          familiarity: familiarity
    - set:
        field: caster_state.teleport_destinations
        value: _teleport_kept
    - set:
        field: _teleport_knowledge
        value: familiarity
    - set:
        field: time_stop_state.time_stop_source.spell_action_active
        value: false
      condition: time_stop_state.time_stop_source != null
    - call: finalize_srd_time_stop

        == true
    metadata:

      result_card:
        version: 1
        footprint: compact
        title: Teleport destination knowledge
        summary:
        - label: Familiarity
          value:
            path: context._teleport_knowledge
    parameters:
    - param_caster_state_5310b8b23a525eea

    - name: familiarity
      type: enum
      enum_values:
      - very_familiar
      - seen_casually
      - viewed_once
      - described
      - false_destination
    - param_time_stop_state_ffde41c75687f2dd
  finish_srd_shared_action_settlements:
    effects:
    - call: settle_srd_travel_exile_returns
      condition: lasting_state.travel_exile_targets != null and len(lasting_state.travel_exile_targets)
        > 0
    - call: settle_srd_levitate_returns

    - call: handoff_srd_telekinesis_releases

    - call: handoff_srd_mirage_support_losses

    - call: resolve_srd_delayed_blast_detonations

    - call: drain_srd_contingency_releases

      params:

    - call: settle_srd_astral_returns

    - call: settle_srd_tsunami_exits_node
      params:
        lasting_state: state
      export_context:
        _tsunami_exit_action_id: _pending_action_id
      condition: lasting_state.has_tsunami_pending_exits == true and (lasting_state.pending_srd_action_stack
        == null or len(lasting_state.pending_srd_action_stack) == 0)
    - call: refresh_srd_lite_retained_area_map

    - call: settle_srd_disappeared_steed_riders

    - call: refresh_srd_lite_persistent_spell_map

        condition: target_state.awakened_source.language not in _awaken_character_languages

        - lasting_state.spatial_scene.map.bounds.min[2]

          map_id: '{lasting_state.spatial_scene.map.id}'
          origin: '{_fall_ray_origin}'
          destination: '{_fall_ray_end}'
          include:
          - geometry
          max_intersections: 1000
      store_as: _fall_ground_ray
    - require:
        condition: _fall_ground_ray.truncated != true
        error: Fall ground support exceeds the admitted ray bound.
    - set:
        field: _fall_hits

    - set:
        field: _fall_geometry
        value: lasting_state.spatial_scene.geometry
    - for_each:
        collection: _fall_hits
        as: _fall_hit

            as: _fall_support
            do:
            - condition: _fall_support.id == _fall_hit.id and _fall_support.active
                == true and _fall_support.movement == 'blocking'
              on_true:
              - condition: _fall_ground_height == null or _fall_hit.point[2] > _fall_ground_height
                on_true:
                - set:
                    field: _fall_ground_height
                    value: _fall_hit.point[2]
                - set:
                    field: _fall_ground_id
                    value: _fall_support.id
          condition: _fall_hit.normal[2] > 0 and _fall_hit.metadata.ground == true
            and _fall_hit.metadata.plane == _info_scene_entity.metadata.plane
    - set:
        field: _support_ground
        value: null
    - for_each:
        collection: _fall_geometry

          plane: _info_scene_entity.metadata.plane
          footprint: _info_scene_entity.footprint

    - set:

        value: null
    - set:

        value: _fall_ground_height

        field: _hand_grip_id

    - set:
        field: _hand_ids

      stat-block source. This adds facts without recreating the creature, changing
      already recorded modifiers, restoring HP or refreshing its Reaction. Use before
      a skill check when an older prepared NPC lacks that skill. Character checks
      derive their own modifiers and cannot use this operation.
    pre_conditions:
    - condition: target_state.creature_kind == 'monster'
      error: Record stat-block skill totals only for an NPC creature.
    effects:
    - set:
        field: target_state.skill_check_modifiers
        value: {}
      condition: target_state.skill_check_modifiers == null
    - set:
        field: _skill_check_names
        value: []
    - for_each:
        collection: skill_checks
        as: _skill_check
        do:
        - require:
            condition: _skill_check.skill not in _skill_check_names
            error: Each prepared skill check must have one authoritative modifier.
        - require:
            condition: _skill_check.skill not in target_state.skill_check_modifiers
              or target_state.skill_check_modifiers[_skill_check.skill] == _skill_check.modifier
            error: An existing stat-block skill modifier cannot be replaced by this
              operation.
        - list_push:
            list: _skill_check_names
            value: _skill_check.skill
          store_as: _skill_check_names
        - set:

            value: _skill_check.modifier

              value: _flame_barrier.metadata.plane

            - call: srd_information_segment_interval

              export_context:

              - set:

    - set:

    - for_each:

    - set:
        field: _symbol_damage_roll

    - set:

          value: _symbol_damage_roll.total
    - for_each:

            three_quarters_cover_targets: '{_srd_area_three_quarters}'
          export_context:

        - for_each:

    - set:

    - set:

    - set:

        value: _info_position
    - set:

        value: _info_scene_entity
    - call: srd_information_barriers
      params:
        start: '{_info_position}'
        end: '{goal}'
        rule: solid
      export_context:
        _information_blocked: _information_blocked
    - condition: _information_blocked != true
      on_true:
      - list_push:
          list: _courier_route
          value: goal
      on_false:
      - set:
          field: _courier_grid
          value: lasting_state.spatial_scene.map.grid
      - set:
          field: _courier_start_cell
          value:
          - floor((_courier_route_origin[0] - _courier_grid.origin[0]) * _courier_grid.cell_size
            ** -1)
          - floor((_courier_route_origin[1] - _courier_grid.origin[1]) * _courier_grid.cell_size
            ** -1)
      - set:
          field: _courier_goal_cell
          value:
          - floor((goal[0] - _courier_grid.origin[0]) * _courier_grid.cell_size **
            -1)
          - floor((goal[1] - _courier_grid.origin[1]) * _courier_grid.cell_size **
            -1)
      - spatial_query:
          scene: state.spatial_scene
          operation: path
          snapshot: '{_info_snapshot}'
          query:
            map_id: '{lasting_state.spatial_scene.map.id}'
            start: '{_courier_start_cell}'
            goal: '{_courier_goal_cell}'
            allow_diagonal: true
            corner_policy: forbid_cutting
            include_entities: true
            moving_entity_id: '{_info_scene_entity.id}'
            max_steps: 10000
        store_as: _courier_path
      - set:
          field: _courier_route_reason
          value: '''blocked'''
      - set:
          field: _courier_route_reason
          value: '''route_search_limit'''
        condition: _courier_path.truncated == true
      - condition: _courier_path.found == true

        - set:
            field: _courier_route_reason
            value: '''calculated_detour'''
        - set:
            field: _courier_cells
            value: _courier_path.cells
        - set:
            field: _courier_cell_index
            value: 0
        - for_each:
            collection: _courier_cells
            as: _courier_cell
            do:
            - condition: _courier_cell_index > 0
              on_true:
              - set:
                  field: _courier_waypoint
                  value:
                  - _courier_grid.origin[0] + (_courier_cell[0] + 0.5) * _courier_grid.cell_size
                  - _courier_grid.origin[1] + (_courier_cell[1] + 0.5) * _courier_grid.cell_size
                  - _courier_route_origin[2]
              - list_push:
                  list: _courier_route
                  value: _courier_waypoint
            - set:
                field: _courier_cell_index
                value: _courier_cell_index + 1
        - list_push:
            list: _courier_route
            value: goal

        export_context:

              <= 25

  state_namespace: pkg
tools:
  retained_spell_query_resolve_srd_magic_zone_membership:
    effects:
    - call: retained_spell_query_srd_information_scene_entity
      params:
        subject: '{subject}'
        lasting_state: '{_lasting_state_id}'
      export_context:
        _info_scene_entity: _info_scene_entity
        _info_position: _info_position
    - set:
        field: _membership_subject
        value: _info_scene_entity
    - require:
        condition: _membership_subject.footprint.kind == 'box'
        error: Barrier membership currently requires an admitted box subject.
    - set:
        field: _membership_point
        value: _membership_subject.position
    - set:
        field: _membership_point
        value: position
      condition: position != null
    - call: retained_spell_query_read_srd_magic_zone_body
      params:
        source_id: '{source_id}'
        lasting_state: '{_lasting_state_id}'
      export_context:
        _magic_zone_body: _magic_zone_body
        _magic_zone_plane: _magic_zone_plane
        _magic_zone_radius: _magic_zone_radius
    - set: '*'
    - set:
        field: _magic_zone_overlap
        value: false
    - condition: _membership_subject.metadata.plane == _magic_zone_plane
      on_true:
      - set:
          field: _membership_axis_0
          value: abs(_membership_point[0] - _magic_zone_body.position[0])
      - set:
          field: _membership_axis_1
          value: abs(_membership_point[1] - _magic_zone_body.position[1])
      - set:
          field: _membership_axis_2
          value: abs(_membership_point[2] + _membership_subject.height * 0.5 - _magic_zone_body.position[2]
            - _magic_zone_body.height * 0.5)
      - set:
          field: _membership_far_0
          value: max(0, _membership_axis_0 + _membership_subject.footprint.half_extents[0]
            - _magic_zone_body.footprint.half_extents[0])
      - set:
          field: _membership_far_1
          value: max(0, _membership_axis_1 + _membership_subject.footprint.half_extents[1]
            - _magic_zone_body.footprint.half_extents[1])
      - set:
          field: _membership_far_2
          value: max(0, _membership_axis_2 + _membership_subject.height * 0.5 - _magic_zone_body.height
            * 0.5)
      - set:
          field: _membership_near_0
          value: max(0, _membership_axis_0 - _membership_subject.footprint.half_extents[0]
            - _magic_zone_body.footprint.half_extents[0])
      - set:
          field: _membership_near_1
          value: max(0, _membership_axis_1 - _membership_subject.footprint.half_extents[1]
            - _magic_zone_body.footprint.half_extents[1])
      - set:
          field: _membership_near_2
          value: max(0, _membership_axis_2 - _membership_subject.height * 0.5 - _magic_zone_body.height
            * 0.5)
      - set:
          field: _magic_zone_inside
          value: _membership_far_0 ** 2 + _membership_far_1 ** 2 + _membership_far_2
            ** 2 <= _magic_zone_radius ** 2
      - set:
          field: _magic_zone_overlap
          value: _membership_near_0 ** 2 + _membership_near_1 ** 2 + _membership_near_2
            ** 2 <= _magic_zone_radius ** 2
    metadata:
      category: internal
      visible_to_player: false
    parameters:
    - param_subject_3f9e3ffc3bfe8ffd
    - param_source_id_da8b650d256d2fc5
    - param_position_d950bc1d28e00ae0
    - param_lasting_state_7bff8d20c3cf7d0f
  reduce_srd_exhaustion:
    description: Remove official Exhaustion levels and clear its condition at level
      0.
    pre_conditions:
    - condition: levels >= 1
      error: At least one Exhaustion level must be removed.
    - condition: target.exhaustion_level >= 1
      error: The target has no Exhaustion to remove.
    effects:
    - set:
        field: target.exhaustion_level
        value: max(0, target.exhaustion_level - levels)
    - remove_condition:
        target: target
        condition: exhaustion
      condition: target.exhaustion_level == 0
    - set:
        field: target.respiration_exhaustion
        value: max(0, target.respiration_exhaustion - levels)
      condition: target.respiration_exhaustion != null
    narrative:
      on_success: The creature loses official Exhaustion levels.
      on_failure: Exhaustion cannot be reduced.
    metadata:
      category: conditions
    parameters:
    - param_target_be55e922774f9bfc

  qualify_srd_environment_sphere_target:
    effects:
    - call: format_srd_information_projection
      params:
        message: '{area_id}'
      export_context:
        _environment_area_key: _info_projection_message
    - set:
        field: _sphere_target_source
        value: lasting_state.persistent_spell_areas[_environment_area_key]
    - set:
        field: _sphere_target_inside
        value: false
    - call: qualify_srd_environment_sphere_source
      params:
        caster_state: '{_sphere_target_source.caster}'
        area_id: '{_environment_area_key}'
      export_context:
        _sphere_source_current: _sphere_source_current
    - condition: _sphere_source_current == true and target_state.is_alive == true
      on_true:
      - call: srd_information_scene_entity
        params:
          subject: '{_target_state_id}'
        export_context:
          _info_scene_entity: _info_scene_entity
          _info_position: _info_position
      - require:
          condition: _info_scene_entity.footprint.kind == 'box'
          error: Creature-space Sphere membership requires an admitted box footprint.
      - condition: _info_scene_entity.metadata.plane == _sphere_target_source.plane
        on_true:
        - set:
            field: _sphere_nearest_body_point
            value:
            - min(max(_sphere_target_source.origin[0], _info_position[0] - _info_scene_entity.footprint.half_extents[0]),
              _info_position[0] + _info_scene_entity.footprint.half_extents[0])
            - min(max(_sphere_target_source.origin[1], _info_position[1] - _info_scene_entity.footprint.half_extents[1]),
              _info_position[1] + _info_scene_entity.footprint.half_extents[1])
            - min(max(_sphere_target_source.origin[2], _info_position[2]), _info_position[2]
              + _info_scene_entity.height)
        - call: measure_srd_information_distance
          params:
            start: '{_sphere_target_source.origin}'
            end: '{_sphere_nearest_body_point}'
          export_context:
            _scene_distance: _scene_distance
        - set:
            field: _sphere_membership
            value: _scene_distance <= _sphere_target_source.radius + 0.000000001
        - call: resolve_srd_environment_cylinder_body_segment
          params:
            moving_subject: '{_target_state_id}'
            area_id: '{area_id}'
            start: '{_info_position}'
            end: '{_info_position}'
          export_context:
            _sphere_membership: _body_hit
          condition: (_sphere_target_source.mode == 'moonbeam' or _sphere_target_source.mode
            == 'sleet')
        - condition: _sphere_membership == true
          on_true:
          - require:
              condition: lasting_state.spatial_scene != null
              error: This operation needs the admitted spatial scene.
          - require:
              condition: lasting_state.spatial_scene.map.grid.unit == 'ft'
              error: SRD scene distances use feet.
          - spatial_query:
              scene: state.spatial_scene
              operation: snapshot
            store_as: _info_snapshot
          - spatial_query:
              scene: state.spatial_scene
              operation: exposure
              snapshot: '{_info_snapshot}'
              query:
                map_id: '{lasting_state.spatial_scene.map.id}'
                observer:
                  point: '{_sphere_target_source.origin}'
                target:
                  entity_id: '{_info_scene_entity.id}'
                samples:
                  horizontal: 3
                  vertical: 3
                include:
                - geometry
            store_as: _sphere_target_exposure
          - set:
              field: _sphere_target_inside
              value: _sphere_target_exposure.visible_samples > 0
    metadata:
      category: internal
      visible_to_player: false
    parameters:
    - param_target_state_cb03a83d0b3e524f
    - param_area_id_e089c46d11628c06
    - param_lasting_state_f791c68f01bb49c8

tools:

    description: Establish this owned active Steed's current fictional proximity for
      one imminent spell healing event. Use current nearest separation, including
      vertical separation, and actual shared-plane knowledge; never reuse birth distance.
      This is a fact declaration, not movement or healing.
    effects:
    - require:
        condition: combat.encounter_active != true
        error: Combat Life Bond uses authoritative saved bodies.
    - require:
        condition: caster_state.created_steed_id == _steed_state_id and steed_state.created_spell_id
          == 'find_steed' and steed_state.created_caster_state_id == _caster_state_id
          and steed_state.created_active == true and steed_state.is_alive == true
        error: Life Bond requires this caster's actual active Otherworldly Steed.
    - require:
        condition: lasting_state.lasting_tick != null and lasting_state.lasting_tick
          >= 0
        error: Use the actual current lasting tick for this healing fact.

          field: lasting_state.exploration_steed_healing_proximity

    - set:
        field: _object_scene
        value: _info_scene_entity
    - require:
        condition: _object_scene.footprint.kind == 'box'
        error: Admit the object's actual bounds before its break.
    - require:
        condition: break_max[0] >= break_min[0]
        error: Break bounds must increase.
    - require:
        condition: break_max[1] >= break_min[1]
        error: Break bounds must increase.
    - require:
        condition: break_max[2] >= break_min[2]
        error: Break bounds must increase.
    - require:
        condition: break_min[0] >= _object_scene.position[0] - _object_scene.footprint.half_extents[0]
          and break_max[0] <= _object_scene.position[0] + _object_scene.footprint.half_extents[0]
        error: The admitted break must lie inside the actual object.
    - require:
        condition: break_min[1] >= _object_scene.position[1] - _object_scene.footprint.half_extents[1]
          and break_max[1] <= _object_scene.position[1] + _object_scene.footprint.half_extents[1]
        error: The admitted break must lie inside the actual object.
    - require:
        condition: break_min[2] >= _object_scene.position[2] and break_max[2] <= _object_scene.position[2]
          + _object_scene.height
        error: The admitted break must lie inside the actual object.
    - set:
        field: _world_breaks
        value: []
    - set:
        field: _world_breaks
        value: _object_scene.metadata.srd_object_breaks
      condition: _object_scene.metadata.srd_object_breaks != null
    - for_each:
        collection: _world_breaks

        target:

        patch:

    - condition: family == 'self_temporary_hit_points' and base_level == 1 and base_dice

    - set:

        value: caster_state.temp_hp
    - dice:
        expression: '{base_dice}{temporary_hit_point_die}'

    - set:
        field: _spell_temporary_hit_point_amount
        value: _spell_temporary_hit_point_roll.total + flat_bonus + (slot_level -
          base_level) * temporary_hit_points_per_slot_level
    - set:
        field: _spell_temporary_hit_point_choice
        value: '''first_grant'''
    - request_choice:
        choice_id: temporary-hit-point-replacement
        prompt: Keep the existing {caster_state.temp_hp} Temporary Hit Points or take
          the rolled {_spell_temporary_hit_point_amount}?
        options:

        - id: take_new
          label: Take new {_spell_temporary_hit_point_amount}

    - set:
        field: caster_state.temp_hp

    - for_each:
        collection: _control_move_ids

        do:
        - set:
            field: _control_move_source
            value: lasting_state.timed_condition_sources[_control_move_id]
        - condition: _control_move_source.suppressed != true and (_control_move_source.condition
            == 'frightened' or _control_move_source.control_profile == 'affinity_sympathy')
          on_true:
          - call: resolve_srd_scene_geometry_relation
            params:
              actor_state: '{_actor_state_id}'
              target_state: '{_control_move_source.caster_state_id}'
            export_context:
              _scene_distance: _scene_distance
              _scene_target_position: _scene_target_position
          - set:
              field: _control_destination_distance
              value: ((destination[0] - _scene_target_position[0]) ** 2 + (destination[1]
                - _scene_target_position[1]) ** 2 + (destination[2] - _scene_target_position[2])
                ** 2) ** 0.5
          - require:
              condition: _control_move_source.condition != 'frightened' or _control_destination_distance
                >= _scene_distance
              error: A Frightened creature cannot willingly move closer to its actual
                fear source.
          - require:

                or _scene_distance > 5 or _control_destination_distance <= _scene_distance
              error: Sympathy prevents willing movement away while within5feet of

    effects:
    - set:

    - call: initialize_srd_lite_constants_87ceaba63be6
      export_context: '*'
    - set:

        value: null
    - set:

    - set:
        field: _reroll_options
        value:
        - id: keep
          label: Keep the failed save
    - list_push:
        list: _reroll_options
        value:
          id: first
          label: Spend 1 Focus to reroll d20 ({_first_die})
    - condition: len(rolls) == 2
      on_true:
      - set:
          field: _second_die
          value: rolls[1]
      - list_push:
          list: _reroll_options
          value:
            id: second
            label: Spend 1 Focus to reroll other d20 ({_second_die})
    - request_choice:
        choice_id: disciplined-survivor
        prompt: '{actor_state.name}: save total {total}, DC {target_number}. Use Disciplined
          Survivor?'
        options: _reroll_options
      store_as: _disciplined_selection
    - condition: _disciplined_selection != 'keep'
      on_true:
      - require:
          condition: actor_state.resources.focus_point >= 1
          error: Disciplined Survivor requires 1 Focus Point.
      - set:
          field: actor_state.resources.focus_point
          value: actor_state.resources.focus_point - 1
      - dice:
          expression: d20
        store_as: _replacement_die
      - set:
          field: _replacement_rolls
          value: []
      - set:
          field: _replacement_total
          value: _replacement_die.total
      - list_push:
          list: _replacement_rolls
          value: _replacement_die.total
      - condition: len(rolls) == 2
        on_true:
        - set:
            field: _retained_die
            value: rolls[1]
        - condition: _disciplined_selection == 'second'
          on_true:
          - set:
              field: _retained_die
              value: rolls[0]
        - list_push:
            list: _replacement_rolls
            value: _retained_die
        - condition: advantage == true and disadvantage == false

          - set:
              field: _replacement_total
              value: max(_replacement_die.total, _retained_die)
          on_false:
          - set:
              field: _replacement_total
              value: min(_replacement_die.total, _retained_die)
      - set:
          field: _disciplined_roll
          value:
            sides: 20
            count: len(rolls)
            results: _replacement_rolls
            total: _replacement_total
            modifier: modifier
      - set:
          field: _disciplined_rerolled
          value: true
      - set:
          field: _disciplined_focus_spent
          value: 1
      - set:
          field: _disciplined_original_total
          value: total

    - call: srd_information_scene_entity
      params:
        subject: '{moving_subject}'
      export_context:
        _info_scene_entity: _info_scene_entity
        _info_position: _info_position

        condition: _info_scene_entity.footprint.kind == 'box'

    - condition: _info_scene_entity.metadata.plane == _tentacle_body_source.plane
        and _info_scene_entity.metadata.flying != true
      on_true:
      - set:
          field: _tentacle_body_volume
          value:
            kind: '''box'''
            min:
            - _tentacle_body_source.volume.min[0] - _info_scene_entity.footprint.half_extents[0]
            - _tentacle_body_source.volume.min[1] - _info_scene_entity.footprint.half_extents[1]
            - _tentacle_body_source.volume.min[2]
            max:
            - _tentacle_body_source.volume.max[0] + _info_scene_entity.footprint.half_extents[0]
            - _tentacle_body_source.volume.max[1] + _info_scene_entity.footprint.half_extents[1]

        export_context:

          _body_entry: _segment_entry
          _body_exit: _segment_exit
      - require:

            and abs(end[2] - _tentacle_body_source.origin[2]) < 0.000000001
          error: Ground square entry currently requires the actual flat source support.
        condition: _body_hit == true

    - require:

        error: Use the source event's printed dice.
    - set:

      - set:
          field: _tsunami_faces
          value: _tsunami_damage.results
      - set:
          field: _tsunami_total
          value: _tsunami_damage.total
    - set:
        field: _tsunami_raw
        value: _tsunami_total
    - condition: count > 0 and caster_state.has_actor_spell_modifiers == true

          value: _ray_raw_damage
    - set:

    - set:

        value: max(0, -_tsunami_raw)
    - set:

    effects:
    - set:

        value: false
    - set:
        field: _divination_rest_epoch
        value: -1
    - set:

        value: caster_state.last_long_rest_tick
      condition: caster_state.last_long_rest_tick != null
    - condition: caster_state.divination_repetition_epoch != _divination_rest_epoch

sylvia_gm_runtime:
  format: 1

tools:
  record_srd_creature_skill_checks:
    description: Record missing NPC skill-check totals from the creature's existing
      stat-block source. This adds facts without recreating the creature, changing
      already recorded modifiers, restoring HP or refreshing its Reaction. Use before
      a skill check when an older prepared NPC lacks that skill. Character checks
      derive their own modifiers and cannot use this operation.
    pre_conditions:
    - condition: target_state.creature_kind == 'monster'
      error: Record stat-block skill totals only for an NPC creature.
    effects:
    - set:
        field: target_state.skill_check_modifiers
        value: {}
      condition: target_state.skill_check_modifiers == null
    - set:
        field: _skill_check_names
        value: []
    - for_each:
        collection: skill_checks
        as: _skill_check
        do:
        - require:
            condition: _skill_check.skill not in _skill_check_names
            error: Each prepared skill check must have one authoritative modifier.
        - require:
            condition: _skill_check.skill not in target_state.skill_check_modifiers
              or target_state.skill_check_modifiers[_skill_check.skill] == _skill_check.modifier
            error: An existing stat-block skill modifier cannot be replaced by this
              operation.
        - list_push:
            list: _skill_check_names
          store_as: _skill_check_names
        - set:
            field: target_state.skill_check_modifiers.{_skill_check.skill}
            value: _skill_check.modifier
    metadata:
      activity_label: Record creature skills
      category: combat
      model_behavior: optional
    parameters:
    - param_target_state_cb03a83d0b3e524f
    - name: skill_checks
      type: array
      max_items: 18
      items:
        type: object
        additionalProperties: false
        required:
        - skill
        - modifier
        properties:
          skill:
            type: string
            enum:
            - acrobatics
            - animal_handling
            - arcana
            - athletics
            - deception
            - history
            - insight
            - intimidation
            - investigation
            - medicine
            - nature
            - perception
            - performance

    effects:
    - set:
        field: _sphere_delta
        value:
        - end[0] - start[0]
        - end[1] - start[1]
        - end[2] - start[2]
    - set:
        field: _sphere_offset
        value:
        - start[0] - origin[0]
        - start[1] - origin[1]
        - start[2] - origin[2]
    - set:
        field: _sphere_a
        value: _sphere_delta[0] ** 2 + _sphere_delta[1] ** 2 + _sphere_delta[2] **
          2
    - set:
        field: _sphere_b
        value: 2 * (_sphere_offset[0] * _sphere_delta[0] + _sphere_offset[1] * _sphere_delta[1]
          + _sphere_offset[2] * _sphere_delta[2])
    - set:
        field: _sphere_c
        value: _sphere_offset[0] ** 2 + _sphere_offset[1] ** 2 + _sphere_offset[2]
          ** 2 - radius ** 2
    - call: initialize_srd_lite_constants_5f62c5a04211
      export_context: '*'

      - set:

      - set:
          field: _sphere_d
          value: _sphere_b ** 2 - 4 * _sphere_a * _sphere_c
      - condition: _sphere_d >= 0
        on_true:
        - set:
            field: _sphere_entry
            value: max(0, (-_sphere_b - _sphere_d ** 0.5) * (2 * _sphere_a) ** -1)
        - set:
            field: _sphere_exit
            value: min(1, (-_sphere_b + _sphere_d ** 0.5) * (2 * _sphere_a) ** -1)
        - set:
            field: _sphere_hit
            value: _sphere_entry <= _sphere_exit

    - call: measure_srd_information_distance
      params:
        start: '{_adoption_caster_position}'
        end: '{point}'
      export_context:
        _scene_distance: _scene_distance
    - require:
        condition: _scene_distance <= 120
        error: The selected spell effect is beyond Dispel range.
    - call: srd_information_barriers
      params:
        start: '{_adoption_caster_position}'
        end: '{point}'
        plane: '{_quake_source.plane}'
        rule: solid
      export_context:
        _information_blocked: _information_blocked
    - require:
        condition: _information_blocked != true
        error: A solid barrier blocks the actual Dispel path.
    - call: resolve_srd_dispel_source_check
      params:
        caster_state: '{_caster_state_id}'
        caster: '{_caster_id}'
        slot_level: '{slot_level}'
        source_level: '{_quake_source.spell_level}'
        casting_modifier: '{casting_modifier}'
        casting_ability: '{casting_ability}'
      export_context:

        _visual_dispel_equation: _visual_dispel_equation
    - set:
        field: _adoption_dispel_check
        value:
          spell: _quake_source.spell
          source_id: source_id

          dc: 10 + _quake_source.spell_level
          feedback: _visual_dispel_description
          equation: null
    - condition: _dispel_roll != null

          field: _adoption_roll_patch
          value:

    - set:

    - set:

    - require:

          phase: '''time'''
          turn: 1000000000

        value: []
    - set:

        value: []

    - for_each:
        collection: destination_subjects
        as: _banishment_subject
        do:
        - call: srd_information_scene_entity
          params:
            subject: '{_banishment_subject}'
          export_context:
            _info_scene_entity: _info_scene_entity
            _info_position: _info_position
        - set:
            field: _banishment_location
            value: _info_scene_entity
        - require:
            condition: _banishment_location.metadata.plane != null and _banishment_location.metadata.plane
              != '' and _banishment_location.active != false
            error: A Banishment destination needs an active admitted location and
              plane.
        - set:
            field: _banishment_plane
            value: _banishment_location.metadata.plane
          condition: _banishment_plane == null
        - require:
            condition: _banishment_location.metadata.plane == _banishment_plane and
              _banishment_location.id not in _banishment_anchor_ids and _banishment_location.position
              not in _banishment_anchor_positions
            error: Register distinct actual locations on the one GM-associated plane.
        - list_push:
            list: _banishment_anchor_ids
            value: _banishment_location.id
        - list_push:
            list: _banishment_anchor_positions
            value: _banishment_location.position
        - list_push:

    - set:
        field: lasting_state.banishment_plane_associations
        value:
          aberration: null
          celestial: null
          elemental: null
          fey: null
          fiend: null
      condition: lasting_state.banishment_plane_associations == null
    - set:
        field: _banishment_record
        value:
          creature_type: creature_type
          plane: _banishment_plane
          anchors: _banishment_anchors
    - set:
        field: lasting_state.banishment_plane_associations.aberration
        value: _banishment_record

    - set:

    - set:

    - require:
        condition: lasting_state.spatial_scene.map.grid.unit == 'ft'

    - spatial_query:
        scene: state.spatial_scene
        operation: snapshot
      store_as: _info_snapshot
    - call: srd_information_scene_entity
      params:
        subject: '{_caster_state_id}'
      export_context:
        _info_scene_entity: _info_scene_entity
        _info_position: _info_position
    - set:
        field: _force_caster_position
        value: _info_position
    - set:
        field: _force_prior_scene
        value: lasting_state.spatial_scene.entities
    - for_each:

        as: _force_prior_entity

        - require:

            error: A spell force needs a unique scene ID.
    - set:
        field: _force_scene_entity
        value:
          id: force_id
          map_id: lasting_state.spatial_scene.map.id
          position: position
          footprint:
            kind: '''circle'''
            radius: 0.01
          height: 0.01
          facing:
          - 1
          - 0
          active: true
          movement: '''passable'''
          visibility: '''clear'''
          metadata:
            source_ref: spell
            source_caster: _caster_state_id
            spell_force: true
            plane: _info_scene_entity.metadata.plane
            lighting: _info_scene_entity.metadata.lighting

    pre_conditions:
    - condition: caster_state.is_alive == true

          - set:
              field: _sense_see_ethereal

          - set:

          - set:

    effects:
    - require:

          lasting_state.solid_spell_wall_sources
        error: Select an actual saved solid spell Wall source.
    - set:
        field: _solid_wall_source
        value: lasting_state.solid_spell_wall_sources[source_id]
    - require:
        condition: (_solid_wall_source.source_sha256 == 'f47aa77fef781cc935dd1f3983da93a43c07d667bd51dfd8b4d874425c50c489'
          and _solid_wall_source.spell_id == 'wall_of_force') or (_solid_wall_source.source_sha256
          == '6ed3739a43979bc4bbb6f0dbe479e81b9e8c9d703d93aea89b5067f4b660dcdc' and
          _solid_wall_source.spell_id == 'wall_of_stone')
        error: Use an actual source-qualified Force or Stone Wall.
    - condition: _solid_wall_source.installed == true and _solid_wall_source.permanent
        != true
      on_true:
      - set:
          field: _solid_wall_scene
          value: lasting_state.spatial_scene.entities
      - set:
          field: _solid_wall_retained_scene
          value: []
      - for_each:
          collection: _solid_wall_scene
          as: _solid_wall_panel
          do:
          - condition: _solid_wall_panel.metadata.solid_wall_source_id == source_id
              and _solid_wall_panel.metadata.solid_wall_serial == _solid_wall_source.serial
            on_true:
            - set:
                field: _solid_wall_panel_end
                value:
                  active: false
            - set:
                field: _solid_wall_panel
                value: merge(_solid_wall_panel, _solid_wall_panel_end)
          - list_push:
              list: _solid_wall_retained_scene
              value: _solid_wall_panel
      - set:
          field: lasting_state.spatial_scene.entities
          value: _solid_wall_retained_scene
      - set:
          field: lasting_state.spatial_scene.map.revision
          value: lasting_state.spatial_scene.map.revision + 1
      - set:
          field: lasting_state.solid_spell_wall_sources.{source_id}.installed
          value: false
      - set:
          field: lasting_state.solid_spell_wall_sources.{source_id}.ended_tick
          value: lasting_state.lasting_tick
      - {}
      - require:
          condition: lasting_state.spatial_scene != null
          error: This operation needs the admitted spatial scene.
      - require:
          condition: lasting_state.spatial_scene.map.grid.unit == 'ft'
          error: SRD scene distances use feet.

        _world_time_map: _world_time_map

        error: Create Undead can be cast only at night.
    metadata:
      category: internal
      visible_to_player: false
    parameters:
    - param_caster_state_5310b8b23a525eea
  end_srd_progressive_turn:
    effects:
    - set:
        field: _progressive_turn_rows
        value: []
    - set:
        field: _progressive_ids
        value: []
    - set:
        field: _progressive_ids
        value: target_state.timed_condition_source_ids
      condition: target_state.timed_condition_source_ids != null
    - for_each:
        collection: _progressive_ids
        as: _progressive_id
        do:
        - set:
            field: _progressive_source
            value: lasting_state.timed_condition_sources[_progressive_id]
        - condition: _progressive_source != null and _progressive_source.installed
            == true
          on_true:
          - condition: target_state.is_alive == true and target_state.turns_started
              != null and _progressive_source.progressive_saved_turn != target_state.turns_started
              and ((_progressive_source.control_profile == 'contagion' and _progressive_source.contagion_locked
              != true) or (_progressive_source.control_profile == 'flesh_stone' and
              _progressive_source.condition == 'restrained'))
            on_true:
            - set:
                field: lasting_state.timed_condition_sources.{_progressive_id}.progressive_saved_turn
                value: target_state.turns_started
            - call: resolve_srd_progressive_save
              params:
                target_state: '{_target_state_id}'
                source_id: '{_progressive_id}'
                lasting_state: '{_lasting_state_id}'
              export_context:
                _progressive_save_roll: _progressive_save_roll
                _progressive_save_outcome: _progressive_save_outcome
                _progressive_save_total: _progressive_save_total
                _progressive_successes: _progressive_successes
                _progressive_failures: _progressive_failures
            - set:
                field: lasting_state.timed_condition_sources.{_progressive_id}.last_repeat_save
                value: _progressive_save_roll
            - set:
                field: lasting_state.timed_condition_sources.{_progressive_id}.last_repeat_outcome
                value: _progressive_save_outcome
            - list_push:
                list: _progressive_turn_rows
                value:
                  label: _progressive_source.spell_id
                  value: '''Save {_progressive_save_outcome}: {_progressive_save_total};
                    successes {_progressive_successes}, failures {_progressive_failures}.'''
            - call: retire_srd_timed_condition_source
              params:
                source_id: '{_progressive_id}'
                lasting_state: '{_lasting_state_id}'
              condition: _progressive_successes >= 3
            - set:
                field: lasting_state.timed_condition_sources.{_progressive_id}.contagion_locked
                value: true
              condition: _progressive_failures >= 3 and _progressive_source.control_profile
                == 'contagion'
            - set:
                field: lasting_state.timed_condition_sources.{_progressive_id}.condition
                value: '''petrified'''
              condition: _progressive_failures >= 3 and _progressive_source.control_profile
                == 'flesh_stone'
    - call: refresh_srd_timed_condition_target
      params:
        target_state: '{_target_state_id}'

      visible_to_player: false

  sync_srd_group_lasting_clock:
    effects:
    - set:
        field: lasting_state.lasting_tick
        value: 0
      condition: lasting_state.lasting_tick == null
    - condition: initialize == true
      on_true:
      - set:
          field: combat.lasting_epoch_tick
          value: lasting_state.lasting_tick
      - set:
          field: combat.lasting_epoch_round
          value: combat.round
    - set:
        field: lasting_state.lasting_tick
        value: combat.lasting_epoch_tick + 2 * (combat.round - combat.lasting_epoch_round)
          + 2 * combat.turn_index * (len(combat.order) ** -1)
    - call: refresh_srd_summon_casters
      params:
        lasting_state: '{_lasting_state_id}'
    - set:
        field: _lasting_tick
        value: lasting_state.lasting_tick
    - condition: lasting_state.revised_tree_stride_caster_ids != null
      on_true:
      - set:
          field: _revised_tree_casters
          value: lasting_state.revised_tree_stride_caster_ids
      - set:
          field: _revised_tree_remaining
          value: []
      - for_each:
          collection: _revised_tree_casters
          as: _revised_tree_caster
          do:
          - call: refresh_revised_srd_tree_stride
            params:
              caster_state: '{_revised_tree_caster}'
              lasting_state: '{_lasting_state_id}'
            export_context:
              _revised_tree_active: _revised_tree_active
          - list_push:
              list: _revised_tree_remaining
              value: _revised_tree_caster
            condition: _revised_tree_active == true
      - set:
          field: lasting_state.revised_tree_stride_caster_ids
          value: _revised_tree_remaining
    - call: refresh_revised_srd_arcane_eye_group_expiry
      params:
        lasting_state: '{_lasting_state_id}'
    metadata:
      category: internal
      _x: false
    pre_conditions:
    - condition: not (time_stop_state.time_stop_source != null and time_stop_state.time_stop_source.active
        == true)
      error: Finish Time Stop turns before ordinary initiative or time advances.
    parameters:
    - param_lasting_state_a0a632fef1e150e2
    - name: initialize
      type: boolean
      required: false
      default: false
    - param_time_stop_state_ffde41c75687f2dd
  recover_srd_ammunition:
    description: Spend one minute after combat recovering half the ammunition expended,
      rounded down.
    pre_conditions:
    - condition: combat.encounter_active == false
      error: Expended ammunition can be recovered only after the fight ends.
    - condition: combat.turn_active != true
      error: Expended ammunition cannot be recovered during an active combat turn.
    - condition: elapsed_minutes >= 1
      error: Recovering ammunition requires at least one minute.
    - condition: actor_state.ammunition != null and actor_state.ammunition_expended
        != null and actor_state.ammunition[ammunition_type] != null and actor_state.ammunition_expended[ammunition_type]
        > 0
      error: The creature has no tracked expended ammunition of this type.
    effects:
    - set:
        field: _ammunition_expended_before
        value: actor_state.ammunition_expended[ammunition_type]
    - set:
        field: _ammunition_before
        value: actor_state.ammunition[ammunition_type]
    - set:
        field: _ammunition_recovered
        value: _ammunition_expended_before // 2
    - increment:
        field: '{_actor_state_id}.ammunition.{ammunition_type}'
        amount: _ammunition_recovered
    - set:
        field: '{_actor_state_id}.ammunition_expended.{ammunition_type}'
        value: 0
    - set:
        field: _ammunition_after
        value: _ammunition_before + _ammunition_recovered
    - log:
        message: The creature spends one minute recovering half its expended ammunition,
          rounded down.
    - set:
        field: time_stop_state.time_stop_source.spell_action_active
        value: false
      condition: time_stop_state.time_stop_source != null
    - call: finalize_srd_time_stop
      condition: time_stop_state.time_stop_source != null and time_stop_state.time_stop_source.ending
        == true
    narrative:
      template: Recovered {_ammunition_recovered} {ammunition_type}; {_ammunition_after}
        now available.
      result_fields:
        ammunition_type: ammunition_type
        expended: _ammunition_expended_before
        recovered: _ammunition_recovered
        available: _ammunition_after
      directives:
      - Recovery takes one minute after the fight and discards the unrecovered remainder.
    metadata:
      category: equipment
      mutates: true
    parameters:
    - param_actor_state_d3c054b169a46c77
    - name: ammunition_type
      type: enum
      enum_values:
      - arrow
      - bolt
      - bullet
      - needle
      - sling_bullet
    - type: integer
      minimum: 1
      name: elapsed_minutes
    - param_time_stop_state_ffde41c75687f2dd

          - condition: target_state.is_alive == true and target_state.turns_started
              != null and _progressive_source.progressive_saved_turn != target_state.turns_started
              and ((_progressive_source.control_profile == 'contagion' and _progressive_source.contagion_locked
              != true) or (_progressive_source.control_profile == 'flesh_stone' and
              _progressive_source.condition == 'restrained'))
            on_true:
            - set:
                field: lasting_state.timed_condition_sources.{_progressive_id}.progressive_saved_turn
                value: target_state.turns_started
            - call: resolve_srd_progressive_save
              params:
                target_state: '{_target_state_id}'
                source_id: '{_progressive_id}'
                lasting_state: '{_lasting_state_id}'
              export_context:
                _progressive_save_roll: _progressive_save_roll
                _progressive_save_outcome: _progressive_save_outcome
                _progressive_save_total: _progressive_save_total
                _progressive_successes: _progressive_successes
                _progressive_failures: _progressive_failures
            - set:
                field: lasting_state.timed_condition_sources.{_progressive_id}.last_repeat_save
                value: _progressive_save_roll
            - set:

                value: _progressive_save_outcome
            - list_push:

                  label: _progressive_source.spell_id
                  value: '''Save {_progressive_save_outcome}: {_progressive_save_total};
                    successes {_progressive_successes}, failures {_progressive_failures}.'''
            - call: retire_srd_timed_condition_source
              params:
                source_id: '{_progressive_id}'

            - set:
                field: lasting_state.timed_condition_sources.{_progressive_id}.contagion_locked

              condition: _progressive_failures >= 3 and _progressive_source.control_profile
                == 'contagion'
            - set:
                field: lasting_state.timed_condition_sources.{_progressive_id}.condition
                value: '''petrified'''
              condition: _progressive_failures >= 3 and _progressive_source.control_profile
                == 'flesh_stone'

sylvia_gm_runtime:
  format: 1
  state_namespace: pkg
tools:
  end_srd_gate_source:
    effects:
    - set:
        field: _gate_sources
        value: []
    - set:
        field: _gate_sources
        value: lasting_state.gate_sources
      condition: lasting_state.gate_sources != null
    - set:
        field: _gate_source
        value: null
    - for_each:
        collection: _gate_sources
        as: _gate_candidate
        do:
        - condition: _gate_candidate.id == source_id
          on_true:
          - - 1
          - set:
              field: _gate_source
              value: _gate_candidate
    - require:
        condition: _gate_source != null and _gate_source.spell == 'gate'
        error: Select one actual retained Gate source.
    - condition: _gate_source.active == true
      on_true:
      - call: retire_srd_gate_portal
        params: state.map
      - call: retire_srd_gate_portal
        params:
          source_id: '{source_id}'
          object_id: '{_gate_source.far_id}'
      - set:
          field: _gate_patch
          value:
            active: false
            ended_tick: lasting_state.lasting_tick
      - set:
          field: _gate_source
          value: merge(_gate_source, _gate_patch)
      - set:
          field: _gate_saved_sources
          value: []
      - for_each:
          collection: _gate_sources
          as: _gate_saved_candidate
          do:
          - set:
              field: _gate_saved_candidate
              value: _gate_source
            condition: _gate_saved_candidate.id == source_id
          - list_push:
              list: _gate_saved_sources
              value: _gate_saved_candidate
      - set:
          field: lasting_state.gate_sources
          value: _gate_saved_sources
    metadata:
      category: internal
      visible_to_player: false
    parameters:
    - param_source_id_da8b650d256d2fc5
    - param_lasting_state_7bff8d20c3cf7d0f

    name: lasting_state
    required: false

    name: source_id

    effects:
    - set:
        field: _environment_entirely_silenced
        value: false
    - set:

        value: 0
    - call: srd_information_scene_entity
      params:
        subject: '{_target_state_id}'
      export_context:
        _info_scene_entity: _info_scene_entity
        _info_position: _info_position
    - set:
        field: _environment_subject
        value: _info_scene_entity
    - set:
        field: _environment_subject_position
        value: _info_position
    - call: initialize_srd_lite_constants_f68db9f9b129
      export_context: '*'
    - set:
        field: _environment_ids
        value: lasting_state.persistent_spell_area_ids
      condition: lasting_state.has_spell_environments == true
    - for_each:
        collection: _environment_ids
        as: _environment_id
        do:
        - set:
            field: _environment_area
            value: lasting_state.persistent_spell_areas[_environment_id]
        - condition: _environment_area.profile == 'environment' and _environment_area.active
            == true and lasting_state.lasting_tick < _environment_area.expires_tick
          on_true:
          - set:
              field: _environment_origin
              value: _environment_area.origin
          - set:
              field: _environment_enabled
              value: true
          - condition: _environment_area.mode == 'silence' and _environment_area.plane
              == _environment_subject.metadata.plane
            on_true:
            - set:
                field: _environment_extent_x
                value: _environment_subject.footprint.radius
            - set:
                field: _environment_extent_y
                value: _environment_subject.footprint.radius
            - condition: _environment_subject.footprint.kind == 'box'
              on_true:
              - set:
                  field: _environment_extent_x
                  value: _environment_subject.footprint.half_extents[0]
              - set:
                  field: _environment_extent_y
                  value: _environment_subject.footprint.half_extents[1]
            - set:
                field: _environment_far_x
                value: abs(_environment_subject_position[0] - _environment_origin[0])
                  + _environment_extent_x
            - set:
                field: _environment_far_y
                value: abs(_environment_subject_position[1] - _environment_origin[1])
                  + _environment_extent_y
            - set:
                field: _environment_far_z
                value: max(abs(_environment_subject_position[2] - _environment_origin[2]),
                  abs(_environment_subject_position[2] + _environment_subject.height
                  - _environment_origin[2]))
            - set:
                field: _environment_horizontal_squared
                value: _environment_far_x ** 2 + _environment_far_y ** 2
            - set:
                field: _environment_horizontal_squared
                value: (((_environment_subject_position[0] - _environment_origin[0])
                  ** 2 + (_environment_subject_position[1] - _environment_origin[1])
                  ** 2) ** 0.5 + _environment_subject.footprint.radius) ** 2
              condition: _environment_subject.footprint.kind == 'circle'
            - condition: _environment_horizontal_squared + _environment_far_z ** 2
                <= _environment_area.radius ** 2
              on_true:
              - set:
                  field: _environment_entirely_silenced
                  value: true
              - set:
                  field: _environment_silence_expires
                  value: max(_environment_silence_expires, _environment_area.expires_tick)
    metadata:
      category: internal
      visible_to_player: false
    parameters:
    - param_target_state_cb03a83d0b3e524f

    parameters:
    - name: actor
      type: entity_id
      resolve: entity
    - name: op
      type: string
    - name: tiles
      type: array
      items:
        type: integer
    - name: base
      type: integer
    pre_conditions: []
    effects:
    - set:
        field: _called
        value: definitions.tiles[state.last_discard.tile].kind
    - set:
        field: _forbidden
        value: one(_called)
    - condition:
        condition: op == 'chi'
        on_true:
        - condition:
            condition: _called == base and base % 9 < 6
            on_true:
            - list_push:
                list: _forbidden
                value: base + 3
            on_false: []
        - condition:
            condition: _called == base + 2 and base % 9 > 0
            on_true:
            - list_push:
                list: _forbidden
                value: base - 1
            on_false: []
        on_false: []
    - set:
        field: _legal_discard
        value: false
    - set:
        field: _remaining
        value: without(actor.game.hand, tiles)
    - for_each:
        collection: _remaining
        as: _tile
        do:
        - condition:
            condition: definitions.tiles[_tile].kind not in _forbidden
            on_true:
            - set:
                field: _legal_discard
                value: true
            on_false: []
    - set:
        field: _option
        value: null
    - condition:
        condition: _legal_discard

        - set:
